window.__traceopsZipReady = null;
window.__traceopsExcelReady = null;
window.__traceopsExcelPreloadDone = false;
window.__traceopsPptxReady = null;

function traceOpsShowError(title, html, background) {
  try {
    var box = document.createElement("div");
    box.style.cssText =
      "position:fixed;top:0;left:0;right:0;background:" + (background || "#C0392B") + ";color:#fff;padding:16px;font-family:monospace;font-size:13px;z-index:99999;word-break:break-all";
    box.innerHTML = "<strong>" + title + "</strong><br>" + html;
    (document.body || document.documentElement).appendChild(box);
  } catch (_) {}
}

function loadExternalScript(src) {
  return new Promise(function(resolve, reject) {
    var existing = document.querySelector('script[data-traceops-src="' + src + '"]');
    if (existing) {
      if (existing.dataset.loaded === "true") {
        resolve();
        return;
      }
      existing.addEventListener("load", function() { resolve(); }, { once: true });
      existing.addEventListener("error", function() {
        reject(new Error("No se pudo cargar el script: " + src));
      }, { once: true });
      return;
    }

    var s = document.createElement("script");
    s.src = src;
    s.crossOrigin = "anonymous";
    s.async = true;
    s.dataset.traceopsSrc = src;
    s.onload = function() {
      s.dataset.loaded = "true";
      resolve();
    };
    s.onerror = function() {
      reject(new Error("No se pudo cargar el script: " + src));
    };
    document.head.appendChild(s);
  });
}

window.ensureZipTools = function() {
  if (window.JSZip) return Promise.resolve();
  if (window.__traceopsZipReady) return window.__traceopsZipReady;

  window.__traceopsZipReady = loadExternalScript(
    "https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/jszip/3.10.1/jszip.min.js"
  ).catch(function(err) {
    window.__traceopsZipReady = null;
    throw err;
  });

  return window.__traceopsZipReady;
};

window.ensureExcelTools = function() {
  if (window.JSZip && window.ExcelJS) return Promise.resolve();
  if (window.__traceopsExcelReady) return window.__traceopsExcelReady;

  window.__traceopsExcelReady = window.ensureZipTools()
    .then(function() {
      if (window.ExcelJS) return;
      return loadExternalScript(
        "https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/exceljs/4.3.0/exceljs.min.js"
      );
    })
    .catch(function(err) {
      window.__traceopsExcelReady = null;
      throw err;
    });

  return window.__traceopsExcelReady;
};

window.preloadExcelTools = function() {
  if (window.__traceopsExcelPreloadDone) return;
  window.__traceopsExcelPreloadDone = true;

  var run = function() {
    window.ensureExcelTools().catch(function(err) {
      console.warn("[TraceOps] Excel libs no cargadas:", err);
    });
  };

  if ("requestIdleCallback" in window) {
    requestIdleCallback(run, { timeout: 4000 });
  } else {
    setTimeout(run, 1500);
  }
};

window.ensurePptxTools = function() {
  if (window.PptxGenJS) return Promise.resolve();
  if (window.__traceopsPptxReady) return window.__traceopsPptxReady;

  window.__traceopsPptxReady = loadExternalScript(
    "https://unpkg.com/pptxgenjs@3.12.0/dist/pptxgen.bundle.js"
  ).catch(function(err) {
    window.__traceopsPptxReady = null;
    throw err;
  });

  return window.__traceopsPptxReady;
};

window.__traceopsPdfReady = null;
window.ensurePdfTools = function() {
  if (window.pdfjsLib) {
    try { window.pdfjsLib.GlobalWorkerOptions.workerSrc = "https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/pdf.js/3.11.174/pdf.worker.min.js"; } catch (_) {}
    return Promise.resolve();
  }
  if (window.__traceopsPdfReady) return window.__traceopsPdfReady;
  window.__traceopsPdfReady = loadExternalScript("https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/pdf.js/3.11.174/pdf.min.js").then(function() {
    if (!window.pdfjsLib) throw new Error("PDF.js no inicializó correctamente");
    window.pdfjsLib.GlobalWorkerOptions.workerSrc = "https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/pdf.js/3.11.174/pdf.worker.min.js";
  }).catch(function(err) { window.__traceopsPdfReady = null; throw err; });
  return window.__traceopsPdfReady;
};

function traceOpsShouldSuppressGlobalScriptError(msg, src, line, col, err) {
  var m = String(msg || '').trim();
  var s = String(src || '').trim();
  var ln = Number(line || 0);
  var cl = Number(col || 0);
  var hasStack = !!(err && err.stack);
  if ((m === 'Script error.' || m === 'Script error') && !s && ln === 0 && cl === 0 && !hasStack) {
    return true;
  }
  return false;
}

window.onerror = function(msg, src, line, col, err) {
  if (traceOpsShouldSuppressGlobalScriptError(msg, src, line, col, err)) {
    try { console.warn('[TraceOps] Suppressed generic iOS script error', { msg: msg, src: src, line: line, col: col }); } catch (_) {}
    return true;
  }
  var parts = [];
  parts.push(String(msg || "Script error."));
  if (src) parts.push(src);
  parts.push("Line: " + (line || 0) + " Col: " + (col || 0));
  if (err && err.stack) parts.push(err.stack);
  else if (err) parts.push(String(err));
  traceOpsShowError("ERROR", parts.join("<br>"), "#C0392B");
  return false;
};

window.addEventListener("error", function(ev) {
  try {
    var target = ev && ev.target;
    if (target && target.tagName === "SCRIPT") {
      traceOpsShowError(
        "SCRIPT LOAD ERROR",
        (target.src || "Script sin src") + "<br>Revisa CDN / CORS / Safari",
        "#7F1D1D"
      );
    }
  } catch (_) {}
}, true);


window.__TRACEOPS_BOOT_OK__ = true;
window.addEventListener("unhandledrejection", function(ev) {
  try {
    var reason = ev && ev.reason ? (ev.reason.stack || ev.reason.message || String(ev.reason)) : "Unhandled promise rejection";
    traceOpsShowError("PROMISE ERROR", reason, "#7F1D1D");
  } catch (_) {}
});

<script crossorigin="anonymous" src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@supabase/supabase-js@2"></script>
<script>
window.TRACEOPS_SUPABASE = window.TRACEOPS_SUPABASE || {
  url: "",
  anonKey: "",
  enabled: false
};

if (typeof window !== "undefined" && !window.global) { window.global = window; }

function traceOpsNormalizeCloudError(err) {
  var raw = err && err.message ? String(err.message) : String(err || "");
  var low = raw.toLowerCase();
  if (low.indexOf("load failed") >= 0 || low.indexOf("failed to fetch") >= 0 || low.indexOf("networkerror") >= 0) {
    var e = new Error("No se pudo conectar con Supabase desde este navegador. Se mantiene modo local.");
    e.isNetworkFallback = true;
    e.originalMessage = raw;
    return e;
  }
  if (low.indexOf('another request stole it') >= 0 || low.indexOf('auth-token') >= 0 && low.indexOf('lock') >= 0) {
    var e2 = new Error("La sesión en nube está ocupada por otra operación. Reintentando sin bloquear la app.");
    e2.isTransientAuthLock = true;
    e2.originalMessage = raw;
    return e2;
  }
  return err instanceof Error ? err : new Error(raw || "Error de nube");
}

window.TraceOpsCloud = (function(){
  var __traceops_user_cache = null;
  var __traceops_user_loading = null;
  function cfg(){
    var raw = window.TRACEOPS_SUPABASE || {};
    return {
      url: (raw.url || "").trim(),
      anonKey: (raw.anonKey || "").trim(),
      enabled: !!raw.enabled
    };
  }

  function isConfigured(){
    var c = cfg();
    return c.enabled && c.url && c.anonKey && window.supabase && typeof window.supabase.createClient === "function";
  }

  function getClient(){
    try {
      if (!window.supabase || typeof window.supabase.createClient !== "function") {
        console.warn("[TraceOps] Supabase library not available");
        return null;
      }
      var c = cfg();
      if (!c.enabled || !c.url || !c.anonKey) {
        console.warn("[TraceOps] Supabase config missing or disabled");
        return null;
      }
      if (!window.__traceopsSupabaseClient) {
        window.__traceopsSupabaseClient = window.supabase.createClient(c.url, c.anonKey, {
          auth: {
            persistSession: true,
            autoRefreshToken: true,
            detectSessionInUrl: true
          },
          global: {
            fetch: function(url, options) {
              return fetch(url, options).catch(function(err){
                throw traceOpsNormalizeCloudError(err);
              });
            }
          }
        });
      }
      return window.__traceopsSupabaseClient;
    } catch (err) {
      console.error("[TraceOps] Supabase init failed:", err);
      return null;
    }
  }

  async function getUser(){
    var client = getClient();
    if (!client) return null;
    if (__traceops_user_cache) return __traceops_user_cache;
    if (__traceops_user_loading) return __traceops_user_loading;
    __traceops_user_loading = (async function(){
      try {
        var out = await client.auth.getUser();
        __traceops_user_cache = out && out.data ? (out.data.user || null) : null;
        return __traceops_user_cache;
      } catch (err) {
        throw traceOpsNormalizeCloudError(err);
      } finally {
        __traceops_user_loading = null;
      }
    })();
    return __traceops_user_loading;
  }

async function initApp(){
  var client = getClient();
  if (!client) return;

  const { data } = await client.auth.getSession();

  if (data && data.session) {
    if(window.__TRACEOPS_DEV__){console.log("[TraceOps] Sesión activa detectada");}

    // 🔥 AUTO LOAD
    await loadRccasFromCloud();
  }
}
async function loadRccasFromCloud(){
  var client = getClient();
  var user = await getUser();
  if (!client || !user) {
    console.warn("No hay cliente Supabase o sesion activa");
    return [];
  }

  const { data, error } = await client
    .from('traceops_rcca_cases')
    .select('rcca_id,payload,updated_at')
    .eq('user_id', user.id)
    .order('updated_at', { ascending: false });

  if (error) {
    console.error("Error cargando RCCA:", error);
    return [];
  }

  if(window.__TRACEOPS_DEV__){console.log("[TraceOps] RCCA desde nube:", data);}

  const rccas = (data || []).map(function(row){ return row.payload; }).filter(Boolean);
  try {
    var localRccas = [];
    try { localRccas = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem("traceops_rcca_cases") || "[]") || []; } catch(_) {}
    var mergedById = {};
    if (Array.isArray(localRccas)) {
      localRccas.forEach(function(item){
        if (item && item.rcca_id) mergedById[item.rcca_id] = traceOpsMergeRccaPayload(mergedById[item.rcca_id], item);
      });
    }
    rccas.forEach(function(item){
      if (item && item.rcca_id) mergedById[item.rcca_id] = traceOpsMergeRccaPayload(mergedById[item.rcca_id], item);
    });
    var mergedList = Object.keys(mergedById).map(function(k){ return mergedById[k]; });
    localStorage.setItem("traceops_rcca_cases", JSON.stringify(mergedList));
    window.__traceops_cloud_rccas = mergedList;
    if (typeof renderInvestigationCarousel === "function") {
      renderInvestigationCarousel(mergedList);
    }
    return mergedList;
  } catch(_) {}

  if(window.__TRACEOPS_DEV__){console.log("[TraceOps] RCCA normalizados:", rccas);}

  localStorage.setItem("traceops_rcca_cases", JSON.stringify(rccas));
  window.__traceops_cloud_rccas = rccas;
  if (typeof renderInvestigationCarousel === "function") {
    renderInvestigationCarousel(rccas);
  }
  return rccas;
} 
async function signIn(email, password){
    var client = getClient();
    if (!client) throw new Error("Supabase no configurado.");
    var out = await client.auth.signInWithPassword({ email: email, password: password });
    if (out.error) throw traceOpsNormalizeCloudError(out.error);
    __traceops_user_cache = out && out.data && out.data.user ? out.data.user : null;
    __traceops_user_loading = null;
    return out.data;
  }

async function signUp(email, password){
    var client = getClient();
    if (!client) throw new Error("Supabase no configurado.");
    var out = await client.auth.signUp({ email: email, password: password });
    if (out.error) throw traceOpsNormalizeCloudError(out.error);
    __traceops_user_cache = out && out.data && out.data.user ? out.data.user : null;
    __traceops_user_loading = null;
    return out.data;
  }

  async function signOut(){
    var client = getClient();
    if (!client) return;
    var out = await client.auth.signOut();
    if (out.error) throw traceOpsNormalizeCloudError(out.error);
    __traceops_user_cache = null;
    __traceops_user_loading = null;
  }

  function onAuthChange(handler){
    var client = getClient();
    if (!client) return { data: { subscription: { unsubscribe: function(){} } } };
    return client.auth.onAuthStateChange(function(evt, session){
      __traceops_user_cache = session && session.user ? session.user : null;
      __traceops_user_loading = null;
      handler(evt, session && session.user ? session.user : null, session);
    });
  }

  function subscribeRccaRealtime(userId, handler, onStatus){
    var client = getClient();
    var normalizedUserId = String(userId || '').trim();
    if (!client || !normalizedUserId || !handler) {
      try { if (onStatus) onStatus('CLOSED'); } catch(_) {}
      return { unsubscribe: function(){} };
    }
    try {
      var channelName = 'traceops-rcca-' + normalizedUserId.replace(/[^a-zA-Z0-9_-]/g, '_');
      var realtimeFilter = 'user_id=eq.' + normalizedUserId;
      try {
        if (window.__TRACEOPS_DEV__) console.log('[TraceOps] RCCA realtime filter:', realtimeFilter);
      } catch(_) {}
      var channel = client.channel(channelName);
      channel.on('postgres_changes', {
        event: '*',
        schema: 'public',
        table: 'traceops_rcca_cases',
        filter: realtimeFilter
      }, function(payload){
        try { handler(payload || null); } catch(_) {}
      });
      channel.subscribe(function(status){
        try {
          if (window.__TRACEOPS_DEV__) console.log('[TraceOps] RCCA realtime status:', status, 'user_id:', normalizedUserId);
        } catch(_) {}
        try { if (onStatus) onStatus(status || 'UNKNOWN'); } catch(_) {}
      });
      return {
        unsubscribe: function(){
          try { if (onStatus) onStatus('CLOSED'); } catch(_) {}
          try { client.removeChannel(channel); } catch(_) {}
        }
      };
    } catch (err) {
      console.warn('[TraceOps] Realtime RCCA unavailable:', err);
      try { if (onStatus) onStatus('CHANNEL_ERROR'); } catch(_) {}
      return { unsubscribe: function(){} };
    }
  }

  async function listRcca(){
    var client = getClient();
    var user = await getUser();
    if (!client || !user) return [];
    var q = await client
      .from("traceops_rcca_cases")
      .select("rcca_id,payload,updated_at")
      .eq("user_id", user.id)
      .order("updated_at", { ascending: false });
    if (q.error) throw traceOpsNormalizeCloudError(q.error);
    return (q.data || []).map(function(row){
      var payload = row.payload || {};
      payload.rcca_id = payload.rcca_id || row.rcca_id;
      payload._cloud_updated_at = row.updated_at || null;
      return payload;
    });
  }

  async function upsertRcca(rcca){
    var client = getClient();
    var user = await getUser();
    if (!client || !user) throw new Error("Sesion no disponible.");
    var row = {
      user_id: user.id,
      rcca_id: rcca.rcca_id,
      payload: Object.assign({}, rcca, {
        updated_at: new Date().toISOString(),
        source: rcca.source || "manual"
      }),
      updated_at: new Date().toISOString()
    };
    var q = await client.from("traceops_rcca_cases").upsert(row, { onConflict: "user_id,rcca_id" }).select("updated_at").single();
    if (q.error) throw traceOpsNormalizeCloudError(q.error);
    return q.data;
  }

  async function removeRcca(rccaId){
    var client = getClient();
    var user = await getUser();
    if (!client || !user) throw new Error("Sesion no disponible.");
    var q = await client.from("traceops_rcca_cases").delete().eq("user_id", user.id).eq("rcca_id", rccaId);
    if (q.error) throw traceOpsNormalizeCloudError(q.error);
  }

  return {
    cfg: cfg,
    isConfigured: isConfigured,
    getClient: getClient,
    getUser: getUser,
    signIn: signIn,
    signUp: signUp,
    signOut: signOut,
    onAuthChange: onAuthChange,
    subscribeRccaRealtime: subscribeRccaRealtime,
    listRcca: listRcca,
    upsertRcca: upsertRcca,
    removeRcca: removeRcca
  };
})();
</script>

<script>



function isMobile(){
  try { return (window.innerWidth || 0) <= 900; } catch(_) { return false; }
}

function traceOpsPptShapeRectSafeLocal() {
  try {
    if (window.PptxGenJS && window.PptxGenJS.ShapeType) {
      return window.PptxGenJS.ShapeType.rect;
    }
  } catch (_) {}
  return 'rect';
}

function traceOpsPptExecutiveStatusToneLocal(statusText) {
  var s = String(statusText || '').toLowerCase();
  if (/closed|complete|validated|complete/.test(s)) return { fill: 'EAF7EE', text: '1B5E20', line: 'B7DEC2' };
  if (/under validation|draft|pending|open|risk|partial/.test(s)) return { fill: 'FFF4E5', text: '9A6700', line: 'F3D19C' };
  return { fill: 'EEF5FF', text: '1F3A5F', line: 'C9DAF5' };
}

function traceOpsPptExecutiveSummaryLocal(d) {
  var model = d.model || d.product || 'N/D';
  var station = d.station || 'N/D';
  var defect = d.defect || d.failureMode || d.problem || 'issue';
  var occ = d.occurrenceConclusion || d.occurrence || '';
  var esc = d.escapeConclusion || d.escape || '';
  var base = d.complaintAnchor || d.description || d.problemDescription || '';
  base = String(base || '').replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim();
  if (!base) {
    base = 'Issue identified on model ' + model + ' at station ' + station + ' involving ' + defect + '.';
  }
  if (base.length > 185) base = base.slice(0, 182) + '...';

  var lines = [base];

  var statusLine = '';
  if (occ) {
    var occTxt = String(occ).replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim();
    if (occTxt.length > 95) occTxt = occTxt.slice(0, 92) + '...';
    statusLine += 'Occurrence: ' + occTxt;
  }
  if (esc) {
    var escTxt = String(esc).replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim();
    if (escTxt.length > 95) escTxt = escTxt.slice(0, 92) + '...';
    statusLine += (statusLine ? ' ' : '') + 'Escape: ' + escTxt;
  } else {
    statusLine += (statusLine ? ' ' : '') + 'Control path remains under validation.';
  }
  if (statusLine) lines.push(statusLine);

  return lines.join('\n\n');
}

function traceOpsPptExecutiveRiskLinesLocal(d) {
  var arr = [];
  var exposure = String(d.exposureWindow || '').replace(/^Exposure window:\s*/i, '').trim();
  var impact = String(d.estimatedImpact || '').replace(/^Estimated impact:\s*/i, '').trim();

  if (exposure) arr.push('Exposure window: ' + exposure);
  if (impact) arr.push('Estimated impact: ' + impact);
  arr.push('Primary risk: ' + (d.defect || d.failureMode || d.problem || 'Issue under review') + ' @ ' + (d.station || 'To be confirmed'));
  return arr.join('\n');
}

function traceOpsPptExecutiveRootCauseLinesLocal(d) {
  var occ = d.occurrenceConclusion || d.occurrence || d.probableCause || 'Under validation';
  var esc = d.escapeConclusion || d.escape || d.controlGap || 'Under validation';
  var status = d.reportStatus || d.status || 'Draft';
  occ = String(occ).replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim();
  esc = String(esc).replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim();
  if (occ.length > 110) occ = occ.slice(0, 107) + '...';
  if (esc.length > 110) esc = esc.slice(0, 107) + '...';
  return 'Occurrence: ' + occ + '\n' +
         'Escape: ' + esc + '\n' +
         'Status: ' + status;
}

function traceOpsPptExecutiveBulletLinesLocal(items, fallback) {
  var arr = Array.isArray(items) ? items.slice(0, 3) : [];
  arr = arr.filter(Boolean).map(function(x){
    return '• ' + String(x).replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim();
  });
  if (!arr.length) arr = ['• ' + (fallback || 'Pending validation')];
  return arr.join('\n');
}

function traceOpsPptExecutiveFocusLinesLocal(d) {
  var arr = [];
  if (d.traceabilityPartial) arr.push('Complete traceability fields to strengthen Appendix evidence.');
  if (d.pendingValidations && Number(d.pendingValidations) > 0) arr.push('Close remaining validation items before status upgrade.');
  if (d.openItems && Number(d.openItems) > 0) arr.push('Maintain follow-up on open items until recurrence risk is reduced.');
  if (!arr.length) arr.push('Validate closure path and maintain recurrence monitoring.');
  return traceOpsPptExecutiveBulletLinesLocal(arr, 'Monitor recurrence and keep closure evidence current.');
}

function buildExecutiveDashboardPptModelLocal(src) {
  var obj = src || {};
  var qd = obj.qualityDashboard || obj.dashboard || {};
  var k = qd.kpis || {};
  var hdr = qd.header || {};
  var read = qd.readiness || {};
  var risk = qd.risk || {};
  var defect = hdr.primaryIssue || obj.defect || obj.failureMode || obj.problem || 'Issue under review';
  var actionsList = [];
  if (Array.isArray(obj.actionsList)) actionsList = obj.actionsList.slice(0,3);
  if (!actionsList.length && Array.isArray(obj.actions)) {
    actionsList = obj.actions.map(function(a){ return (a && (a.action || a.title || a.name)) || ''; }).filter(Boolean).slice(0,3);
  }
  if (!actionsList.length && obj.d5ActionsText) {
    actionsList = String(obj.d5ActionsText).split(/\n+/).filter(Boolean).slice(0,3);
  }
  var readinessFn = (typeof window !== 'undefined' && typeof window.traceOpsComputeEightdReadiness === 'function') ? window.traceOpsComputeEightdReadiness : null;
  var maturity = readinessFn ? readinessFn(obj) : { overallScore: 0, evidenceScore: 0, stage: (obj.reportStatus || obj.status || 'Draft') };
  return {
    title: obj.title || obj.caseTitle || defect,
    model: obj.model || obj.product || hdr.model || obj.modelo || 'To be confirmed',
    line: hdr.line || obj.line || obj.linea || 'To be confirmed',
    station: hdr.station || obj.station || obj.estacion_dominante || 'To be confirmed',
    window: hdr.window || obj.window || obj.detectionWindow || obj.fecha || 'To be confirmed',
    openItems: (obj.pendingValidations != null ? obj.pendingValidations : (read.pendingValidations != null ? read.pendingValidations : (k.openItems != null ? k.openItems : (obj.openItems != null ? obj.openItems : 0)))),
    readiness8d: String(maturity.overallScore) + '%',
    evidenceBadge: maturity.evidenceScore >= 85 ? 'Complete' : (maturity.evidenceScore >= 60 ? 'Partial' : 'Weak'),
    reportStatus: obj.reportStatus || obj.status || read.currentStatus || maturity.stage || 'Draft',
    complaintAnchor: obj.complaintAnchor || obj.description || obj.problemDescription || obj.d2_problem || '',
    occurrenceConclusion: obj.occurrenceConclusion || obj.d4_root_cause || '',
    escapeConclusion: obj.escapeConclusion || obj.d4_escape_point || '',
    exposureWindow: obj.exposureWindow || obj.detectionWindow || obj.window || obj.fecha || '',
    estimatedImpact: obj.estimatedImpact || obj.impact || obj.exposureImpact || '',
    defect: defect,
    traceabilityPartial: maturity.evidence.traceabilityCoverage < 60,
    pendingValidations: read.pendingValidations || obj.pendingValidations || 0,
    closureEligibility: read.closureEligibility || obj.closureEligibility || (maturity.canPromote ? 'Ready for review' : 'Pending'),
    statusBanner: /closed|complete/i.test(obj.reportStatus || '') ? 'CLOSED' : (maturity.canPromote ? 'READY FOR REVIEW' : 'UNDER VALIDATION'),
    riskBanner: (Number(risk.high || 0) > 0 ? 'HIGH' : (Number(risk.medium || 0) > 0 ? 'MEDIUM' : 'LOW')) + ' – ' + (maturity.canPromote ? 'CONTROLLED' : 'EVIDENCE / CONTROL GAP OPEN'),
    actionsList: actionsList
  };
}


function parseTurno(h, min, dateIso) {
  var m = parseInt(min) || 0;
  var dow = 1;
  if (dateIso) {
    var parts = dateIso.split("-");
    var d = new Date(parseInt(parts[0]), parseInt(parts[1])-1, parseInt(parts[2]));
    dow = d.getDay();
  }
  if (dow === 6) {
    if (h >= 0 && h < 9) return "3T";
    if (h >= 9 && h < 18) return "1T-Sab";
    return "2T-Sab";
  }
  if (dow === 0) {
    if (h >= 6 && h < 18) return "1T-Dom";
    return "2T-Dom";
  }
  if (h >= 0 && h < 6) return "3T";
  if (h < 15 || (h === 15 && m < 15)) return "1T";
  return "2T";
}

function traceOpsNormalizeUnicodeFilenameLocal(name) {
  try {
    return String(name || '').normalize('NFC');
  } catch (_) {
    return String(name || '');
  }
}

function traceOpsNormalizeWhatsAppLineLocal(raw) {
  return String(raw || '')
    .replace(/[\u00a0\u200e\u200f\u202a-\u202f\u2066-\u2069]/g, ' ')
    .replace(/\s+/g, ' ')
    .trim();
}

function traceOpsIsWhatsAppSystemLineLocal(line) {
  var s = traceOpsNormalizeWhatsAppLineLocal(line);
  if (!s) return false;
  var bracketUser = /^\[\d{1,2}\/\d{1,2}\/\d{2,4},\s*\d{1,2}:\d{2}(?::\d{2})?\s*(?:a\.?m\.?|p\.?m\.?)?\]\s*[^:]+?:\s*/i;
  var dashUser = /^\d{1,2}\/\d{1,2}\/\d{2,4},\s*\d{1,2}:\d{2}(?::\d{2})?\s*(?:a\.?m\.?|p\.?m\.?)?\s*-\s*[^:]+?:\s*/i;
  if (bracketUser.test(s) || dashUser.test(s)) return false;
  var tsOnly = /^(?:\[)?\d{1,2}\/\d{1,2}\/\d{2,4},\s*\d{1,2}:\d{2}(?::\d{2})?\s*(?:a\.?m\.?|p\.?m\.?)?(?:\])?\s*-\s*/i;
  return tsOnly.test(s);
}

function parseWhatsApp(txt) {
  var lines = txt.split(/\r?\n/);
  var msgs = [];
  var dateOrder = inferWhatsAppDateOrder(txt);
  var reA = /^\[(\d{1,2})\/(\d{1,2})\/(\d{2,4}),\s*(\d{1,2}):(\d{2})(?::(\d{2}))?\s*(a\.?m\.?|p\.?m\.?)?\]\s*([^:]+?):\s*(.*)$/i;
  var reB = /^(\d{1,2})\/(\d{1,2})\/(\d{2,4}),\s*(\d{1,2}):(\d{2})(?::(\d{2}))?\s*(a\.?m\.?|p\.?m\.?)?\s*-\s*([^:]+?):\s*(.*)$/i;
  var cur = null;
  for (var i = 0; i < lines.length; i++) {
    var line = traceOpsNormalizeWhatsAppLineLocal(lines[i]);
    var matchA = line.match(reA);
    var matchB = matchA ? null : line.match(reB);
    var m = matchA || matchB;
    if (m) {
      if (cur) msgs.push(cur);
      var d, mo, yr, h2, min, sec, mer, sender, text;
      if (matchA) {
        d = m[1]; mo = m[2]; yr = m[3]; h2 = m[4]; min = m[5]; sec = m[6] || '00'; mer = m[7] || ''; sender = m[8]; text = m[9];
      } else {
        d = m[1]; mo = m[2]; yr = m[3]; h2 = m[4]; min = m[5]; sec = m[6] || '00'; mer = m[7] || ''; sender = m[8]; text = m[9];
      }
      var resolved = resolveWhatsAppDatePartsLocal(d, mo, dateOrder);
      var year = parseInt(yr, 10);
      if (year < 100) year += 2000;
      var t = to24h(h2, min, sec, mer);
      var dateIso = year + '-' + String(resolved.month).padStart(2, '0') + '-' + String(resolved.day).padStart(2, '0');
      cur = {
        dateIso: dateIso,
        dateDisp: String(resolved.day).padStart(2, '0') + '/' + String(resolved.month).padStart(2, '0') + '/' + year,
        timeStr: t.timeStr,
        hour: t.hour,
        turno: parseTurno(t.hour, min, dateIso),
        sender: String(sender || '').replace(/^~/, '').trim(),
        text: String(text || '').trim()
      };
    } else if (traceOpsIsWhatsAppSystemLineLocal(line)) {
      continue;
    } else if (cur && line && !line.startsWith('[')) {
      cur.text += ' ' + line;
    }
  }
  if (cur) msgs.push(cur);
  return msgs;
}

function filterByDays(msgs, days) {
  if (!msgs.length) return msgs;
  var sorted = msgs.slice().sort(function(a,b){ return a.dateIso.localeCompare(b.dateIso); });
  var last = new Date(sorted[sorted.length-1].dateIso);
  var cutoff = new Date(last);
  cutoff.setDate(cutoff.getDate() - days + 1);
  var cutStr = cutoff.toISOString().slice(0,10);
  return sorted.filter(function(m){ return m.dateIso >= cutStr; });
}

function getISOWeek(d) {
  var date = new Date(Date.UTC(d.getFullYear(), d.getMonth(), d.getDate()));
  var day = date.getUTCDay() || 7;
  date.setUTCDate(date.getUTCDate() + 4 - day);
  var yearStart = new Date(Date.UTC(date.getUTCFullYear(), 0, 1));
  return Math.ceil((((date - yearStart) / 86400000) + 1) / 7);
}

function getWeekRange(weekN, year) {
  var jan4 = new Date(Date.UTC(year, 0, 4));
  var day = jan4.getUTCDay() || 7;
  var monday = new Date(jan4);
  monday.setUTCDate(jan4.getUTCDate() - day + 1 + (weekN - 1) * 7);
  var sunday = new Date(monday);
  sunday.setUTCDate(monday.getUTCDate() + 6);
  return {
    from: monday.toISOString().slice(0,10),
    to: sunday.toISOString().slice(0,10)
  };
}

function filterMsgs(msgs, mode, days, dateFrom, dateTo, weekNum, weekYear) {
  if (!msgs.length) return msgs;

  var sorted = msgs.slice().sort(function(a,b){
    var ad = String(a.dateIso || "");
    var bd = String(b.dateIso || "");
    if (ad === bd) return String(a.timeStr || "").localeCompare(String(b.timeStr || ""));
    return ad.localeCompare(bd);
  });

  if (mode === "range" && dateFrom && dateTo) {
    var f = dateFrom <= dateTo ? dateFrom : dateTo;
    var t = dateFrom <= dateTo ? dateTo : dateFrom;
    return sorted.filter(function(m){ return m.dateIso >= f && m.dateIso <= t; });
  }

  if (mode === "week" && weekNum && weekYear) {
    var wr = getWeekRange(parseInt(weekNum, 10), parseInt(weekYear, 10));
    return sorted.filter(function(m){ return m.dateIso >= wr.from && m.dateIso <= wr.to; });
  }

  var lastMsg = sorted[sorted.length - 1] || null;
  var refMs = 0;
  if (lastMsg && typeof timeToMinsLocal === "function") {
    refMs = timeToMinsLocal(lastMsg.dateIso, lastMsg.timeStr || "00:00");
  }
  if (!refMs && lastMsg && lastMsg.dateIso) {
    var fallbackRef = new Date(lastMsg.dateIso + "T23:59:59");
    refMs = isNaN(fallbackRef.getTime()) ? 0 : fallbackRef.getTime();
  }

  var refDate = refMs ? new Date(refMs) : new Date();
  var cutoff = new Date(refDate.getFullYear(), refDate.getMonth(), refDate.getDate());
  cutoff.setDate(cutoff.getDate() - Math.max(1, parseInt(days, 10) || 1) + 1);

  var cutoffStart = new Date(cutoff.getFullYear(), cutoff.getMonth(), cutoff.getDate(), 0, 0, 0, 0).getTime();
  var refEnd = new Date(refDate.getFullYear(), refDate.getMonth(), refDate.getDate(), 23, 59, 59, 999).getTime();

  return sorted.filter(function(m){
    var ms = 0;
    if (typeof timeToMinsLocal === "function") {
      ms = timeToMinsLocal(m.dateIso, m.timeStr || "00:00");
    }
    if (!ms && m.dateIso) {
      var d = new Date(m.dateIso + "T00:00:00");
      ms = isNaN(d.getTime()) ? 0 : d.getTime();
    }
    return ms >= cutoffStart && ms <= refEnd;
  });
}

function traceOpsFilterMediaNamesBySelectedRange(mediaNames, imgMeta, filteredMsgs) {
  var out = { names: [], outsideRangeCount: 0, unknownDateCount: 0 };
  var names = mediaNames || [];
  if (!names.length) return out;
  if (!filteredMsgs || !filteredMsgs.length) {
    out.outsideRangeCount = names.length;
    return out;
  }
  var allowedDates = {};
  filteredMsgs.forEach(function(m) {
    if (m && m.dateIso) allowedDates[m.dateIso] = true;
  });
  names.forEach(function(fname) {
    var meta = (imgMeta && imgMeta[fname]) || null;
    var dateIso = meta && meta.dateIso ? meta.dateIso : "";
    if (!dateIso) {
      out.unknownDateCount += 1;
      return;
    }
    if (allowedDates[dateIso]) out.names.push(fname);
    else out.outsideRangeCount += 1;
  });
  return out;
}

function cleanMsgs(msgs) {
  var skip = /imagen omitida|sticker omitido|audio omitido|video omitido|gif omitido|documento omitido|media omitted|image omitted|sticker omitted|audio omitted|video omitted|document omitted|messages and calls are end-to-end encrypted|cifrados de extremo|ahora es admin|created group|added you|security code changed|changed this group's icon|changed the group description|join(?:ed)? using this group's invite link/i;
  var noise = /^(buenos d|buenas t|buen d|gracias|de nada|enterado|recibido|entendido|ok|thanks|got it|understood|roger)$/i;
  return msgs.filter(function(m){
    return m.text && m.text.trim().length > 8 && !m.text.match(skip) && !m.text.trim().match(noise);
  });
}

function inferWhatsAppDateOrder(txt) {
  var lines = String(txt || '').split(/\r?\n/);
  var re = /^(?:\[(\d{1,2})\/(\d{1,2})\/(\d{2,4}),\s*(\d{1,2}):(\d{2})(?::(\d{2}))?\s*(a\.?m\.?|p\.?m\.?)?\]\s*([^:]+?):\s*(.*)|(\d{1,2})\/(\d{1,2})\/(\d{2,4}),\s*(\d{1,2}):(\d{2})(?::(\d{2}))?\s*(a\.?m\.?|p\.?m\.?)?\s*-\s*([^:]+?):\s*(.*))$/i;
  var dmyScore = 0;
  var mdyScore = 0;
  var inspected = 0;
  for (var i = 0; i < lines.length && inspected < 80; i++) {
    var line = traceOpsNormalizeWhatsAppLineLocal(lines[i]);
    var m = line.match(re);
    if (!m) continue;
    inspected += 1;
    var a = parseInt(m[1] || m[9] || 0, 10) || 0;
    var b = parseInt(m[2] || m[10] || 0, 10) || 0;
    var mer = String(m[7] || m[15] || '').toLowerCase();
    if (a > 12 && b <= 12) dmyScore += 3;
    else if (b > 12 && a <= 12) mdyScore += 3;
    else if (mer) mdyScore += 1;
  }
  return mdyScore > dmyScore ? 'MDY' : 'DMY';
}

function resolveWhatsAppDatePartsLocal(a, b, order) {
  var p1 = parseInt(a, 10) || 0;
  var p2 = parseInt(b, 10) || 0;
  if (p1 > 12 && p2 <= 12) return { day: p1, month: p2 };
  if (p2 > 12 && p1 <= 12) return { day: p2, month: p1 };
  if (String(order || 'DMY').toUpperCase() === 'MDY') return { day: p2, month: p1 };
  return { day: p1, month: p2 };
}

// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// EML / MBOX PARSER — TraceOps v2026-03-22-clean
// Normaliza emails al mismo formato de mensajes WhatsApp
// Limpia HTML/MIME, quoted-printable, firmas y replies largos
// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

function decodeQuotedPrintable(str) {
  if (!str) return '';
  return String(str)
    .replace(/=\r?\n/g, '')
    .replace(/=([0-9A-Fa-f]{2})/g, function(_, hex) {
      try { return String.fromCharCode(parseInt(hex, 16)); } catch(_) { return _; }
    });
}

function decodeMimeWords(str) {
  if (!str) return '';
  return String(str).replace(/=\?([^?]+)\?([BQbq])\?([^?]+)\?=/g, function(_, charset, enc, text) {
    try {
      if (String(enc).toUpperCase() === 'B') {
        return decodeURIComponent(escape(atob(String(text).replace(/\s/g, ''))));
      }
      var qp = String(text).replace(/_/g, ' ');
      return decodeQuotedPrintable(qp);
    } catch(_) {
      return text;
    }
  });
}

function decodeHtmlEntities(str) {
  if (!str) return '';
  try {
    var ta = document.createElement('textarea');
    ta.innerHTML = str;
    return ta.value;
  } catch(_) {
    return str
      .replace(/&nbsp;/gi, ' ')
      .replace(/&amp;/gi, '&')
      .replace(/&lt;/gi, '<')
      .replace(/&gt;/gi, '>')
      .replace(/&quot;/gi, '"')
      .replace(/&#39;/gi, "'");
  }
}

function stripHtmlToText(str) {
  if (!str) return '';
  var s = String(str)
    .replace(/<style[\s\S]*?<\/style>/gi, ' ')
    .replace(new RegExp('<script[\\s\\S]*?<\\/script>', 'gi'), ' ')
    .replace(/<head[\s\S]*?<\/head>/gi, ' ')
    .replace(/<br\s*\/?>/gi, '\n')
    .replace(/<\/p>/gi, '\n')
    .replace(/<\/div>/gi, '\n')
    .replace(/<\/li>/gi, '\n')
    .replace(/<li[^>]*>/gi, '• ')
    .replace(/<[^>]+>/g, ' ');
  return decodeHtmlEntities(s);
}

function decodeEmlEncoding(str, encoding) {
  if (!str) return '';
  var enc = (encoding || '').toLowerCase().trim();
  if (enc === 'base64') {
    try { return decodeURIComponent(escape(atob(String(str).replace(/\s/g, '')))); } catch(_) { return str; }
  }
  if (enc === 'quoted-printable') return decodeQuotedPrintable(str);
  return str;
}

function normalizeEmailSubjectLocal(subject) {
  var s = decodeMimeWords(subject || '');
  s = String(s)
    .replace(/\[[^\]]+\]\s*/g, function(m){ return /^\[(re|fw|fwd):/i.test(m) ? m : ' '; })
    .replace(/^(\s*(re|fw|fwd)\s*[:\-]\s*)+/i, '')
    .replace(/\.(xlsx|xlsm|xls|csv|pdf|pptx|ppt|docx|doc)\b/gi, ' ')
    .replace(/[\/_]+/g, ' ')
    .replace(/[|]+/g, ' | ')
    .replace(/\s{2,}/g, ' ')
    .trim()
    .toLowerCase();
  return s || 'sin-asunto';
}

function canonicalEmailMessageIdLocal(raw) {
  var s = String(raw || '').trim().toLowerCase();
  if (!s) return '';
  s = s.replace(/^<|>$/g, '');
  s = s.replace(/@[^>\s]+$/i, '');
  return s;
}

function extractEmailThreadKeyLocal(headers) {
  var refs = String(headers['references'] || '').trim();
  var irt = String(headers['in-reply-to'] || '').trim();
  var mid = String(headers['message-id'] || '').trim();
  var allRefs = [];
  function pullIds(raw) {
    return String(raw || '').match(/<[^>]+>/g) || [];
  }
  allRefs = allRefs.concat(pullIds(refs));
  allRefs = allRefs.concat(pullIds(irt));
  if (allRefs.length) return canonicalEmailMessageIdLocal(allRefs[0]);
  if (mid) return canonicalEmailMessageIdLocal(mid);
  return 'subject:' + normalizeEmailSubjectLocal(headers['subject'] || '');
}

function parseEmlHeaders(lines) {
  var headers = {};
  var i = 0;
  while (i < lines.length) {
    if (!lines[i] || lines[i].trim() === '') { i++; break; }
    var m = lines[i].match(/^([\w\-]+):\s*(.*)/);
    if (m) {
      var key = m[1].toLowerCase();
      var val = m[2];
      while (i + 1 < lines.length && /^[ \t]/.test(lines[i + 1])) {
        i++;
        val += ' ' + lines[i].trim();
      }
      headers[key] = decodeMimeWords(val);
    }
    i++;
  }
  return { headers: headers, bodyStart: i };
}

function scoreEmailBodyCandidateLocal(text, flavor) {
  var s = String(text || '').trim();
  if (!s) return -999999;
  var score = Math.min(s.length, 4000);
  if (/\b(linea|línea|station|feeder|bga|socket|flux|material|aoi|smt|open|short|falla|defecto|component|misalign|hundimiento|repair|rework|paro)\b/i.test(s)) score += 500;
  if (/\b(aviso de confidencialidad|confidentiality notice|disclaimer|lotus notes|ibm notes|image\d+\.gif)\b/i.test(s)) score -= 1200;
  if (/\b(from|to|cc|bcc|subject|sent|date):/i.test(s) && s.length < 500) score -= 350;
  if ((flavor || '') === 'html') score += 80;
  if ((flavor || '') === 'plain') score += 20;
  return score;
}

function cleanEmailTextLocal(text, options) {
  if (!text) return '';
  var opts = options || {};
  var preserveBreaks = !!opts.preserveBreaks;
  var s = String(text);
  s = s.replace(/\r\n/g, '\n').replace(/\r/g, '\n');
  s = s.replace(/\u00a0/g, ' ').replace(/[\u200B-\u200F\u202A-\u202E]/g, '');
  s = stripHtmlToText(s);
  s = decodeHtmlEntities(s);
  s = s.replace(/^\s*(mime-version|content-type|content-transfer-encoding|content-disposition|content-id|x-[\w\-]+):.*$/gim, ' ');
  s = s.replace(/^--[\w=:\-\.\/\+]+\s*$/gim, ' ');
  s = s.replace(/\[(cid|image):[^\]]+\]/gi, ' ');
  s = s.replace(/\b(?:image\d+\.gif|notes\.bmp|memo\.htm)\b/gi, ' ');
  s = s.replace(/\n\s*(from|de|to|para|cc|bcc|subject|asunto|sent|date|fecha):\s*\n/gi, '\n');
  var cutPatterns = [
    /\n\s*-----Original Message-----[\s\S]*$/i,
    /\n\s*Begin forwarded message:[\s\S]*$/i,
    /\n\s*From:\s.*\n\s*Sent:\s.*\n\s*To:\s.*[\s\S]*$/i,
    /\n\s*De:\s.*\n\s*Enviado el:\s.*\n\s*Para:\s.*[\s\S]*$/i,
    /\n\s*(?:From|De):\s.+\n\s*(?:To|Para):\s.+\n\s*(?:Cc:\s.*\n)?\s*(?:Subject|Asunto):\s.+[\s\S]*$/i,
    /\n\s*On .*wrote:[\s\S]*$/i,
    /\n\s*El .*escribi[oó]:[\s\S]*$/i,
    /\n\s*________________________________[\s\S]*$/i,
    /\n\s*-----\s*Forwarded by .*?[\s\S]*$/i,
    /\n\s*(?:From|De):\s.*?\/NSG\/FOXCONN.*[\s\S]*$/i,
    /\n\s*Forwarded by\b[\s\S]*$/i,
    /\n\s*IBM Notes[\s\S]*$/i,
    /\n\s*Lotus Notes[\s\S]*$/i
  ];
  for (var i = 0; i < cutPatterns.length; i++) {
    if (cutPatterns[i].test(s)) {
      s = s.replace(cutPatterns[i], ' ');
      break;
    }
  }
  s = s.replace(/\n\s*>.*$/gm, ' ');
  s = s.replace(/https?:\/\/\S+/gi, ' ');
  s = s.replace(/\b(?:AVISO DE CONFIDENCIALIDAD|CONFIDENTIALITY NOTICE|DISCLAIMER|Microsoft Teams meeting|Join the meeting|Start Free Trial|Book a Demo)\b[\s\S]*$/i, ' ');
  s = s.replace(/\n{2,}/g, '\n');
  s = s.replace(/[ \t]+/g, ' ');
  s = s.replace(/\s*\n\s*/g, '\n');
  var lines = s.split(/\n+/).map(function(line){ return line.trim(); }).filter(function(line){
    if (!line) return false;
    if (/^(from|to|cc|bcc|subject|sent|date|de|para|asunto|enviado|fecha):\s*$/i.test(line)) return false;
    if (/^(--|__)+$/.test(line)) return false;
    if (/^(image\d+\.gif|notes\.bmp|memo\.htm)$/i.test(line)) return false;
    return true;
  });
  s = lines.join('\n').trim();
  if (!preserveBreaks) s = s.replace(/\n/g, ' ');
  s = s.replace(/\s{2,}/g, ' ').trim();
  return s;
}

function extractEmlBodyText(lines, bodyStart, contentType, encoding, options) {
  var rawBody = lines.slice(bodyStart).join('\n');
  var ctRaw = String(contentType || '');
  var ct = ctRaw.toLowerCase();
  var boundaryM = ctRaw.match(/boundary="?([^";]+)"?/i);
  if (boundaryM) {
    var boundary = boundaryM[1].trim();
    var safeBoundary = boundary.replace(/[.*+?^${}()|[\]\\]/g, '\\$&');
    var re = new RegExp('(?:^|\\n)--' + safeBoundary + '(?:--)?(?=\\n|$)', 'g');
    var normalizedBody = '\n' + rawBody.replace(/\r\n/g, '\n').replace(/\r/g, '\n');
    var segments = normalizedBody.split(re);
    var bestText = '';
    var bestHtml = '';
    var bestTextScore = -999999;
    var bestHtmlScore = -999999;
    for (var pi = 0; pi < segments.length; pi++) {
      var part = segments[pi];
      if (!part || /^\s*$/.test(part) || /^\s*--\s*$/.test(part)) continue;
      var partLines = part.replace(/^\s+/, '').split(/\n/);
      var partInfo = parseEmlHeaders(partLines);
      var partCtRaw = String(partInfo.headers['content-type'] || '');
      var partCt = partCtRaw.toLowerCase();
      var partEnc = String(partInfo.headers['content-transfer-encoding'] || '').toLowerCase().trim();
      var payload = decodeEmlEncoding(partLines.slice(partInfo.bodyStart).join('\n').trim(), partEnc);
      if (partCt.indexOf('multipart/') >= 0) {
        var nested = extractEmlBodyText(partLines, partInfo.bodyStart, partCtRaw, partEnc, options);
        var nestedScore = scoreEmailBodyCandidateLocal(nested, 'nested');
        if (nestedScore > bestTextScore) {
          bestText = nested;
          bestTextScore = nestedScore;
        }
        continue;
      }
      if (partCt.indexOf('message/rfc822') >= 0) {
        var nestedMsg = parseEmlToMsg(payload, 'embedded.eml');
        var nestedText = nestedMsg && nestedMsg.text ? nestedMsg.text : cleanEmailTextLocal(payload, options);
        var embeddedScore = scoreEmailBodyCandidateLocal(nestedText, 'embedded');
        if (embeddedScore > bestTextScore) {
          bestText = nestedText;
          bestTextScore = embeddedScore;
        }
        continue;
      }
      if (partCt.indexOf('text/plain') >= 0) {
        var cleanPlain = cleanEmailTextLocal(payload, options);
        var plainScore = scoreEmailBodyCandidateLocal(cleanPlain, 'plain');
        if (plainScore > bestTextScore) {
          bestText = cleanPlain;
          bestTextScore = plainScore;
        }
      } else if (partCt.indexOf('text/html') >= 0) {
        var cleanHtml = cleanEmailTextLocal(payload, options);
        var htmlScore = scoreEmailBodyCandidateLocal(cleanHtml, 'html');
        if (htmlScore > bestHtmlScore) {
          bestHtml = cleanHtml;
          bestHtmlScore = htmlScore;
        }
      }
    }
    if (bestHtmlScore >= bestTextScore && bestHtml) return bestHtml;
    if (bestText) return bestText;
    if (bestHtml) return bestHtml;
  }
  var decoded = decodeEmlEncoding(rawBody.trim(), encoding);
  return cleanEmailTextLocal(decoded, options);
}

function parseEmlToMsg(rawText, sourceName) {
  if (!rawText || !rawText.trim()) return null;
  rawText = String(rawText).replace(/\r\n/g, '\n').replace(/\r/g, '\n');
  var lines = rawText.split(/\n/);
  var info = parseEmlHeaders(lines);
  var h = info.headers;

  var dateObj = null;
  try { dateObj = h['date'] ? new Date(h['date']) : null; } catch(_) {}
  if (!dateObj || isNaN(dateObj.getTime())) dateObj = new Date();

  var year = dateObj.getFullYear();
  var month = dateObj.getMonth() + 1;
  var day = dateObj.getDate();
  var hour = dateObj.getHours();
  var min = dateObj.getMinutes();
  var dateIso = year + '-' + String(month).padStart(2,'0') + '-' + String(day).padStart(2,'0');
  var timeStr = String(hour).padStart(2,'0') + ':' + String(min).padStart(2,'0');

  var fromRaw = decodeMimeWords(h['from'] || 'email@desconocido');
  var addrM = fromRaw.match(/<([^>]+)>/);
  var addr = addrM ? addrM[1] : fromRaw.replace(/"/g,'').trim();
  var displayM = fromRaw.match(/^"?([^"<]+)"?\s*</);
  var sender = displayM ? displayM[1].trim() : addr;
  sender = sender.replace(/^~/, '').trim();

  var rawSubject = decodeMimeWords(h['subject'] || '');
  var subject = cleanEmailTextLocal(rawSubject);
  var normalizedSubject = normalizeEmailSubjectLocal(rawSubject);
  var threadKey = extractEmailThreadKeyLocal(h);
  var body = extractEmlBodyText(lines, info.bodyStart, h['content-type'] || '', h['content-transfer-encoding'] || '');
  var bodyStructured = extractEmlBodyText(lines, info.bodyStart, h['content-type'] || '', h['content-transfer-encoding'] || '', { preserveBreaks: true });
  var text = ((subject ? '[' + subject + '] ' : '') + body).replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim();
  if (!text || text.trim().length < 12) return null;
  if (text.length > 8000) text = text.slice(0, 8000) + '...';

  return {
    dateIso: dateIso,
    dateDisp: String(day).padStart(2,'0') + '/' + String(month).padStart(2,'0') + '/' + year,
    timeStr: timeStr,
    hour: hour,
    turno: parseTurno(hour, min, dateIso),
    sender: sender,
    text: text,
    source: 'email',
    subject: subject,
    subjectNormalized: normalizedSubject,
    bodyStructured: String(bodyStructured || '').trim(),
    threadKey: threadKey,
    sourceFile: sourceName || '',
    messageId: String(h['message-id'] || '').trim(),
    inReplyTo: String(h['in-reply-to'] || '').trim(),
    references: String(h['references'] || '').trim()
  };
}

function parseMboxToMsgs(rawText) {
  if (!rawText) return [];
  var chunks = String(rawText).split(/^From [^\r\n]*$/m);
  var results = [];
  chunks.forEach(function(chunk) {
    var msg = parseEmlToMsg(String(chunk || '').trim());
    if (msg) results.push(msg);
  });
  return results;
}

function traceOpsIsStickerMediaLocal(baseName) {
  var b = String(baseName || "").toLowerCase().trim();
  if (!b) return false;
  if (/\.webp$/i.test(b)) return true;
  if (/(^|[_\-\s])(sticker|stickers|emoji|meme|funny|tenor|giphy|gif)([_\-\s]|\.)/i.test(b)) return true;
  return false;
}

var _zipRef = null;
var _imgCache = {};

async function readZip(file) {
  await window.ensureZipTools();

  var zip = await JSZip.loadAsync(file);
  _zipRef = zip;
  _imgCache = {};
  var names = Object.keys(zip.files);
  var txt = null;
  var imgNames = [];
  var filteredMediaNames = [];
  var imgMeta = {};
  var emlMsgs = [];

  for (var i = 0; i < names.length; i++) {
    var name = names[i];
    if (name.startsWith("__MACOSX")) continue;
    var base = traceOpsNormalizeUnicodeFilenameLocal(name.split("/").pop());
    if (!base) continue;

    if (!txt && /\.txt$/i.test(base) && !base.toLowerCase().endsWith(".eml")) {
      txt = await zip.files[name].async("string");
    }

    if (/\.(jpe?g|png|webp)$/i.test(base)) {
      if (traceOpsIsStickerMediaLocal(base)) {
        filteredMediaNames.push(base);
      } else {
        imgNames.push(base);
      }
    }

    if (base.toLowerCase().endsWith(".eml")) {
      try {
        var emlRaw = await zip.files[name].async("string");
        var msg = parseEmlToMsg(emlRaw, base);
        if (msg) emlMsgs.push(msg);
      } catch (_) {}
    }

    if (base.toLowerCase().endsWith(".mbox")) {
      try {
        var mboxRaw = await zip.files[name].async("string");
        var mboxMsgs = parseMboxToMsgs(mboxRaw);
        emlMsgs = emlMsgs.concat(mboxMsgs);
      } catch (_) {}
    }
  }

  if (txt) {
    var dateOrder = inferWhatsAppDateOrder(txt);
    var reA = /^\[(\d{1,2})\/(\d{1,2})\/(\d{2,4}),\s*(\d{1,2}):(\d{2})(?::(\d{2}))?\s*(a\.?m\.?|p\.?m\.?)?\]\s*([^:]+?):\s*(.*)$/i;
    var reB = /^(\d{1,2})\/(\d{1,2})\/(\d{2,4}),\s*(\d{1,2}):(\d{2})(?::(\d{2}))?\s*(a\.?m\.?|p\.?m\.?)?\s*-\s*([^:]+?):\s*(.*)$/i;
    var lastMeta = null;
    var lastTextAny = '';
    var lastTextBySender = {};
    txt.split(/\r?\n/).forEach(function(rawLine) {
      var line = traceOpsNormalizeWhatsAppLineLocal(rawLine);
      var matchA = line.match(reA);
      var matchB = matchA ? null : line.match(reB);
      var m = matchA || matchB;
      if (m) {
        var d = m[1], mo = m[2], yr = m[3], h2 = m[4], min2 = m[5], sec2 = m[6] || '00', mer = m[7] || '';
        var sender = m[8];
        var text = m[9];
        var resolved = resolveWhatsAppDatePartsLocal(d, mo, dateOrder);
        var year = parseInt(yr, 10);
        if (year < 100) year += 2000;
        var t = to24h(h2, min2, sec2, mer);
        var senderNorm = String(sender || '').replace(/^~/, '').trim();
        lastMeta = {
          dateIso: year + '-' + String(resolved.month).padStart(2, '0') + '-' + String(resolved.day).padStart(2, '0'),
          timeStr: t.timeStr,
          sender: senderNorm
        };
        if (text && !/(?:<(?:adjunto|attached):|<media omitted>|<imagen omitida>|<video omitted>|<sticker omitted>|<audio omitted>)/i.test(text)) {
          lastTextAny = String(text || '').replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim();
          if (senderNorm) lastTextBySender[senderNorm] = lastTextAny;
        }
      } else if (traceOpsIsWhatsAppSystemLineLocal(line)) {
        return;
      } else if (lastMeta && line && !line.startsWith('[')) {
        var prev = lastTextBySender[lastMeta.sender] || lastTextAny || '';
        var merged = (prev + ' ' + line).replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim();
        lastTextAny = merged;
        if (lastMeta.sender) lastTextBySender[lastMeta.sender] = merged;
      }
      var adj = line.match(/<(?:adjunto|attached):\s*([^>]+\.(?:jpe?g|png|webp))\s*>/i);
      if (adj && lastMeta) {
        var adjName = traceOpsNormalizeUnicodeFilenameLocal(adj[1].trim());
        imgMeta[adjName] = {
          dateIso: lastMeta.dateIso,
          timeStr: lastMeta.timeStr,
          sender: lastMeta.sender,
          contextText: (lastTextBySender[lastMeta.sender] || lastTextAny || '').slice(0, 320)
        };
      }
    });
  }

  var hasWA = !!(txt && txt.trim().length > 0);
  var hasEml = emlMsgs.length > 0;

  if (!hasWA && !hasEml) {
    throw new Error("No se encontro .txt de WhatsApp ni archivos .eml/.mbox en el ZIP");
  }

  return {
    txt: txt || "",
    imgNames: imgNames,
    filteredMediaNames: filteredMediaNames,
    imgMeta: imgMeta,
    emlMsgs: emlMsgs || [],
    hasWA: hasWA,
    hasEml: hasEml
  };
}

async function loadImg(fname) {
  if (_imgCache[fname]) return _imgCache[fname];
  if (!_zipRef) return null;
  var allNames = Object.keys(_zipRef.files);
  var targetName = traceOpsNormalizeUnicodeFilenameLocal(fname);
  var match = allNames.find(function(n){ return traceOpsNormalizeUnicodeFilenameLocal(n.split("/").pop()) === targetName; });
  if (!match) return null;
  try {
    var b64 = await _zipRef.files[match].async("base64");
    var ext = fname.split(".").pop().toLowerCase().replace("jpg","jpeg");
    var url = "data:image/"+ext+";base64,"+b64;
    _imgCache[fname] = url;
    return url;
  } catch(_) { return null; }
}



// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// HYBRID ENGINE — TraceOps v3
// Semantic pre-processing + token reduction (85-90%)
// All helpers encapsulated inside analyzeWithAI
// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

async function analyzeWithAI(msgs, apiKey) {
  function estimateTokensLocal(text) {
    if (!text) return 1;
    return Math.max(1, Math.ceil(text.length / 3.7));
  }

  function normalizeLocal(text) {
    return (text || "")
      .toLowerCase()
      .normalize("NFD")
      .replace(/[\u0300-\u036f]/g, "")
      .replace(/[^\w\s\-\/\.]/g, " ")
      .replace(/\s+/g, " ")
      .trim();
  }

  function isNoiseLocal(text) {
    var short = normalizeLocal(text);
    var trivial = [
      "ok","enterado","recibido","gracias","de nada","listo",
      "va","copiado","entendido","si","no","claro","bien","perfecto","roger"
    ];
    if (!short || short.length < 4) return true;
    return trivial.indexOf(short) >= 0;
  }

  function detectTypeLocal(text) {
    var t = normalizeLocal(text);
    if (!t) return null;
    if (/seguridad|alarma|puerta|riesgo|acceso|celda/.test(t)) return "Seguridad";
    if (/material|lcr|reel|etiquetad|faltante|rollo/.test(t)) return "Material";
    if (/aoi|ict|wrong|orientation|defecto|scrap|open|short|cross|tablilla/.test(t)) return "Calidad";
    if (/paro|deten|setup|fallando|feeder|linea|maquina|machine|stop/.test(t)) return "Proceso";
    if (/produccion|eficiencia|lote|output|rendimiento/.test(t)) return "Produccion";
    if (/sistema|red|servidor|software|erp|mes/.test(t)) return "Sistema";
    return null;
  }

  function extractLineLocal(text) {
    var raw = text || "";
    var m = raw.match(/\b(?:L\s*\d+|BB\s*\d+|linea\s*\d+|line\s*\d+)\b/i);
    if (!m) return "N/D";
    return m[0].replace(/\s+/g, "").toUpperCase();
  }

  function extractStationLocal(text) {
    var t = normalizeLocal(text);
    if (/\baoi\b/.test(t)) return "AOI";
    if (/\bict\b/.test(t)) return "ICT";
    if (/\bsmt\b/.test(t)) return "SMT";
    if (/\bpth\b/.test(t)) return "PTH";
    if (/seguridad|celda/.test(t)) return "Seguridad";
    return "N/D";
  }

  function timeToMinsLocal(dateIso, timeStr) {
    var dp = (dateIso || "").split("-").map(Number);
    var tp = (timeStr || "00:00").split(":").map(Number);
    if (dp.length < 3) return 0;
    return new Date(dp[0], dp[1] - 1, dp[2], tp[0] || 0, tp[1] || 0).getTime() / 60000;
  }



  function traceOpsEnsureLongTextFieldsLocal(parsed) {
    if (!parsed || !parsed.eventos || !parsed.eventos.length) return parsed;
    parsed.eventos = parsed.eventos.map(function(ev) {
      var eventoFull = String(ev.evento_detectado_full || ev.evento_detectado || "").trim();
      var accionFull = String(ev.accion_ejecutada_full || ev.accion_ejecutada || "").trim();
      var findingFull = String(ev.engineer_findings_full || ev.engineer_findings || "").trim();

      ev.evento_detectado_full = eventoFull;
      ev.evento_detectado_preview = ev.evento_detectado_preview || (eventoFull.length > 220 ? eventoFull.slice(0, 220) + "..." : eventoFull);
      ev.evento_detectado = ev.evento_detectado_preview || eventoFull;

      ev.accion_ejecutada_full = accionFull;
      ev.accion_ejecutada_preview = ev.accion_ejecutada_preview || (accionFull.length > 180 ? accionFull.slice(0, 180) + "..." : accionFull);
      ev.accion_ejecutada = ev.accion_ejecutada_preview || accionFull;

      ev.engineer_findings_full = findingFull;
      ev.engineer_findings_preview = ev.engineer_findings_preview || (findingFull.length > 240 ? findingFull.slice(0, 240) + "..." : findingFull);
      ev.engineer_findings = ev.engineer_findings_preview || findingFull;

      return ev;
    });
    return parsed;
  }

  function traceOpsDropWeakEventsLocal(parsed) {
    if (!parsed || !parsed.eventos || !parsed.eventos.length) return parsed;

    var kept = [];
    var removed = [];
    (parsed.eventos || []).forEach(function(ev) {
      var eventTxt = String(ev.evento_detectado || "");
      var blob = [
        ev.tipo_evento || "",
        ev.modelo || "",
        ev.linea_estacion || "",
        ev.defecto_smt || "",
        ev.evento_detectado || "",
        ev.impacto || "",
        ev.accion_requerida || ""
      ].join(" ");

      var weakSignals = 0;
      if (ev.modelo && ev.modelo !== "N/D") weakSignals++;
      if (ev.linea_estacion && ev.linea_estacion !== "N/D") weakSignals++;
      if (ev.defecto_smt && ev.defecto_smt !== "N/A") weakSignals++;
      if (typeof technicalHitCountLocal === "function" && technicalHitCountLocal(blob) >= 2) weakSignals++;
      if (/\b(?:u|r|c|q|l|d|tp|ic|cn|fb)\d{1,4}\b/i.test(blob)) weakSignals++;

      var drop = false;
      if (traceOpsLooksAdministrativeEventLocal(blob)) drop = true;
      if (!drop && !traceOpsLooksOperationalEventLocal(eventTxt) && weakSignals < 2) drop = true;
      if (!drop && /router|junta|retrab|reparaciones|pass vanguard|esperando tecnico|chamber/i.test(blob) && weakSignals < 3) drop = true;

      if (drop) removed.push({id: ev.id || "", titulo: String(ev.evento_detectado || "").slice(0, 90)});
      else kept.push(ev);
    });

    parsed.eventos = kept;
    if (parsed.resumen) {
      parsed.resumen.total_eventos = kept.length;
      if (Array.isArray(parsed.resumen.alertas_criticas)) {
        parsed.resumen.alertas_criticas = parsed.resumen.alertas_criticas.filter(function(item) {
          return kept.some(function(ev) { return item.indexOf(ev.id + " - ") === 0; });
        });
      }
      if (Array.isArray(parsed.resumen.acciones_pendientes)) {
        parsed.resumen.acciones_pendientes = parsed.resumen.acciones_pendientes.filter(function(item) {
          return kept.some(function(ev) { return item.indexOf(ev.id + " - ") === 0; });
        });
      }
    }

    parsed.__traceops_weak_events = {
      removed_count: removed.length,
      removed_samples: removed.slice(0, 8)
    };

    return parsed;
  }

  function buildLocalResult(msgs, candidates, clusters) {
    function padId(n){ return "EVT-" + String(n).padStart(3, "0"); }
    function detectDefecto(text){
      var t = normalizeLocal(text);
      if (/missing material|faltante|falta material/.test(t)) return "Missing material";
      if (/wrong part|material mix|mezcla de material|wrong component/.test(t)) return "Wrong component";
      if (/short|bridge|corto|puente/.test(t)) return "Short / bridge";
      if (/open|abierto/.test(t)) return "Open";
      if (/misalign|desalinead/.test(t)) return "Misaligned component";
      if (/socket|dimm|bga|u\d+|r\d+|c\d+/.test(t)) return "Hallazgo tecnico";
      return "N/A";
    }
    function detectPrioridad(text, tipo){
      var t = normalizeLocal(text);
      if (/critical|critico|paro|line down|deten/.test(t)) return "Critica";
      if (tipo === "Calidad" || /scrap|rechazo|rma|defecto/.test(t)) return "Alta";
      if (tipo === "Material" || tipo === "Proceso") return "Media";
      return "Baja";
    }
    function detectEstatus(text){
      var t = normalizeLocal(text);
      if (/cerrado|closed|resuelto|resolved/.test(t)) return "Cerrado";
      if (/en proceso|working|follow up|seguimiento/.test(t)) return "En proceso";
      return "Abierto";
    }
    function detectModelo(text){
      var raw = String(text || "");
      var m = raw.match(/\b(?:N\/P|P\/N|MODEL|MODELO|PART)\s*[:# ]?\s*([A-Z0-9][A-Z0-9-]{4,})/i);
      if (m) return String(m[1]).toUpperCase();
      var m2 = raw.match(/\b([A-Z]{2,}[0-9]{3,}[A-Z0-9-]*)\b/);
      if (m2) return String(m2[1]).toUpperCase();
      return "N/D";
    }
    function impactFor(tipo, prioridad){
      if (prioridad === "Critica") return "Paro o riesgo alto para la operacion";
      if (tipo === "Calidad") return "Riesgo de defecto o retrabajo";
      if (tipo === "Material") return "Riesgo de paro por material";
      if (tipo === "Proceso") return "Afectacion al flujo de manufactura";
      return "Afectacion operativa";
    }
    function actionFor(tipo, defecto){
      if (defecto !== "N/A") return "Revisar " + defecto + " y ejecutar contencion en piso";
      if (tipo === "Material") return "Verificar disponibilidad y segregacion de material";
      if (tipo === "Proceso") return "Revisar parametros y condicion de equipo";
      if (tipo === "Calidad") return "Containment y validacion de calidad";
      return "Asignar responsable y seguimiento";
    }

    var eventos = (clusters || []).map(function(cluster, i){
      var arr = cluster.messages || [];
      var first = arr[0] || {};
      var allText = arr.map(function(m){ return m.text || ""; }).join(" ");
      var longest = arr.slice().sort(function(a,b){ return String(b.text||"").length - String(a.text||"").length; })[0] || first || {};
      var tipo = cluster.type || detectTypeLocal(allText) || "Proceso";
      var prioridad = detectPrioridad(allText, tipo);
      var estatus = detectEstatus(allText);
      var linea = cluster.line && cluster.line !== "N/D" ? cluster.line : extractLineLocal(allText);
      var estacion = cluster.station && cluster.station !== "N/D" ? cluster.station : extractStationLocal(allText);
      var lineaEstacion = linea !== "N/D" ? (estacion !== "N/D" ? (linea + " / " + estacion) : linea) : estacion;
      if (!lineaEstacion || lineaEstacion === "N/D") lineaEstacion = "N/D";
      var fechaIso = first.dateIso || "";
      var dp = fechaIso.split("-");
      var fechaDisp = dp.length === 3 ? (dp[2] + "/" + dp[1] + "/" + dp[0]) : (first.dateDisp || "");
      var eventoDetectadoFull = String(longest.text || "").trim();
      var accionEjecutadaFull = arr.length > 1 ? String(arr[arr.length - 1].text || "").trim() : "";
      var engineerFindingsFull = "";
      return {
        id: padId(i + 1),
        fecha: fechaDisp || first.dateDisp || "",
        hora: String(first.timeStr || "").slice(0,5),
        turno: first.turno || "N/D",
        modelo: detectModelo(allText),
        linea_estacion: lineaEstacion,
        reporta: first.sender || "N/D",
        area_involucrada: tipo,
        tipo_evento: tipo,
        defecto_smt: detectDefecto(allText),
        evento_detectado: eventoDetectadoFull.length > 220 ? (eventoDetectadoFull.slice(0, 220) + "...") : eventoDetectadoFull,
        evento_detectado_preview: eventoDetectadoFull.length > 220 ? (eventoDetectadoFull.slice(0, 220) + "...") : eventoDetectadoFull,
        evento_detectado_full: eventoDetectadoFull,
        impacto: impactFor(tipo, prioridad),
        accion_requerida: actionFor(tipo, detectDefecto(allText)),
        accion_ejecutada: accionEjecutadaFull.length > 180 ? (accionEjecutadaFull.slice(0, 180) + "...") : accionEjecutadaFull,
        accion_ejecutada_preview: accionEjecutadaFull.length > 180 ? (accionEjecutadaFull.slice(0, 180) + "...") : accionEjecutadaFull,
        accion_ejecutada_full: accionEjecutadaFull,
        engineer_findings: "",
        engineer_findings_preview: "",
        engineer_findings_full: engineerFindingsFull,
        responsable_sugerido: first.sender || "N/D",
        actores: [first.sender || "Produccion"],
        estado_historia: estatus === "Cerrado" ? "Cerrado" : "Detectado",
        estatus: estatus,
        prioridad: prioridad,
        fuente_chat: (fechaDisp || first.dateIso || "") + " " + (first.timeStr || "") + " " + (first.sender || ""),
        notas: ""
      };
    });

    var kpis = [];
    var senderMap = {};
    (msgs || []).forEach(function(m){
      if (m && m.sender) {
        if (!senderMap[m.sender]) senderMap[m.sender] = { nombre: m.sender, mensajes: 0, eventos: 0, departamento: "", rol: "", area_owner: "" };
        senderMap[m.sender].mensajes += 1;
      }
    });
    eventos.forEach(function(ev){
      if (ev.reporta && senderMap[ev.reporta]) senderMap[ev.reporta].eventos += 1;
    });
    var allDates = (msgs || []).map(function(m){ return m.dateIso; }).filter(Boolean).sort();
    function isoToDisp(iso){
      var p = String(iso || "").split("-");
      return p.length === 3 ? (p[2] + "/" + p[1] + "/" + p[0]) : iso;
    }
    var resumen = {
      periodo: allDates.length ? (isoToDisp(allDates[0]) + " a " + isoToDisp(allDates[allDates.length - 1])) : "",
      grupo: "Planta",
      total_eventos: eventos.length,
      alertas_criticas: eventos.filter(function(e){ return e.prioridad === "Critica"; }).slice(0,5).map(function(e){ return e.id + " - " + e.linea_estacion + " - " + String(e.evento_detectado || "").slice(0,60); }),
      acciones_pendientes: eventos.filter(function(e){ return e.estatus !== "Cerrado"; }).slice(0,5).map(function(e){ return e.id + " - " + String(e.accion_requerida || "").slice(0,60); }),
      estatus_lineas: []
    };

    return {
      eventos: eventos,
      kpis: kpis,
      resumen: resumen,
      directorio: Object.keys(senderMap).map(function(k){ return senderMap[k]; }).sort(function(a,b){ return b.mensajes - a.mensajes; }).slice(0, 20),
      __traceops_window: {
        from: allDates.length ? allDates[0] : "",
        to: allDates.length ? allDates[allDates.length - 1] : ""
      },
      __traceops_api: {
        api_calls: 0,
        cache_hit: false,
        local_mode: true,
        provider: "local-only",
        model: "local-engine-v1",
        max_tokens: 0,
        input_tokens: 0,
        output_tokens: 0,
        server_stop_reason: "local",
        requested_msgs: msgs.length,
        cluster_mode: candidates.length >= 3 && clusters.length >= 2 ? 1 : 0
      }
    };
  }


  function traceOpsApplyFindingsRefineSafeLocal(parsed) {
    try {
      if (typeof traceOpsRefineEngineerFindingsAcrossEventsLocal === "function") {
        return traceOpsRefineEngineerFindingsAcrossEventsLocal(parsed);
      }
    } catch (_) {}
    return parsed;
  }


  function traceOpsNormEventTextLocal(text) {
    return String(text || "")
      .toLowerCase()
      .normalize("NFD")
      .replace(/[\u0300-\u036f]/g, "")
      .replace(/[^a-z0-9\s]/g, " ")
      .replace(/\s+/g, " ")
      .trim();
  }

  function traceOpsLooksAdministrativeEventLocal(text) {
    var t = traceOpsNormEventTextLocal(text);
    if (!t) return true;
    return /router\s*\d+\s*sigue\s*alarmad|router\s*alarmad|no hay red|sin red|network down|falla de red|e fox|efox|it support|infraestructura|junta de produccion|igual lo revisamos en la junta|solo informativo|scheduled maintenance|mantenimiento programado|agenda auditoria|apertura auditoria|meeting|kickoff|recordatorio|weekly report|awb|eta/.test(t);
  }

  function traceOpsOperationalSignalCountLocal(text) {
    var raw = String(text || "");
    var t = traceOpsNormEventTextLocal(raw);
    var signals = 0;

    if (/(short|bridge|corto|puente|open|missing material|falta material|wrong part|wrong component|mezcla de material|misalign|desalinead|aoi|ict|spi|x ray|rayos x|socket|dimm|flux|bga|scrap|rework|hold|paro|line down|detenido|detenida|stopped|componente|component|material|primera pieza|first piece|label|etiqueta|polaridad|failure|falla|fallas|reject|rechazo|contencion|validation|validacion|programa de pruebas|reprobando|debug|debugueo|pict|suben las fallas|cambio revision|prueba|pruebas|material no entregado|material pendiente)/.test(t)) signals++;
    if (/\b(?:u|r|c|q|l|d|tp|ic|cn|fb)\d{1,4}\b/i.test(raw)) signals++;
    if (/\b(?:N\/P|P\/N|MODEL|MODELO|PART)\s*[:# ]?\s*([A-Z0-9][A-Z0-9-]{4,})/i.test(raw) || /\b([A-Z]{2,}[0-9]{3,}[A-Z0-9-]*)\b/.test(raw)) signals++;
    if (/\b(?:l\s*\d+|bb\s*\d+|linea\s*\d+|line\s*\d+|aoi|ict|smt|pth|pict)\b/i.test(raw)) signals++;
    if (typeof technicalHitCountLocal === "function" && technicalHitCountLocal(raw) >= 1) signals++;

    return signals;
  }

  function traceOpsLooksOperationalEventLocal(text) {
    var raw = String(text || "");
    var t = traceOpsNormEventTextLocal(raw);
    if (!t || t.length < 10) return false;
    if (traceOpsLooksAdministrativeEventLocal(raw)) return false;

    var signals = traceOpsOperationalSignalCountLocal(raw);
    var hasOpsPhrase = /(ict|pict|aoi|spi|material|falla|fallas|corto|short|open|rework|primera pieza|debug|programa de pruebas|detenida|detenido|paro|reprobando|cambio revision|modelo|prueba|pruebas|feeder|laser mark|mix|mezcla)/.test(t);

    // Eventos genéricos siguen requiriendo algo de evidencia, pero ya no tanto
    if (/revisar|verificar|pendiente|favor|apoyar|trabajando|working|ok|pass|liberar|liberado|habilitar|definir/.test(t) && signals < 2 && !hasOpsPhrase) return false;

    return signals >= 1 || hasOpsPhrase;
  }

  function traceOpsSplitEmailOperationalSegmentsLocal(msg) {
    var raw = String(
      (msg && msg.bodyStructured) ||
      (msg && msg.text) ||
      ""
    ).trim();
    if (!raw) return [];

    var text = raw
      .replace(/\r\n/g, "\n")
      .replace(/\r/g, "\n")
      .replace(/\u2022/g, "\n• ")
      .replace(/\n{3,}/g, "\n\n")
      .replace(/([:;])\s+(?=(?:caso|case|issue|evento|problema|modelo|linea|línea|station|estacion|socket|flux|material|aoi|ict|spi)\b)/gi, "$1\n")
      .replace(/\n\s*(?=(?:caso|case|issue|evento|problema)\s*\d+\b)/gi, "\n\n")
      .replace(/\n\s*(?=(?:modelo|model|linea|línea|station|estacion)\s*[:#-])/gi, "\n\n");

    var chunks = text
      .split(/\n{2,}/)
      .map(function(part) { return String(part || "").trim(); })
      .filter(Boolean);

    var segments = [];
    chunks.forEach(function(chunk) {
      var normalizedChunk = chunk
        .replace(/\n\s*(?:[-*•]+|\d+[.)])\s*/g, "\n")
        .replace(/\n\s+/g, "\n")
        .trim();

      var lines = normalizedChunk
        .split(/\n+/)
        .map(function(line) { return String(line || "").trim(); })
        .filter(Boolean);

      if (lines.length > 1 && traceOpsLooksOperationalEventLocal(normalizedChunk) && Boolean(detectTypeLocal(normalizedChunk))) {
        segments.push(normalizedChunk);
      } else if (lines.length > 1) {
        lines.forEach(function(line) {
          if (line.length < 18) return;
          segments.push(line);
        });
      } else if (normalizedChunk) {
        segments.push(normalizedChunk);
      }
    });

    segments = uniqLocal(segments.map(function(segment) {
      var cleanedSegment = String(segment || "")
        .replace(/^[^\n]{0,120}---\d{2}\/\d{2}\/\d{4}[^-]{0,80}---/i, " ")
        .replace(/^(?:buen[oa]s?\s+dias|buen[oa]s?\s+tardes|hola)\b[:, ]*/i, " ")
        .replace(/^caso\s*\d+\s+[^\n]{0,120}?(?=\s+(?:se reporta|el mayor|debido|cabe mencionar|este afecta|el problema))/i, " ")
        .replace(/\bsend by\b[\s\S]*$/i, " ")
        .replace(/\bcel\s*:\s*[\d\s\-()+]{7,}\b/gi, " ");
      var s = cleanEmailTextLocal(cleanedSegment);
      if (!s) return "";
      return s;
    }).filter(Boolean));

    var operational = segments.filter(function(segment) {
      if (/^(from|to|cc|bcc|date|sent|subject|asunto|de|para|fecha|enviado)\s*:/i.test(segment)) return false;
      if (/^(send by|cel\s*:|ext\.\s*\d+|mba\b|foxconn\b.*manufactura)/i.test(segment)) return false;
      if (/^(buen[oa]s?\s+dias|buen[oa]s?\s+tardes|hola|gracias|quedo en espera|de antemano gracias)\b/i.test(segment)) return false;
      if (/^[^ ]+---\d{2}\/\d{2}\/\d{4}/i.test(segment)) return false;
      if (/^caso\s*\d+\b/i.test(segment) && segment.length < 110) return false;
      if (segment.length < 45 && traceOpsOperationalSignalCountLocal(segment) < 2) return false;
      return !isNoiseLocal(segment)
        && !traceOpsIsHardExcludedEventLocal(segment)
        && !traceOpsIsSoftExcludedEventLocal(segment)
        && traceOpsLooksOperationalEventLocal(segment)
        && Boolean(detectTypeLocal(segment));
    });

    if (operational.length > 1) return operational;
    if (operational.length === 1 && operational[0] !== String(msg && msg.text || '').trim()) return operational;
    return [];
  }


  function traceOpsInferEstadoHistoriaLocal(ev) {
    var est = String((ev && ev.estatus) || "").toLowerCase();
    if (est === "cerrado") return "Cerrado";

    var txt = [
      ev && ev.evento_detectado || "",
      ev && ev.impacto || "",
      ev && ev.accion_requerida || "",
      ev && ev.accion_ejecutada || "",
      ev && ev.engineer_findings || "",
      ev && ev.notas || ""
    ].join(" ");
    var t = String(txt || "")
      .toLowerCase()
      .normalize("NFD")
      .replace(/[\u0300-\u036f]/g, "")
      .replace(/[^a-z0-9\s]/g, " ")
      .replace(/\s+/g, " ")
      .trim();

    if (/\b(validad|validated|confirmad|confirmed|monitoreo|monitoring|conforme a tu request|cada hora|release approved|primera pieza ok|verified)\b/.test(t)) return "Validado";
    if (/\b(corregid|corrected|fixed|reparad|repair|rework|retrabaj|refluy|reflow|reemplaz|replace|cambio de fixtura|cleaned|limpian|lavar|ajuste realizado)\b/.test(t)) return "Corregido";
    if (/\b(conten|containment|segregad|owner|escalad|probando|testing|revisamos|ya revisamos|checar|verificar|en proceso|hold|esperando|monitoreo|trabajando)\b/.test(t)) return "Contenido";
    if (String(ev && ev.engineer_findings || "").trim()) return "Contenido";
    if (String(ev && ev.accion_ejecutada || "").trim()) return "Contenido";
    return "Detectado";
  }

  function traceOpsNormalizeLifecycleLocal(parsed) {
    if (!parsed || !parsed.eventos || !parsed.eventos.length) return parsed;
    parsed.eventos = parsed.eventos.map(function(ev) {
      ev.estado_historia = traceOpsInferEstadoHistoriaLocal(ev);
      return ev;
    });
    return parsed;
  }

  function candidateDetectorLocal(msgs) {
    return msgs
      .flatMap(function(m) {
        var candidateTexts = [];
        if (m && m.source === 'email') {
          candidateTexts = traceOpsSplitEmailOperationalSegmentsLocal(m);
        }
        if (!candidateTexts.length) candidateTexts = [m.text];

        return candidateTexts
          .filter(function(text) {
            return !isNoiseLocal(text)
              && !traceOpsIsHardExcludedEventLocal(text)
              && !traceOpsIsSoftExcludedEventLocal(text)
              && traceOpsLooksOperationalEventLocal(text);
          })
          .map(function(text, idx) {
            return {
              dateIso: m.dateIso,
              timeStr: m.timeStr,
              sender: m.sender,
              text: text,
              turno: m.turno,
              source: m.source || '',
              threadKey: m.threadKey || '',
              threadTitle: m.subject || m.subjectNormalized || '',
              sourceFile: m.sourceFile || '',
              type: detectTypeLocal(text),
              __traceops_signal_count: traceOpsOperationalSignalCountLocal(text),
              __traceops_parent_email: m.source === 'email',
              __traceops_segment_index: idx
            };
          });
      })
      .filter(function(m) { return Boolean(m.type); });
  }

  function clusterIncidentsLocal(candidates) {
    var sorted = candidates.slice().sort(function(a, b) {
      return timeToMinsLocal(a.dateIso, a.timeStr) - timeToMinsLocal(b.dateIso, b.timeStr);
    });

    var clusters = [];

    sorted.forEach(function(msg) {
      var msgTime = timeToMinsLocal(msg.dateIso, msg.timeStr);
      var line = extractLineLocal(msg.text);
      var station = extractStationLocal(msg.text);
      var last = clusters[clusters.length - 1];

      if (last) {
        var dt = msgTime - last.lastTime;
        var sameType = msg.type === last.type;
        var lineOk = line === last.line || line === "N/D" || last.line === "N/D";
        var emailScoped = (msg.source === 'email' || last.source === 'email');
        var sameThread = !emailScoped || !msg.threadKey || !last.threadKey || msg.threadKey === last.threadKey;

        // PATCH 1: 180 min window to capture post-incident engineer findings
        if (sameType && lineOk && dt <= 180 && sameThread) {
          last.messages.push(msg);
          last.lastTime = msgTime;
          if (last.line === "N/D" && line !== "N/D") last.line = line;
          if (last.station === "N/D" && station !== "N/D") last.station = station;
          return;
        }
      }

      clusters.push({
        type: msg.type,
        line: line,
        station: station,
        lastTime: msgTime,
        source: msg.source || '',
        threadKey: msg.threadKey || '',
        threadTitle: msg.threadTitle || '',
        messages: [msg]
      });
    });

    return clusters;
  }

  function buildClusterPayload(clusters) {
    return clusters.map(function(cluster, i) {
      var msgs = cluster.messages;
      var first = msgs[0];
      var last2 = msgs[msgs.length - 1];

      var senders = msgs
        .map(function(m) { return m.sender; })
        .filter(function(s, idx, arr) { return arr.indexOf(s) === idx; })
        .join(", ");

      var texts = msgs
        .map(function(m) { return m.sender + ": " + m.text; })
        .join(" | ");

      return (
        "CLUSTER-" + String(i + 1).padStart(2, "0") +
        " | " + (first.dateIso || "") + " " + (first.timeStr || "") +
        " -> " + (last2.dateIso || "") + " " + (last2.timeStr || "") +
        " | fuente:" + (cluster.source || first.source || 'chat') +
        (cluster.threadTitle ? (" | hilo:" + cluster.threadTitle) : "") +
        " | tipo:" + cluster.type +
        " | linea:" + cluster.line +
        " | estacion:" + cluster.station +
        " | turno:" + (first.turno || "") +
        " | actores:" + senders +
        " | msgs:" + texts.slice(0, 480)
      );
    }).join("\n");
  }

  // --- Engine logic ---

  var candidates = candidateDetectorLocal(msgs);
  var clusters = clusterIncidentsLocal(candidates);
  var localFallbackResult = (typeof traceOpsNormalizeLifecycleLocal==="function"?traceOpsNormalizeLifecycleLocal:function(x){return x;})(traceOpsDedupeEngineerFindingsLocal(traceOpsDropWeakEventsLocal((typeof traceOpsApplyFindingsRefineSafeLocal==="function"?traceOpsApplyFindingsRefineSafeLocal:function(x){return x;})(pruneOperationalExceptionsLocal(enrichEngineerFindingsLocal(buildLocalResult(msgs, candidates, clusters)))))));

  if (!apiKey || !apiKey.trim()) {
    return localFallbackResult;
  }

  var useClusterMode = candidates.length >= 3 && clusters.length >= 2;
  var userContent;

  if (useClusterMode) {
    var clusterPayload = buildClusterPayload(clusters);
    var rawTok = estimateTokensLocal(msgs.map(function(m) { return m.text; }).join(" "));
    var clTok = estimateTokensLocal(clusterPayload);

    console.log(
      "[TraceOps Hybrid] " +
      msgs.length + " msgs -> " +
      candidates.length + " candidatos -> " +
      clusters.length + " clusters | " +
      rawTok + " tok -> " + clTok + " tok | " +
      Math.round((1 - clTok / Math.max(rawTok, 1)) * 100) + "% reduccion"
    );

    userContent =
      "Analiza estos " + clusters.length +
      " clusters pre-procesados de " + msgs.length + " mensajes. " +
      "Cada CLUSTER = un incidente. Extrae un evento por cluster. " +
      "Usa linea y estacion cuando esten disponibles. Solo JSON:\n\n" +
      clusterPayload;
  } else {
    var sample = msgs.slice(0, 150).map(function(m) {
      return "[" + m.dateIso + " " + m.timeStr + "|" + m.turno + "|" + m.sender + "]:" + m.text;
    }).join("\n");

    console.log(
      "[TraceOps Hybrid] Fallback semantico: " +
      msgs.length + " msgs | " +
      candidates.length + " candidatos | " +
      clusters.length + " clusters"
    );

    userContent =
      "Analiza " + msgs.length +
      " mensajes de manufactura SMT/PTH/AOI/ICT. " +
      "Extrae incidentes operativos accionables. Solo JSON:\n\n" +
      sample;
  }

  function uniqLocal(arr) {
    var out = [];
    var seen = {};
    (arr || []).forEach(function(x) {
      var k = String(x || "").trim();
      if (!k || seen[k]) return;
      seen[k] = true;
      out.push(k);
    });
    return out;
  }

  function normalizeLooseLocal(text) {
    return String(text || "")
      .toLowerCase()
      .normalize("NFD")
      .replace(/[\u0300-\u036f]/g, "")
      .replace(/[^a-z0-9]+/g, " ")
      .trim();
  }
