  function traceOpsGetExceptionRulesLocal() {
    if (typeof TRACEOPS_EXCEPTION_RULES !== "undefined" && TRACEOPS_EXCEPTION_RULES) return TRACEOPS_EXCEPTION_RULES;
    if (typeof window !== "undefined" && window.TRACEOPS_EXCEPTION_RULES) return window.TRACEOPS_EXCEPTION_RULES;
    return { hardExclude: [], softExclude: [], findingsExclude: [] };
  }

  if (typeof window !== "undefined") {
    window.TRACEOPS_EXCEPTION_RULES = TRACEOPS_EXCEPTION_RULES;
  }

  function traceOpsMatchesAnyRuleLocal(text, list) {
    var s = String(text || "");
    return (list || []).some(function(rx) { return rx.test(s); });
  }

  function traceOpsTextForExceptionLocal(evOrText) {
    if (typeof evOrText === "string") return evOrText;
    var ev = evOrText || {};
    return [
      ev.tipo_evento || "",
      ev.modelo || "",
      ev.linea_estacion || "",
      ev.evento_detectado || "",
      ev.impacto || "",
      ev.accion_requerida || "",
      ev.accion_ejecutada || "",
      ev.engineer_findings || "",
      ev.notas || ""
    ].join(" | ");
  }

  function traceOpsIsHardExcludedEventLocal(evOrText) {
    var rules = traceOpsGetExceptionRulesLocal();
    return traceOpsMatchesAnyRuleLocal(traceOpsTextForExceptionLocal(evOrText), rules.hardExclude);
  }

  function traceOpsIsSoftExcludedEventLocal(evOrText) {
    var rules = traceOpsGetExceptionRulesLocal();
    return traceOpsMatchesAnyRuleLocal(traceOpsTextForExceptionLocal(evOrText), rules.softExclude);
  }

  function traceOpsIsFindingsExceptionLocal(text) {
    var rules = traceOpsGetExceptionRulesLocal();
    return traceOpsMatchesAnyRuleLocal(String(text || ""), rules.findingsExclude);
  }

  function pruneOperationalExceptionsLocal(parsed) {
    if (!parsed || !parsed.eventos || !parsed.eventos.length) return parsed;

    var kept = [];
    var removed = [];

    (parsed.eventos || []).forEach(function(ev) {
      var blob = traceOpsTextForExceptionLocal(ev);
      var hard = traceOpsIsHardExcludedEventLocal(blob);
      var soft = traceOpsIsSoftExcludedEventLocal(blob);
      var tech = technicalHitCountLocal(blob);
      var parts = extractPartsLocal(blob).length;
      var keep = true;

      if (hard) keep = false;
      if (!hard && soft && tech < 3 && parts === 0) keep = false;

      if (keep) {
        kept.push(ev);
      } else {
        removed.push({
          id: ev.id || "",
          tipo: hard ? "hard" : "soft",
          titulo: String(ev.evento_detectado || "").slice(0, 120)
        });
      }
    });

    parsed.eventos = kept;

    if (parsed.resumen) {
      parsed.resumen.total_eventos = kept.length;
      if (Array.isArray(parsed.resumen.alertas_criticas)) {
        parsed.resumen.alertas_criticas = parsed.resumen.alertas_criticas.filter(function(item) {
          return kept.some(function(ev) { return item.indexOf(ev.id + " - ") === 0; });
        });
      }
      if (Array.isArray(parsed.resumen.acciones_pendientes)) {
        parsed.resumen.acciones_pendientes = parsed.resumen.acciones_pendientes.filter(function(item) {
          return kept.some(function(ev) { return item.indexOf(ev.id + " - ") === 0; });
        });
      }
    }

    parsed.__traceops_exceptions = {
      removed_count: removed.length,
      removed_samples: removed.slice(0, 8)
    };

    return parsed;
  }

  function extractPartsLocal(text) {
    return uniqLocal((String(text || "").toUpperCase().match(/\b(?:U|R|C|L|Q|D|TP)\d{1,4}\b/g) || []));
  }

  function extractModelTokensLocal(text) {
    return uniqLocal(
      normalizeLooseLocal(text)
        .split(/\s+/)
        .filter(function(tok) {
          if (!tok || tok === "n" || tok === "d" || tok === "nd") return false;
          if (tok.length < 3) return false;
          if (/^(caso|owner|linea|estacion|evento|detectado|accion|reporta|responsable|abierto|cerrado|proceso|calidad|material|sistema|seguridad|produccion|smt|pth|ict|aoi|mod|modelo|falla|fallas|pass|open|short|wrong|component|components|loading|setup|engineer|findings|analisis|analizado|mitigacion|validacion|reporte|root|cause)$/.test(tok)) return false;
          return true;
        })
    );
  }

  function parseEventDateTimeMsLocal(ev) {
    if (!ev || !ev.fecha) return null;
    var dp = String(ev.fecha).split("/");
    if (dp.length !== 3) return null;
    var tp = String(ev.hora || "00:00").split(":");
    var dd = parseInt(dp[0], 10) || 1;
    var mm = parseInt(dp[1], 10) || 1;
    var yy = parseInt(dp[2], 10) || 2000;
    var hh = parseInt(tp[0], 10) || 0;
    var mi = parseInt(tp[1], 10) || 0;
    return new Date(yy, mm - 1, dd, hh, mi, 0).getTime();
  }

  function technicalHitCountLocal(text) {
    var t = normalizeLooseLocal(text);
    var keys = [
      "owner", "escalado", "escalar", "analizado", "analisis", "findings", "causa", "hipotesis",
      "mitigacion", "contencion", "validacion", "inspeccion", "inspection", "ict", "aoi", "5dx", "xray",
      "flux", "test point", "test points", "pogo", "componente", "componentes", "wrong", "open", "short",
      "bridge", "soldadura", "limpieza", "residuo", "residuos", "fixtura", "recomendacion", "preventiva",
      "preventivo", "monitoreo", "pallet", "autopressfit", "feeder", "reel", "material mix", "wrong p n"
    ];
    var hits = 0;
    keys.forEach(function(k) {
      if (t.indexOf(k) >= 0) hits += 1;
    });
    return hits;
  }

  function senderLooksTechnicalLocal(msg) {
    var s = normalizeLooseLocal((msg && msg.sender) || "");
    var t = normalizeLooseLocal((msg && msg.text) || "").slice(0, 160);
    var combo = s + " " + t;
    return /(eng|engineer|ingenier|qa|quality|calidad|maint|maintenance|mantenimiento|proceso|process|smt|pth|ict|aoi|superintendent|superintendente|tecnico|tec|manager|owner)/.test(combo) ? 1 : 0;
  }

  function buildEventAnchorLocal(ev, evTimeMs) {
    var sourceTexts = msgs.filter(function(m) {
      var ms = timeToMinsLocal(m.dateIso, m.timeStr) * 60000;
      return evTimeMs && ms >= (evTimeMs - 90 * 60000) && ms <= (evTimeMs + 180 * 60000);
    }).map(function(m) { return m.text; }).join(" ");

    var anchorText = [
      ev.evento_detectado, ev.accion_requerida, ev.accion_ejecutada, ev.notas,
      ev.modelo, ev.linea_estacion, ev.defecto_smt, sourceTexts
    ].join(" ");

    return {
      components: extractPartsLocal(anchorText),
      modelTokens: extractModelTokensLocal([ev.modelo, ev.evento_detectado, sourceTexts].join(" ")).slice(0, 10),
      line: extractLineLocal([ev.linea_estacion, ev.evento_detectado, sourceTexts].join(" ")),
      station: extractStationLocal([ev.linea_estacion, ev.evento_detectado, sourceTexts].join(" "))
    };
  }

  function overlapCountLocal(a, b) {
    var setB = {};
    (b || []).forEach(function(x) { setB[x] = true; });
    var n = 0;
    (a || []).forEach(function(x) { if (setB[x]) n += 1; });
    return n;
  }


  function traceOpsNormSenderSafeLocal(s) {
    return String(s || "")
      .toLowerCase()
      .replace(/^~/, "")
      .normalize("NFD")
      .replace(/[\u0300-\u036f]/g, "")
      .replace(/[^a-z0-9]+/g, " ")
      .trim();
  }

  function findingAdminNoiseScoreLocal(text) {
    var t = normalizeLooseLocal(text);
    var pats = [
      "auditoria", "audit", "agenda", "meeting", "reunion", "recordatorio", "reminder",
      "autenticacion", "authentication", "password", "contrasena", "login", "signin", "efox",
      "mantenimiento programado", "scheduled maintenance", "favor confirmar", "please confirm",
      "book a demo", "start free trial", "trial", "demo", "copyright", "all rights reserved",
      "politica de privacidad", "privacy policy", "unsubscribe", "click here", "notification",
      "notificacion", "sistema caido", "portal", "sesion", "session expired"
    ];
    var score = 0;
    pats.forEach(function(p) { if (t.indexOf(p) >= 0) score += 1; });
    if (/\b(?:from|to|cc|bcc|subject|sent|date|de|para|asunto|enviado):\b/i.test(text)) score += 3;
    if (/[A-Za-z0-9+\/]{90,}={0,2}/.test(text)) score += 4;
    return score;
  }

  function cleanFindingTextLocal(text) {
    if (!text) return "";
    if (traceOpsIsFindingsExceptionLocal(text)) return "";
    var s = cleanEmailTextLocal(String(text || ""));
    s = s.replace(/\[[^\]]{0,120}\]\s*/g, function(m) {
      return /subject|fw|fwd|re:/i.test(m) ? " " : m;
    });
    s = s.replace(/\b(?:from|to|cc|bcc|subject|sent|date|de|para|asunto|enviado):\s*[^\n]+/gi, " ");
    s = s.replace(/[A-Za-z0-9+\/]{90,}={0,2}/g, " ");
    s = s.replace(/\b(?:http|https):\/\/\S+/gi, " ");
    s = s.replace(/\S+@\S+/g, " ");
    s = s.replace(/\b(?:book a demo|start free trial|click here|unsubscribe|privacy policy|all rights reserved)\b[\s\S]*$/i, " ");
    s = s.replace(/\s*\|\|\s*/g, " ");
    s = s.replace(/\s{2,}/g, " ").trim();

    var rawParts = s
      .replace(/([.!?;])\s+/g, "$1\n")
      .replace(/\s+\u2022\s+/g, "\n")
      .replace(/\s+-\s+/g, "\n")
      .split(/\n+/);
    var kept = [];
    rawParts.forEach(function(part) {
      var p = String(part || "").trim();
      if (!p || p.length < 18) return;
      var tech = technicalHitCountLocal(p);
      var admin = findingAdminNoiseScoreLocal(p);
      var hasPart = extractPartsLocal(p).length > 0;
      var hasModel = extractModelTokensLocal(p).length > 0;
      if (admin >= 3 && tech < 3 && !hasPart && !hasModel) return;
      if (tech === 0 && !hasPart && !hasModel && p.length < 70) return;
      kept.push(p);
    });

    if (!kept.length) return "";
    var out = kept.slice(0, 4).join(" ");
    out = out.replace(/\s{2,}/g, " ").trim();
    if (out.length > 900) out = out.slice(0, 897) + "...";
    if (findingLooksAdministrativeUpdateLocal(out) && !findingHasStrongTechnicalSignalLocal(out)) return "";
    if (!findingHasStrongTechnicalSignalLocal(out) && out.length < 85) return "";
    return out;
  }

  function findingHasStrongTechnicalSignalLocal(text) {
    var s = String(text || "");
    if (!s) return false;
    var techHits = technicalHitCountLocal(s);
    var parts = extractPartsLocal(s).length;
    var models = extractModelTokensLocal(s).length;
    var hasRefdes = /\b(?:u|r|c|q|l|d|tp|ic|cn|fb)\d{1,4}\b/i.test(s);
    var hasTechWords = /\b(?:causa|cause|hipotesis|hypothesis|validacion|validation|mitigacion|mitigation|inspeccion|inspection|analisis|analysis|flux|pogo|ict|aoi|bga|short|open|owner|escalad|conten(?:cion|tion)|componente|component)\b/i.test(s);

    var signals = 0;
    if (techHits >= 3) signals++;
    if (parts > 0) signals++;
    if (models > 0) signals++;
    if (hasRefdes) signals++;
    if (hasTechWords && techHits >= 1) signals++;

    if (signals >= 2) return true;
    if (techHits >= 4) return true;
    if ((parts > 0 || hasRefdes) && techHits >= 1) return true;
    return false;
  }

  function findingLooksAdministrativeUpdateLocal(text) {
    var s = normalizeLooseLocal(text);
    if (!s) return false;
    var pats = [
      "actualizacion de smt",
      "buen dia team",
      "favor de tomar en cuenta",
      "se reduce la corrida",
      "adicion modelos npi",
      "plan smt",
      "wo ",
      "favor revisar",
      "se informa",
      "para su conocimiento",
      "update de smt"
    ];
    var score = 0;
    pats.forEach(function(p) { if (s.indexOf(p) >= 0) score += 1; });
    return score >= 2;
  }

  function findingSignalScoreLocal(text, msg, anchor) {
    var clean = cleanFindingTextLocal(text);
    if (!clean) return -999;
    var parts = extractPartsLocal(clean);
    var models = extractModelTokensLocal(clean);
    var techHits = technicalHitCountLocal(clean);
    var adminNoise = findingAdminNoiseScoreLocal(clean);
    var score = 0;
    score += overlapCountLocal(parts, anchor.components) * 4;
    score += overlapCountLocal(models, anchor.modelTokens) * 2;
    score += Math.min(10, techHits * 2);
    score += senderLooksTechnicalLocal(msg) * 3;
    if (/\b(?:owner|causa|hipotesis|analisis|validacion|mitigacion|contencion|escalado|recomendacion)\b/i.test(clean)) score += 4;
    if (/\b(?:u|r|c|l|q|d|tp)\d{1,4}\b/i.test(clean)) score += 3;
    if (anchor.line !== "N/D" && extractLineLocal(clean) === anchor.line) score += 2;
    if (anchor.station !== "N/D" && extractStationLocal(clean) === anchor.station) score += 2;
    score -= adminNoise * 3;
    return score;
  }

  function formatFindingLocal(msg, cleanText) {
    var body = cleanText || cleanFindingTextLocal(msg && msg.text);
    if (!body) return "";
    return "[" + (msg.dateDisp || msg.dateIso || "") + " " + (msg.timeStr || "") + " " + (msg.sender || "") + "] " + body;
  }


  function traceOpsFindingEventOverlapLocal(findingText, ev) {
    var txt = String(findingText || "");
    if (!txt || !ev) return 0;
    var blob = [
      ev.modelo || "",
      ev.linea_estacion || "",
      ev.tipo_evento || "",
      ev.defecto_smt || "",
      ev.evento_detectado || "",
      ev.impacto || "",
      ev.accion_requerida || "",
      ev.accion_ejecutada || ""
    ].join(" ");
    var a = String(txt || "").toLowerCase().normalize("NFD").replace(/[\u0300-\u036f]/g, "").replace(/[^a-z0-9\s]/g, " ").replace(/\s+/g, " ").trim();
    var b = String(blob || "").toLowerCase().normalize("NFD").replace(/[\u0300-\u036f]/g, "").replace(/[^a-z0-9\s]/g, " ").replace(/\s+/g, " ").trim();
    var score = 0;
    Array.from(new Set(a.split(" ").filter(function(w){ return w && w.length > 3; }))).forEach(function(tok){
      if ((" " + b + " ").indexOf(" " + tok + " ") >= 0) score += 1;
    });
    var partHits = (txt.match(/\b(?:U|R|C|Q|L|D|TP|IC|CN|FB)\d{1,4}\b/ig) || []);
    partHits.forEach(function(p){
      var pn = String(p || "").toLowerCase();
      if ((" " + b + " ").indexOf(" " + pn + " ") >= 0) score += 3;
    });
    if (ev.defecto_smt && a.indexOf(String(ev.defecto_smt || "").toLowerCase()) >= 0) score += 2;
    return score;
  }

  function traceOpsEventNeedsHighFindingOverlapLocal(ev) {
    var t = String((ev && ev.evento_detectado) || "").toLowerCase();
    var x = String((ev && ev.tipo_evento) || "").toLowerCase();
    return /router|red|network|efox|junta|retrabajo|reparaciones|pass vanguard|mesa|area|soporte|support|alarmad|chamber|esperando tecnico/.test(t + " " + x);
  }


  function traceOpsFindingAcceptedLocal(findingText, ev, msg) {
    var txt = String(findingText || "");
    if (!txt || !ev) return false;

    var techHits = technicalHitCountLocal(txt);
    var parts = extractPartsLocal(txt);
    var models = extractModelTokensLocal(txt);
    var hasRefdes = /\b(?:u|r|c|q|l|d|tp|ic|cn|fb)\d{1,4}\b/i.test(txt);
    var hasTechWords = /\b(?:causa|cause|hipotesis|hypothesis|validacion|validation|mitigacion|mitigation|inspeccion|inspection|analisis|analysis|flux|pogo|ict|aoi|bga|short|open|owner|escalad|conten(?:cion|tion)|componente|component|rework|debug|falla|failure|defecto|defect)\b/i.test(txt);

    var partOverlap = overlapCountLocal(parts, extractPartsLocal([
      ev.modelo || "",
      ev.linea_estacion || "",
      ev.evento_detectado_full || ev.evento_detectado || "",
      ev.impacto || "",
      ev.accion_requerida || "",
      ev.accion_ejecutada_full || ev.accion_ejecutada || ""
    ].join(" ")));

    var modelOverlap = overlapCountLocal(models, extractModelTokensLocal([
      ev.modelo || "",
      ev.evento_detectado_full || ev.evento_detectado || ""
    ].join(" ")));

    var stationMatch = false;
    if (ev.linea_estacion && ev.linea_estacion !== "N/D") {
      var st = extractStationLocal(txt);
      var ln = extractLineLocal(txt);
      stationMatch = (st && ev.linea_estacion.indexOf(st) >= 0) || (ln && ev.linea_estacion.indexOf(ln) >= 0);
    }

    var overlap = traceOpsFindingEventOverlapLocal(txt, ev);
    var senderTech = msg ? (senderLooksTechnicalLocal(msg) >= 1) : false;

    if (hasRefdes && techHits >= 1) return true;
    if (partOverlap > 0) return true;
    if (modelOverlap > 0 && techHits >= 1) return true;
    if (stationMatch && techHits >= 1) return true;
    if (senderTech && hasTechWords && techHits >= 2) return true;
    if (senderTech && overlap >= 2 && techHits >= 1) return true;
    if (hasTechWords && techHits >= 3) return true;
    if (overlap >= 4) return true;

    return false;
  }

  function traceOpsFindingFingerprintLocal(text) {
    return String(text || "")
      .replace(/\[[^\]]+\]\s*/g, " ")
      .toLowerCase()
      .normalize("NFD")
      .replace(/[\u0300-\u036f]/g, "")
      .replace(/[^a-z0-9\s]/g, " ")
      .replace(/\b(?:aldair|superintendente|ildefonso|valenzuela|luis|tecalco|prod|produccion|quality|team|miriam)\b/g, " ")
      .replace(/\b\d{1,2}:\d{2}(?::\d{2})?\b/g, " ")
      .replace(/\s+/g, " ")
      .trim()
      .split(" ")
      .filter(function(w){ return w && w.length > 3; })
      .slice(0, 18)
      .join(" ");
  }

  function traceOpsDedupeEngineerFindingsLocal(parsed) {
    if (!parsed || !parsed.eventos || !parsed.eventos.length) return parsed;
    var groups = {};
    parsed.eventos.forEach(function(ev, idx){
      var fp = traceOpsFindingFingerprintLocal(ev.engineer_findings || "");
      if (!fp || fp.length < 20) return;
      if (!groups[fp]) groups[fp] = [];
      groups[fp].push({
        idx: idx,
        overlap: traceOpsFindingEventOverlapLocal(ev.engineer_findings || "", ev),
        strong: findingHasStrongTechnicalSignalLocal(ev.engineer_findings || "")
      });
    });
    Object.keys(groups).forEach(function(fp){
      var arr = groups[fp];
      if (arr.length <= 1) return;
      arr.sort(function(a,b){
        if ((b.overlap || 0) !== (a.overlap || 0)) return (b.overlap || 0) - (a.overlap || 0);
        if ((b.strong ? 1 : 0) !== (a.strong ? 1 : 0)) return (b.strong ? 1 : 0) - (a.strong ? 1 : 0);
        return a.idx - b.idx;
      });
      for (var i = 1; i < arr.length; i++) {
        parsed.eventos[arr[i].idx].engineer_findings = "";
      }
    });
    return parsed;
  }


  function findingIsRedundantLocal(findingText, ev) {
    function miniNorm(s) {
      return String(s || "")
        .toLowerCase()
        .normalize("NFD")
        .replace(/[\u0300-\u036f]/g, "")
        .replace(/[^a-z0-9\s]/g, " ")
        .replace(/\s+/g, " ")
        .trim();
    }
    var f = miniNorm(findingText || "").split(" ").filter(function(w){ return w.length > 4; });
    var e = miniNorm((ev && ev.evento_detectado) || "").split(" ").filter(function(w){ return w.length > 4; });
    if (!f.length || !e.length) return false;
    var setE = {};
    e.forEach(function(w){ setE[w] = true; });
    var overlap = f.filter(function(w){ return setE[w]; }).length;
    return overlap / Math.max(f.length, 1) >= 0.65;
  }

  function enrichEngineerFindingsLocal(parsed) {
    if (!parsed || !parsed.eventos || !parsed.eventos.length) return parsed;
    var followWindowMs = 48 * 60 * 60000;

    parsed.eventos = (parsed.eventos || []).map(function(ev) {
      var evTimeMs = parseEventDateTimeMsLocal(ev);
      if (!evTimeMs) return ev;

      var anchor = buildEventAnchorLocal(ev, evTimeMs);
      var anchorTextNorm = normalizeLooseLocal([ev.modelo, ev.evento_detectado, ev.linea_estacion].join(" "));
      var hits = [];

      msgs.forEach(function(m) {
        var msgTimeMs = timeToMinsLocal(m.dateIso, m.timeStr) * 60000;
        if (!msgTimeMs || msgTimeMs <= (evTimeMs + 5 * 60000) || msgTimeMs > (evTimeMs + followWindowMs)) return;
        if (!m.text || m.text.length < 40) return;

        var cleanText = cleanFindingTextLocal(m.text);
        if (!cleanText || cleanText.length < 30) return;

        var msgParts = extractPartsLocal(cleanText);
        var msgModels = extractModelTokensLocal(cleanText);
        var partOverlap = overlapCountLocal(msgParts, anchor.components);
        var modelOverlap = overlapCountLocal(msgModels, anchor.modelTokens);
        var techHits = technicalHitCountLocal(cleanText);
        var score = findingSignalScoreLocal(cleanText, m, anchor);

        if (anchorTextNorm && normalizeLooseLocal(cleanText).indexOf(anchorTextNorm.slice(0, 24)) >= 0) score += 2;

        var msgSenderNorm = traceOpsNormSenderSafeLocal(m.sender || "");
        var evReportaNorm = traceOpsNormSenderSafeLocal(ev.reporta || "");
        if (msgSenderNorm && evReportaNorm && msgSenderNorm === evReportaNorm) {
          score -= 6;
        }

        var distHours = (msgTimeMs - evTimeMs) / 3600000;
        if (distHours > 24) score -= Math.floor((distHours - 24) / 6) * 2;

        var hasAnchor = partOverlap > 0 || modelOverlap > 0 || (anchor.station !== "N/D" && extractStationLocal(cleanText) === anchor.station);
        if (findingLooksAdministrativeUpdateLocal(cleanText) && !findingHasStrongTechnicalSignalLocal(cleanText) && !traceOpsFindingAcceptedLocal(cleanText, ev, m)) return;
        var senderTech = senderLooksTechnicalLocal(m) >= 1;
        var acceptedByRule = traceOpsFindingAcceptedLocal(cleanText, ev, m);
        if (!hasAnchor && techHits < 2 && !senderTech && !acceptedByRule) return;
        if (!findingHasStrongTechnicalSignalLocal(cleanText) && techHits < 2 && !acceptedByRule) return;
        if (score < 9 && !acceptedByRule) return;

        hits.push({ msg: m, ms: msgTimeMs, score: score, cleanText: cleanText, acceptedByRule: acceptedByRule });
      });

      hits.sort(function(a, b) {
        if (b.score !== a.score) return b.score - a.score;
        return a.ms - b.ms;
      });

      hits.forEach(function(h) {
        h.evOverlap = traceOpsFindingEventOverlapLocal(h.cleanText || h.msg.text, ev);
      });

      hits = hits.filter(function(h){
        var needHigh = traceOpsEventNeedsHighFindingOverlapLocal(ev);
        if (needHigh) return (h.evOverlap || 0) >= 4 || h.acceptedByRule;
        return (h.evOverlap || 0) >= 2 || h.acceptedByRule;
      });

      hits.sort(function(a, b) {
        if ((b.evOverlap || 0) !== (a.evOverlap || 0)) return (b.evOverlap || 0) - (a.evOverlap || 0);
        if ((b.score || 0) !== (a.score || 0)) return (b.score || 0) - (a.score || 0);
        return (a.ms || 0) - (b.ms || 0);
      });

      var best = hits.length ? hits[0] : null;
      var followText = best ? formatFindingLocal(best.msg, best.cleanText) : "";
      var existing = traceOpsIsFindingsExceptionLocal(ev.engineer_findings || "") ? "" : cleanFindingTextLocal(String(ev.engineer_findings_full || ev.engineer_findings || "").trim());
      var selectedFindingFull = "";

      if (followText && findingIsRedundantLocal(followText, ev)) {
        followText = "";
      }

      if (!existing) {
        selectedFindingFull = followText || "";
        ev.engineer_findings = selectedFindingFull;
      } else if (followText) {
        var existingOverlap = traceOpsFindingEventOverlapLocal(existing, ev);
        var followOverlap = traceOpsFindingEventOverlapLocal(followText, ev);
        selectedFindingFull = followOverlap >= existingOverlap ? followText : existing;
        ev.engineer_findings = selectedFindingFull;
      } else {
        selectedFindingFull = existing || "";
        ev.engineer_findings = selectedFindingFull;
      }

      var acceptedFinal = traceOpsFindingAcceptedLocal(ev.engineer_findings || "", ev, best ? best.msg : null);
      if (findingAdminNoiseScoreLocal(ev.engineer_findings || "") >= 5 && technicalHitCountLocal(ev.engineer_findings || "") < 2 && !acceptedFinal) {
        ev.engineer_findings = "";
      }
      if (findingLooksAdministrativeUpdateLocal(ev.engineer_findings || "") && !findingHasStrongTechnicalSignalLocal(ev.engineer_findings || "") && !acceptedFinal) {
        ev.engineer_findings = "";
      }
      if (ev.engineer_findings && !findingHasStrongTechnicalSignalLocal(ev.engineer_findings) && !acceptedFinal && technicalHitCountLocal(ev.engineer_findings || "") < 2) {
        ev.engineer_findings = "";
      }

      if (ev.engineer_findings) {
        var finalOverlap = traceOpsFindingEventOverlapLocal(ev.engineer_findings, ev);
        if (traceOpsEventNeedsHighFindingOverlapLocal(ev) && finalOverlap < 4 && !acceptedFinal) ev.engineer_findings = "";
        else if (finalOverlap < 2 && !acceptedFinal) ev.engineer_findings = "";
      }
      if (ev.engineer_findings && findingIsRedundantLocal(ev.engineer_findings, ev) && !acceptedFinal) {
        ev.engineer_findings = "";
      }
      var fullFinding = String(selectedFindingFull || ev.engineer_findings_full || ev.engineer_findings || "").trim();
      if (!fullFinding && ev.engineer_findings) fullFinding = String(ev.engineer_findings).trim();
      ev.engineer_findings_full = fullFinding;
      ev.engineer_findings_preview = fullFinding ? (fullFinding.length > 320 ? fullFinding.slice(0, 320) + "..." : fullFinding) : "";
      ev.engineer_findings = ev.engineer_findings_preview || "";
      return ev;
    });

    return parsed;
  }

  var resp = await fetch("https://api.anthropic.com/v1/messages", {
    method: "POST",
    headers: {
      "Content-Type": "application/json",
      "x-api-key": apiKey,
      "anthropic-version": "2023-06-01",
      "anthropic-dangerous-direct-browser-access": "true"
    },
    body: JSON.stringify({
      model: "claude-sonnet-4-6",
      max_tokens: TRACEOPS_MAX_OUTPUT_TOKENS,
      system: system,
      messages: [
        { role: "user", content: userContent },
        { role: "assistant", content: "{" }
      ]
    })
  });

  if (!resp.ok) {
    var err = await resp.json().catch(function() { return {}; });
    var msgErr = (err.error && err.error.message) || ("Error API " + resp.status);
    try {
      localFallbackResult.__traceops_api.fallback_reason = msgErr;
      localFallbackResult.__traceops_api.fallback_from = "anthropic";
    } catch (_) {}
    console.warn("[TraceOps] IA no disponible, usando modo local:", msgErr);
    return localFallbackResult;
  }

  var data = await resp.json();

  if (!data.content || !data.content.length) {
    try {
      localFallbackResult.__traceops_api.fallback_reason = "Respuesta vacia de IA";
      localFallbackResult.__traceops_api.fallback_from = "anthropic";
    } catch (_) {}
    return localFallbackResult;
  }

  function extractBalancedJsonObject(text) {
    var start = text.indexOf("{");
    if (start === -1) return "";
    var depth = 0, inString = false, esc = false;
    for (var i = start; i < text.length; i++) {
      var ch = text[i];
      if (inString) {
        if (esc) { esc = false; continue; }
        if (ch === "\\") { esc = true; continue; }
        if (ch === '"') { inString = false; }
        continue;
      }
      if (ch === '"') { inString = true; continue; }
      if (ch === "{") depth += 1;
      else if (ch === "}") {
        depth -= 1;
        if (depth === 0) return text.slice(start, i + 1);
      }
    }
    return text.slice(start);
  }

  var raw = "{" + data.content.map(function(b) { return b.text || ""; }).join("");
  var clean = raw.replace(/```json\s*/gi, "").replace(/```\s*/g, "").trim();
  if (/^\{\s*\{/.test(clean)) clean = clean.replace(/^\{\s*\{/, "{");

  var jsonStr = extractBalancedJsonObject(clean);
  if (!jsonStr) {
    try { localFallbackResult.__traceops_api.fallback_reason = "JSON invalido de IA"; localFallbackResult.__traceops_api.fallback_from = "anthropic"; } catch (_) {}
    return localFallbackResult;
  }

  var parsed = null;

  try {
    parsed = JSON.parse(jsonStr);
  } catch (_) {}

  if (!parsed) {
    var fixed = jsonStr
      .replace(/,\s*([}\]])/g, "$1")
      .replace(/\n/g, " ")
      .replace(/	/g, " ");
    try {
      parsed = JSON.parse(fixed);
    } catch (_) {}
  }

  if (!parsed) {
    try { localFallbackResult.__traceops_api.fallback_reason = ((data.stop_reason || "") === "max_tokens") ? "Respuesta truncada de IA" : "Error procesando respuesta de IA"; localFallbackResult.__traceops_api.fallback_from = "anthropic"; } catch (_) {}
    return localFallbackResult;
  }

  var usage = data.usage || {};
  parsed.__traceops_api = {
    api_calls: 1,
    cache_hit: false,
    model: "claude-sonnet-4-6",
    max_tokens: TRACEOPS_MAX_OUTPUT_TOKENS,
    input_tokens: usage.input_tokens || estimateTokensLocal(system + "\n" + userContent),
    output_tokens: usage.output_tokens || estimateTokensLocal(raw),
    server_stop_reason: data.stop_reason || "",
    requested_msgs: msgs.length,
    cluster_mode: useClusterMode ? 1 : 0
  };

  return (typeof traceOpsNormalizeLifecycleLocal==="function"?traceOpsNormalizeLifecycleLocal:function(x){return x;})(traceOpsDedupeEngineerFindingsLocal(traceOpsDropWeakEventsLocal((typeof traceOpsApplyFindingsRefineSafeLocal==="function"?traceOpsApplyFindingsRefineSafeLocal:function(x){return x;})(pruneOperationalExceptionsLocal(enrichEngineerFindingsLocal(parsed))))));
}

async function buildXlsx(result) {
  await window.ensureExcelTools();

  var ev = result.eventos || [];
  var kpis = result.kpis || [];
  var res = result.resumen || {};
  var directorio = result.directorio || [];

  var wb = new ExcelJS.Workbook();
  wb.creator = "TraceOps by SMTintel - ALDA";
  wb.created = new Date();

  var C = {
    hBg:"1E5545", hFg:"FFFFFF",
    critica:"F4CCCC", alta:"FCE4D6", media:"EEF5FB", baja:"E2F0D9",
    cerrado:"E2F0D9", enProceso:"FFF2CC", abierto:"F4CCCC", alt:"F5F3EE"
  };

  function hFill(bg){ return {type:"pattern",pattern:"solid",fgColor:{argb:"FF"+bg}}; }
  function brd(){ return {top:{style:"thin"},left:{style:"thin"},bottom:{style:"thin"},right:{style:"thin"}}; }
  function hFont(sz){ return {name:"Segoe UI",size:sz||11,bold:true,color:{argb:"FF"+C.hFg}}; }
  function dFont(){ return {name:"Segoe UI",size:10}; }
  function prioFill(p){ return ({Critica:C.critica,Alta:C.alta,Media:C.media,Baja:C.baja})[p] || "FFFFFF"; }
  function estFill(s){ return ({Abierto:C.abierto,"En proceso":C.enProceso,Cerrado:C.cerrado})[s] || "FFFFFF"; }

  function styleHdr(ws, n) {
    var r = ws.getRow(1);
    for (var i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
      var c = r.getCell(i);
      c.fill = hFill(C.hBg); c.font = hFont(); c.border = brd();
      c.alignment = {horizontal:"center",vertical:"middle"};
    }
    r.height = 18;
  }

  var H = ["ID","Fecha","Hora","Turno","Modelo","Linea_Estacion","Reporta","Area_involucrada",
           "Tipo_evento","Defecto_SMT","Evento_detectado","Impacto","Accion_requerida","Accion_ejecutada",
           "Engineer_Findings","Actores","Responsable_sugerido","Estado_historia","Estatus","Prioridad","Aging_dias","Fuente_chat","Notas"];

  function addEvSheet(name, evArr) {
    var ws = wb.addWorksheet(name);
    ws.addRow(H);
    styleHdr(ws, H.length);
    evArr.forEach(function(e, ri) {
      var actoresStr = Array.isArray(e.actores) ? e.actores.join(", ") : (e.actores || "");
      var row = ws.addRow([
        e.id, e.fecha, e.hora, e.turno, e.modelo, e.linea_estacion, e.reporta,
        e.area_involucrada, e.tipo_evento, e.defecto_smt || "N/A", (e.evento_detectado_full || e.evento_detectado),
        e.impacto, e.accion_requerida, (e.accion_ejecutada_full || e.accion_ejecutada || ""),
        (e.engineer_findings_full || e.engineer_findings || ""),
        actoresStr, e.responsable_sugerido,
        e.estado_historia || "Detectado",
        e.estatus, e.prioridad,
        {formula: "IF(OR(R"+(ri+2)+"=\"Abierto\",R"+(ri+2)+"=\"En proceso\"),TODAY()-B"+(ri+2)+",\"\")"},
        e.fuente_chat, e.notas
      ]);
      row.height = 38;
      row.eachCell({includeEmpty:false}, function(cell, col) {
        cell.font = dFont();
        cell.alignment = {wrapText:true, vertical:"top"};
        if (col === 17) {
          var ehFill = ({
            Detectado:"FCE8D0", Contenido:"FFF2CC", Corregido:"D0E8FC",
            Validado:"D0F0D8", Cerrado:"E2F0D9"
          })[e.estado_historia] || "FFFFFF";
          cell.fill = hFill(ehFill);
        } else if (col === 18) cell.fill = hFill(estFill(e.estatus));
        else if (col === 19) cell.fill = hFill(prioFill(e.prioridad));
        else cell.fill = hFill(ri % 2 === 0 ? "FFFFFF" : C.alt);
      });
    });
    ws.columns = [6,12,8,6,16,18,18,20,14,20,40,26,30,30,36,24,22,14,12,10,10,28,28].map(function(w){ return {width:w}; });
    ws.views = [{state:"frozen",ySplit:1}];
  }

  addEvSheet("Bitacora", ev);
  addEvSheet("Pendientes", ev.filter(function(e){ return e.estatus !== "Cerrado"; }));

  var wsIS = wb.addWorksheet("Incident_Stories");
  wsIS.mergeCells("A1:H1");
  var isT = wsIS.getCell("A1");
  isT.value = "Incident Story Model - TraceOps by SMTintel";
  isT.fill = hFill(C.hBg); isT.font = hFont(12);
  wsIS.getRow(1).height = 22;

  var ESTADOS = ["Detectado","Contenido","Corregido","Validado","Cerrado"];
  var eColors = {Detectado:"FCE8D0",Contenido:"FFF2CC",Corregido:"D0E8FC",Validado:"D0F0D8",Cerrado:"E2F0D9"};
  var eRow = wsIS.addRow(ESTADOS);
  eRow.height = 16;
  ESTADOS.forEach(function(est, ci) {
    var cell = eRow.getCell(ci+1);
    cell.fill = hFill(eColors[est] || "FFFFFF");
    cell.font = {name:"Segoe UI",size:10,bold:true};
    cell.alignment = {horizontal:"center"};
  });

  var countRow = wsIS.addRow(ESTADOS.map(function(est){
    return ev.filter(function(e){ return (e.estado_historia||"Detectado") === est; }).length;
  }));
  countRow.height = 14;
  ESTADOS.forEach(function(est, ci) {
    var cell = countRow.getCell(ci+1);
    cell.font = {name:"Segoe UI",size:11,bold:true};

function to24h(h, min, sec, mer) {
    var hour = parseInt(h);
    var m = (mer || "").toLowerCase().replace(/[\s.]/g, "");
    if (m.indexOf("p") === 0 && hour !== 12)
        hour += 12;
    if (m.indexOf("a") === 0 && hour === 12)
        hour = 0;
    return {
        hour: hour,
        timeStr: String(hour).padStart(2, "0") + ":" + min + ":" + (sec || "00")
    };
}

function traceOpsSafeStorageError(err) {
    return err && err.message ? err.message : String(err || "Error de almacenamiento");
}
function traceOpsOpenDb() {
    return new Promise(function (resolve, reject) {
        try {
            if (!window.indexedDB) {
                reject(new Error("IndexedDB no disponible"));
                return;
            }
            var req = window.indexedDB.open("traceops_local_db", 1);
            req.onupgradeneeded = function (ev) {
                var db = ev.target.result;
                if (!db.objectStoreNames.contains("kv"))
                    db.createObjectStore("kv");
            };
            req.onsuccess = function () { resolve(req.result); };
            req.onerror = function () { reject(req.error || new Error("No se pudo abrir IndexedDB")); };
        }
        catch (err) {
            reject(err);
        }
    });
}
async function traceOpsDbGet(key) {
    var db = await traceOpsOpenDb();
    return new Promise(function (resolve, reject) {
        try {
            var tx = db.transaction("kv", "readonly");
            var store = tx.objectStore("kv");
            var req = store.get(key);
            req.onsuccess = function () { resolve(req.result); };
            req.onerror = function () { reject(req.error || new Error("No se pudo leer IndexedDB")); };
            tx.oncomplete = function () { try {
                db.close();
            }
            catch (_) { } };
            tx.onerror = function () { reject(tx.error || new Error("Transaccion IndexedDB fallida")); };
        }
        catch (err) {
            try {
                db.close();
            }
            catch (_) { }
            reject(err);
        }
    });
}
async function traceOpsDbSet(key, value) {
    var db = await traceOpsOpenDb();
    return new Promise(function (resolve, reject) {
        try {
            var tx = db.transaction("kv", "readwrite");
            var store = tx.objectStore("kv");
            store.put(value, key);
            tx.oncomplete = function () { try {
                db.close();
            }
            catch (_) { } resolve(true); };
            tx.onerror = function () { try {
                db.close();
            }
            catch (_) { } reject(tx.error || new Error("No se pudo guardar en IndexedDB")); };
        }
        catch (err) {
            try {
                db.close();
            }
            catch (_) { }
            reject(err);
        }
    });
}
var TRACEOPS_CACHE_VERSION = "v2026-03-22-token-save-2";
var TRACEOPS_MAX_OUTPUT_TOKENS = 1800;
var TRACEOPS_ANALYSIS_CACHE_PREFIX = "traceops_ai_cache::";
function traceOpsGetMaxOutputTokens(requestedDays, cleanCount) {
    if (traceOpsIsAdminOverride())
        return traceOpsAdminTokenCeiling();
    var d = Math.max(1, parseInt(requestedDays, 10) || 1);
    var c = Math.max(0, parseInt(cleanCount, 10) || 0);
    var t = 1800;
    if (d <= 1)
        t = 1800;
    else if (d <= 3)
        t = 2800;
    else if (d <= 5)
        t = 3400;
    else if (d <= 7)
        t = 4200;
    else
        t = 5200;
    if (c > 220)
        t += 400;
    if (c > 320)
        t += 400;
    return Math.min(6000, t);
}
function traceOpsGetWindowDays(filterMode, days, dateFrom, dateTo, weekNum, weekYear) {
    if (filterMode === "quick")
        return Math.max(1, parseInt(days, 10) || 3);
    if (filterMode === "week")
        return 7;
    if (filterMode === "range" && dateFrom && dateTo) {
        var ms = Math.abs(new Date(dateTo) - new Date(dateFrom));
        return Math.max(1, Math.round(ms / 86400000) + 1);
    }
    return 0;
}
function traceOpsBuildRangeLabel(filterMode, days, dateFrom, dateTo, weekNum, weekYear) {
    if (filterMode === "quick")
        return "Ultimos " + Math.max(1, parseInt(days, 10) || 3) + " dias";
    if (filterMode === "week")
        return "Semana " + (weekNum || "") + " / " + (weekYear || "");
    if (filterMode === "range")
        return (dateFrom || "?") + " -> " + (dateTo || "?");
    return "sin-rango";
}
async function traceOpsHashFile(file) {
    // iOS Safari can crash if we read the whole ZIP twice (arrayBuffer for hash + unzip).
    // Use a lightweight signature instead of a full SHA-256 to keep memory stable.
    return [file && file.name || "file", file && file.size || 0, file && file.lastModified || 0].join("|");
}

        "f=" + (dateFrom || ""),
        "t=" + (dateTo || ""),
        "w=" + (weekNum || ""),
        "y=" + (weekYear || "")
    ].join("::");
}

function traceOpsMaterialNorm(text) {
    return String(text || "")
        .toLowerCase()
        .normalize("NFD")
        .replace(/[\u0300-\u036f]/g, "")
        .replace(/[^a-z0-9\/\-\s]/g, " ")
        .replace(/\s+/g, " ")
        .trim();
}
function traceOpsMaterialIncludesAny(text, values) {
    var s = String(text || "");
    for (var i = 0; i < (values || []).length; i++) {
        if (s.indexOf(values[i]) >= 0)
            return true;
    }
    return false;
}

        ev && ev.engineer_findings_full || ev && ev.engineer_findings || "",

        ev && ev.impacto || "",
        ev && ev.notas || "",

        ev && ev.modelo || ""
    ].join(" | ");
}
function traceOpsDeriveMaterialGap(ev) {
    if (!ev)
        return null;
    var blob = traceOpsMaterialTraceBlob(ev);
    var norm = traceOpsMaterialNorm(blob);
    var eligibleByType = String(ev.tipo_evento || "").toLowerCase() === "material";
    var materialSignals = ["material", "reel", "feeder", "part number", "pn ", " p n ", "wo ", "work order", "checkout", "salida", "kitting", "traceability", "lcr", "wrong reel", "wrong component", "missing material", "falta material", "material mix", "lot", "serial", "scan out", "issue to line"];
    var eligibleByText = traceOpsMaterialIncludesAny(norm, materialSignals);
    if (!eligibleByType && !eligibleByText)
        return null;
    var rules = [
        {
            stage: "LCR / QA release missing",
            missingStep: "Quality release before material movement",
            ownerHint: "Quality",
            tokens: [" lcr ", "lcr vencido", "qa release", "release pending", "liberacion qa", "sin liberacion", "material hold", "hold por lcr", "qa no libero", "qa no libero", "qa not released", "lib release", "release missing"]
        },
        {
            stage: "Material checkout / salida missing",
            missingStep: "Material movement registration before line consumption",
            ownerHint: "Materiales / Kitting",
            tokens: ["checkout", "salida", "scan out", "issue to line", "issue material", "material no descargado", "sin salida", "no checkout", "consumo no registrado", "kitting out", "issue missing", "material issue"]
        },
        {
            stage: "WO / PN linkage incorrect",
            missingStep: "Correct WO-PN-lot-serial validation before use",
            ownerHint: "Materiales / Kitting",
            tokens: ["wo no coincide", "wrong wo", "wrong pn", "pn mismatch", "part number mismatch", "wo pn", "linkage", "serial mismatch", "lot mismatch", "wrong reel", "wrong component", "reel equivocado", "componente equivocado", "material mix", "mix de material"]
        },
        {
            stage: "Handoff without trace",
            missingStep: "Inter-area handoff registration",
            ownerHint: "Produccion / Materiales",
            tokens: ["handoff", "transfer", "traspaso", "entrega", "move to line", "paso a linea", "paso a linea", "sin traza", "sin scan", "sin registro", "no record", "moved without trace", "line side without trace"]
        }
    ];
    var chosen = null;
    for (var i = 0; i < rules.length; i++) {
        var hits = [];
        for (var j = 0; j < rules[i].tokens.length; j++) {
            if (norm.indexOf(rules[i].tokens[j]) >= 0)
                hits.push(rules[i].tokens[j]);
        }
        if (hits.length) {
            chosen = { rule: rules[i], hits: hits };
            break;
        }
    }
    if (!chosen) {
        return {
            traceability_gap_stage: "No traceability gap identified",
            traceability_gap_confidence: eligibleByType ? "Medium" : "Low",
            traceability_gap_basis: eligibleByType ? ["tipo_evento=Material"] : ["material-text-signal"],
            traceability_missing_step: "None inferred",
            traceability_owner_hint: "N/A",
            traceability_is_derived: true,
            traceability_rule_version: "v1.0"
        };
    }
    var confidence = chosen.hits.length >= 2 ? "High" : (eligibleByType ? "Medium" : "Low");
    return {
        traceability_gap_stage: chosen.rule.stage,
        traceability_gap_confidence: confidence,
        traceability_gap_basis: chosen.hits,
        traceability_missing_step: chosen.rule.missingStep,
        traceability_owner_hint: chosen.rule.ownerHint,
        traceability_is_derived: true,
        traceability_rule_version: "v1.0"
    };
}
function traceOpsMaterialEvidenceSummary(ev) {
    var txt = String(ev && (ev.engineer_findings_full || ev.engineer_findings || ev.evento_detectado_full || ev.evento_detectado || ev.accion_requerida || ev.impacto || "")).replace(/\s+/g, " ").trim();
    if (!txt)
        return "-";
    return txt.length > 180 ? txt.slice(0, 179) + "…" : txt;
}

        "Handoff without trace": { bg: "#F5F0FE", border: "#DBCDF8", fg: "#6B2DA8" },

    };
    return map[stage] || map["No traceability gap identified"];
}
function traceOpsDownloadCsv(filename, rows) {
    if (!(rows || []).length)
        return;
    var headers = Object.keys(rows[0] || {});
    var lines = [headers.join(",")].concat(rows.map(function (row) {
        return headers.map(function (h) {
            var v = row[h] == null ? "" : String(row[h]);
            if (/[",\n]/.test(v))
                return '"' + v.replace(/"/g, '""') + '"';
            return v;
        }).join(",");
    }));
    var blob = new Blob([lines.join("\n")], { type: "text/csv;charset=utf-8;" });
    var a = document.createElement("a");
    a.href = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
    a.download = filename;
    a.click();
    URL.revokeObjectURL(a.href);
}

function traceOpsYieldNorm(value) {
    return String(value == null ? "" : value).toLowerCase().normalize("NFD").replace(/[\u0300-\u036f]/g, "").replace(/[^a-z0-9]+/g, " ").trim();
}
function traceOpsYieldCompact(value) { return traceOpsYieldNorm(value).replace(/\s+/g, ""); }
function traceOpsYieldPick(row, names) {
    if (!row)
        return "";
    var keyMap = {};
    Object.keys(row).forEach(function (k) { keyMap[traceOpsYieldCompact(k)] = k; });
    for (var i = 0; i < names.length; i++) {
        var target = traceOpsYieldCompact(names[i]);
        if (keyMap[target] != null)
            return row[keyMap[target]];
    }
    var keys = Object.keys(row);
    for (var n = 0; n < names.length; n++) {
        var wanted = traceOpsYieldCompact(names[n]);
        for (var j = 0; j < keys.length; j++) {
            var ck = traceOpsYieldCompact(keys[j]);
            if (ck.indexOf(wanted) >= 0 || wanted.indexOf(ck) >= 0)
                return row[keys[j]];
        }
    }
    return "";
}
function traceOpsYieldPickFunctionalFailName(row) {
    if (!row)
        return "";
    var primary = String(traceOpsYieldPick(row, ["test info", "Test Info", "TEST INFO", "test_info", "TestInfo", "testinfo"]) || "").trim();
    if (primary && !/^n\/?d$|^n\/?a$/i.test(primary))
        return primary;
    var keyAliases = { testinfo: true, testinformation: true };
    var keys = Object.keys(row || {});
    for (var i = 0; i < keys.length; i++) {
        var compactKey = traceOpsYieldCompact(keys[i]);
        if (keyAliases[compactKey]) {
            var candidate = String(row[keys[i]] || "").trim();
            if (candidate && !/^n\/?d$|^n\/?a$/i.test(candidate))
                return candidate;
        }
    }
    var fallback = String(traceOpsYieldPick(row, ["Failing Test Name", "Falling Test Name", "FailingTestName", "FallingTestName", "Fail Test Name", "Failed Test Name", "Failure Test Name", "TESTNAME", "TestName", "Test Name", "Failure Name", "Failure Symptom", "Symptom", "Failure", "Fail Name"]) || "").trim();
    return fallback;
}
function traceOpsYieldToNumber(value) {
    if (typeof value === "number")
        return value;
    var st = String(value == null ? "" : value).replace(/,/g, "").replace(/%/g, "").trim();
    var n = Number(st);
    return isFinite(n) ? n : 0;
}
function traceOpsYieldCleanWo(value) {
    var st = String(value == null ? "" : value).trim();
    if (!st)
        return "";
    if (/^\d+(\.0+)?$/.test(st))
        st = String(Math.trunc(Number(st)));
    return st;
}
function traceOpsYieldCleanSn(value) {
    var st = String(value == null ? "" : value).trim();
    if (/^\d+(\.0+)?$/.test(st))
        st = String(Math.trunc(Number(st)));
    return st.toUpperCase();
}

function traceOpsYieldIndexByBridge(map, row) {

        k = traceOpsYieldCleanSn(k);
        if (k && !map[k]) map[k] = row;
    });
}
function traceOpsYieldPushByBridge(map, row) {
    if (!map || !row) return;
    var seen = {};
    [row.sn, row.sfcSn, row.bridgeKey, row.parentsernum, row.partsernum, row.repairSn, row.cesiumSn].forEach(function(k) {
        k = traceOpsYieldCleanSn(k);
        if (!k || seen[k]) return;
        seen[k] = true;
        if (!map[k]) map[k] = [];
        map[k].push(row);
    });
}

function traceOpsYieldTopRootcauseFromRepairs(rows) {
    var map = {};
    (rows || []).forEach(function (r) {
        var rc = traceOpsYieldRepairRootcause(r);
        if (!rc)
            return;
        map[rc] = (map[rc] || 0) + 1;
    });
    var keys = Object.keys(map).sort(function (a, b) {
        if (map[b] !== map[a])
            return map[b] - map[a];
        return String(a).localeCompare(String(b));
    });
    return keys[0] || "Sin sintoma";
}

        out.push(loc);
    });

}
function traceOpsYieldParseDate(value) {
    if (value == null || value === "")
        return "";
    if (value instanceof Date && !isNaN(value.getTime()))
        return value.toISOString().slice(0, 16).replace("T", " ");
    if (typeof value === "number") {
        var ms = Math.round((value - 25569) * 86400 * 1000);
        var d = new Date(ms);
        if (!isNaN(d.getTime()))
            return d.toISOString().slice(0, 16).replace("T", " ");
    }
    var st = String(value).trim();
    if (!st)
        return "";
    var d2 = new Date(st.replace(/(\d{1,2})\/(\d{1,2})\/(\d{4})/, "$3-$1-$2"));
    if (!isNaN(d2.getTime()))
        return d2.toISOString().slice(0, 16).replace("T", " ");
    return st;
}
function traceOpsYieldPad2(n) { n = Number(n || 0); return n < 10 ? "0" + n : String(n); }
function traceOpsYieldDateKey(value) {
    if (value == null || value === "")
        return "";
    if (value instanceof Date && !isNaN(value.getTime()))
        return value.getFullYear() + "-" + traceOpsYieldPad2(value.getMonth() + 1) + "-" + traceOpsYieldPad2(value.getDate());
    if (typeof value === "number") {
        var ms = Math.round((value - 25569) * 86400 * 1000);
        var d = new Date(ms);
        if (!isNaN(d.getTime()))
            return d.getUTCFullYear() + "-" + traceOpsYieldPad2(d.getUTCMonth() + 1) + "-" + traceOpsYieldPad2(d.getUTCDate());
    }
    var st = String(value).trim();
    if (!st)
        return "";
    var m = st.match(/^(\d{1,2})[\/\-](\d{1,2})[\/\-](\d{4})/);
    if (m)
        return m[3] + "-" + traceOpsYieldPad2(m[1]) + "-" + traceOpsYieldPad2(m[2]);
    var y = st.match(/^(\d{4})[\/\-](\d{1,2})[\/\-](\d{1,2})/);
    if (y)
        return y[1] + "-" + traceOpsYieldPad2(y[2]) + "-" + traceOpsYieldPad2(y[3]);
    var d2 = new Date(st);
    if (!isNaN(d2.getTime()))
        return d2.getFullYear() + "-" + traceOpsYieldPad2(d2.getMonth() + 1) + "-" + traceOpsYieldPad2(d2.getDate());
    return "";
}
function traceOpsYieldBuildCiscoCalendarMap(calendarRows) {
    var map = {};
    var weekRanges = {};
    (calendarRows || []).forEach(function (row) {
        var key = traceOpsYieldDateKey(traceOpsYieldPick(row, ["Date", "Fecha", "Calendar Date", "Cisco Date"]));
        if (!key)
            return;
        var wf = String(traceOpsYieldPick(row, ["WFCSY", "Cisco Week", "Fiscal Week", "Cisco Fiscal Week", "Week Cisco Full"]) || "").trim();
        var quarter = String(traceOpsYieldPick(row, ["Quarter", "Fiscal Quarter", "Qtr"]) || "").trim();
        var weekCisco = String(traceOpsYieldPick(row, ["Week Cisco", "Cisco Week Number", "Week"]) || "").trim();
        if (!wf || !/FY\d{4}.*W[- ]?\d{1,3}/i.test(wf)) {
            var fy = quarter.match(/FY\d{4}/i);
            var q = quarter.match(/Q\d/i);
            var wk = weekCisco ? ("W-" + String(weekCisco).replace(/^W[- ]?/i, "").padStart(3, "0")) : "";
            wf = [fy ? fy[0].toUpperCase() : "", q ? q[0].toUpperCase() : "", wk].filter(Boolean).join(" ");
        }
        wf = wf || "Imported";
        map[key] = { week: wf, quarter: quarter, weekCisco: weekCisco };
        if (wf && wf !== "Imported") {
            if (!weekRanges[wf])
                weekRanges[wf] = { start: key, end: key };
            if (key < weekRanges[wf].start)
                weekRanges[wf].start = key;
            if (key > weekRanges[wf].end)
                weekRanges[wf].end = key;
        }
    });
    TRACEOPS_YIELD_CISCO_WEEK_RANGES = weekRanges;
    return map;
}
function traceOpsYieldFiscalDateUTC(key) {
    var m = String(key || "").match(/^(\d{4})-(\d{2})-(\d{2})$/);
    if (!m)
        return null;
    return new Date(Date.UTC(Number(m[1]), Number(m[2]) - 1, Number(m[3])));
}
function traceOpsYieldFiscalMonthName(date, lang) {
    if (!date)
        return "";
    var en = ["Jan", "Feb", "Mar", "Apr", "May", "Jun", "Jul", "Aug", "Sep", "Oct", "Nov", "Dec"];
    var es = ["Ene", "Feb", "Mar", "Abr", "May", "Jun", "Jul", "Ago", "Sep", "Oct", "Nov", "Dic"];
    return ((lang === "es") ? es : en)[date.getUTCMonth()] || "";
}
function traceOpsYieldFiscalWeekRangeLabel(week, lang) {
    var ranges = TRACEOPS_YIELD_CISCO_WEEK_RANGES || {};
    var r = ranges[String(week || "").trim()];
    if (!r || !r.start || !r.end)
        return "";
    var a = traceOpsYieldFiscalDateUTC(r.start);
    var b = traceOpsYieldFiscalDateUTC(r.end);
    if (!a || !b)
        return "";
    var sameMonth = a.getUTCFullYear() === b.getUTCFullYear() && a.getUTCMonth() === b.getUTCMonth();
    var sameYear = a.getUTCFullYear() === b.getUTCFullYear();
    var langKey = (lang === "es") ? "es" : "en";
    if (langKey === "es") {
        if (sameMonth)
            return a.getUTCDate() + "-" + b.getUTCDate() + " " + traceOpsYieldFiscalMonthName(b, langKey) + " " + b.getUTCFullYear();
        if (sameYear)
            return a.getUTCDate() + " " + traceOpsYieldFiscalMonthName(a, langKey) + "-" + b.getUTCDate() + " " + traceOpsYieldFiscalMonthName(b, langKey) + " " + b.getUTCFullYear();
        return a.getUTCDate() + " " + traceOpsYieldFiscalMonthName(a, langKey) + " " + a.getUTCFullYear() + "-" + b.getUTCDate() + " " + traceOpsYieldFiscalMonthName(b, langKey) + " " + b.getUTCFullYear();
    }
    if (sameMonth)
        return traceOpsYieldFiscalMonthName(a, langKey) + " " + a.getUTCDate() + "-" + b.getUTCDate() + ", " + b.getUTCFullYear();
    if (sameYear)
        return traceOpsYieldFiscalMonthName(a, langKey) + " " + a.getUTCDate() + "-" + traceOpsYieldFiscalMonthName(b, langKey) + " " + b.getUTCDate() + ", " + b.getUTCFullYear();
    return traceOpsYieldFiscalMonthName(a, langKey) + " " + a.getUTCDate() + ", " + a.getUTCFullYear() + "-" + traceOpsYieldFiscalMonthName(b, langKey) + " " + b.getUTCDate() + ", " + b.getUTCFullYear();
}
function traceOpsYieldResolveCiscoWeek(row, calendarMap) {
    var direct = String(traceOpsYieldPick(row, ["WFCSY", "Cisco Week", "Fiscal Week", "Cisco Fiscal Week", "Week Cisco Full", "Week", "Semana"]) || "").trim();
    if (/FY\d{4}.*W[- ]?\d{1,3}/i.test(direct))
        return direct;
    var dateValue = traceOpsYieldPick(row, ["Build Start Date", "Build Start Date (Month)", "Start Date", "Date", "Fecha", "WO Start Time", "Time Start", "lasteditdt", "Last Edit DT", "Current Event Time"]);
    var key = traceOpsYieldDateKey(dateValue);
    if (key && calendarMap && calendarMap[key] && calendarMap[key].week)
        return calendarMap[key].week;
    return direct || "Imported";
}
function traceOpsYieldClassifyStation(value) {
    var t = traceOpsYieldNorm(value);
    if (!t)
        return "";
    if (/(paste|printer|print|screen print|solder paste|impresion|spi)/.test(t))
        return "";
    if (/(smts*loading|smtloading|loading|load board|loader|smt|aois*2|aoi2|aois*4|aoi4|aoi|optical|placement|picks*place|mounter|reflow)/.test(t))
        return "SMT";
    if (/(router|routing|depanel|depane|vis*2|vi2|vi|visual|inspection|inspeccion|insp|ict|in circuit|pth|presss*fit|pressfit)/.test(t))
        return "PTH";
    if (/(stocks*in|stockin|stock|almacen|wip|store|shipping prep|prep.*ft)/.test(t))
        return "STOCKIN";
    if (/(pcbassy|pcbp2|pcb2c|functional|funcional|final test|fct|ft|test station|station fpy)/.test(t))
        return "FT";
    return "";
}
function traceOpsYieldClassifyFtArea(value) {
    var t = traceOpsYieldNorm(value);
    if (!t)
        return "";
    if (/(pcbassy|pcbp2|pcb2c|functional|funcional|final test|fct|ft|test station|station fpy)/.test(t))
        return "FT";
    return "";
}
function traceOpsYieldSheetRole(sheetName) {
    var n = traceOpsYieldNorm(sheetName);
    if (/cesium|functional test|funcional|ft report|test station|station fpy|fpy test/.test(n))
        return "cesium";
    if (/cisco calendar|cisco calendary|calendar|calendario|fiscal/.test(n))
        return "calendar";
    if (/db model|dbmodel|dm model|dmmodel|model master|modelo maestro|master model|db_model/.test(n))
        return "dbmodel";
    if (/(^|\s)sfc(0\s)|shop floor|shopfloor|current event|sf control/.test(n))
        return "sfc";
    if (/repair|repar|rework|retrab|defect|failure|fail|ng record/.test(n))
        return "repair";
    if (/work order|workorder|orden|\bwo\b|build info|ordenes|orders/.test(n))
        return "wo";
    return "";
}
function traceOpsYieldXmlText(node, tag) { var el = node.getElementsByTagName(tag)[0]; return el ? (el.textContent || "") : ""; }
function traceOpsYieldColFromRef(ref) { var letters = String(ref || "").replace(/[^A-Z]/gi, "").toUpperCase(); var n = 0; for (var i = 0; i < letters.length; i++)
    n = n * 26 + (letters.charCodeAt(i) - 64); return Math.max(0, n - 1); }
function traceOpsYieldParseSharedStrings(xmlText) {
    if (!xmlText)
        return [];
    var doc = new DOMParser().parseFromString(xmlText, "application/xml");
    return Array.prototype.slice.call(doc.getElementsByTagName("si")).map(function (si) {
        return Array.prototype.slice.call(si.getElementsByTagName("t")).map(function (t) { return t.textContent || ""; }).join("");
    });
}
function traceOpsYieldReadCell(cell, sharedStrings) {
    var type = cell.getAttribute("t") || "";
    if (type === "s") {
        var idx = Number(traceOpsYieldXmlText(cell, "v"));
        return sharedStrings[idx] == null ? "" : sharedStrings[idx];
    }
    if (type === "inlineStr")
        return traceOpsYieldXmlText(cell, "t");
    return traceOpsYieldXmlText(cell, "v");
}
function traceOpsYieldRowsFromSheetXml(xmlText, sharedStrings, maxRows) {
    var doc = new DOMParser().parseFromString(xmlText, "application/xml");
    var rowNodes = Array.prototype.slice.call(doc.getElementsByTagName("row"));
    var rawRows = [];
    var limit = Math.min(rowNodes.length, maxRows || 60000);
    for (var r = 0; r < limit; r++) {
        var cells = Array.prototype.slice.call(rowNodes[r].getElementsByTagName("c"));
        var row = [];
        cells.forEach(function (c) { row[traceOpsYieldColFromRef(c.getAttribute("r"))] = traceOpsYieldReadCell(c, sharedStrings); });
        rawRows.push(row);
    }
    return rawRows;
}
function traceOpsYieldHeaderScore(headers, role) {
    var h = headers.map(traceOpsYieldCompact).join("|");
    var score = 0;
    function hasAny(list) { return list.some(function (x) { return h.indexOf(traceOpsYieldCompact(x)) >= 0; }); }
    if (role === "sfc") {
        if (hasAny(["sn", "serial", "serial number"]))
            score += 3;
        if (hasAny(["current event", "event", "station", "proceso actual"]))
            score += 3;
        if (hasAny(["work order", "wo"]))
            score += 2;
        if (hasAny(["model", "sku", "skuno"]))
            score += 1;
    }
    else if (role === "repair") {
        if (hasAny(["sn", "serial", "serial number"]))
            score += 3;
        if (hasAny(["defect", "symptom", "failure", "falla", "defecto"]))
            score += 3;
        if (hasAny(["reference", "location", "refdes", "fail location", "referencia"]))
            score += 2;
        if (hasAny(["part number", "pn", "key fail sku"]))
            score += 1;
    }
    else if (role === "wo") {
        if (hasAny(["work order", "wo", "orden"]))
            score += 3;
        if (hasAny(["line", "line id", "linea"]))
            score += 2;
        if (hasAny(["model", "product family", "skuno", "sku"]))
            score += 2;
        if (hasAny(["time start", "start time", "build start", "start date"]))
            score += 3;
    }
    else if (role === "calendar") {
        if (hasAny(["date", "fecha"]))
            score += 3;
        if (hasAny(["wfcsy", "week cisco", "cisco week", "quarter", "fiscal"]))
            score += 3;
    }
    else if (role === "dbmodel") {
        if (hasAny(["skuno", "sku", "model", "modelo", "part number", "pn", "p_no", "key fail sku"]))
            score += 3;
        if (hasAny(["bu", "business unit", "unidad negocio", "unidad de negocio"]))
            score += 3;
        if (hasAny(["product family", "prodcut family", "model name", "nombre del modelo", "family", "uuttype", "uut type", "description"]))
            score += 3;
    }
    else if (role === "cesium") {
        if (hasAny(["serial number", "serial", "sn"]))
            score += 3;
        if (hasAny(["test area", "area de prueba", "station", "test station"]))
            score += 3;
        if (hasAny(["status", "pass", "fail"]))
            score += 2;
        if (hasAny(["failing test name", "failure test", "test name", "failing test"]))
            score += 2;
        if (hasAny(["record time", "timestamp", "date time", "rec time"]))
            score += 2;
    }
    else if (role === "bom") {
        if (hasAny(["number", "part number", "pn", "component code"]))
            score += 3;
        if (hasAny(["subclass", "type", "component type", "tipo de componente"]))
            score += 3;
        if (hasAny(["description", "descripcion", "component description"]))
            score += 3;
    }
    return score;
}
function traceOpsYieldDetectTextRole(name) {
    var n = traceOpsYieldCompact(name || "");
    if (n.indexOf("cesium") >= 0 || n.indexOf("functionaltest") >= 0 || n.indexOf("teststation") >= 0 || n.indexOf("ftreport") >= 0 || n.indexOf("fpytest") >= 0)
        return "cesium";
    if (n.indexOf("ciscocalendary") >= 0 || n.indexOf("ciscocalendar") >= 0 || n.indexOf("calendario") >= 0 || n.indexOf("fiscalcalendar") >= 0)
        return "calendar";
    if (n.indexOf("dbmodel") >= 0 || n.indexOf("db_model") >= 0 || n.indexOf("dmmodel") >= 0 || n.indexOf("dm_model") >= 0 || n.indexOf("modelmaster") >= 0 || n.indexOf("maestromodelo") >= 0)
        return "dbmodel";
    if (n === "bomtxt" || n.indexOf("bom") >= 0 || n.indexOf("billofmaterial") >= 0 || n.indexOf("componentmaster") >= 0 || n.indexOf("componentlookup") >= 0)
        return "bom";
    if (n.indexOf("sfc") >= 0 || n.indexOf("shopfloor") >= 0 || n.indexOf("currentevent") >= 0)
        return "sfc";
    if (n.indexOf("repair") >= 0 || n.indexOf("repar") >= 0 || n.indexOf("defect") >= 0)
        return "repair";
    if (n.indexOf("stationonlinereport") >= 0 || n.indexOf("workorder") >= 0 || n.indexOf("workorders") >= 0 || n.indexOf("buildinfo") >= 0 || n.indexOf("build") >= 0)
        return "wo";
    return "";
}
function traceOpsYieldParseDelimitedText(text) {
    var raw = String(text || "").replace(/^\uFEFF/, "").replace(/\r\n/g, "\n").replace(/\r/g, "\n");
    var lines = raw.split("\n");
    var sample = [];
    for (var f = 0; f < lines.length && sample.length < 40; f++) {
        if (lines[f] && lines[f].trim())
            sample.push(lines[f]);
    }
    function countDelim(line, ch) {
        var count = 0;
        for (var j = 0; j < String(line).length; j++) {
            if (line[j] === ch)
                count++;
        }
        return count;
    }
    var candidates = ["\t", "|", ";", ","];
    var delimiterMeta = candidates.map(function (ch) {
        var total = 0, max = 0;
        for (var s = 0; s < sample.length; s++) {
            var c = countDelim(sample[s], ch);
            total += c;
            if (c > max)
                max = c;
        }
        return { ch: ch, total: total, max: max };
    }).sort(function (a, b) { return b.total - a.total || b.max - a.max; })[0] || { ch: ",", total: 0 };
    var delimiter = delimiterMeta.ch || ",";
    var whitespaceMode = delimiterMeta.total === 0;
    var rows = [];
    for (var i = 0; i < lines.length; i++) {
        var line = lines[i];
        if (i > 250000)
            break;
        if (!line || !line.trim())
            continue;
        if (whitespaceMode)
            rows.push(line.trim().split(/\s{2,}/).map(function (v) { return String(v == null ? "" : v).trim(); }));
        else if (delimiter === "," && line.indexOf('"') >= 0)
            rows.push(traceOpsYieldCsvSplit(line));
        else
            rows.push(line.split(delimiter).map(function (v) { return String(v == null ? "" : v).trim(); }));
    }
    return rows;
}
function traceOpsYieldCsvSplit(line) {
    var out = [], cur = "", q = false;
    for (var i = 0; i < String(line).length; i++) {
        var ch = line[i];
        if (ch === '"') {
            if (q && line[i + 1] === '"') {
                cur += '"';
                i++;
            }
            else
                q = !q;
        }
        else if (ch === ',' && !q) {
            out.push(cur.trim());
            cur = "";
        }
        else
            cur += ch;
    }
    out.push(cur.trim());
    return out;
}
async function traceOpsYieldTryImportTextZip(file) {
    if (!file || !/\.zip$/i.test(file.name || ""))
        return null;
    await window.ensureZipTools();
    var outer = await JSZip.loadAsync(file);
    var entries = [];
    outer.forEach(function (path, entry) {
        if (entry.dir || /^__MACOSX\//i.test(path))
            return;
        if (/\.(txt|tsv|csv)$/i.test(path)) {
            var role = traceOpsYieldDetectTextRole(path);
            if (role)
                entries.push({ path: path, entry: entry, role: role });
        }
    });
    if (!entries.length)
        return null;
    var parsed = { wo: [], sfc: [], repair: [], calendar: [], dbmodel: [], cesium: [], bom: [] };
    var pulledSheets = [];
    for (var i = 0; i < entries.length; i++) {
        await traceOpsYieldYieldThread();
        var item = entries[i];
        var text = await item.entry.async("string");
        var rawRows = traceOpsYieldParseDelimitedText(text);
        var objects = traceOpsYieldObjectsFromRawRows(rawRows, item.role);
        if (objects.length) {
            parsed[item.role] = parsed[item.role].concat(objects);
            pulledSheets.push({ name: item.path.split('/').pop(), role: item.role, rows: objects.length });
        }
    }
    if (!parsed.wo.length && !parsed.sfc.length && !parsed.repair.length) {
        throw new Error("El ZIP ligero contiene TXT/CSV, pero no se reconocieron encabezados utiles. Revisa que SFC tenga SN/currentevent, Station On Line tenga WO/Date/Line/SKU, y Repair Record tenga SN/FailTime/FailSymptom/FailLocation.");
    }
    return traceOpsYieldBuildFromImported(parsed.wo, parsed.sfc, parsed.repair, {
        source: "ZIP TXT local",
        mode: "text-import",
        fileName: file.name,
        workbookName: "TXT/TSV lightweight package",
        container: file.name,
        sheets: pulledSheets,
        notes: "Import ligero: se procesaron archivos TXT/TSV/CSV locales. No se cargo XLSM, PowerPivot, pivots, macros, estilos ni dashboards pesados. Evidencia visible solo durante esta sesion."
    }, parsed.calendar, parsed.dbmodel, parsed.cesium, parsed.bom);
}
function traceOpsYieldObjectsFromRawRows(rawRows, role) {
    var bestIdx = -1, bestScore = 0;
    for (var i = 0; i < Math.min(rawRows.length, 25); i++) {
        var headers = (rawRows[i] || []).map(function (v) { return String(v == null ? "" : v).trim(); });
        var score = traceOpsYieldHeaderScore(headers, role);
        if (score > bestScore) {
            bestScore = score;
            bestIdx = i;
        }
    }
    if (bestIdx < 0 || bestScore < 3)
        return [];
    var header = (rawRows[bestIdx] || []).map(function (v, idx) { var h = String(v == null ? "" : v).trim(); return h || ("Column_" + (idx + 1)); });
    var out = [];
    for (var r = bestIdx + 1; r < rawRows.length; r++) {
        var arr = rawRows[r] || [];
        var obj = {};
        var nonEmpty = 0;
        for (var c = 0; c < header.length; c++) {
            var val = arr[c];
            if (val != null && String(val).trim() !== "")
                nonEmpty++;
            obj[header[c]] = val == null ? "" : val;
        }
        if (nonEmpty)
            out.push(obj);
    }
    return out;
}
function traceOpsYieldDbModelSku(row) {
    return String(traceOpsYieldPick(row, ["skuno", "SkuNo", "SKU", "P_NO", "P NO", "Part Number", "PN", "Model", "Modelo", "Key_Fail_SKU", "Key Fail SKU", "Product Number", "Number Model", "Model Number"]) || "").trim();
}
function traceOpsYieldDbModelFamily(row) {
    return String(traceOpsYieldPick(row, ["Product Family", "Prodcut Family", "Model Name", "Nombre del Modelo", "Nombre Modelo", "Family", "UUTType", "UUT Type", "UUT Type Name", "Product Family Name", "Description", "Descripcion", "Descripción"]) || "").trim();
}
function traceOpsYieldDbModelBU(row) {
    return String(traceOpsYieldPick(row, ["BU", "Business Unit", "BU Name", "BusinessUnit", "Unidad Negocio", "Unidad de Negocio", "Division", "División"]) || "").trim();
}
function traceOpsYieldBuildDbModelMap(rows) {
    var map = {}, opts = [], seen = {};
    (rows || []).forEach(function (row) {
        var sku = traceOpsYieldDbModelSku(row);
        var family = traceOpsYieldDbModelFamily(row);
        var bu = traceOpsYieldNormalizeBU(traceOpsYieldDbModelBU(row));
        if (!sku && !family)
            return;
        if (!bu || bu === "N/D")
            bu = traceOpsYieldInferBU("", family, sku);
        var rec = { sku: sku, family: family || sku || "N/A", bu: bu };
        if (sku) {
            map[String(sku)] = rec;
            map[traceOpsYieldCompact(sku)] = rec;
        }
        var key = [rec.bu, rec.family, rec.sku].join("|");
        if (!seen[key]) {
            seen[key] = true;
            opts.push(rec);
        }
    });
    TRACEOPS_YIELD_DB_MODEL_MAP = map;
    TRACEOPS_YIELD_DB_MODEL_OPTIONS = opts;
    return map;
}
function traceOpsYieldDbLookup(sku) {
    var map = TRACEOPS_YIELD_DB_MODEL_MAP || {};
    if (!sku)
        return null;
    return map[String(sku)] || map[traceOpsYieldCompact(sku)] || null;
}
function traceOpsYieldLooksLikeSku(value) {
    var v = String(value || "").trim();
    if (!v)
        return false;
    if (/^\d{2,3}-\d{4,6}-\d{2}$/i.test(v))
        return true;
    if (/^\d{2,3}-\d{5,}-\d{1,2}$/i.test(v))
        return true;
    if (/^\d{2,3}-\d{5,}$/i.test(v))
        return true;
    if (/^\d{3,}-\d{3,}/i.test(v))
        return true;
    return false;
}
function traceOpsYieldSafeFamily(candidate, fallback, sku) {
    var c = String(candidate || "").trim();
    var f = String(fallback || "").trim();
    var s = String(sku || "").trim();
    if (c && !traceOpsYieldLooksLikeSku(c) && traceOpsYieldCompact(c) !== traceOpsYieldCompact(s))
        return c;
    if (f && !traceOpsYieldLooksLikeSku(f) && traceOpsYieldCompact(f) !== traceOpsYieldCompact(s))
        return f;
    if (f)
        return f;
    return s || "N/A";
}
function traceOpsYieldApplyDbModel(sku, family, bu) {
    var db = traceOpsYieldDbLookup(sku);
    var outSku = sku || (db && db.sku) || "";
    // DB Model is enrichment only. Do not let catalog/part-number columns replace a real Product Family.
    var outFamily = traceOpsYieldSafeFamily((db && db.family), family, outSku);
    var dbBu = db && db.bu ? traceOpsYieldNormalizeBU(db.bu) : "";
    var explicitBu = bu ? traceOpsYieldNormalizeBU(bu) : "";
    var key = traceOpsYieldNorm([outFamily, outSku].join(' '));
    var familyKnown = /westminster|woodside|hyde park|lancer|tuffnel|tufnell|csf|warwick|maryland|brentwood|shenfield/.test(key);
    var inferredBu = traceOpsYieldInferBU(bu, outFamily, outSku);
    // Priority: explicit SFC BU > known-family inference > DB catalog > fallback inference
    var outBu = familyKnown ? inferredBu : (explicitBu || dbBu || inferredBu);
    return { sku: outSku, family: outFamily, bu: outBu, db: db };
}
function traceOpsYieldSummarizeRisk(rows) {
    var map = {};
    rows.forEach(function (r) {
        var sn = traceOpsYieldCleanSn(r.sn || r.SN);
        var sku = String(r.sku || "N/A");
        var family = traceOpsYieldCleanFamilyLabel(r.family || r.model) || String(r.sku || "N/A");
        var symptom = String(r.symptom || r.defect || "Sin sintoma");
        var location = String(r.location || r.reference || "N/D");
        var componentCode = String(r.componentCode || r.componentPn || r.partNumber || r.pn || "").trim();
        var key = [sku, family, symptom, location, componentCode].join("|");
        if (!map[key])
            map[key] = { bu: traceOpsYieldInferBU(r.bu, family, sku), sku: sku, family: family, symptom: symptom, location: location, componentCode: componentCode, componentPn: componentCode, partNumber: componentCode, risk: 0, serials: [], _sns: {} };
        var snKey = sn || ("row_" + Object.keys(map[key]._sns).length + "_" + Math.random());
        if (!map[key]._sns[snKey]) {
            map[key]._sns[snKey] = true;
            map[key].risk += 1;
            map[key].serials.push({
                sn: sn || "N/D", wo: String(r.wo || r.workOrder || ""), sku: sku, family: family,
                bu: traceOpsYieldInferBU(r.bu, family, sku), symptom: symptom, location: location, componentCode: componentCode, componentPn: componentCode, partNumber: componentCode,
                station: String(r.station || r.currentEvent || ""), week: String(r.week || ""), line: String(r.line || ""),
                event: String(r.event || r.currentEvent || "")
            });
        }
    });
    return Object.keys(map).map(function (k) { var row = map[k]; delete row._sns; return row; }).sort(function (a, b) { return b.risk - a.risk; });
}

function traceOpsYieldParseAttributes(value) {
    try {
        var txt = String(value || "").trim();
        if (!txt || txt[0] !== "{")
            return {};
        return JSON.parse(txt);
    }
    catch (_) {
        return {};
    }
}
function traceOpsYieldStatusKind(value) {
    var v = String(value || "").toLowerCase();
    if (v.indexOf("fail") >= 0)
        return "fail";
    if (v.indexOf("pass") >= 0)
        return "pass";
    return "other";
}
function traceOpsYieldIsSignalSymptom(value) {
    var v = String(value || "").trim();
    if (!v) return false;
    var u = v.toUpperCase();
    if (u === "N/D" || u === "NA" || u === "N/A" || u === "0" || u === "OFFLINE-MANUAL" || u === "MANUAL" || u === "NONE") return false;
    return true;
}
function traceOpsYieldAddCount(map, key, weight) {
    key = String(key || "").trim();
    if (!traceOpsYieldIsSignalSymptom(key)) return;
    map[key] = (map[key] || 0) + (Number(weight || 0) || 1);
}
function traceOpsYieldBuildCesiumRows(cesiumRows, snToSfc, ciscoCalendarMap) {
    var out = [];
    (cesiumRows || []).forEach(function (row, idx) {
        var sn = traceOpsYieldPickSn(row);
        var parent = traceOpsYieldPickParentSn(row);
        var partsernum = traceOpsYieldPickPartSn(row);
        // Cesium reports the functional-test unit SN, while SFC may hold a different carrier/assembly SN.
        // partsernum is the primary bridge; parentsernum is the secondary bridge.
        var bridgeKey = traceOpsYieldBridgeKeyFromParts(sn, parent, partsernum);
        if (!bridgeKey)
            return;
        var sfc = snToSfc[bridgeKey] || snToSfc[sn] || (partsernum ? snToSfc[partsernum] : null) || (parent ? snToSfc[parent] : null);
        if (!sfc)
            return;
        var attrs = traceOpsYieldParseAttributes(traceOpsYieldPick(row, ["Attributes", "attributes", "Attr", "Atributos"]));
        var boardPn = String(attrs["Board_P/N"] || attrs.Board_PN || attrs.BoardPN || "").trim();
        var testArea = String(traceOpsYieldPick(row, ["Test Area", "TestArea", "Area", "Area de Prueba", "Station", "Test Station"]) || "N/D").trim() || "N/D";
        var status = String(traceOpsYieldPick(row, ["Status", "Result", "Pass Fail", "Pass/Fail", "Last Status", "LastStatus"]) || "").trim();
        var kind = traceOpsYieldStatusKind(status);
        var failName = traceOpsYieldPickFunctionalFailName(row);
        var recordTime = traceOpsYieldParseDate(traceOpsYieldPick(row, ["Record Time (US/Mountain)", "Record Time", "Rec Time", "Timestamp", "DateTime", "Date Time", "Fecha Hora", "Fecha"]));
        var machine = String(traceOpsYieldPick(row, ["Machine", "Tester", "Equipo"]) || "").trim();
        var uutType = String(traceOpsYieldPick(row, ["UUT Type", "UUTType", "UUT", "Model"]) || "").trim();
        var assyPn = String(traceOpsYieldPick(row, ["Assy Part Number", "TAN", "Part Number", "PN"]) || "").trim();
        var db = traceOpsYieldApplyDbModel(boardPn || sfc.sku, sfc.family, sfc.bu);
        out.push({
            sn: bridgeKey,
            cesiumSn: sn || "",
            parentsernum: parent,
            partsernum: partsernum,
            bridgeKey: bridgeKey,
            bridgeSource: partsernum ? "partsernum" : (parent ? "parentsernum" : "sn"),
            wo: sfc.wo || "",
            sku: db.sku || boardPn || sfc.sku || "N/A",
            family: db.family || sfc.family || boardPn || "N/A",
            bu: db.bu || sfc.bu || traceOpsYieldInferBU("", sfc.family, sfc.sku),
            line: sfc.line || "",
            week: recordTime ? traceOpsYieldResolveCiscoWeek({ Date: recordTime }, ciscoCalendarMap) : (sfc.week || "Imported"),
            testArea: testArea,
            station: testArea,
            status: status,
            kind: kind,
            pass: kind === "pass" ? 1 : 0,
            fail: kind === "fail" ? 1 : 0,
            failingTestName: failName || (kind === "fail" ? "N/D" : ""),
            machine: machine,
            recordTime: recordTime || "",
            uutType: uutType,
            assyPartNumber: assyPn,
            boardPn: boardPn,
            rawStatus: status,
            __seq: idx
        });
    });
    return out;
}
function traceOpsYieldCesiumTimeValue(row, fallbackIdx) {
    var raw = row && (row.recordTime || row.timestamp || row.dateTime || row.datetime || row.date || row.Date);
    var t = raw ? Date.parse(raw) : NaN;
    return Number.isFinite(t) ? t : Number(fallbackIdx || (row && row.__seq) || 0);
}
function traceOpsYieldBuildLatestCesiumBySN(rows) {
    var latest = {};
    (rows || []).forEach(function(row, idx) {
        var key = traceOpsYieldCleanSn(row.bridgeKey || row.parentsernum || row.sn || row.serial);
        if (!key)
            return;
        var tv = traceOpsYieldCesiumTimeValue(row, idx);
        if (!latest[key] || tv >= latest[key].__timeValue) {
            latest[key] = Object.assign({}, row, { __timeValue: tv, __bridgeKey: key });
        }
    });
    return latest;
}
function traceOpsYieldDisplayTestInfo(row) {
    var txt = String((row && (row.failingTestName || row.testInfo || row.testinfo || row["Test Info"] || row["test info"])) || "").trim();
    if (txt && !/^n\/?d$|^n\/?a$/i.test(txt))
        return txt;
    var kind = row ? (row.kind || traceOpsYieldStatusKind(row.status || row.rawStatus || "")) : "";
    if (kind === "fail")
        return "FAILED";
    return "";
}
function traceOpsYieldBuildCesiumCurrentBreakdown(rows) {
    var latest = traceOpsYieldBuildLatestCesiumBySN(rows || []);
    var map = {};
    Object.keys(latest).forEach(function(key) {
        var r = latest[key];
        var st = String(r.testArea || r.station || "N/D").trim() || "N/D";
        if (!map[st])
            map[st] = { station: st, total: 0, pass: 0, fail: 0, retry: 0, other: 0, serials: [] };
        var x = map[st];
        var kind = r.kind || traceOpsYieldStatusKind(r.status || r.rawStatus || "");
        x.total += 1;
        if (kind === "pass") x.pass += 1;
        else if (kind === "fail") x.fail += 1;
        else if (/retry|retest/i.test(String(r.status || ""))) x.retry += 1;
        else x.other += 1;
        var testInfoLabel = traceOpsYieldDisplayTestInfo(r);
        x.serials.push(Object.assign({}, r, { station: st, symptom: testInfoLabel || r.status || "Last Cesium status", testInfoLabel: testInfoLabel || (kind === "fail" ? "FAILED" : "") }));
    });
    return Object.keys(map).map(function(k) { return map[k]; }).sort(function(a,b) { return b.total - a.total || String(a.station).localeCompare(String(b.station)); });
}
function traceOpsYieldBuildFtAreaRows(rows) {
    var goal = 96;
    var stationSn = {};
    (rows || []).forEach(function (r, idx) {
        var area = String(r.testArea || r.station || "N/D").trim() || "N/D";
        var snKey = traceOpsYieldCleanSn(r.bridgeKey || r.parentsernum || r.sn || r.serial);
        if (!snKey)
            return;
        if (!stationSn[area])
            stationSn[area] = {};
        var current = stationSn[area][snKey];
        var tv = traceOpsYieldCesiumTimeValue(r, idx);
        if (!current || tv < current.__firstTimeValue) {
            stationSn[area][snKey] = Object.assign({}, r, { __firstTimeValue: tv });
        }
    });
    var map = {};
    Object.keys(stationSn).forEach(function(area) {
