        map[area] = { testArea: area, pass: 0, fail: 0, test: 0, failMap: {}, serials: [], machineMap: {}, woMap: {} };
        Object.keys(stationSn[area]).forEach(function(snKey) {
            var r = stationSn[area][snKey];
            var x = map[area];
            var kind = r.kind || traceOpsYieldStatusKind(r.status || r.rawStatus || "");
            x.test += 1;
            if (kind === "pass") {
                x.pass += 1;
            } else if (kind === "fail") {
                x.fail += 1;
                var name = r.failingTestName || "N/D";
                x.failMap[name] = (x.failMap[name] || 0) + 1;
                var corr = traceOpsYieldBestRepairCorrelation(r.sn || snKey, name);
                if (corr) {
                    if (!x.correlationMap) x.correlationMap = {};
                    var corrKey = corr.refdes + "|" + corr.failureMode + "|" + corr.responsibleArea;
                    if (!x.correlationMap[corrKey]) x.correlationMap[corrKey] = { refdes: corr.refdes, failureMode: corr.failureMode, responsibleArea: corr.responsibleArea, confidence: corr.confidence, count: 0, sns: {} };
                    x.correlationMap[corrKey].count += 1;
                    x.correlationMap[corrKey].sns[r.sn || snKey] = true;
                }
                x.serials.push({ sn: r.sn, parentsernum: r.parentsernum, bridgeKey: r.bridgeKey, wo: r.wo, sku: r.sku, family: r.family, bu: r.bu, week: r.week, line: r.line, testArea: r.testArea, status: r.status, failingTestName: name, machine: r.machine, recordTime: r.recordTime, repairCorrelation: corr });
            }
            if (r.machine) x.machineMap[r.machine] = true;
            if (r.wo) x.woMap[r.wo] = true;
        });
    });
    return Object.keys(map).map(function (k) {
        var x = map[k];
        x.yieldPct = x.test ? (x.pass / x.test * 100) : 0;
        x.frPct = x.test ? (x.fail / x.test * 100) : 0;
        x.goalPct = goal;
        x.deltaPct = x.yieldPct - goal;
        x.passToGoal = x.yieldPct >= goal ? 0 : Math.max(0, Math.ceil(((goal / 100) * x.test - x.pass) / (1 - goal / 100)));
        x.topFails = Object.keys(x.failMap).map(function (name) { return { name: name, count: x.failMap[name], share: x.fail ? (x.failMap[name] / x.fail * 100) : 0 }; }).sort(function (a, b) { return b.count - a.count; }).slice(0, 5);
        x.correlations = Object.keys(x.correlationMap || {}).map(function (k) { var c = x.correlationMap[k]; return { refdes: c.refdes, failureMode: c.failureMode, responsibleArea: c.responsibleArea, confidence: c.confidence, count: c.count, snCount: Object.keys(c.sns || {}).length }; }).sort(function(a,b){ return b.count - a.count; }).slice(0,3);
        x.woCount = Object.keys(x.woMap || {}).length;
        x.machineCount = Object.keys(x.machineMap || {}).length;
        x.severity = x.yieldPct >= goal ? "At goal" : (x.deltaPct < -10 ? "Critical" : (x.deltaPct < -3 ? "High" : "Watch"));
        return x;
    }).sort(function (a, b) { return b.fail - a.fail || a.yieldPct - b.yieldPct; });
}
function traceOpsYieldBuildActionTracker(failurePatterns, ftAreaRows, rows) {
    var out = [];
    var id = 1;
    function severityFromQty(qty, rate) {
        if (qty >= 30 || rate >= 10)
            return "Critical";
        if (qty >= 10 || rate >= 5)
            return "High";
        return "Watch";
    }
    (failurePatterns || []).slice(0, 5).forEach(function (p) {
        out.push({
            id: "YF-A" + String(id++).padStart(3, "0"),
            source: "Yield Flow",
            focus: p.pattern,
            context: ((p.refs || []).slice(0, 3).join(", ") || "N/D"),
            units: Number(p.units || 0),
            owner: p.origin === "Handling / SMT" ? "Supervision / Production" : "Process / Test / Mantto",
            actionType: "Containment / Analysis",
            action: "Validate impacted serials, confirm physical evidence and define containment or debug priority.",
            status: "Open",
            severity: severityFromQty(Number(p.units || 0), Number(p.impact || 0)),
            serials: p.serials || []
        });
    });
    (ftAreaRows || []).filter(function (x) { return x.fail > 0; }).slice(0, 4).forEach(function (a) {
        out.push({
            id: "YF-A" + String(id++).padStart(3, "0"),
            source: "Cesium FT",
            focus: a.testArea + " / " + ((a.topFails[0] && a.topFails[0].name) || "N/D"),
            context: "Yield " + traceOpsYieldFlowFmt(a.yieldPct, 2) + "% vs goal " + traceOpsYieldFlowFmt(a.goalPct, 2) + "%",
            units: Number(a.fail || 0),
            owner: "Test Engineering",
            actionType: "FT Debug / Retest control",
            action: "Review failing test name Pareto, tester behavior and retest recovery before opening RCCA.",
            status: "Open",
            severity: a.severity,
            serials: a.serials || []
        });
    });
    (rows || []).slice().sort(function (a, b) {
        var ar = Number(a.total || 0) ? Number(a.risk || 0) / Number(a.total || 0) : 0;
        var br = Number(b.total || 0) ? Number(b.risk || 0) / Number(b.total || 0) : 0;
        return br - ar || Number(b.risk || 0) - Number(a.risk || 0);
    }).slice(0, 3).forEach(function (r) {
        var rate = Number(r.total || 0) ? Number(r.risk || 0) / Number(r.total || 0) * 100 : 0;
        if (!r.risk)
            return;
        out.push({
            id: "YF-A" + String(id++).padStart(3, "0"),
            source: "Critical WO",
            focus: "WO " + r.wo,
            context: (r.family || "N/D") + " · " + (r.sku || "N/D") + " · " + traceOpsYieldFlowFmt(rate, 1) + "% OJT",
            units: Number(r.risk || 0),
            owner: "PM / Project",
            actionType: "Priority push",
            action: "Drive supervisor follow-up by WO criticality and align support areas until units are released.",
            status: "Open",
            severity: severityFromQty(Number(r.risk || 0), rate),
            serials: []
        });
    });
    return out.slice(0, 12);
}

function traceOpsYieldComponentCodeFromRepair(row) {
    return String(traceOpsYieldPick(row || {}, ["ComponentCode", "Component Code", "Component", "Component PN", "Component P/N", "Component Part Number", "Part Number", "PN", "NP", "Numero de Parte", "Número de Parte", "Mfr PN", "Manufacturer PN"]) || "").trim();
}
function traceOpsYieldTopComponentCodeFromRepairs(rows) {
    var map = {};
    (Array.isArray(rows) ? rows : []).forEach(function(row) {
        var code = traceOpsYieldComponentCodeFromRepair(row);
        if (!code) return;
        map[code] = (map[code] || 0) + 1;
    });
    return Object.keys(map).sort(function(a,b) { return map[b] - map[a] || String(a).localeCompare(String(b)); })[0] || "";
}
function traceOpsYieldNormalizeBomNumber(value) {
    return String(value == null ? "" : value).trim().toUpperCase().replace(/\s+/g, "");
}
function traceOpsYieldBuildBomMap(rows) {
    var map = {};
    (Array.isArray(rows) ? rows : []).forEach(function(row) {
        var number = traceOpsYieldNormalizeBomNumber(traceOpsYieldPick(row || {}, ["Number", "Part Number", "Component Code", "ComponentCode", "PN", "P/N", "NP", "Numero de Parte", "Número de Parte"]));
        if (!number) return;
        var subclass = String(traceOpsYieldPick(row || {}, ["Subclass", "Sub Class", "Component Type", "Tipo de Componente", "Type", "Tipo"]) || "").trim();
        var description = String(traceOpsYieldPick(row || {}, ["Description", "Descripcion", "Descripción", "Component Description", "Detalle"]) || "").trim();
        map[number] = { number: number, componentType: subclass, componentDescription: description, subclass: subclass, description: description };
    });
    TRACEOPS_YIELD_BOM_MAP = map;
    return map;
}
function traceOpsYieldBomLookup(componentCode) {
    var key = traceOpsYieldNormalizeBomNumber(componentCode);
    return key && TRACEOPS_YIELD_BOM_MAP ? (TRACEOPS_YIELD_BOM_MAP[key] || null) : null;
}
function traceOpsYieldEnrichComponent(componentCode) {
    var bom = traceOpsYieldBomLookup(componentCode) || {};
    return {
        componentCode: componentCode || "",
        componentPn: componentCode || "",
        partNumber: componentCode || "",
        componentType: bom.componentType || bom.subclass || "",
        componentDescription: bom.componentDescription || bom.description || ""
    };
}

function traceOpsYieldBuildFromImported(workRows, sfcRows, repairRows, sourceMeta, calendarRows, dbModelRows, cesiumRows, bomRows) {
    var woMap = {}, snToSfc = {}, sfcByWo = {}, repairsByWo = {}, repairsClean = [], repairRowsBySnRaw = {};
    var validRepairRawRows = 0;
    var rejectedRepairRows = { noSn: 0, snNotInSfc: 0 };
    var ciscoCalendarMap = traceOpsYieldBuildCiscoCalendarMap(calendarRows || []);
    traceOpsYieldBuildDbModelMap(dbModelRows || []);
    traceOpsYieldBuildBomMap(bomRows || []);
    workRows.forEach(function (row) {
        var wo = traceOpsYieldCleanWo(traceOpsYieldPick(row, ["Work Orde 00000", "Work Order to search", "Work Order", "WO", "WO_NO", "Order", "Orden", "WorkOrder", "WO NO", "WO Number"]));
        if (!wo)
            return;
        var sku = String(traceOpsYieldPick(row, ["P_NO", "skuno", "SkuNo", "SKU", "model", "part number", "pn", "Product", "Modelo"]) || "").trim();
        var family = String(traceOpsYieldPick(row, ["Prodcut Family", "Product Family", "Model Name", "Nombre del Modelo", "Product Family Name", "Family", "Nombre"]) || sku || "N/A").trim();
        var dbWork = traceOpsYieldApplyDbModel(sku, family, traceOpsYieldPick(row, ["BU", "Business Unit", "BU Name", "BusinessUnit"]));
        sku = dbWork.sku || sku;
        family = dbWork.family || family;
        woMap[wo] = {
            wo: wo,
            week: traceOpsYieldResolveCiscoWeek(row, ciscoCalendarMap),
            date: String(traceOpsYieldPick(row, ["Build Start Date", "Start Date", "Date", "Fecha"]) || ""),
            line: String(traceOpsYieldPick(row, ["Line ID", "Line", "Linea", "Línea"]) || ""),
            bu: dbWork.bu,
            family: family,
            sku: sku,
            startSmt: traceOpsYieldParseDate(traceOpsYieldPick(row, ["Time Start", "Start Time", "WO Start Time", "Build Start Time", "Build Start Date", "Start Date", "Fecha Inicio", "Date"])),
            qty: traceOpsYieldToNumber(traceOpsYieldPick(row, ["Build Qty", "Lot Qty", "Qty", "Quantity", "Total Units Processed", "Input", "Lote", "Paste", "REAL_QTY", "STD_QTY", "SN_QTY"]))
        };
    });
    var hasWorkOrderSource = Object.keys(woMap).length > 0;
    sfcRows.forEach(function (row) {
        var sn = traceOpsYieldPickSn(row);
        var wo = traceOpsYieldCleanWo(traceOpsYieldPick(row, ["Work Order to search", "workorderno", "Work Order", "WO", "Order", "Orden", "WorkOrder"]));
        var sku = String(traceOpsYieldPick(row, ["skuno", "SkuNo", "SKU", "model", "part number", "pn", "Modelo"]) || "").trim();
        var family = String(traceOpsYieldPick(row, ["Product Family", "Prodcut Family", "Model Name", "Nombre del Modelo", "Family"]) || "").trim();
        var event = String(traceOpsYieldPick(row, ["currentevent", "Current Event", "Event", "Station", "Current Station", "Proceso Actual", "Current Process"]) || "").trim();
        var eventTime = traceOpsYieldParseDate(traceOpsYieldPick(row, ["lasteditdt", "Last Edit DT", "Current Event Time", "Event Time", "Timestamp", "DateTime", "Date Time", "Rec Time", "Fecha Hora", "Fecha"]));
        var line = String(traceOpsYieldPick(row, ["Line ID", "Line", "productionline", "Linea", "Línea"]) || "").trim();
        var sfcBu = String(traceOpsYieldPick(row, ["BU", "Business Unit", "bu", "businessunit", "Business_Unit", "BU/Division", "Division", "Org", "Organization", "NGFWBU", "Business_Group"]) || "").trim();
        if (!sfcBu && line) { var _linePfx = line.split('-')[0].trim(); if (_linePfx && _linePfx.length > 2 && !/^\d+$/.test(_linePfx)) sfcBu = _linePfx; }
        if (!sfcBu && event) { var _evPfx = event.split('-')[0].trim(); if (_evPfx && _evPfx.length > 2 && !/^\d+$/.test(_evPfx) && !/^(stockin|ict|aoi|smt|spi|pth|ft)$/i.test(_evPfx)) sfcBu = _evPfx; }
        var station = traceOpsYieldClassifyStation(event);
        var dbSfc = traceOpsYieldApplyDbModel(sku, family, sfcBu);
        sku = dbSfc.sku || sku;
        family = dbSfc.family || family;
        var sfcParent = traceOpsYieldPickParentSn(row);
        var sfcPart = traceOpsYieldPickPartSn(row);
        var clean = { sn: sn, sfcSn: sn, parentsernum: sfcParent, partsernum: sfcPart, bridgeKey: traceOpsYieldBridgeKeyFromParts(sn, sfcParent, sfcPart), wo: wo, sku: sku, family: family, bu: traceOpsYieldInferBU(sfcBu, family, sku), event: event, eventTime: eventTime, line: line, station: station, week: traceOpsYieldResolveCiscoWeek(row, ciscoCalendarMap) };
        if (sn)
            snToSfc[sn] = clean;
        traceOpsYieldIndexByBridge(snToSfc, clean);
        if (wo) {
            if (!sfcByWo[wo])
                sfcByWo[wo] = [];
            sfcByWo[wo].push(clean);
            if (!woMap[wo] && !hasWorkOrderSource)
                woMap[wo] = { wo: wo, week: traceOpsYieldResolveCiscoWeek(row, ciscoCalendarMap), date: "", line: line, bu: traceOpsYieldInferBU(sfcBu, family, sku), family: family || sku || "N/A", sku: sku, startSmt: "", qty: 0 };
            if (woMap[wo]) {
                if (!woMap[wo].sku && sku)
                    woMap[wo].sku = sku;
                if ((!woMap[wo].family || woMap[wo].family === "N/A") && family)
                    woMap[wo].family = family;
                if (!woMap[wo].line && line)
                    woMap[wo].line = line;
            }
        }
    });
    TRACEOPS_YIELD_FT_ROWS = traceOpsYieldBuildCesiumRows(cesiumRows || [], snToSfc, ciscoCalendarMap);
    TRACEOPS_YIELD_FT_AREA_ROWS = traceOpsYieldBuildFtAreaRows(TRACEOPS_YIELD_FT_ROWS);
    // SFC is the commanding data source for Yield Flow scope.
    // DB Model is used only to enrich BU/model by SKU, and Station On Line only supplies WO start/time.
    Object.keys(sfcByWo).forEach(function (wo) {
        var list = sfcByWo[wo] || [];
        if (!list.length)
            return;
        var rep = list.find(function (x) { return x.sku || x.family || x.line || x.week || x.bu; }) || list[0] || {};
        var sfcBuAuthority = rep.bu ? traceOpsYieldNormalizeBU(rep.bu) : traceOpsYieldInferBU("", rep.family || "", rep.sku || "");
        if (!woMap[wo]) {
            woMap[wo] = {
                wo: wo,
                week: rep.week || 'Imported',
                date: rep.eventTime ? String(rep.eventTime).slice(0, 10) : '',
                line: rep.line || '',
                bu: sfcBuAuthority,
                family: rep.family || rep.sku || 'N/A',
                sku: rep.sku || 'N/A',
                startSmt: '',
                qty: 0
            };
        }
        else {
            // SFC controls the filter identity: BU, Product Family, SKU, WO, SN.
            // Work Order / DB Model can enrich missing values only; Cesium and Repair must not create scope.
            if (rep.sku)
                woMap[wo].sku = rep.sku;
            if (rep.family)
                woMap[wo].family = rep.family;
            if (sfcBuAuthority)
                woMap[wo].bu = sfcBuAuthority;
            if (rep.line)
                woMap[wo].line = rep.line;
            if ((!woMap[wo].week || woMap[wo].week === 'Imported') && rep.week)
                woMap[wo].week = rep.week;
        }
    });
    repairRows.forEach(function (row) {
        var repairSn = traceOpsYieldPickSn(row);
        var repairParent = traceOpsYieldPickParentSn(row);
        var repairPart = traceOpsYieldPickPartSn(row);
        var repairBridgeKey = traceOpsYieldBridgeKeyFromParts(repairSn, repairParent, repairPart);
        if (!repairBridgeKey) {
            rejectedRepairRows.noSn += 1;
            return;
        }
        var sfc = snToSfc[repairBridgeKey] || snToSfc[repairSn] || (repairPart ? snToSfc[repairPart] : null) || (repairParent ? snToSfc[repairParent] : null);
        if (!sfc) {
            rejectedRepairRows.snNotInSfc += 1;
            return;
        }
        var sn = traceOpsYieldCleanSn((sfc && (sfc.sn || sfc.sfcSn)) || repairBridgeKey);
        validRepairRawRows += 1;
        if (!repairRowsBySnRaw[sn])
            repairRowsBySnRaw[sn] = [];
        repairRowsBySnRaw[sn].push(row);
        var wo = traceOpsYieldCleanWo(traceOpsYieldPick(row, ["Workorderno", "workorderno", "Work Order", "WO", "Order", "Orden", "WorkOrder"])) || (sfc && sfc.wo) || "";
        // SFC is authoritative for product scope. Repair Record SKU columns can be component/fail-SKU
        // and must not reassign the serial to a different model or BU.
        var repairSku = String(traceOpsYieldPick(row, ["SkuNo", "Key_Fail_SKU", "Key Fail SKU", "skuno", "sku", "model", "part number", "pn", "Modelo"]) || "").trim();
        var sku = String((sfc && sfc.sku) || repairSku || "").trim();
        var family = String((sfc && sfc.family) || traceOpsYieldPick(row, ["ModelName", "Model Name", "Product Family", "Prodcut Family", "Family", "Nombre del Modelo"]) || sku || "N/A").trim();
        var rootCause = String(traceOpsYieldPick(row, ["Rootcause", "Root Cause", "RootCause", "Defect", "Failure", "Failure Mode", "Falla", "Defecto"]) || "").trim();
        var repairSymptom = String(traceOpsYieldPick(row, ["FailSymptom", "Fail Symptom", "Failure Symptom", "Symptom", "Test Symptom", "Falling Test Name", "Failing Test Name", "Fail Test Name", "Failed Test Name", "TESTNAME", "TestName", "Test Name", "Failure Name"]) || "").trim();
        var symptom = rootCause || repairSymptom || "Sin sintoma";
        var location = String(traceOpsYieldPick(row, ["FailLocation", "Fail Location", "Location", "Reference", "Reference Designator", "RefDes", "Referencia", "Area"]) || "N/D").trim();
        var pn = traceOpsYieldComponentCodeFromRepair(row);
        var componentInfo = traceOpsYieldEnrichComponent(pn);
        var station = traceOpsYieldClassifyStation(traceOpsYieldPick(row, ["Station", "Process", "Area", "Current Event", "Evento"])) || (sfc && sfc.station) || "";
        var repairTime = traceOpsYieldParseDate(traceOpsYieldPick(row, ["RepairTime", "Repair Time", "Repair Date", "Repaired Date", "Timestamp", "DateTime", "Fecha", "Fecha Hora"]));
        var dbRep = traceOpsYieldApplyDbModel(sku, family, (sfc && sfc.bu) || "");
        // Keep SFC SKU/family/BU if present; DB Model is enrichment only when SFC is blank.
        sku = (sfc && sfc.sku) || dbRep.sku || sku;
        family = (sfc && sfc.family) || dbRep.family || family;
        var side = String(traceOpsYieldPick(row, ["Side", "Lado", "Board Side", "PCB Side"]) || "").trim();
        var actionDesc = String(traceOpsYieldPick(row, ["Actiondesc", "Action Desc", "Action Description", "Repair Action", "Accion", "Acción"]) || "").trim();
        var repairType = String(traceOpsYieldPick(row, ["Type", "Repair Type", "Tipo"]) || "").trim();
        var responsibleArea = traceOpsYieldClassifyResponsibleArea(symptom);
        var clean = { sn: sn, sfcSn: sn, repairSn: repairSn || "", parentsernum: repairParent || (sfc && sfc.parentsernum) || "", partsernum: repairPart || (sfc && sfc.partsernum) || "", bridgeKey: sn, bridgeSource: repairPart ? "partsernum" : (repairParent ? "parentsernum" : "sn"), wo: wo, sku: sku, family: family, symptom: symptom, failureMode: symptom, rootCause: symptom, mode: symptom, repairSymptom: repairSymptom, detectionSymptom: repairSymptom, location: location, refdes: location, failLocation: location, partNumber: componentInfo.partNumber, componentCode: componentInfo.componentCode, componentPn: componentInfo.componentPn, componentType: componentInfo.componentType, componentDescription: componentInfo.componentDescription, station: station, detectionStation: station, responsibleArea: responsibleArea, side: side, actionDesc: actionDesc, repairType: repairType, repairTime: repairTime, eventTime: (sfc && sfc.eventTime) || "", risk: 1, bu: (sfc && sfc.bu) || dbRep.bu, week: (sfc && sfc.week) || traceOpsYieldResolveCiscoWeek(row, ciscoCalendarMap), line: (sfc && sfc.line) || "" };
        repairsClean.push(clean);
        if (wo) {
            if (!repairsByWo[wo])
                repairsByWo[wo] = [];
            repairsByWo[wo].push(clean);
            if (!woMap[wo] && !hasWorkOrderSource)
                woMap[wo] = { wo: wo, week: traceOpsYieldResolveCiscoWeek(row, ciscoCalendarMap), date: "", line: (sfc && sfc.line) || "", bu: traceOpsYieldInferBU("", family, sku), family: family, sku: sku, startSmt: "", qty: 0 };
            if (woMap[wo]) {
                if (!woMap[wo].sku && sku)
                    woMap[wo].sku = sku;
                if ((!woMap[wo].family || woMap[wo].family === "N/A") && family)
                    woMap[wo].family = family;
            }
        }
    });
    var rows = Object.keys(sfcByWo).sort().map(function (wo) {
        var meta = woMap[wo];
        var sfcList = sfcByWo[wo] || [];
        var total = sfcList.length || Number(meta.qty || 0) || 0;
        var rep = repairsByWo[wo] || [];
        var seen = {};
        rep.forEach(function (x) { if (x.sn)
            seen[x.sn] = true; });
        var risk = Object.keys(seen).length;
        var clean = Math.max(0, total - risk);
        return { week: meta.week || "Imported", date: meta.date || (meta.startSmt ? String(meta.startSmt).slice(0, 10) : ""), line: meta.line || "N/D", bu: traceOpsYieldInferBU(meta.bu, meta.family, meta.sku), family: meta.family || meta.sku || "N/A", sku: meta.sku || "N/A", wo: wo, yield: total ? (clean / total * 100) : 0, touch: total ? (risk / total * 100) : 0, total: total, clean: clean, risk: risk };
    }).filter(function (x) { return x.total || x.risk; }).sort(function (a, b) { return b.total - a.total; });
    var topWos = rows.map(function (row) {
        var wo = row.wo, meta = woMap[wo] || {}, sfcList = sfcByWo[wo] || [], repairList = repairsByWo[wo] || [], completedByStation = {}, defectsByStation = {};
        TRACEOPS_YIELD_FLOW_STATIONS.forEach(function (st) { completedByStation[st] = 0; defectsByStation[st] = 0; });
        // Breakdown rule: station volume comes from SFC[currentevent].
        // Count each SN only in its CURRENT station bucket, not cumulatively across previous stations.
        var currentEventSeenByStation = {};
        TRACEOPS_YIELD_FLOW_STATIONS.forEach(function (st) { currentEventSeenByStation[st] = {}; });
        sfcList.forEach(function (sfc) {
            var st = traceOpsYieldClassifyStation(sfc.event || sfc.currentEvent || sfc.station || "");
            if (!st || !Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(TRACEOPS_YIELD_STATION_ORDER, st))
                return;
            var snKey = sfc.sn || (st + "_row_" + completedByStation[st]);
            if (!currentEventSeenByStation[st][snKey]) {
                currentEventSeenByStation[st][snKey] = true;
                completedByStation[st] += 1;
            }
        });
        var defectSeenByStation = {};
        repairList.forEach(function (rep) { var st = rep.responsibleArea || traceOpsYieldClassifyResponsibleArea(rep.rootCause || rep.failureMode || rep.symptom || ""); if (!st || st === "UNCLASSIFIED") st = rep.station || "SMT"; if (!defectSeenByStation[st])
            defectSeenByStation[st] = {}; if (rep.sn && !defectSeenByStation[st][rep.sn]) {
            defectSeenByStation[st][rep.sn] = true;
            if (!defectsByStation[st])
                defectsByStation[st] = 0;
            defectsByStation[st] += 1;
        } });
        var ftSeenBySn = {};
        (TRACEOPS_YIELD_FT_ROWS || []).forEach(function (fr) {
            var frWo = String(fr.wo || "");
            var frNormWo = frWo.replace(/^0+/, "") || frWo;
            var thisNormWo = String(wo || "").replace(/^0+/, "") || String(wo || "");
            if (!(frWo === String(wo || "") || frNormWo === thisNormWo)) return;
            var snKey = traceOpsYieldCleanSn(fr.sn || ("ft_row_" + Object.keys(ftSeenBySn).length));
            if (!ftSeenBySn[snKey]) { ftSeenBySn[snKey] = true; if (completedByStation.FT != null) completedByStation.FT += 1; }
        });
        var ftTimes = (TRACEOPS_YIELD_FT_ROWS || []).filter(function (fr) {
            var frWo = String(fr.wo || "");
            var frNormWo = frWo.replace(/^0+/, "") || frWo;
            var thisNormWo = String(wo || "").replace(/^0+/, "") || String(wo || "");
            return (frWo === String(wo || "") || frNormWo === thisNormWo) && fr.recordTime;
        }).map(function (fr) { return fr.recordTime; }).sort();
        var stockinTimes = sfcList.filter(function (x) { return (x.station === "STOCKIN") && x.eventTime; }).map(function (x) { return x.eventTime; }).sort();
        var recoveryMap = {};
        var recoverySeen = {};
        repairList.forEach(function (rep) { var st = rep.responsibleArea || rep.station || "Repair"; var key = st + "|" + rep.sn; if (recoverySeen[key])
            return; recoverySeen[key] = true; if (!recoveryMap[st])
            recoveryMap[st] = { station: st, qty: 0, totalHours: 0, countHours: 0, cause: rep.symptom || "Repair / debug" }; recoveryMap[st].qty += 1; var outOfFlowTime = rep.eventTime || meta.startSmt; if (rep.repairTime && outOfFlowTime) {
            var hrs = traceOpsYieldFlowHoursBetween(outOfFlowTime, rep.repairTime);
            if (hrs != null) {
                recoveryMap[st].totalHours += hrs;
                recoveryMap[st].countHours += 1;
            }
        } if (rep.symptom && recoveryMap[st].cause === "Repair / debug")
            recoveryMap[st].cause = rep.symptom; });
        var recoveryQueue = Object.keys(recoveryMap).map(function (k) { var r = recoveryMap[k]; return { station: r.station, qty: r.qty, avgHours: r.countHours ? r.totalHours / r.countHours : 0, cause: r.cause }; }).sort(function (a, b) { return b.qty - a.qty; }).slice(0, 3);
        if (!recoveryQueue.length && row.risk)
            recoveryQueue.push({ station: "Repair", qty: row.risk, avgHours: 0, cause: "Repair records imported" });
        return { skuno: row.sku, sku: row.sku, workOrder: wo, wo: wo, model: row.family, family: row.family, bu: row.bu, week: row.week, line: row.line, lotQty: row.total, startSmt: meta.startSmt || "N/D", firstFunctional: ftTimes[0] || "N/D", firstStockin: stockinTimes[0] || "N/D", completedByStation: completedByStation, defectsByStation: defectsByStation, recoveryQueue: recoveryQueue, processTimeline: traceOpsYieldBuildWoProcessTimeline(sfcList, repairList, TRACEOPS_YIELD_FT_ROWS || [], wo) };
    });
    if (rows.length)
        TRACEOPS_YIELD_BY_WO_ROWS = rows;
    if (topWos.length)
        TRACEOPS_YIELD_FLOW_TRACKER = topWos;
    var sfcStoryRows = Object.keys(repairRowsBySnRaw).map(function (sn) {
        var sfc = snToSfc[sn] || {};
        var repList = repairRowsBySnRaw[sn] || [];
        var topComponentCode = traceOpsYieldTopComponentCodeFromRepairs(repList);
        var topComponentInfo = traceOpsYieldEnrichComponent(topComponentCode);
        return {
            sn: sn,
            wo: sfc.wo || "",
            sku: sfc.sku || traceOpsYieldPick(repList[0] || {}, ["SkuNo", "Key_Fail_SKU", "Key Fail SKU", "skuno", "sku", "model", "part number", "pn", "Modelo"]) || "N/A",
            family: sfc.family || traceOpsYieldPick(repList[0] || {}, ["ModelName", "Model Name", "Product Family", "Prodcut Family", "Family", "Nombre del Modelo"]) || "N/A",
            symptom: traceOpsYieldTopRootcauseFromRepairs(repList),
            location: traceOpsYieldFailLocationsFromRepairs(repList),
            componentCode: topComponentInfo.componentCode,
            componentPn: topComponentInfo.componentPn,
            partNumber: topComponentInfo.partNumber,
            componentType: topComponentInfo.componentType,
            componentDescription: topComponentInfo.componentDescription,
            station: sfc.station || traceOpsYieldClassifyStation(traceOpsYieldPick(repList[0] || {}, ["Station", "Process", "Area", "Current Event", "Evento"])),
            event: sfc.event || "",
            week: sfc.week || "",
            line: sfc.line || "",
            risk: 1,
            bu: (sfc.bu || traceOpsYieldApplyDbModel(sfc.sku, sfc.family, "").bu)
        };
    });
    if (sfcStoryRows.length)
        TRACEOPS_RISK_SUMMARY_ROWS = traceOpsYieldSummarizeRisk(sfcStoryRows);
    TRACEOPS_YIELD_SN_TO_SFC = snToSfc;
    var _repBySn = {};
    repairsClean.forEach(function(r) { traceOpsYieldPushByBridge(_repBySn, r); });
    TRACEOPS_YIELD_REPAIRS_BY_SN = _repBySn;
    TRACEOPS_YIELD_IMPORT_META = Object.assign({ source: "ZIP/Excel" }, sourceMeta || {}, { mode: "imported", rows: { workOrders: workRows.length, sfc: sfcRows.length, repairs: repairRows.length, sfcWorkOrders: Object.keys(sfcByWo).length, calendar: (calendarRows || []).length, dbModel: (dbModelRows || []).length, cesium: (cesiumRows || []).length, bom: (bomRows || []).length, bomParts: Object.keys(TRACEOPS_YIELD_BOM_MAP || {}).length, cesiumInScope: (TRACEOPS_YIELD_FT_ROWS || []).length, validRepairs: validRepairRawRows, validRepairSn: (function () { var m = {}; repairsClean.forEach(function (r) { if (r.sn)
                m[r.sn] = true; }); return Object.keys(m).length; })(), storySn: sfcStoryRows.length, rejectedRepairs: rejectedRepairRows }, daxRule: "Risk/OJT = DISTINCTCOUNT(SFC[SN]) where SFC[SN] matches RepairRecord[partsernum] first, then parentsernum, then SN.", storyRule: "Symptom = top Rootcause per SFC[SN] from RepairRecord; Fail Location = distinct RepairRecord[FailLocation] for that SN. Used for the story of why units left the flow.", stationRule: "Breakdown station counts = DISTINCTCOUNT(SFC[SN]) grouped by SFC[currentevent] bucket; non cumulative. Repair defects are attributed to responsible process from Rootcause, not detection station.", calendarRule: "Cisco Week/FY/Qtr resolved from Cisco Calendary.txt by matching Build Start Date or event date to calendar Date/WFCSY." });
    return TRACEOPS_YIELD_IMPORT_META;
}
function traceOpsYieldIsMobileDevice() {
    try {
        return (window.innerWidth <= 900) || /iphone|ipad|ipod|android/i.test(navigator.userAgent || "");
    }
    catch (_) {
        return false;
    }
}
function traceOpsYieldMb(bytes) { return Number(bytes || 0) / 1048576; }
function traceOpsYieldAbortHeavyImport(file, innerEntry) {
    var mobile = traceOpsYieldIsMobileDevice();
    var fileMb = traceOpsYieldMb(file && file.size);
    var innerMb = traceOpsYieldMb(innerEntry && innerEntry._data && innerEntry._data.uncompressedSize);
    var estimatedMb = Math.max(fileMb, innerMb || 0);
    var mobileLimitMb = 8;
    var desktopLimitMb = 140;
    if (mobile && estimatedMb > mobileLimitMb) {
        throw new Error("Import local protegido: archivo de " + estimatedMb.toFixed(1) + " MB. En movil el navegador puede cerrar la pagina al descomprimir XLSM/ZIP. Este modulo no guarda el archivo; solo muestra evidencia temporal. Para este tamaño usa PC/laptop, o genera un ZIP ligero con CSV/Excel reducido: SFC, Work Orders/Build Info y Repair Record.");
    }
    if (estimatedMb > desktopLimitMb) {
        throw new Error("Import local detenido: el Excel estimado supera " + estimatedMb.toFixed(1) + " MB. Para evitar bloqueo del navegador, usa una extraccion ligera con solo SFC, Work Orders/Build Info y Repair Record.");
    }
}
function traceOpsYieldPreflightLocalFile(file) {
    if (!file)
        return;
    var lower = String(file.name || "").toLowerCase();
    var mb = traceOpsYieldMb(file.size);
    var mobile = traceOpsYieldIsMobileDevice();
    if (!/\.(zip|xlsx|xlsm|txt|tsv|csv)$/.test(lower))
        throw new Error("Carga un archivo .zip, .xlsx, .xlsm, .txt, .tsv o .csv para Yield Flow.");
    if (mobile && mb > 8) {
        throw new Error("Import local protegido: el archivo pesa " + mb.toFixed(1) + " MB. En movil se bloquea antes de descomprimir para evitar que Chrome/Safari reinicie la pagina. Este modulo es local y temporal: no conserva el Excel ni evidencia. Usa PC/laptop o sube una version ligera con solo SFC, Work Orders/Build Info y Repair Record.");
    }
    if (mb > 140) {
        throw new Error("Import local detenido: archivo de " + mb.toFixed(1) + " MB. Usa una extraccion ligera; el navegador no debe cargar el libro completo.");
    }
}
function traceOpsYieldYieldThread() { return new Promise(function (resolve) { setTimeout(resolve, 0); }); }
async function traceOpsYieldFindWorkbookFile(file) {
    var lower = String(file && file.name || "").toLowerCase();
    if (/\.(xlsx|xlsm)$/.test(lower)) {
        traceOpsYieldAbortHeavyImport(file, null);
        return { name: file.name, bytes: await file.arrayBuffer(), container: "direct" };
    }
    if (!/\.zip$/.test(lower))
        throw new Error("Carga un .zip, .xlsx o .xlsm.");
    await window.ensureZipTools();
    if (traceOpsYieldIsMobileDevice() && traceOpsYieldMb(file.size) > 8) {
        throw new Error("Import local protegido: el ZIP pesa " + traceOpsYieldMb(file.size).toFixed(1) + " MB. En movil esto puede reiniciar la pagina al descomprimir. Usa PC/laptop o un ZIP ligero con solo SFC, Work Orders/Build Info y Repair Record.");
    }
    var outer = await JSZip.loadAsync(file);
    var candidates = [];
    outer.forEach(function (path, entry) { if (!entry.dir && /\.(xlsx|xlsm)$/i.test(path) && !/^__MACOSX\//i.test(path))
        candidates.push(entry); });
    if (!candidates.length)
        throw new Error("El ZIP no contiene .xlsx/.xlsm.");
    candidates.sort(function (a, b) { return a.name.length - b.name.length; });
    traceOpsYieldAbortHeavyImport(file, candidates[0]);
    return { name: candidates[0].name, bytes: await candidates[0].async("arraybuffer"), container: file.name };
}
async function traceOpsYieldImportExcelZip(file) {
    if (!file)
        throw new Error("No se selecciono archivo.");
    await window.ensureZipTools();
    var lightweight = await traceOpsYieldTryImportTextZip(file);
    if (lightweight)
        return lightweight;
    var wbFile = await traceOpsYieldFindWorkbookFile(file);
    await traceOpsYieldYieldThread();
    var xlsx = await JSZip.loadAsync(wbFile.bytes);
    var workbookEntry = xlsx.file("xl/workbook.xml");
    var relsEntry = xlsx.file("xl/_rels/workbook.xml.rels");
    if (!workbookEntry || !relsEntry)
        throw new Error("El archivo encontrado no parece ser un XLSX/XLSM valido.");
    var workbookXml = await workbookEntry.async("string");
    var relsXml = await relsEntry.async("string");
    var wbDoc = new DOMParser().parseFromString(workbookXml, "application/xml");
    var relDoc = new DOMParser().parseFromString(relsXml, "application/xml");
    var rels = {};
    Array.prototype.slice.call(relDoc.getElementsByTagName("Relationship")).forEach(function (rel) { rels[rel.getAttribute("Id")] = rel.getAttribute("Target"); });
    var parsed = { wo: [], sfc: [], repair: [], calendar: [], dbmodel: [], cesium: [] }, pulledSheets = [], targetSheetFiles = [];
    var sheets = Array.prototype.slice.call(wbDoc.getElementsByTagName("sheet"));
    for (var i = 0; i < sheets.length; i++) {
        var sh = sheets[i], name = sh.getAttribute("name") || ("Sheet" + (i + 1)), role = traceOpsYieldSheetRole(name);
        if (!role)
            continue;
        var rid = sh.getAttribute("r:id") || sh.getAttribute("id"), target = rels[rid];
        if (!target)
            continue;
        var path = target.indexOf("xl/") === 0 ? target : "xl/" + target.replace(/^\//, "");
        path = path.replace(/xl\/xl\//, "xl/");
        var sheetFile = xlsx.file(path);
        if (!sheetFile)
            continue;
        targetSheetFiles.push({ name: name, role: role, file: sheetFile, path: path });
    }
    if (!targetSheetFiles.length)
        throw new Error("No se detectaron hojas por nombre. Esperado: SFC, Work Orders/Build Info y Repair Record.");
    var sharedFile = xlsx.file("xl/sharedStrings.xml");
    var sharedStrings = [];
    if (sharedFile) {
        if (traceOpsYieldIsMobileDevice() && sharedFile._data && traceOpsYieldMb(sharedFile._data.uncompressedSize) > 35) {
            throw new Error("Import protegido: sharedStrings.xml es muy grande para movil. Usa PC/laptop o exporta hojas ligeras como valores.");
        }
        sharedStrings = traceOpsYieldParseSharedStrings(await sharedFile.async("string"));
    }
    for (var t = 0; t < targetSheetFiles.length; t++) {
        await traceOpsYieldYieldThread();
        var info = targetSheetFiles[t];
        var xml = await info.file.async("string");
        var rawRows = traceOpsYieldRowsFromSheetXml(xml, sharedStrings, 25000);
        var objects = traceOpsYieldObjectsFromRawRows(rawRows, info.role);
        if (objects.length) {
            parsed[info.role] = parsed[info.role].concat(objects);
            pulledSheets.push({ name: info.name, role: info.role, rows: objects.length });
        }
    }
    if (!parsed.wo.length && !parsed.sfc.length && !parsed.repair.length)
        throw new Error("No se detectaron filas utiles. Revisa encabezados: SN/current event, WO/time start, defecto/referencia/PN.");
    return traceOpsYieldBuildFromImported(parsed.wo, parsed.sfc, parsed.repair, { fileName: file.name, workbookName: wbFile.name, container: wbFile.container, sheets: pulledSheets, notes: "Import protegido: se procesaron solo hojas objetivo y se limito a 25,000 filas por hoja para evitar reinicios en navegador." }, parsed.calendar, parsed.dbmodel, parsed.cesium);
}
function traceOpsYieldFlowHoursBetween(start, end) {
    var a = new Date(String(start || "").replace(" ", "T"));
    var b = new Date(String(end || "").replace(" ", "T"));
    if (isNaN(a.getTime()) || isNaN(b.getTime()))
        return null;
    return Math.max(0, (b.getTime() - a.getTime()) / 36e5);
}
function traceOpsYieldFlowFmt(value, digits) {
    var n = Number(value || 0);
    if (!isFinite(n))
        n = 0;
    return n.toLocaleString("en-US", { minimumFractionDigits: digits || 0, maximumFractionDigits: digits || 0 });
}
function traceOpsYieldFlowFmtHoursDays(value, digits) {
    if (value == null || value === "" || !isFinite(Number(value)))
        return "N/D";
    var h = Number(value);
    var d = h / 24;
    var hText = traceOpsYieldFlowFmt(h, digits == null ? 1 : digits) + " h";
    var dText = traceOpsYieldFlowFmt(d, 1) + " d";
    return hText + " (" + dText + ")";
}
function traceOpsYieldWeekSortValue(week) {
    var raw = String(week || 'Imported');
    var m = raw.match(/W[- ]?(\d{1,3})/i);
    var y = raw.match(/FY(\d{4})/i);
    var q = raw.match(/Q(\d)/i);
    return (y ? Number(y[1]) : 0) * 1000 + (q ? Number(q[1]) : 0) * 100 + (m ? Number(m[1]) : 0);
}
function traceOpsBuildYieldFlowWeeklyTrend(rows, trackerRows) {
    var ftByWo = {};
    (trackerRows || []).forEach(function (t) {
        var wo = String(t.workOrder || t.wo || '').replace(/^0+/, '') || String(t.workOrder || t.wo || '');
        var done = t.completedByStation || {};
        var ft = Number(done.FT || 0);
        var lead = traceOpsYieldFlowHoursBetween(t.startSmt, t.firstFunctional);
        ftByWo[wo] = { ft: ft, lead: lead };
    });
    var map = {};
    (rows || []).forEach(function (r) {
        var week = String(r.week || 'Imported');
        if (!map[week])
            map[week] = { week: week, total: 0, clean: 0, risk: 0, ft: 0, leadTotal: 0, leadCount: 0, woCount: 0 };
        map[week].total += Number(r.total || 0);
        map[week].clean += Number(r.clean || 0);
        map[week].risk += Number(r.risk || 0);
        map[week].woCount += 1;
        var woKey = String(r.wo || '').replace(/^0+/, '') || String(r.wo || '');
        var ftMeta = ftByWo[woKey] || ftByWo[String(r.wo || '')];
        if (ftMeta) {
            map[week].ft += Number(ftMeta.ft || 0);
            if (ftMeta.lead != null) {
                map[week].leadTotal += ftMeta.lead;
                map[week].leadCount += 1;
            }
        }
    });
    return Object.keys(map).map(function (k) {
        var x = map[k];
        x.period = traceOpsYieldFiscalWeekRangeLabel(x.week, "en");
        x.pendingFt = Math.max(0, x.total - x.ft);
        x.cleanPct = x.total ? (x.clean / x.total * 100) : 0;
        x.ojtPct = x.total ? (x.risk / x.total * 100) : 0;
        x.ftPct = x.total ? (x.ft / x.total * 100) : 0;
        x.avgLeadHours = x.leadCount ? (x.leadTotal / x.leadCount) : null;
        return x;
    }).sort(function (a, b) { return traceOpsYieldWeekSortValue(b.week) - traceOpsYieldWeekSortValue(a.week) || String(b.week).localeCompare(String(a.week)); });
}

function traceOpsBuildYieldFlowStationFpy(rows, trackerRows) {
    var activeByWo = {};
    (rows || []).forEach(function (r) {
        var raw = String(r.wo || '');
        var norm = raw.replace(/^0+/, '') || raw;
        activeByWo[raw] = r;
        activeByWo[norm] = r;
    });
    var stationMap = {};
    TRACEOPS_YIELD_FLOW_STATIONS.forEach(function (st) {
        stationMap[st] = { station: st, expected: 0, current: 0, defects: 0, woMap: {} };
    });
    (trackerRows || []).forEach(function (t) {
        var rawWo = String(t.workOrder || t.wo || '');
        var normWo = rawWo.replace(/^0+/, '') || rawWo;
        var meta = activeByWo[rawWo] || activeByWo[normWo] || null;
        var expected = Number((meta && meta.total) || t.lotQty || 0);
        var completed = t.completedByStation || {};
        var defects = t.defectsByStation || {};
        TRACEOPS_YIELD_FLOW_STATIONS.forEach(function (st) {
            var row = stationMap[st];
            var current = Number(completed[st] || 0);
            var leak = Number(defects[st] || 0);
            row.expected += expected;
            row.current += current;
            row.defects += leak;
            if (current || leak) row.woMap[rawWo || normWo || ('WO-' + Object.keys(row.woMap).length)] = true;
        });
    });
    return TRACEOPS_YIELD_FLOW_STATIONS.map(function (st) {
        var r = stationMap[st];
        var fpy = r.expected ? (Math.max(0, r.current - r.defects) / r.expected * 100) : null;
        var ojt = r.current ? (r.defects / r.current * 100) : (r.expected ? (r.defects / r.expected * 100) : 0);
        var health = 'Normal';
        var tone = { bg: '#F7FAFF', border: '#D9E6F7', text: '#1F3A5F', fill: '#2F6FB3' };
        if (ojt >= 10 || r.defects >= 30) {
            health = 'Critical';
            tone = { bg: '#FFF7F5', border: '#F1B5AE', text: '#A43B2E', fill: '#A43B2E' };
        } else if (ojt >= 5 || r.defects >= 10) {
            health = 'High';
            tone = { bg: '#FFF9EE', border: '#F5E4A0', text: '#B87820', fill: '#D9A441' };
        } else if (ojt > 0) {
            health = 'Watch';
            tone = { bg: '#FBFDFF', border: '#CFE0FB', text: '#1F3A5F', fill: '#4A90E2' };
        }
        return {
            station: st,
            expected: r.expected,
            current: r.current,
            defects: r.defects,
            fpy: fpy,
            ojt: ojt,
            woCount: Object.keys(r.woMap || {}).filter(Boolean).length,
            health: health,
            tone: tone
        };
    }).filter(function (x) { return Number(x.expected || 0) || Number(x.current || 0) || Number(x.defects || 0); });
}

function traceOpsYieldNormalizeSequenceStation(value) {
    var raw = String(value || "").trim().toUpperCase().replace(/\s+/g, "");
    if (!raw) return "";
    var map = {
        "VI1": "VI",
        "VISUALINSP": "VI",
        "PCBASSY1": "PCBASSY",
        "PCBBRIDGE": "PCBBS",
        "O-PCB2C": "OPCB2C",
        "5DXPREP": "FIVE_DX",
        "5DXPROCESS": "5DX",
        "SYSTEMASSY": "SYSASSY",
        "SYSTEMVF": "SYSVF",
        "SYSTEMFT": "SYSFT",
        "PMCHECK": "PCBPM",
        "PM3VALIDATE": "PCBPM3",
        "PCBFTFINAL": "PCBFT"
    };
    if (map[raw]) return map[raw];
    return raw;
}

function traceOpsYieldBuildStationSequenceBreakdown(snToSfc, ftRows) {
    var sequence = TRACEOPS_YIELD_STATION_SEQUENCE || [];
    var seqMap = {};
    sequence.forEach(function (s, idx) {
        var code = traceOpsYieldNormalizeSequenceStation(s.station);
        if (code && !seqMap[code]) seqMap[code] = { no: s.no, station: s.station, qty: 0, idx: idx };
    });
    var snCurrent = {};
    Object.keys(snToSfc || {}).forEach(function (k) {
        var r = snToSfc[k] || {};
        var sn = traceOpsYieldCleanSn(r.sn || r.sfcSn || "");
        if (!sn || snCurrent[sn]) return;
        var st = traceOpsYieldNormalizeSequenceStation(r.event || r.currentEvent || r.station || "");
        snCurrent[sn] = st || "UNMAPPED";
    });
    var latestFtBySn = {};
    (ftRows || []).forEach(function (r) {
        var sn = traceOpsYieldCleanSn(r.sn || r.sfcSn || r.cesiumSn || "");
        if (!sn) return;
        var st = traceOpsYieldNormalizeSequenceStation(r.testArea || r.station || "");
        if (!st) return;
        var tv = r.recordTime ? new Date(r.recordTime).getTime() : NaN;
        var t = isNaN(tv) ? 0 : tv;
        var prev = latestFtBySn[sn];
        if (!prev || t >= prev.t) latestFtBySn[sn] = { station: st, t: t };
    });
    Object.keys(latestFtBySn).forEach(function (sn) { snCurrent[sn] = latestFtBySn[sn].station; });
    Object.keys(snCurrent).forEach(function (sn) {
        var st = snCurrent[sn];
        if (seqMap[st]) seqMap[st].qty += 1;
    });
    var total = Object.keys(snCurrent).length;
    var rows = Object.keys(seqMap).map(function (k) { return seqMap[k]; }).sort(function (a, b) { return a.idx - b.idx; });
    rows.forEach(function (r) { r.flowPct = total ? (r.qty / total * 100) : 0; });
    return { totalUnits: total, rows: rows.filter(function (r) { return r.qty > 0; }), allRows: rows };
}

function traceOpsBuildYieldFlowCauseSummary(rows) {
    var map = {};
    (rows || []).forEach(function (r) {
        var cause = String(r.symptom || r.topSymptom || 'Sin sintoma').trim() || 'Sin sintoma';
        var risk = Number(r.risk || 0);
        var location = String(r.location || r.reference || '').trim();
        var family = traceOpsYieldCleanFamilyLabel(r.family || r.model);
        var sku = String(r.sku || '').trim();
        if (!map[cause])
            map[cause] = { cause: cause, risk: 0, refsMap: {}, familyMap: {}, skuMap: {}, serialMap: {}, symptomMap: {}, testMap: {} };
        map[cause].risk += risk;
        if (location && location !== 'N/D')
            map[cause].refsMap[location] = (map[cause].refsMap[location] || 0) + risk;
        if (family)
            map[cause].familyMap[family] = (map[cause].familyMap[family] || 0) + risk;
        if (sku)
            map[cause].skuMap[sku] = (map[cause].skuMap[sku] || 0) + risk;
        traceOpsYieldAddCount(map[cause].symptomMap, r.repairSymptom || r.detectionSymptom || r.failSymptom || r.FailSymptom, risk || 1);
        traceOpsYieldAddCount(map[cause].testMap, r.failingTestName || r.FailingTestName || r.fallingTestName || r.FallingTestName, risk || 1);
        (r.serials || []).forEach(function (x) {
            var snKey = traceOpsYieldCleanSn(x.sn || x.SN) || [x.wo, x.sku, x.location, Math.random()].join('|');
            if (!map[cause].serialMap[snKey])
                map[cause].serialMap[snKey] = Object.assign({}, x, { symptom: cause, repairSymptom: x.repairSymptom || r.repairSymptom || r.detectionSymptom || '', failingTestName: x.failingTestName || r.failingTestName || '' });
            traceOpsYieldAddCount(map[cause].symptomMap, x.repairSymptom || x.detectionSymptom || x.failSymptom || x.FailSymptom, 1);
            traceOpsYieldAddCount(map[cause].testMap, x.failingTestName || x.FailingTestName || x.fallingTestName || x.FallingTestName, 1);
        });
        if ((!r.serials || !r.serials.length) && (r.sn || r.SN)) {
            var oneSn = traceOpsYieldCleanSn(r.sn || r.SN);
            if (oneSn && !map[cause].serialMap[oneSn])
                map[cause].serialMap[oneSn] = { sn: oneSn, wo: r.wo || '', sku: sku, family: family, symptom: cause, repairSymptom: r.repairSymptom || r.detectionSymptom || '', failingTestName: r.failingTestName || '', location: location, station: r.station || '', week: r.week || '', line: r.line || '' };
        }
    });
    var list = Object.keys(map).map(function (k) {
        var row = map[k];
        var refs = Object.keys(row.refsMap).sort(function (a, b) { return row.refsMap[b] - row.refsMap[a]; }).slice(0, 4);
        var topFamilies = Object.keys(row.familyMap).sort(function (a, b) { return row.familyMap[b] - row.familyMap[a]; }).slice(0, 2);
        var topSkus = Object.keys(row.skuMap).sort(function (a, b) { return row.skuMap[b] - row.skuMap[a]; }).slice(0, 2);
        var serials = Object.keys(row.serialMap || {}).map(function (k) { return row.serialMap[k]; }).sort(function (a, b) { return String(a.sn || '').localeCompare(String(b.sn || '')); });
        var topSymptoms = Object.keys(row.symptomMap || {}).map(function (name) { return { name: name, count: row.symptomMap[name] }; }).sort(function(a,b){ return b.count - a.count; }).slice(0,3);
        var topTests = Object.keys(row.testMap || {}).map(function (name) { return { name: name, count: row.testMap[name] }; }).sort(function(a,b){ return b.count - a.count; }).slice(0,3);
        return { cause: row.cause, risk: row.risk, refs: refs, topFamilies: topFamilies, topSkus: topSkus, topSymptoms: topSymptoms, topTests: topTests, serials: serials };
    }).sort(function (a, b) { return b.risk - a.risk; });
    var total = list.reduce(function (sum, item) { return sum + Number(item.risk || 0); }, 0);
    var cumulative = 0;
    list.forEach(function (item, idx) {
        var prev = cumulative;
        var risk = Number(item.risk || 0);
        item.sharePct = total ? (risk / total * 100) : 0;
        cumulative += risk;
        item.cumulativePct = total ? (cumulative / total * 100) : 0;
        item.isPareto = risk > 1 && (idx === 0 || prev < total * 0.8);
    });
    return list;
}
function traceOpsYieldFlowBarPct(value, max) {
    var n = Number(value || 0);
    var m = Number(max || 0);
    if (!m)
        return 0;
    return Math.max(0, Math.min(100, n / m * 100));
}
function traceOpsYieldInferBU(rawBu, family, sku) {
    var explicit = String(rawBu || '').trim();
    var explicitNorm = explicit.toUpperCase();
    var key = traceOpsYieldNorm([family, sku].join(' '));
    // SFC/family identity is stronger than DB Model BU when the DB catalog carries legacy or mixed labels.
    // This prevents Warwick/CSF/Tuffnel/Maryland from being pulled into FIELDWORKS only because of a catalog row.
    // SFC is the authority for BU. This inference is only a fallback when SFC has no BU.
    // Keep product families in their operational BU; do not let catalog/legacy labels move them.
    if (/woodside|tuffnel|tufnell|csf|warwick|maryland|brentwood|shenfield|ngfw/.test(key))
        return 'NGFWBU';
    if (/westminster|hyde park|fieldwork|fieldworks|lancer/.test(key))
        return 'FIELDWORKS';
    if (explicitNorm && explicitNorm !== 'N/D' && explicitNorm !== 'NA' && explicitNorm !== 'N/A' && explicitNorm !== 'UNKNOWN' && explicitNorm !== 'IMPORTADO' && explicitNorm !== 'IMPORTED')
        return traceOpsYieldNormalizeBU(explicit);
    return explicit ? traceOpsYieldNormalizeBU(explicit) : 'NGFWBU';
}
function traceOpsYieldNormalizeBU(value) {
    var v = String(value || '').trim().toUpperCase();
    if (!v)
        return 'N/D';
    if (v.indexOf('NGFW') >= 0)
        return 'NGFWBU';
    if (v.indexOf('FIELD') >= 0 || v === 'FW' || v.indexOf('FWBU') >= 0)
        return 'FIELDWORKS';
    return String(value || 'N/D').trim();
}
function traceOpsYieldNormFilter(value) { return String(value == null ? '' : value).trim(); }
function traceOpsYieldIsBusinessUnitLabel(value) {
    var v = traceOpsYieldNormalizeBU(value);
    var raw = String(value || '').trim().toUpperCase();
    return v === 'FIELDWORKS' || v === 'NGFWBU' || raw === 'BU' || raw === 'BUSINESS UNIT' || raw === 'FIELDWORK' || raw === 'NGFW';
}
function traceOpsYieldIsInvalidFamilyLabel(value) {
    var v = String(value || '').trim();
    if (!v) return true;
    if (traceOpsYieldIsBusinessUnitLabel(v)) return true;
    if (/^(ALL|TODOS|N\/A|NA|N\/D|UNKNOWN|IMPORTADO|IMPORTED)$/i.test(v)) return true;
    return false;
}
function traceOpsYieldCleanFamilyLabel(value) {
    var v = String(value || '').trim();
    if (traceOpsYieldIsInvalidFamilyLabel(v)) return '';
    return v.replace(/\s*,\s*/g, ' ').replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim();
}
function traceOpsYieldUniqueSorted(values) {
    var seen = {};
    (values || []).forEach(function (v) { v = traceOpsYieldNormFilter(v); if (v)
        seen[v] = true; });
    return Object.keys(seen).sort(function (a, b) { return String(a).localeCompare(String(b)); });
}
function traceOpsYieldMatchesFilter(value, selected) {
    if (!selected || selected === 'ALL')
        return true;
    return String(value || '') === String(selected || '');
}
function traceOpsYieldWoRiskCount(row) {
    if (!row)
        return 0;
    if (row.risk != null)
        return Number(row.risk || 0);
    var defects = row.defectsByStation || {};
    return Object.keys(defects).reduce(function (sum, k) { return sum + Number(defects[k] || 0); }, 0);
}
function traceOpsYieldWoTotalCount(row) {
    if (!row)
        return 0;
    return Number(row.total || row.lotQty || row.units || row.qty || 0);
}
function traceOpsYieldWoSeverity(row) {
    var total = traceOpsYieldWoTotalCount(row);
    var risk = traceOpsYieldWoRiskCount(row);
    var rate = total > 0 ? (risk / total * 100) : 0;
    var sev = { level: 'Normal', short: 'OK', rate: rate, risk: risk, total: total, border: '#D9E6F7', bg: '#fff', soft: '#F8FBFF', text: '#1F3A5F', chipBg: '#EEF5FF' };
    if (rate >= 15)
        return Object.assign(sev, { level: 'Critica', short: 'Critical', border: '#F1B5AE', bg: '#FFF7F5', soft: '#FFF1EE', text: '#A43B2E', chipBg: '#FDEDEA' });
    if (rate >= 10)
        return Object.assign(sev, { level: 'Alta', short: 'High', border: '#F2C185', bg: '#FFF9EE', soft: '#FFF4DE', text: '#B87820', chipBg: '#FFF2D5' });
    if (rate >= 5)
        return Object.assign(sev, { level: 'Media', short: 'Medium', border: '#F5E4A0', bg: '#FFFDF4', soft: '#FFF9E8', text: '#9A6A16', chipBg: '#FEF7D7' });
    if (rate >= 1.5)
        return Object.assign(sev, { level: 'Baja', short: 'Low', border: '#CFE0FB', bg: '#FBFDFF', soft: '#F3F8FF', text: '#1F3A5F', chipBg: '#EEF5FF' });
    return sev;
}
function traceOpsYieldWeekSortDesc(a, b) { return traceOpsYieldWeekSortValue(b) - traceOpsYieldWeekSortValue(a) || String(b).localeCompare(String(a)); }
function traceOpsYieldRiskOrigin(cause) {
    var t = String(cause || '').toUpperCase();
    var responsible = traceOpsYieldClassifyResponsibleArea(cause);
    if (responsible === "SMT")
        return { criticality: 'High', origin: 'SMT', responsibleArea: responsible };
    if (responsible === "PTH")
        return { criticality: 'High', origin: 'PTH', responsibleArea: responsible };
    if (responsible === "FT")
        return { criticality: 'Medium', origin: 'FT', responsibleArea: responsible };
    if (/BGA|REBALL|ASIC|CPU|FPGA|UNDERFILL|U\d{2,}/.test(t))
        return { criticality: 'Critical', origin: 'Process / Repair', responsibleArea: responsible };
    return { criticality: 'Medium', origin: 'UNCLASSIFIED', responsibleArea: responsible };
}

function traceOpsYieldClassifyResponsibleArea(rootcause) {
    var rc = String(rootcause || '').toUpperCase().normalize("NFD").replace(/[\u0300-\u036f]/g, "");
    if (/OPEN\s*SOLDER|INSUFFICIENT\s*SOLDER|SOLDER\s*BRIDGE|MISALIGN|MISALIGNED|FACE\s*UP|REVERSED|WRONG\s*COMPONENT|MISSING\s*COMPONENT|TOMBSTONE|COLD\s*SOLDER|POROUS\s*SOLDER/.test(rc))
        return "SMT";
    if (/SUPPLIER\s*(COMPONENT\s*)?(DEFECT|DEFECTIVE)|DEFECTIVE\s*COMPONENT|DAMAGED|DANADO|DAÑADO|TEST\s*POINT|CONTAMINATION|BROKEN\s*PIN|BENT\s*PIN|CONNECTOR\s*DAMAGE|FRACTURADO|FRACTURED/.test(rc))
        return "PTH";
    if (/HEATSINK|RETEST|ICT\s*PARAMETER|PARAMETER|SCRIPT|TEST\s*SETUP|FIRMWARE|SOFTWARE|FUNCTIONAL|PCB2C|PCBP2|PCBASSY/.test(rc))
        return "FT";
    return "UNCLASSIFIED";
}
function traceOpsYieldResponsibleTone(area) {
    var a = String(area || '').toUpperCase();
    if (a === "SMT") return { bg: "#EAF2FF", border: "#CFE0FB", text: "#1F3A5F" };
    if (a === "PTH") return { bg: "#FFF9EE", border: "#F5E4A0", text: "#B87820" };
    if (a === "FT") return { bg: "#F5F0FE", border: "#DBCDF8", text: "#6B2DA8" };
    return { bg: "#F7FAFF", border: "#D9E6F7", text: "#5F766C" };
}
function traceOpsYieldBestRepairCorrelation(sn, failingTestName) {
    var key = traceOpsYieldCleanSn(sn || "");
    var repairs = (TRACEOPS_YIELD_REPAIRS_BY_SN && TRACEOPS_YIELD_REPAIRS_BY_SN[key]) || [];
    if (!repairs.length) return null;
    var ft = String(failingTestName || '').toUpperCase();
    var exact = null;
    for (var i = 0; i < repairs.length; i++) {
        var ref = String(repairs[i].refdes || repairs[i].failLocation || repairs[i].location || '').toUpperCase();
        if (ref && ref !== 'N/D' && ref !== 'NA' && ft.indexOf(ref) >= 0) { exact = repairs[i]; break; }
    }
    var r = exact || repairs[0];
    var refdes = r.refdes || r.failLocation || r.location || "N/D";
    var area = r.responsibleArea || traceOpsYieldClassifyResponsibleArea(r.rootCause || r.failureMode || r.symptom || "");
    return {
        sn: key,
        refdes: refdes,
        failureMode: r.rootCause || r.failureMode || r.symptom || "N/D",
        responsibleArea: area,
        detectionStation: r.detectionStation || r.station || "N/D",
        confidence: exact ? "High" : "Medium",
        message: exact ? ("Functional symptom matches physical repair at " + refdes + ".") : ("Functional symptom has repair evidence on " + refdes + ".")
    };
}
function traceOpsYieldBuildFtNarrative(area) {
    area = area || {};
    var topFail = (area.topFails && area.topFails[0]) || null;
    var corr = (area.correlations && area.correlations[0]) || null;
    if (!topFail || !corr) return null;
    var station = area.testArea || "N/D";
    var refdes = corr.refdes || "N/D";
    var responsible = corr.responsibleArea || "UNCLASSIFIED";
    var confidence = corr.confidence || (corr.snCount >= 2 ? "High" : "Medium");
    var severity = area.severity || (area.fail >= 3 ? "Critical" : "Watch");
    return {
        title: station + " · " + topFail.name,
        station: station,
        failingTestName: topFail.name,
        refdes: refdes,
        responsibleArea: responsible,
        failureMode: corr.failureMode || "N/D",
        confidence: confidence,
        severity: severity,
        impactedSn: corr.snCount || area.fail || 0,
        failCount: topFail.count || 0,
        yieldPct: area.yieldPct,
        failureRate: area.frPct,
        summary: "El KPI indica un problema activo: el falling test name dominante en " + station + " tiene evidencia de reparacion fisica en " + refdes + ".",
        narrative: "TraceOps correlaciono el sintoma funcional '" + topFail.name + "' con Repair Record sobre " + refdes + ". Esto separa deteccion funcional vs causa real, y atribuye el seguimiento a " + responsible + " segun el root cause.",
        action: "Abrir seguimiento RCCA/tracker para validar evidencia fisica, confirmar alcance por SN/WO y definir contencion sobre " + refdes + "."
    };
}


function traceOpsYieldTopMapKey(map) {
    var keys = Object.keys(map || {}).filter(function(k) { return traceOpsYieldIsSignalSymptom(k); });
    if (!keys.length) return "N/D";
    keys.sort(function(a, b) { return Number(map[b] || 0) - Number(map[a] || 0) || String(a).localeCompare(String(b)); });
    return keys[0] || "N/D";
}
function traceOpsYieldNormalizeStatusLabel(value) {
    var v = String(value || "").trim();
    if (!v) return "Repair evidence";
    if (/pass/i.test(v)) return "PASS";
    if (/fail/i.test(v)) return "FAIL";
    if (/retry|retest/i.test(v)) return "RETRY";
    return v;
}
function traceOpsYieldWoMatches(a, b) {
    var aa = String(a || "");
    var bb = String(b || "");
    var an = aa.replace(/^0+/, "") || aa;
    var bn = bb.replace(/^0+/, "") || bb;
    return !!aa && !!bb && (aa === bb || an === bn);
}
function traceOpsYieldIsMissingText(v) {
    var t = String(v == null ? "" : v).trim();
    if (!t) return true;
    return /^(N\/D|NA|N\/A|NONE|NULL|UNDEFINED|SIN DATO|SIN DATOS|SIN SINTOMA|SIN SÍNTOMA|-|--|—)$/i.test(t);
}
function traceOpsYieldMeaningfulDisplay(v) {
    var t = String(v == null ? "" : v).trim();
    return traceOpsYieldIsMissingText(t) ? "" : t;
}
function traceOpsYieldJoinDisplay(parts, sep) {
    var out = [];
    (parts || []).forEach(function(p) {
        p = traceOpsYieldMeaningfulDisplay(p);
        if (p && out.indexOf(p) < 0) out.push(p);
    });
    return out.join(sep || " · ");
}
function traceOpsYieldBestFtnFromEvidence(ft, rep) {
    ft = ft || {};
    rep = rep || {};
    return traceOpsYieldJoinDisplay([
        ft.failingTestName,
        ft.FailingTestName,
        ft.fallingTestName,
        ft.FallingTestName,
        rep.failingTestName,
        rep.FailingTestName,
        rep.fallingTestName,
        rep.FallingTestName,
        rep.detectionSymptom,
        rep.repairSymptom
    ], " · ");
}
function traceOpsYieldBuildInsightDisplaySignal(ftn, refdes, rootCause, area) {
    var realFtn = traceOpsYieldMeaningfulDisplay(ftn);
    if (realFtn) return realFtn;
    var ref = traceOpsYieldMeaningfulDisplay(refdes);
    var root = traceOpsYieldMeaningfulDisplay(rootCause);
    var ar = traceOpsYieldMeaningfulDisplay(area);
    return traceOpsYieldJoinDisplay([ref, root, ar || "Repair evidence"], " · ") || "Repair evidence";
}
function traceOpsYieldDefaultDueDate(priority) {
    var days = /critical/i.test(priority || "") ? 7 : (/high/i.test(priority || "") ? 14 : 30);
    var d = new Date();
    d.setDate(d.getDate() + days);
    return d.toISOString().slice(0, 10);
}


function traceOpsYieldProcessNode(rawEvent) {
    var e = String(rawEvent || '').toUpperCase().normalize("NFD").replace(/[\u0300-\u036f]/g, "");
    if (!e) return "UNKNOWN";
    if (/PCBP2/.test(e)) return "PCBP2";
    if (/PCB2C|PCB C|PCB-C/.test(e)) return "PCB2C";
    if (/STOCK\s*IN|STOCKIN|FG|FINISH|COMPLETE/.test(e)) return "STOCKIN";
    if (/WAVE|WAVE\s*SOLDER|SOLDER\s*WAVE/.test(e)) return "WAVE";
    if (/VI\s*1|VI1|VISUAL\s*1|VISUAL INSPECTION 1/.test(e)) return "VI1";
    if (/VI\s*2|VI2|VISUAL\s*2|VISUAL INSPECTION 2/.test(e)) return "VI2";
    if (/AOI\s*4|AOI4/.test(e)) return "AOI4";
    if (/AOI\s*2|AOI2/.test(e)) return "AOI2";
    if (/AOI/.test(e)) return "AOI";
    if (/SPI|PASTE|PRINT/.test(e)) return "SMT";
    if (/ICT|FCT|FUNCTIONAL|FT/.test(e)) return "FT";
    if (/PTH|ROUTER|PRESS|INSERT|SELECTIVE|SOLDER/.test(e)) return "PTH";
    if (/SMT|LOADING|PLACEMENT|REFLOW/.test(e)) return "SMT";
    return traceOpsYieldClassifyStation(e) || "UNKNOWN";
}
function traceOpsYieldProcessNodeOrder() {
    return ["SMT", "AOI2", "AOI4", "VI1", "VI2", "WAVE", "PTH", "PCBP2", "PCB2C", "STOCKIN"];
}
function traceOpsYieldBuildWoProcessTimeline(sfcList, repairList, ftRows, wo) {
    var nodes = {}, order = traceOpsYieldProcessNodeOrder(), rawWo = String(wo || ""), normWo = rawWo.replace(/^0+/, "") || rawWo;
    order.forEach(function(n){ nodes[n] = { node: n, snMap: {}, failMap: {}, repairMap: {}, timeMap: {}, examples: [] }; });
    function ensureNode(n) { if (!nodes[n]) nodes[n] = { node: n, snMap: {}, failMap: {}, repairMap: {}, timeMap: {}, examples: [] }; return nodes[n]; }
    function addRow(n, sn, time, opts) {
        opts = opts || {};
        n = n || "UNKNOWN";
        var node = ensureNode(n);
        var key = traceOpsYieldCleanSn(sn || "") || (n + "_row_" + node.examples.length);
        node.snMap[key] = true;
        if (opts.fail) node.failMap[key] = true;
        if (opts.repair) node.repairMap[key] = true;
        if (time && (!node.timeMap[key] || String(time) < String(node.timeMap[key]))) node.timeMap[key] = time;
        if (node.examples.length < 4) node.examples.push({ sn: key, time: time || "", event: opts.event || n, status: opts.status || "" });
    }
    (sfcList || []).forEach(function(r){
        var node = traceOpsYieldProcessNode(r.event || r.currentEvent || r.station || "");
        addRow(node, r.sn || r.sfcSn, r.eventTime || "", { event: r.event || r.station || node, status: r.status || r.result || "" });
    });
    (ftRows || []).forEach(function(fr){
        var frWo = String(fr.wo || ""), frNorm = frWo.replace(/^0+/, "") || frWo;
        if (!(frWo === rawWo || frNorm === normWo)) return;
        var node = traceOpsYieldProcessNode(fr.testArea || fr.station || "FT");
        addRow(node, fr.sn || fr.bridgeKey || fr.parentsernum, fr.recordTime || "", { event: fr.testArea || node, status: fr.status || fr.rawStatus || "", fail: /fail/i.test(String(fr.status || fr.rawStatus || fr.kind || "")) });
    });
    (repairList || []).forEach(function(rep){
        var node = traceOpsYieldProcessNode(rep.station || rep.detectionStation || rep.responsibleArea || "Repair");
        if (node === "UNKNOWN") node = rep.responsibleArea === "PTH" ? "PTH" : (rep.responsibleArea === "FT" ? "FT" : "SMT");
        addRow(node, rep.sn || rep.sfcSn || rep.bridgeKey, rep.repairTime || rep.eventTime || "", { event: rep.rootCause || rep.failureMode || rep.symptom || "Repair evidence", status: "Repair", repair: true, fail: true });
    });
    var list = order.map(function(n){
        var node = nodes[n] || ensureNode(n);
        var units = Object.keys(node.snMap || {}).length;
        var fails = Object.keys(node.failMap || {}).length;
        var repairs = Object.keys(node.repairMap || {}).length;
        var tone = fails || repairs ? "risk" : (units ? "active" : "empty");
        return Object.assign(node, { units: units, fails: fails, repairs: repairs, tone: tone });
    });
    function nodeTimeBySn(name, sn) { var n = nodes[name] || {}; return n.timeMap ? n.timeMap[sn] : ""; }
    function deltaBetween(a, b) {
        var start = nodes[a] || {}, out = [];
        Object.keys(start.timeMap || {}).forEach(function(sn){
            var t1 = start.timeMap[sn], t2 = nodeTimeBySn(b, sn);
            var hrs = traceOpsYieldFlowHoursBetween(t1, t2);
            if (hrs != null) out.push({ sn: sn, from: a, to: b, fromTime: t1, toTime: t2, hours: hrs });
        });
        out.sort(function(x,y){ return y.hours - x.hours; });
        return out;
    }
    var aoi4Vi1 = deltaBetween("AOI4", "VI1");
    var avg = aoi4Vi1.length ? aoi4Vi1.reduce(function(sum,x){ return sum + x.hours; },0) / aoi4Vi1.length : null;
    var max = aoi4Vi1.length ? aoi4Vi1[0].hours : null;
    var outliers = aoi4Vi1.filter(function(x){ return x.hours > 6; });
    var repairSn = {};
    (repairList || []).forEach(function(r){ var sn = traceOpsYieldCleanSn(r.sn || r.sfcSn || r.bridgeKey || ""); if (sn) repairSn[sn] = true; });
    var linkedRepair = aoi4Vi1.filter(function(x){ return repairSn[x.sn]; });
    var oxidationRisk = (repairList || []).filter(function(r){ return /OXID|OXIDE|CORROS|CONTAM|WETTING|SOLDERABILITY|SOLDER/.test(String(r.rootCause || r.failureMode || r.symptom || r.repairSymptom || "").toUpperCase()); }).length;
    return {
        nodes: list,
        criticalDelta: { label: "AOI4 → VI1", samples: aoi4Vi1.length, avgHours: avg, maxHours: max, outliers: outliers.length, linkedRepair: linkedRepair.length, oxidationRisk: oxidationRisk, rows: aoi4Vi1 },
        narrative: aoi4Vi1.length
            ? ("AOI4 → VI1 movement has " + aoi4Vi1.length + " measured SN, avg " + traceOpsYieldFlowFmtHoursDays(avg, 1) + ", max " + traceOpsYieldFlowFmtHoursDays(max, 1) + ". " + linkedRepair.length + " SN also have linked repair evidence.")
            : "AOI4 → VI1 delta needs historical station timestamps. Current scope still shows unit distribution and downstream repair evidence by station."
    };
}
