function traceOpsYieldBuildWoRepairInsight(item) {
    item = item || {};
    var rawWo = String(item.workOrder || item.wo || "");
    if (!rawWo) return null;
    var snScope = {};
    Object.keys(TRACEOPS_YIELD_SN_TO_SFC || {}).forEach(function(snKey) {
        var sfc = TRACEOPS_YIELD_SN_TO_SFC[snKey] || {};
        if (traceOpsYieldWoMatches(sfc.wo, rawWo)) {
            var clean = traceOpsYieldCleanSn(snKey || sfc.sn || "");
            if (clean) snScope[clean] = true;
        }
    });
    (TRACEOPS_YIELD_FT_ROWS || []).forEach(function(fr) {
        if (traceOpsYieldWoMatches(fr.wo, rawWo)) {
            var k = traceOpsYieldCleanSn(fr.bridgeKey || fr.parentsernum || fr.sn || "");
            if (k) snScope[k] = true;
        }
    });
    var snList = Object.keys(snScope);
    if (!snList.length) return null;
    var latestFt = traceOpsYieldBuildLatestCesiumBySN(TRACEOPS_YIELD_FT_ROWS || []);
    var groups = {};
    var allRows = [];
    snList.forEach(function(sn) {
        var sfc = (TRACEOPS_YIELD_SN_TO_SFC && (TRACEOPS_YIELD_SN_TO_SFC[sn] || TRACEOPS_YIELD_SN_TO_SFC[sn.toUpperCase && sn.toUpperCase()] || {})) || {};
        var ft = latestFt[sn] || null;
        var repairs = (TRACEOPS_YIELD_REPAIRS_BY_SN && TRACEOPS_YIELD_REPAIRS_BY_SN[sn]) || [];
        repairs.forEach(function(rep) {
            if (!rep) return;
            var refdes = String(rep.refdes || rep.failLocation || rep.location || "N/D").trim() || "N/D";
            var root = String(rep.rootCause || rep.failureMode || rep.symptom || rep.repairSymptom || "Repair evidence").trim() || "Repair evidence";
            var area = rep.responsibleArea || traceOpsYieldClassifyResponsibleArea(root);
            var realFtn = traceOpsYieldBestFtnFromEvidence(ft, rep);
            var displaySignal = traceOpsYieldBuildInsightDisplaySignal(realFtn, refdes, root, area);
            var ftn = realFtn || displaySignal || "Repair evidence";
            var status = traceOpsYieldNormalizeStatusLabel((ft && (ft.status || ft.rawStatus)) || "Repair evidence");
            var station = String((ft && (ft.testArea || ft.station)) || rep.detectionStation || rep.station || sfc.station || "Repair").trim() || "Repair";
            var key = [ftn, refdes, root, area].join("|");
            if (!groups[key]) {
                groups[key] = { key: key, failingTestName: realFtn || "", displaySignal: displaySignal, displayTitle: displaySignal, refdes: refdes, rootCause: root, failureMode: root, responsibleArea: area, station: station, statusMap: {}, ftnMap: {}, realFtnMap: {}, refMap: {}, rootMap: {}, areaMap: {}, snMap: {}, rows: [], latestStatus: status };
            }
            var g = groups[key];
            g.snMap[sn] = true;
            traceOpsYieldAddCount(g.statusMap, status, 1);
            traceOpsYieldAddCount(g.ftnMap, ftn, 1);
            if (realFtn) traceOpsYieldAddCount(g.realFtnMap, realFtn, 1);
            traceOpsYieldAddCount(g.refMap, refdes, 1);
            traceOpsYieldAddCount(g.rootMap, root, 1);
            traceOpsYieldAddCount(g.areaMap, area, 1);
            if (/FAIL/i.test(status)) g.hasFail = true;
            var row = { sn: sn, sfcSn: sn, cesiumSn: (ft && ft.cesiumSn) || "", repairSn: rep.repairSn || "", parentsernum: (ft && ft.parentsernum) || rep.parentsernum || "", partsernum: (ft && ft.partsernum) || rep.partsernum || "", bridgeKey: (ft && ft.bridgeKey) || rep.bridgeKey || sn, bridgeSource: (ft && ft.bridgeSource) || rep.bridgeSource || "sn", wo: rawWo, sku: item.skuno || item.sku || sfc.sku || rep.sku || "N/A", family: item.model || item.family || sfc.family || rep.family || "N/A", line: item.line || sfc.line || rep.line || "N/D", week: item.week || sfc.week || rep.week || "Imported", station: station, status: status, failingTestName: realFtn || "", displaySignal: displaySignal, symptom: root, failureMode: root, rootCause: root, location: refdes, refdes: refdes, responsibleArea: area, repairTime: rep.repairTime || "", recordTime: (ft && ft.recordTime) || "", source: "Repair_record ↔ Cesium via " + ((ft && ft.bridgeSource) || rep.bridgeSource || "SN") };
            g.rows.push(row);
            allRows.push(row);
        });
    });
    var ranked = Object.keys(groups).map(function(k) {
        var g = groups[k];
        var snCount = Object.keys(g.snMap || {}).length;
        var ftnCount = Number(g.ftnMap[g.failingTestName] || 0);
        var refCount = Number(g.refMap[g.refdes] || 0);
        var score = (snCount * 10) + (ftnCount * 3) + (refCount * 2) + (g.hasFail ? 8 : 0) + (g.responsibleArea && g.responsibleArea !== "UNCLASSIFIED" ? 3 : 0);
        g.impactedSn = snCount;
        g.snCount = snCount;
        g.score = score;
        g.dominantFtn = traceOpsYieldTopMapKey(g.ftnMap);
        g.dominantRealFtn = traceOpsYieldTopMapKey(g.realFtnMap);
        g.dominantRefdes = traceOpsYieldTopMapKey(g.refMap);
        g.dominantRootCause = traceOpsYieldTopMapKey(g.rootMap);
        g.dominantResponsibleArea = traceOpsYieldTopMapKey(g.areaMap);
        g.latestStatus = traceOpsYieldTopMapKey(g.statusMap);
        g.displaySignal = traceOpsYieldBuildInsightDisplaySignal(g.dominantRealFtn, g.dominantRefdes, g.dominantRootCause, g.dominantResponsibleArea);
        g.displayTitle = g.displaySignal || g.dominantFtn || "Repair evidence";
        g.severity = score >= 60 || snCount >= 6 ? "Critical" : (score >= 30 || snCount >= 3 ? "High" : (snCount >= 2 ? "Medium" : "Watch"));
        g.confidence = g.hasFail ? "High" : "Repair-driven";
        if (g.dominantRealFtn) {
            g.summary = "Repair-driven insight: " + snCount + " SN in WO " + rawWo + " share FTN/symptom '" + g.dominantRealFtn + "' with Repair Record evidence at " + g.dominantRefdes + ", dominant root cause '" + g.dominantRootCause + "' and responsible area " + g.dominantResponsibleArea + ".";
        } else {
            g.summary = "Repair-driven insight: " + snCount + " SN in WO " + rawWo + " show linked repair evidence at " + g.dominantRefdes + ", with dominant root cause '" + g.dominantRootCause + "' and responsible area " + g.dominantResponsibleArea + ".";
        }
        g.narrative = "TraceOps found repair evidence even when the latest functional state is " + g.latestStatus + ". The KPI should escalate the " + (g.dominantRealFtn ? "FTN ↔ Repair Record" : "Repair Record ↔ RefDes / Root Cause") + " pattern to validate scope by SN, RefDes and root cause.";
        g.action = "Create RCCA / tracker follow-up for WO " + rawWo + ": confirm affected serial numbers, review physical evidence at " + g.dominantRefdes + ", validate dominant cause and define containment by area " + g.dominantResponsibleArea + ".";
        return g;
    }).sort(function(a, b) { return b.score - a.score || b.snCount - a.snCount || String(a.dominantFtn).localeCompare(String(b.dominantFtn)); });
    if (!ranked.length) return null;
    var top = ranked[0];
    return Object.assign({}, top, { title: "WO " + rawWo + " · " + (top.displayTitle || top.dominantRealFtn || top.dominantFtn || "Repair evidence"), workOrder: rawWo, model: item.model || item.family || "N/A", sku: item.skuno || item.sku || "N/A", allGroups: ranked, allRows: allRows });
}

function traceOpsYieldBuildFailurePatterns(causeSummary) {
    var filtered = (causeSummary || []).filter(function (c) { return Number(c.risk || 0) > 1; });
    var total = filtered.reduce(function (a, c) { return a + Number(c.risk || 0); }, 0);
    var cumulative = 0;
    return filtered.reduce(function (out, c, idx) {
        var prev = cumulative;
        var risk = Number(c.risk || 0);
        cumulative += risk;
        if (!(idx === 0 || prev < total * 0.8))
            return out;
        var tag = traceOpsYieldRiskOrigin(c.cause);
        out.push({
            pattern: c.cause,
            units: risk,
            impact: total ? (risk / total * 100) : 0,
            cumulativePct: total ? (cumulative / total * 100) : 0,
            criticality: tag.criticality,
            origin: tag.origin,
            responsibleArea: tag.responsibleArea || traceOpsYieldClassifyResponsibleArea(c.cause),
            refs: c.refs || [],
            topFamilies: c.topFamilies || [],
            topSkus: c.topSkus || [],
            serials: c.serials || []
        });
        return out;
    }, []).slice(0, 6);
}

function traceOpsYieldValueIsAll(value) {
    return !value || String(value || '') === 'ALL';
}

var TRACEOPS_YIELD_FILTER_INDEX_CACHE = null;
function traceOpsYieldFilterIndexSignature() {
    var sfcLen = TRACEOPS_YIELD_SN_TO_SFC ? Object.keys(TRACEOPS_YIELD_SN_TO_SFC).length : 0;
    var ftLen = TRACEOPS_YIELD_FT_ROWS ? TRACEOPS_YIELD_FT_ROWS.length : 0;
    return [sfcLen, ftLen].join('|');
}
function traceOpsYieldPushUnique(map, key, value) {
    key = String(key || '');
    value = String(value || '').trim();
    if (!key || !value) return;
    if (!map[key]) map[key] = [];
    if (map[key].indexOf(value) < 0) map[key].push(value);
}
function traceOpsYieldGetFilterIndex() {
    var sig = traceOpsYieldFilterIndexSignature();
    if (TRACEOPS_YIELD_FILTER_INDEX_CACHE && TRACEOPS_YIELD_FILTER_INDEX_CACHE.sig === sig) return TRACEOPS_YIELD_FILTER_INDEX_CACHE;
    var idx = { sig: sig, woStations: {}, woCesiumAreas: {}, snToSfc: {} };
    Object.keys(TRACEOPS_YIELD_SN_TO_SFC || {}).forEach(function(snKey) {
        var r = TRACEOPS_YIELD_SN_TO_SFC[snKey] || {};
        var cleanSn = traceOpsYieldCleanSn(snKey || r.sn || r.serial || r.sernum || r.partsernum || r.parentsernum || '');
        if (cleanSn) idx.snToSfc[cleanSn] = r;
        var rawWo = String(r.wo || r.workOrder || r.WO || '');
        var normWo = rawWo.replace(/^0+/, '') || rawWo;
        var station = traceOpsYieldStationValue(r);
        traceOpsYieldPushUnique(idx.woStations, rawWo, station);
        traceOpsYieldPushUnique(idx.woStations, normWo, station);
    });
    (TRACEOPS_YIELD_FT_ROWS || []).forEach(function(r) {
        var rawWo = String(r.wo || r.workOrder || r.WO || '');
        if (!rawWo) {
            var bridge = traceOpsYieldCleanSn(r.bridgeKey || r.partsernum || r.parentsernum || r.sn || r.serial || '');
            var sfc = bridge ? idx.snToSfc[bridge] : null;
            rawWo = String((sfc && (sfc.wo || sfc.workOrder || sfc.WO)) || '');
        }
        var normWo = rawWo.replace(/^0+/, '') || rawWo;
        var area = traceOpsYieldCesiumAreaValue(r);
        traceOpsYieldPushUnique(idx.woCesiumAreas, rawWo, area);
        traceOpsYieldPushUnique(idx.woCesiumAreas, normWo, area);
    });
    Object.keys(idx.woStations).forEach(function(k) { idx.woStations[k].sort(); });
    Object.keys(idx.woCesiumAreas).forEach(function(k) { idx.woCesiumAreas[k].sort(); });
    TRACEOPS_YIELD_FILTER_INDEX_CACHE = idx;
    return idx;
}
function traceOpsYieldStationValue(row) {
    return String((row && (row.station || row.currentEvent || row.event || row.current_event || row.CurrentEvent || row.processStation)) || '').trim();
}
function traceOpsYieldCesiumAreaValue(row) {
    return String((row && (row.testArea || row.test_area || row.station || row.area || row.TestArea || row['Test Area'])) || '').trim();
}
function traceOpsYieldWoStationList(wo) {
    var rawWo = String(wo || '');
    var normWo = rawWo.replace(/^0+/, '') || rawWo;
    var idx = traceOpsYieldGetFilterIndex();
    return (idx.woStations[rawWo] || idx.woStations[normWo] || []);
}
function traceOpsYieldWoCesiumAreaList(wo) {
    var rawWo = String(wo || '');
    var normWo = rawWo.replace(/^0+/, '') || rawWo;
    var idx = traceOpsYieldGetFilterIndex();
    return (idx.woCesiumAreas[rawWo] || idx.woCesiumAreas[normWo] || []);
}
function traceOpsYieldWoHasSfcStation(wo, selected) {
    if (traceOpsYieldValueIsAll(selected)) return true;
    var target = String(selected || '');
    return traceOpsYieldWoStationList(wo).some(function(st) { return st === target; });
}
function traceOpsYieldWoHasCesiumArea(wo, selected) {
    if (traceOpsYieldValueIsAll(selected)) return true;
    var target = String(selected || '');
    return traceOpsYieldWoCesiumAreaList(wo).some(function(area) { return area === target; });
}
function traceOpsYieldCesiumRowMatchesSfcStation(row, selected) {
    if (traceOpsYieldValueIsAll(selected)) return true;
    var wo = row && row.wo;
    if (wo && traceOpsYieldWoHasSfcStation(wo, selected)) return true;
    var sn = traceOpsYieldCleanSn((row && (row.bridgeKey || row.partsernum || row.parentsernum || row.sn)) || '');
    var idx = traceOpsYieldGetFilterIndex();
    var sfc = (idx.snToSfc && idx.snToSfc[sn]) || (TRACEOPS_YIELD_SN_TO_SFC && (TRACEOPS_YIELD_SN_TO_SFC[sn] || TRACEOPS_YIELD_SN_TO_SFC[String(sn || '').toUpperCase()])) || null;
    return !!(sfc && traceOpsYieldStationValue(sfc) === String(selected || ''));
}

function traceOpsBuildYieldFlowModelLocalRaw(filters) {
    filters = filters || {};
    var yieldSnFilter = traceOpsYieldCleanSn(filters.sn || filters.serial || filters.serialNumber || "");
    var yieldSnScopeMap = {};
    var yieldSnWoMap = {};
    if (yieldSnFilter) {
        Object.keys(TRACEOPS_YIELD_SN_TO_SFC || {}).forEach(function(snKey) {
            var cleanKey = traceOpsYieldCleanSn(snKey);
            if (cleanKey && cleanKey.indexOf(yieldSnFilter) >= 0) {
                yieldSnScopeMap[cleanKey] = true;
                var sfc = TRACEOPS_YIELD_SN_TO_SFC[snKey] || TRACEOPS_YIELD_SN_TO_SFC[cleanKey] || {};
                var rawWo = String(sfc.wo || "");
                var normWo = rawWo.replace(/^0+/, "") || rawWo;
                if (rawWo) yieldSnWoMap[rawWo] = true;
                if (normWo) yieldSnWoMap[normWo] = true;
            }
        });
    }
    function yieldSnMatchesValue(value) {
        if (!yieldSnFilter) return true;
        var clean = traceOpsYieldCleanSn(value || "");
        return !!(clean && yieldSnScopeMap[clean]);
    }
    function yieldWoInSnScope(value) {
        if (!yieldSnFilter) return true;
        var rawWo = String(value || "");
        var normWo = rawWo.replace(/^0+/, "") || rawWo;
        return !!(yieldSnWoMap[rawWo] || yieldSnWoMap[normWo]);
    }
    function traceOpsYieldCoerceDateObject(value, boundary) {
        if (value == null || value === "") return null;

        if (value instanceof Date) {
            return isNaN(value.getTime()) ? null : value;
        }

        if (typeof value === "number") {
            var excelDate = new Date(Math.round((value - 25569) * 86400 * 1000));
            return isNaN(excelDate.getTime()) ? null : excelDate;
        }

        var raw = String(value || "").trim();
        if (!raw) return null;

        var monthMatch = raw.match(/^(\\d{4})-(\\d{1,2})$/);
        if (monthMatch) {
            var y = Number(monthMatch[1]);
            var m = Number(monthMatch[2]) - 1;
            if (boundary === "to") return new Date(y, m + 1, 0, 23, 59, 59, 999);
            return new Date(y, m, 1, 0, 0, 0, 0);
        }

        var normalized = traceOpsYieldParseDate(raw);
        var dateText = String(normalized || raw).trim();
        var parsed = new Date(dateText.replace(" ", "T"));

        if (isNaN(parsed.getTime())) {
            parsed = new Date(dateText);
        }

        return isNaN(parsed.getTime()) ? null : parsed;
    }

    function traceOpsYieldRowDateInRange(r) {
        var raw = r && (r.date || r.startSmt || r.buildStart || r.startDate || "");
        var d = traceOpsYieldCoerceDateObject(raw, "row");
        var from = traceOpsYieldCoerceDateObject(filters.from, "from");
        var to = traceOpsYieldCoerceDateObject(filters.to, "to");

        if (!from && !to) return true;
        if (!d) return false;

        if (from && d < from) return false;
        if (to && d > to) return false;

        return true;
    }
    var baseRows = TRACEOPS_YIELD_BY_WO_ROWS.filter(function (item) {
        if (TRACEOPS_YIELD_IMPORT_META && TRACEOPS_YIELD_IMPORT_META.mode === "imported")
            return true;
        return String(item.bu || "").toUpperCase().indexOf("NGFW") >= 0;
    }).map(function (r) {
        // SFC-derived rows are authoritative for filter identity.
        // DB catalog is not allowed to move a model between BUs or replace Product Family.
        var sku = String(r.sku || '').trim();
        var family = traceOpsYieldCleanFamilyLabel(r.family || r.model);
        var bu = r.bu ? traceOpsYieldNormalizeBU(r.bu) : traceOpsYieldInferBU('', family, sku);
        return Object.assign({}, r, { sku: sku || 'N/A', family: traceOpsYieldCleanFamilyLabel(family) || sku || 'N/A', bu: bu, buLabel: bu });
    });
    function rowMatchesCurrentScope(r, ignoreKey) {
        return (ignoreKey === 'bu' || traceOpsYieldMatchesFilter(r.buLabel, filters.bu)) &&
            (ignoreKey === 'family' || traceOpsYieldMatchesFilter(r.family, filters.family)) &&
            (ignoreKey === 'sku' || traceOpsYieldMatchesFilter(r.sku, filters.sku)) &&
            (ignoreKey === 'week' || traceOpsYieldMatchesFilter(r.week, filters.week)) &&
            (ignoreKey === 'line' || traceOpsYieldMatchesFilter(r.line, filters.line)) &&
            (ignoreKey === 'sfcStation' || traceOpsYieldWoHasSfcStation(r.wo, filters.sfcStation)) &&
            (ignoreKey === 'cesiumArea' || traceOpsYieldWoHasCesiumArea(r.wo, filters.cesiumArea)) &&
            (ignoreKey === 'wo' || traceOpsYieldMatchesFilter(String(r.wo || ''), filters.wo)) &&
            yieldWoInSnScope(r.wo) &&
            traceOpsYieldRowDateInRange(r);
    }
    function scopedOptions(key, getter, rejectFn, sorter) {
        var list = [];
        baseRows.filter(function (r) { return rowMatchesCurrentScope(r, key); }).forEach(function(r) {
            var v = getter(r);
            if (Array.isArray(v)) list = list.concat(v);
            else list.push(v);
        });
        list = traceOpsYieldUniqueSorted(list).filter(function (x) { return x && !(rejectFn && rejectFn(x)); });
        return sorter ? list.sort(sorter) : list;
    }
    var options = {
        bu: scopedOptions('bu', function (r) { return r.buLabel; }, function (x) { return x === 'N/D'; }),
        family: scopedOptions('family', function (r) { return traceOpsYieldCleanFamilyLabel(r.family); }, function (x) { return traceOpsYieldIsInvalidFamilyLabel(x) || traceOpsYieldLooksLikeSku(x); }),
        sku: scopedOptions('sku', function (r) { return r.sku; }, function (x) { return x === 'N/A'; }),
        week: scopedOptions('week', function (r) { return r.week; }, function (x) { return x === 'Imported'; }, traceOpsYieldWeekSortDesc),
        line: scopedOptions('line', function (r) { return r.line; }, function (x) { return x === 'N/D'; }),
        sfcStation: scopedOptions('sfcStation', function (r) { return traceOpsYieldWoStationList(r.wo); }, function (x) { return x === 'N/D'; }),
        cesiumArea: scopedOptions('cesiumArea', function (r) { return traceOpsYieldWoCesiumAreaList(r.wo); }, function (x) { return x === 'N/D'; }),
        wo: scopedOptions('wo', function (r) { return String(r.wo || ''); }, function (x) { return x === 'N/D'; })
    };
    var rows = baseRows.filter(function (r) { return rowMatchesCurrentScope(r, null); });
    if (yieldSnFilter) {
        rows = rows.map(function(r) {
            var rawWo = String(r.wo || "");
            var normWo = rawWo.replace(/^0+/, "") || rawWo;
            var totalSn = 0;
            var riskSn = 0;
            Object.keys(TRACEOPS_YIELD_SN_TO_SFC || {}).forEach(function(snKey) {
                var cleanSn = traceOpsYieldCleanSn(snKey);
                if (!yieldSnScopeMap[cleanSn]) return;
                var sfc = TRACEOPS_YIELD_SN_TO_SFC[snKey] || {};
                var sfcWo = String(sfc.wo || "");
                var sfcNormWo = sfcWo.replace(/^0+/, "") || sfcWo;
                if (sfcWo === rawWo || sfcNormWo === normWo) {
                    totalSn += 1;
                    if (TRACEOPS_YIELD_REPAIRS_BY_SN && TRACEOPS_YIELD_REPAIRS_BY_SN[cleanSn] && TRACEOPS_YIELD_REPAIRS_BY_SN[cleanSn].length) riskSn += 1;
                }
            });
            var cleanSnCount = Math.max(0, totalSn - riskSn);
            return Object.assign({}, r, { total: totalSn, risk: riskSn, clean: cleanSnCount, yield: totalSn ? (cleanSnCount / totalSn * 100) : 0, touch: totalSn ? (riskSn / totalSn * 100) : 0 });
        }).filter(function(r) { return Number(r.total || 0) > 0 || Number(r.risk || 0) > 0; });
    }
    var activeWo = {};
    rows.forEach(function (r) { activeWo[String(r.wo || '')] = true; });
    var activeSku = {};
    rows.forEach(function (r) { activeSku[String(r.sku || '')] = true; });
    var activeFamily = {};
    rows.forEach(function (r) { var fam = traceOpsYieldCleanFamilyLabel(r.family); if (fam) activeFamily[fam] = true; });
    var baseRowMetaByWo = {};
    baseRows.forEach(function (r) {
        var rawWo = String(r.wo || '');
        var normWo = rawWo.replace(/^0+/, '') || rawWo;
        baseRowMetaByWo[rawWo] = r;
        baseRowMetaByWo[normWo] = r;
    });
    var trackerRows = TRACEOPS_YIELD_FLOW_TRACKER.filter(function (t) {
        var rawWo = String(t.workOrder || t.wo || '');
        var normWo = rawWo.replace(/^0+/, '') || rawWo;
        var meta = baseRowMetaByWo[rawWo] || baseRowMetaByWo[normWo] || null;
        var family = meta ? meta.family : (t.model || t.family || '');
        var sku = meta ? meta.sku : (t.skuno || t.sku || '');
        var line = meta ? meta.line : (t.line || '');
        var week = meta ? meta.week : (t.week || '');
        var buLabel = meta ? traceOpsYieldInferBU(meta.bu, meta.family, meta.sku) : traceOpsYieldInferBU(t.bu || '', t.model || t.family || '', t.skuno || t.sku || '');
        var basicMatch = traceOpsYieldMatchesFilter(buLabel, filters.bu) &&
            traceOpsYieldMatchesFilter(family, filters.family) &&
            traceOpsYieldMatchesFilter(sku, filters.sku) &&
            traceOpsYieldMatchesFilter(line, filters.line) &&
            traceOpsYieldMatchesFilter(rawWo, filters.wo) &&
            ((!filters.week || filters.week === 'ALL') ? true : (week ? traceOpsYieldMatchesFilter(week, filters.week) : true)) &&
            traceOpsYieldRowDateInRange(meta || { date: t.date || '', startSmt: t.startSmt || '' });
        if (!basicMatch)
            return false;
        if (!rows.length) {
            return TRACEOPS_YIELD_BY_WO_ROWS.length ? false : true;
        }
        if (activeWo[rawWo] || activeWo[normWo])
            return true;
        var hasSpecificIdentityFilter = (!!filters.family && filters.family !== 'ALL') || (!!filters.sku && filters.sku !== 'ALL') || (!!filters.line && filters.line !== 'ALL') || (!!filters.wo && filters.wo !== 'ALL');
        if (hasSpecificIdentityFilter) {
            var familyMatchLoose = !filters.family || filters.family === 'ALL' || traceOpsYieldNorm(family) === traceOpsYieldNorm(filters.family);
            var skuMatch = !filters.sku || filters.sku === 'ALL' || String(sku || '') === String(filters.sku || '');
            var lineMatch = !filters.line || filters.line === 'ALL' || String(line || '') === String(filters.line || '');
            var woMatch = !filters.wo || filters.wo === 'ALL' || String(rawWo || '') === String(filters.wo || '') || String(normWo || '') === String(filters.wo || '').replace(/^0+/, '');
            return familyMatchLoose && skuMatch && lineMatch && woMatch;
        }
        return false;
    });
    if (yieldSnFilter) {
        trackerRows = trackerRows.map(function(t) {
            var rawWo = String(t.workOrder || t.wo || "");
            var normWo = rawWo.replace(/^0+/, "") || rawWo;
            var completedByStation = {};
            var defectsByStation = {};
            TRACEOPS_YIELD_FLOW_STATIONS.forEach(function(st) { completedByStation[st] = 0; defectsByStation[st] = 0; });
            var firstStockin = "N/D";
            var firstFunctional = "N/D";
            var startSmt = "N/D";
            var recoveryMap = {};
            Object.keys(yieldSnScopeMap).forEach(function(snKey) {
                var sfc = TRACEOPS_YIELD_SN_TO_SFC[snKey] || {};
                var sfcWo = String(sfc.wo || "");
                var sfcNormWo = sfcWo.replace(/^0+/, "") || sfcWo;
                if (!(sfcWo === rawWo || sfcNormWo === normWo)) return;
                var st = traceOpsYieldClassifyStation(sfc.event || sfc.currentEvent || sfc.station || "");
                if (st && completedByStation[st] != null) completedByStation[st] += 1;
                if (sfc.eventTime && startSmt === "N/D") startSmt = sfc.eventTime;
                if (st === "STOCKIN" && sfc.eventTime && firstStockin === "N/D") firstStockin = sfc.eventTime;
                var ftSnSeen = false;
                (TRACEOPS_YIELD_FT_ROWS || []).filter(function(fr) { return traceOpsYieldCleanSn(fr.sn) === snKey; }).forEach(function(fr) {
                    if (!ftSnSeen && completedByStation.FT != null) { completedByStation.FT += 1; ftSnSeen = true; }
                    if (fr.recordTime && firstFunctional === "N/D") firstFunctional = fr.recordTime;
                });
                (TRACEOPS_YIELD_REPAIRS_BY_SN && TRACEOPS_YIELD_REPAIRS_BY_SN[snKey] || []).forEach(function(rep) {
                    var rst = rep.station || "Repair";
                    if (defectsByStation[rst] == null) defectsByStation[rst] = 0;
                    defectsByStation[rst] += 1;
                    if (!recoveryMap[rst]) recoveryMap[rst] = { station: rst, qty: 0, totalHours: 0, countHours: 0, cause: rep.symptom || "Repair / debug" };
                    recoveryMap[rst].qty += 1;
                    var outOfFlowTime = rep.eventTime || sfc.eventTime || startSmt;
                    var hrs = traceOpsYieldFlowHoursBetween(outOfFlowTime, rep.repairTime);
                    if (hrs != null) { recoveryMap[rst].totalHours += hrs; recoveryMap[rst].countHours += 1; }
                    if (rep.symptom && recoveryMap[rst].cause === "Repair / debug") recoveryMap[rst].cause = rep.symptom;
                });
            });
            var recoveryQueue = Object.keys(recoveryMap).map(function(k) { var r = recoveryMap[k]; return { station: r.station, qty: r.qty, avgHours: r.countHours ? r.totalHours / r.countHours : 0, cause: r.cause }; }).sort(function(a,b) { return b.qty - a.qty; });
            return Object.assign({}, t, { lotQty: rows.filter(function(r) { return String(r.wo || "") === rawWo || String(r.wo || "").replace(/^0+/, "") === normWo; }).reduce(function(a,r){ return a + Number(r.total || 0); }, 0), startSmt: startSmt, firstFunctional: firstFunctional, firstStockin: firstStockin, completedByStation: completedByStation, defectsByStation: defectsByStation, recoveryQueue: recoveryQueue });
        });
    }
    var totalUnits = rows.reduce(function (sum, item) { return sum + Number(item.total || 0); }, 0);
    var totalClean = rows.reduce(function (sum, item) { return sum + Number(item.clean || 0); }, 0);
    var totalRisk = rows.reduce(function (sum, item) { return sum + Number(item.risk || 0); }, 0);
    var weightedYield = totalUnits ? rows.reduce(function (sum, item) { return sum + (Number(item.yield || 0) * Number(item.total || 0)); }, 0) / totalUnits : 0;
    var weightedTouch = totalUnits ? rows.reduce(function (sum, item) { return sum + (Number(item.touch || 0) * Number(item.total || 0)); }, 0) / totalUnits : 0;
    var flowHours = trackerRows.map(function (item) {
        var target = item.firstFunctional && item.firstFunctional !== 'N/D' ? item.firstFunctional : item.firstStockin;
        return traceOpsYieldFlowHoursBetween(item.startSmt, target);
    }).filter(function (v) { return v != null; });
    var ftHours = trackerRows.map(function (item) { return traceOpsYieldFlowHoursBetween(item.startSmt, item.firstFunctional); }).filter(function (v) { return v != null; });
    var stockinHours = trackerRows.map(function (item) { return traceOpsYieldFlowHoursBetween(item.startSmt, item.firstStockin); }).filter(function (v) { return v != null; });
    var activeWoMeta = {};
    rows.forEach(function (r) {
        var rawWo = String(r.wo || '');
        var normWo = rawWo.replace(/^0+/, '') || rawWo;
        activeWoMeta[rawWo] = r;
        activeWoMeta[normWo] = r;
    });
    var riskRows = TRACEOPS_RISK_SUMMARY_ROWS.map(function (item) {
        var db = traceOpsYieldApplyDbModel(item.sku, item.family, item.bu);
        var itemSku = db.sku || item.sku;
        var itemFamily = db.family || item.family;
        var rowSerials = (item.serials || []).map(function (x) {
            var rawWo = String(x.wo || '');
            var normWo = rawWo.replace(/^0+/, '') || rawWo;
            var meta = activeWoMeta[rawWo] || activeWoMeta[normWo] || null;
            return Object.assign({}, x, {
                wo: rawWo,
                sku: meta ? meta.sku : (x.sku || itemSku),
                family: meta ? meta.family : (x.family || itemFamily),
                bu: meta ? meta.buLabel : traceOpsYieldInferBU(x.bu || item.bu, itemFamily, itemSku),
                week: meta ? meta.week : x.week,
                line: meta ? meta.line : x.line
            });
        }).filter(function (x) {
            var rawWo = String(x.wo || '');
            var normWo = rawWo.replace(/^0+/, '') || rawWo;
            return !!(activeWoMeta[rawWo] || activeWoMeta[normWo]) && yieldSnMatchesValue(x.sn);
        });
        var dominantMeta = rowSerials[0] || {};
        return Object.assign({}, item, {
            sku: dominantMeta.sku || itemSku,
            family: dominantMeta.family || itemFamily,
            bu: dominantMeta.bu || db.bu,
            serials: rowSerials,
            risk: rowSerials.length
        });
    }).filter(function (item) {
        return Number(item.risk || 0) > 0;
    });
    var riskBySku = {};
    riskRows.forEach(function (item) {
        var sku = item.sku || "N/A";
        if (!riskBySku[sku])
            riskBySku[sku] = { sku: sku, family: item.family || "N/A", risk: 0, symptomMap: {}, serialMap: {} };
        riskBySku[sku].risk += Number(item.risk || 0);
        riskBySku[sku].symptomMap[item.symptom || "Sin sintoma"] = (riskBySku[sku].symptomMap[item.symptom || "Sin sintoma"] || 0) + Number(item.risk || 0);
        (item.serials || []).forEach(function (x) { var snKey = traceOpsYieldCleanSn(x.sn || x.SN) || [x.wo, x.location, Math.random()].join('|'); if (!riskBySku[sku].serialMap[snKey])
            riskBySku[sku].serialMap[snKey] = Object.assign({}, x, { sku: sku, family: item.family || x.family || 'N/A' }); });
    });
    var topRiskSku = Object.keys(riskBySku).map(function (key) {
        var row = riskBySku[key];
        var symptom = Object.keys(row.symptomMap).sort(function (a, b) { return row.symptomMap[b] - row.symptomMap[a]; })[0] || "Sin sintoma";
        var serials = Object.keys(row.serialMap || {}).map(function (k) { return row.serialMap[k]; }).sort(function (a, b) { return String(a.sn || '').localeCompare(String(b.sn || '')); });
        return { sku: row.sku, family: row.family, risk: row.risk, topSymptom: symptom, serials: serials };
    }).sort(function (a, b) { return b.risk - a.risk; }).slice(0, 6);
    var weeklyTrend = traceOpsBuildYieldFlowWeeklyTrend(rows, trackerRows);
    var causeSummary = traceOpsBuildYieldFlowCauseSummary(riskRows);
    var failurePatterns = traceOpsYieldBuildFailurePatterns(causeSummary);
    var stationFpy = traceOpsBuildYieldFlowStationFpy(rows, trackerRows);
    var ftRows = (TRACEOPS_YIELD_FT_ROWS || []).filter(function (r) {
        var rr = { date: r.recordTime || "", family: r.family, sku: r.sku, week: r.week, line: r.line, wo: r.wo, buLabel: r.bu, testArea: traceOpsYieldCesiumAreaValue(r) };
        return traceOpsYieldMatchesFilter(rr.family, filters.family) &&
            traceOpsYieldMatchesFilter(rr.sku, filters.sku) &&
            traceOpsYieldMatchesFilter(rr.week, filters.week) &&
            traceOpsYieldMatchesFilter(rr.line, filters.line) &&
            traceOpsYieldMatchesFilter(rr.testArea, filters.cesiumArea) &&
            traceOpsYieldCesiumRowMatchesSfcStation(r, filters.sfcStation) &&
            traceOpsYieldMatchesFilter(String(rr.wo || ''), filters.wo) &&
            yieldSnMatchesValue(r.sn) &&
            traceOpsYieldRowDateInRange(rr);
    });
    var ftAreaRows = traceOpsYieldBuildFtAreaRows(ftRows);
    var stationSequenceBreakdown = traceOpsYieldBuildStationSequenceBreakdown(TRACEOPS_YIELD_SN_TO_SFC || {}, ftRows);
    var cesiumCurrentBreakdown = traceOpsYieldBuildCesiumCurrentBreakdown(ftRows);
    var bgaUnits = riskRows.filter(function (x) { return /BGA|REBALL|U8300|ASIC|CPU|FPGA|UNDERFILL/i.test([x.symptom, x.location, x.family, x.sku].join(' ')); }).reduce(function (a, b) { return a + Number(b.risk || 0); }, 0);
    var stockinUnits = trackerRows.reduce(function (a, t) { return a + Number((t.completedByStation && t.completedByStation.STOCKIN) || 0); }, 0);
    var ftUnits = trackerRows.reduce(function (a, t) { var c = t.completedByStation || {}; return a + Number(c.FT || 0); }, 0);
    var reintegrationCandidates = trackerRows.reduce(function (a, t) { return a + ((t.recoveryQueue || []).reduce(function (x, r) { return x + Number(r.qty || 0); }, 0)); }, 0);
    var reintegrationWeightedHours = 0;
    var reintegrationWeightedQty = 0;
    trackerRows.forEach(function (t) {
        (t.recoveryQueue || []).forEach(function (r) {
            var qty = Number(r.qty || 0);
            var hrs = Number(r.avgHours || 0);
            if (qty > 0 && hrs > 0) {
                reintegrationWeightedHours += qty * hrs;
                reintegrationWeightedQty += qty;
            }
        });
    });
    var avgReintegrationProxy = reintegrationWeightedQty ? (reintegrationWeightedHours / reintegrationWeightedQty) : null;
    var actionTracker = traceOpsYieldBuildActionTracker(failurePatterns, ftAreaRows, rows);
    var topPainCases = [];
    if (failurePatterns && failurePatterns.length) {
        topPainCases.push({
            type: 'Modo de falla',
            title: failurePatterns[0].pattern,
            metric: traceOpsYieldFlowFmt(failurePatterns[0].units) + ' unidades',
            detail: 'Pareto ' + traceOpsYieldFlowFmt(failurePatterns[0].impact, 1) + '% · refs ' + ((failurePatterns[0].refs || []).slice(0, 3).join(', ') || 'N/D'),
            action: { kind: 'serials', title: failurePatterns[0].pattern, rows: failurePatterns[0].serials || [] }
        });
    }
    if (topRiskSku && topRiskSku.length) {
        topPainCases.push({
            type: 'SKU / modelo',
            title: topRiskSku[0].family,
            metric: traceOpsYieldFlowFmt(topRiskSku[0].risk) + ' risk units',
            detail: topRiskSku[0].sku + ' · ' + (topRiskSku[0].topSymptom || 'N/D'),
            action: { kind: 'filterSku', sku: topRiskSku[0].sku, family: topRiskSku[0].family, rows: topRiskSku[0].serials || [] }
        });
    }
    if (rows && rows.length) {
        var worstWo = rows.slice().sort(function (a, b) {
            var ar = Number(a.total || 0) ? Number(a.risk || 0) / Number(a.total || 0) : 0;
            var br = Number(b.total || 0) ? Number(b.risk || 0) / Number(b.total || 0) : 0;
            return br - ar || Number(b.risk || 0) - Number(a.risk || 0) || Number(b.total || 0) - Number(a.total || 0);
        })[0];
        var worstSev = traceOpsYieldWoSeverity(worstWo);
        topPainCases.push({
            type: 'Work order',
            title: 'WO ' + (worstWo.wo || 'N/D'),
            metric: traceOpsYieldFlowFmt(worstWo.risk || 0) + ' risk / ' + traceOpsYieldFlowFmt(worstWo.total || 0) + ' unidades',
            detail: worstSev.level + ' · ' + traceOpsYieldFlowFmt(worstSev.rate, 1) + '% OJT · ' + (worstWo.family || 'N/D') + ' · ' + (worstWo.week || 'N/D') + ' · ' + (worstWo.line || 'N/D'),
            action: { kind: 'filterWo', wo: String(worstWo.wo || '') }
        });
    }
    return {
        filters: filters,
        options: options,
        kpi: {
            orders: rows.length,
            units: totalUnits,
            clean: totalClean,
            risk: totalRisk,
            builtUnits: Number((stationSequenceBreakdown && stationSequenceBreakdown.totalUnits) || 0),
            failureRateManufactured: totalUnits ? (totalRisk / totalUnits * 100) : 0,
            failureRateBuilt: Number((stationSequenceBreakdown && stationSequenceBreakdown.totalUnits) || 0) ? (totalRisk / Number((stationSequenceBreakdown && stationSequenceBreakdown.totalUnits) || 1) * 100) : 0,
            yield: weightedYield,
            touch: weightedTouch,
            avgLeadHours: flowHours.length ? (flowHours.reduce(function (a, b) { return a + b; }, 0) / flowHours.length) : 0,
            avgFtHours: ftHours.length ? (ftHours.reduce(function (a, b) { return a + b; }, 0) / ftHours.length) : null,
            avgStockinHours: stockinHours.length ? (stockinHours.reduce(function (a, b) { return a + b; }, 0) / stockinHours.length) : null,
            weeklyCount: weeklyTrend.length,
            bgaUnits: bgaUnits,
            stockinUnits: stockinUnits,
            ftUnits: ftUnits,
            reintegrationCandidates: reintegrationCandidates,
            avgReintegrationProxy: avgReintegrationProxy
        },
        rows: rows,
        trackerRows: trackerRows,
        topRiskSku: topRiskSku,
        weeklyTrend: weeklyTrend,
        causeSummary: causeSummary,
        failurePatterns: failurePatterns,
        stationFpy: stationFpy,
        ftRows: ftRows,
        ftAreaRows: ftAreaRows,
        stationSequenceBreakdown: stationSequenceBreakdown,
        cesiumCurrentBreakdown: cesiumCurrentBreakdown,
        actionTracker: actionTracker,
        topPainCases: topPainCases
    };
}
var TRACEOPS_YIELD_MODEL_CACHE = { key: null, value: null };
function traceOpsYieldModelCacheSignature() {
    var sfcLen = TRACEOPS_YIELD_SN_TO_SFC ? Object.keys(TRACEOPS_YIELD_SN_TO_SFC).length : 0;
    return [
        TRACEOPS_YIELD_BY_WO_ROWS ? TRACEOPS_YIELD_BY_WO_ROWS.length : 0,
        TRACEOPS_YIELD_FLOW_TRACKER ? TRACEOPS_YIELD_FLOW_TRACKER.length : 0,
        TRACEOPS_RISK_SUMMARY_ROWS ? TRACEOPS_RISK_SUMMARY_ROWS.length : 0,
        TRACEOPS_YIELD_FT_ROWS ? TRACEOPS_YIELD_FT_ROWS.length : 0,
        sfcLen
    ].join('|');
}
function traceOpsBuildYieldFlowModelLocal(filters) {
    filters = filters || {};
    var key = traceOpsYieldModelCacheSignature() + '::' + JSON.stringify(filters || {});
    if (TRACEOPS_YIELD_MODEL_CACHE && TRACEOPS_YIELD_MODEL_CACHE.key === key) return TRACEOPS_YIELD_MODEL_CACHE.value;
    var model = traceOpsBuildYieldFlowModelLocalRaw(filters);
    TRACEOPS_YIELD_MODEL_CACHE = { key: key, value: model };
    return model;
}
const TRACEOPS_NIGHT_OPS_HERO = 'data:image/png;base64,';


function buildStatusAlerts(statusData, readinessMeta, linkedRcca, evList, findingsCount) {
  var alerts = [];
  var draftScore = parseInt(statusData.header.readiness) || 0;
  if (draftScore > 0 && draftScore < 100) {
    var sectionsRemaining = 8 - readinessMeta.completed;
    alerts.push({
      type: 'CRITICAL',
      icon: '🔴',
      title: readinessMeta.completed + ' DE 8 SECCIONES',
      message: 'Draft en progreso. ' + sectionsRemaining + ' secciones pendientes.',
      button: { label: 'COMPLETAR AHORA', action: 'openDraftEditor' }
    });
  }
  if (linkedRcca !== 'Yes' && evList.length > 0) {
    alerts.push({
      type: 'CRITICAL',
      icon: '🔴',
      title: 'NO HAY RCCA VINCULADA',
      message: 'Los ' + evList.length + ' eventos detectados no tienen investigación documentada.',
      button: { label: 'INICIAR RCCA', action: 'openRccaForm' }
    });
  }
  if (evList.length > 0 && findingsCount === 0 && draftScore > 0) {
    alerts.push({
      type: 'WARNING',
      icon: '🟠',
      title: 'HALLAZGOS TÉCNICOS PENDIENTES',
      message: 'De los ' + evList.length + ' eventos, ninguno tiene hallazgos técnicos revisados.',
      button: null
    });
  }
  return alerts;
}

function renderStatusRowWithColor(rowData, language) {
  var label = rowData[0];
  var status = rowData[1];
  var remark = rowData[2];
  var criticality = rowData[3] || 'INFO';
  
  var criticalityColor = {
    CRITICAL: { bg: '#FEE2E2', border: '4px solid #DC2626', weight: 700 },
    WARNING: { bg: '#FEF3C7', border: '4px solid #F59E0B', weight: 600 },
    INFO: { bg: '#F9FAFB', border: '1px solid #E5E7EB', weight: 400 }
  };
  
  var style = criticalityColor[criticality] || criticalityColor.INFO;
  var icons = { CRITICAL: '🔴', WARNING: '🟠', INFO: '⚪' };
  
  return h('tr', { style: { backgroundColor: style.bg, borderLeft: style.border, fontWeight: style.weight } }, [
    h('td', { style: { padding: '10px 9px' } }, label),
    h('td', { style: { padding: '10px 9px' } }, status),
    h('td', { style: { padding: '10px 9px' } }, remark),
    h('td', { style: { textAlign: 'center', fontSize: '16px' } }, icons[criticality])
  ]);
}

    function updateYieldFilter(key, value) {
        setYieldFilters(function (prev) {
            var next = Object.assign({}, prev);
            next[key] = value;
            // SFC-driven cascade: parent filters invalidate child filters.
            // Prevents BU/Product Family mixing such as FIELDWORKS + WOODSIDE.
            if (key === 'bu') { next.family = 'ALL'; next.sku = 'ALL'; next.wo = 'ALL'; next.sfcStation = 'ALL'; next.cesiumArea = 'ALL'; }
            if (key === 'family') { next.sku = 'ALL'; next.wo = 'ALL'; next.sfcStation = 'ALL'; next.cesiumArea = 'ALL'; }
            if (key === 'sku') { next.wo = 'ALL'; next.sfcStation = 'ALL'; next.cesiumArea = 'ALL'; }
            if (key === 'wo') { next.sfcStation = 'ALL'; next.cesiumArea = 'ALL'; }
            return next;
        });
    }

    var TRACEOPS_RCCA_META_ACCEPT = [".zip", ".ppt", ".pptx", ".jpg", ".jpeg", ".png"];

    function traceOpsFormatBytes(bytes) {
        var n = Number(bytes || 0);
        if (!isFinite(n) || n <= 0)
            return "0 B";
        var units = ["B", "KB", "MB", "GB"];
        var idx = 0;
        while (n >= 1024 && idx < units.length - 1) {
            n /= 1024;
            idx += 1;
        }
        return (idx === 0 ? String(Math.round(n)) : n.toFixed(n >= 10 ? 1 : 2)) + " " + units[idx];
    }
    function traceOpsMetaExt(name) {
        var m = String(name || "").toLowerCase().match(/(\.[a-z0-9]+)$/i);
        return m ? m[1] : "";
    }
    function traceOpsMetaTypeLabel(file) {
        var ext = traceOpsMetaExt(file && file.name);
        if (ext === '.zip')
            return 'ZIP';
        if (ext === '.ppt' || ext === '.pptx')
            return 'PPT';
        if (ext === '.jpg' || ext === '.jpeg' || ext === '.png')
            return 'JPG';
        return ext ? ext.replace('.', '').toUpperCase() : 'FILE';
    }
    function traceOpsMetaIcon(file) {
        var ext = traceOpsMetaExt(file && file.name);
        if (ext === '.zip')
            return 'ZIP';
        if (ext === '.ppt' || ext === '.pptx')
            return 'PPT';
        if (ext === '.jpg' || ext === '.jpeg' || ext === '.png')
            return 'IMG';
        return 'FILE';
    }
    function traceOpsDownloadMetaFile(item) {
        if (!item || !item.data_url)
            return;
        var a = document.createElement('a');
        a.href = item.data_url;
        a.download = item.name || 'meta-file';
        a.rel = 'noopener';
        document.body.appendChild(a);
        a.click();
        setTimeout(function () {
            try {
                if (a.parentNode)
                    a.parentNode.removeChild(a);
            }
            catch (_) { }
            try {
                if (a.href && String(a.href).indexOf('blob:') === 0)
                    URL.revokeObjectURL(a.href);
            }
            catch (_) { }
        }, 50);
    }
    function traceOpsIsImageMetaFile(file) {
        var ext = traceOpsMetaExt(file && file.name);
        return ext === '.jpg' || ext === '.jpeg' || ext === '.png';
    }
    function traceOpsNormalizeEvidenceRole(role) {
        var s = String(role || '').toLowerCase().trim();
        if (s === 'bad' || s === 'good' || s === 'general')
            return s;
        return 'general';
    }
    function traceOpsInferEvidenceRoleFromName(name) {
        var s = String(name || '').toLowerCase();
        if (!s)
            return '';
        if (/(^|[^a-z])(bad|ng|nok|defect|failed?|fail|issue|wrong|reject|removed|as[-_ ]?found)([^a-z]|$)/i.test(s))
            return 'bad';
        if (/(^|[^a-z])(good|ok|golden|reference|ref|ideal|control|nominal|baseline|after|fixed)([^a-z]|$)/i.test(s))
            return 'good';
        return '';
    }
    function traceOpsCountEvidenceRoles(metaFiles) {
        return (Array.isArray(metaFiles) ? metaFiles : []).reduce(function (acc, file) {
            if (!file || !traceOpsIsImageMetaFile(file))
                return acc;
            var role = traceOpsNormalizeEvidenceRole(file.evidence_role || file.role);
            if (role === 'bad')
                acc.bad += 1;
            else if (role === 'good')
                acc.good += 1;
            else
                acc.general += 1;
            return acc;
        }, { bad: 0, good: 0, general: 0 });
    }
    function traceOpsSuggestEvidenceRole(file, currentMetaFiles) {
        if (!traceOpsIsImageMetaFile(file))
            return undefined;
        var inferred = traceOpsInferEvidenceRoleFromName(file && file.name);
        if (inferred)
            return inferred;
        var counts = traceOpsCountEvidenceRoles(currentMetaFiles);
        if (!counts.bad)
            return 'bad';
        if (!counts.good)
            return 'good';
        return 'general';
    }
    function traceOpsNormalizeMetaFiles(list) {
        return (Array.isArray(list) ? list : []).map(function (item) {
            var normalized = {
                id: item && item.id ? item.id : ('meta_' + Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 10)),
                name: item && item.name ? item.name : 'file',
                type: item && item.type ? item.type : '',
                size: Number(item && item.size || 0),
                kind: item && item.kind ? item.kind : traceOpsMetaTypeLabel(item || {}),
                data_url: item && item.data_url ? item.data_url : ''
            };
            if (traceOpsIsImageMetaFile(normalized)) {
                normalized.evidence_role = traceOpsNormalizeEvidenceRole(item && (item.evidence_role || item.role));
            }
            return normalized;
        }).filter(function (item) { return !!item.data_url; });
    }
    function traceOpsBuildEvidenceMetaFromFiles(metaFiles) {
        var out = { bad_part: [], good_part: [], general: [] };
        (Array.isArray(metaFiles) ? metaFiles : []).forEach(function (file) {
            if (!file || !file.data_url || !traceOpsIsImageMetaFile(file))
                return;
            var role = traceOpsNormalizeEvidenceRole(file.evidence_role || file.role);
            if (role === 'bad')
                out.bad_part.push(file.data_url);
            else if (role === 'good')
                out.good_part.push(file.data_url);
            else
                out.general.push(file.data_url);
        });
        return out;
    }
    function traceOpsMetaFilesFingerprint(metaFiles) {
        return (Array.isArray(metaFiles) ? metaFiles : []).map(function (file) {
            if (!file)
                return '';
            var normalized = traceOpsNormalizeMetaFileForMerge ? traceOpsNormalizeMetaFileForMerge(file) : file;
            var key = traceOpsMetaFileStableKey ? traceOpsMetaFileStableKey(normalized) : (String((file && file.name) || '') + '|' + String((file && file.size) || 0));
            var role = traceOpsNormalizeEvidenceRole(file && (file.evidence_role || file.role));
            return [key, role, traceOpsIsImageMetaFile(file) ? 'image' : 'file'].join('|');
        }).filter(Boolean).sort().join('||');
    }
    function traceOpsRccaFingerprint(rcca) {
        var metaFiles = (rcca && rcca.meta_files) || [];
        return [
            String((rcca && rcca.rcca_id) || ''),
            String((rcca && rcca.updated_at) || ''),
            traceOpsMetaFilesFingerprint(metaFiles)
        ].join('@@');
    }

    function traceOpsShouldClearRetryStatus(statusText) {
        var low = String(statusText || "").toLowerCase();
        return low.indexOf("reintentando conexion") >= 0 ||
            low.indexOf("reintentando conexión") >= 0 ||
            low.indexOf("reintento fallido") >= 0 ||
            low.indexOf("sesion ocupada") >= 0 ||
            low.indexOf("sesión ocupada") >= 0;
    }
    function traceOpsClearCloudCooldown() {
        try {
            if (cloudCooldownTimerRef.current)
                clearTimeout(cloudCooldownTimerRef.current);
        }
        catch (_) { }
        cloudCooldownTimerRef.current = null;
        cloudCooldownRef.current = false;
        cloudModeRef.current = "OK";
    }
    function traceOpsTriggerCloudCooldown(reasonLabel) {
        try {
            if (cloudCooldownTimerRef.current)
                clearTimeout(cloudCooldownTimerRef.current);
        }
        catch (_) { }
        cloudCooldownRef.current = true;
        cloudModeRef.current = "DEGRADED";
        setCloudStatus(reasonLabel || "Nube saturada · trabajando local");
        setRealtimeStatus("LOCAL_ONLY");
        cloudCooldownTimerRef.current = setTimeout(function () {
            cloudCooldownRef.current = false;
            cloudModeRef.current = "OK";
            setCloudStatus(function (prev) {
                var low = String(prev || "").toLowerCase();
                if (low.indexOf("sesion") >= 0)
                    return prev;
                return "Reintentando conexion...";
            });
            try {
                if (cloudRetryHookRef.current && typeof cloudRetryHookRef.current === "function") {
                    cloudRetryHookRef.current();
                }
            }
            catch (_) { }
        }, 12000);
    }
    async function traceOpsSafeCloudCall(promiseFactory, timeoutMs) {
        var ms = Math.max(1500, Number(timeoutMs || 5000));
        if (cloudCooldownRef.current) {
            try {
                console.warn("[TraceOps] Cloud in cooldown, retrying softly...");
            }
            catch (_) { }
        }
        try {
            return await Promise.race([
                Promise.resolve().then(promiseFactory),
                new Promise(function (_, reject) {
                    setTimeout(function () {
                        var timeoutErr = new Error("cloud_timeout");
                        timeoutErr.isCloudTimeout = true;
                        reject(timeoutErr);
                    }, ms);
                })
            ]);
        }
        catch (err) {
            var cloudErr = traceOpsNormalizeCloudError(err);
            var raw = String((cloudErr && (cloudErr.originalMessage || cloudErr.message)) || err || "").toLowerCase();
            var isHardNetworkError = !!(cloudErr && cloudErr.isNetworkFallback) || raw.indexOf("failed to fetch") >= 0 || raw.indexOf("networkerror") >= 0 || raw.indexOf("load failed") >= 0;
            var isSoftError = !!(cloudErr && cloudErr.isCloudTimeout) || raw.indexOf("timeout") >= 0 || raw.indexOf("504") >= 0 || raw.indexOf("connection terminated") >= 0 || raw.indexOf("too many concurrent requests") >= 0;
            if (isHardNetworkError) {
                traceOpsTriggerCloudCooldown("Sin conexión real");
            }
            else if (isSoftError) {
                traceOpsTriggerCloudCooldown("Servidor lento · trabajando local");
            }
            else {
                setCloudStatus("Error controlado");
            }
            throw cloudErr;
        }
    }
