    function mergeRccaRecords(localItems, remoteItems) {
        var map = {};
        (localItems || []).forEach(function (item) {
            if (item && item.rcca_id)
                map[item.rcca_id] = item;
        });
        (remoteItems || []).forEach(function (item) {
            if (!item || !item.rcca_id)
                return;
            var prev = map[item.rcca_id];
            var prevTs = prev && prev.updated_at ? new Date(prev.updated_at).getTime() : 0;
            var nextTs = item.updated_at ? new Date(item.updated_at).getTime() : 0;
            if (!prev || nextTs >= prevTs)
                map[item.rcca_id] = Object.assign({}, prev || {}, item, { _synced: true });
        });
        return Object.keys(map).map(function (key) { return map[key]; }).sort(function (a, b) {
            var ta = a && a.updated_at ? new Date(a.updated_at).getTime() : 0;
            var tb = b && b.updated_at ? new Date(b.updated_at).getTime() : 0;
            return tb - ta;
        });
    }
    async function persistRccaLocal(list) {
        var payload = list || [];
        setRccaList(payload);
        var lastErr = null;
        try {
            await traceOpsDbSet(RCCA_KEY, payload);
            try {
                localStorage.removeItem(RCCA_KEY);
            }
            catch (_) { }
            return { ok: true, mode: "indexeddb" };
        }
        catch (err) {
            lastErr = err;
        }
        try {
            localStorage.setItem(RCCA_KEY, JSON.stringify(payload));
            return { ok: true, mode: "localStorage" };
        }
        catch (err2) {
            lastErr = err2;
        }
        return { ok: false, error: lastErr };
    }
    async function persistEightdLocal(list) {
        var payload = list || [];
        setEightdList(payload);
        var lastErr = null;
        try {
            await traceOpsDbSet(EIGHTD_KEY, payload);
            try {
                localStorage.removeItem(EIGHTD_KEY);
            }
            catch (_) { }
            return { ok: true, mode: "indexeddb" };
        }
        catch (err) {
            lastErr = err;
        }
        try {
            localStorage.setItem(EIGHTD_KEY, JSON.stringify(payload));
            return { ok: true, mode: "localStorage" };
        }
        catch (err2) {
            lastErr = err2;
        }
        return { ok: false, error: lastErr };
    }
    async function refreshCloudRcca(opts) {
        opts = opts || {};
        if (!(window.TraceOpsCloud && window.TraceOpsCloud.isConfigured())) {
            setAuthReady(true);
            setCloudStatus("Modo local");
            return [];
        }
        try {
            setSyncBusy(true);
            var remoteItems = await window.TraceOpsCloud.listRcca();
            var merged = mergeRccaRecords(opts.baseList || rccaList, remoteItems);
            await persistRccaLocal(merged);
            setCloudStatus(remoteItems.length ? ("Sincronizado · " + remoteItems.length + " RCCA") : "Sesion activa · nube vacia");
            setAuthErrMsg("");
            return remoteItems;
        }
        catch (err) {
            var cloudErr = traceOpsNormalizeCloudError(err);
            setAuthErrMsg(cloudErr && cloudErr.message ? cloudErr.message : String(cloudErr));
            if (cloudErr && cloudErr.isTransientAuthLock) {
                setCloudStatus("Sesion ocupada · reintentando");
            }
            else if (cloudErr && (cloudErr.isNetworkFallback || cloudErr.isCloudTimeout || cloudErr.isCloudCooldown)) {
                traceOpsTriggerCloudCooldown("Nube saturada · trabajando local");
            }
            else {
                setCloudStatus("Error nube: " + (cloudErr && cloudErr.message ? cloudErr.message : String(cloudErr)));
            }
            return [];
        }
        finally {
            setSyncBusy(false);
            setAuthReady(true);
        }
    }
    async function syncAllLocalToCloud(baseList) {
        if (!(window.TraceOpsCloud && window.TraceOpsCloud.isConfigured()) || !authUser)
            return;
        var items = baseList || rccaList;
        if (!items.length) {
            setCloudStatus("Sesion activa · sin RCCA por subir");
            return;
        }
        setSyncBusy(true);
        try {
            for (var i = 0; i < items.length; i++) {
                await window.TraceOpsCloud.upsertRcca(items[i]);
            }
            setCloudStatus("Sincronizado · " + items.length + " RCCA");
        }
        catch (err) {
            var cloudErr = traceOpsNormalizeCloudError(err);
            setAuthErrMsg(cloudErr && cloudErr.message ? cloudErr.message : String(cloudErr));
            setCloudStatus(cloudErr && cloudErr.isNetworkFallback ? "Modo local · pendiente de sincronizacion" : "Pendiente de sincronizacion");
            return false;
        }
        finally {
            setSyncBusy(false);
        }
    }
    async function handleAuthSubmit() {
        if (!(window.TraceOpsCloud && window.TraceOpsCloud.isConfigured())) {
            setAuthErrMsg("Backend no configurado. Se mantiene modo local.");
            setCloudStatus("Modo local · sin backend");
            setRealtimeStatus("LOCAL_ONLY");
            return;
        }
        var email = String(authEmail || "").trim();
        var password = String(authPassword || "");
        if (!email || !password) {
            setAuthErrMsg("Ingresa correo y contrasena.");
            setCloudStatus("Credenciales incompletas");
            setRealtimeStatus("LOCAL_ONLY");
            return;
        }
        setAuthErrMsg("");
        setSyncBusy(true);
        setRealtimeStatus("LOCAL_ONLY");
        try {
            localStorage.setItem("traceops_auth_email", email);
        }
        catch (_) { }
        try {
            setCloudStatus(authMode === "signup" ? "Creando cuenta..." : "Conectando...");
            if (authMode === "signup") {
                await traceOpsSafeCloudCall(function () { return window.TraceOpsCloud.signUp(email, password); }, 7000);
                setCloudStatus("Cuenta creada · revisa confirmacion");
                setAuthErrMsg("Si el proyecto requiere confirmacion por correo, valida tu email antes de sincronizar.");
                setRealtimeStatus("LOCAL_ONLY");
                return;
            }
            await traceOpsSafeCloudCall(function () { return window.TraceOpsCloud.signIn(email, password); }, 7000);
            var currentUser = null;
            try {
                currentUser = await window.TraceOpsCloud.getUser();
            }
            catch (_) {
                currentUser = null;
            }
            traceOpsClearCloudCooldown();
            setAuthUser(currentUser || null);
            setCloudStatus("Sesion activa");
            setRealtimeStatus(currentUser && currentUser.id ? "DISCONNECTED" : "LOCAL_ONLY");
            try {
                await syncAllLocalToCloud(rccaList);
            }
            catch (_) { }
            try {
                await refreshCloudRcca({ baseList: rccaList });
            }
            catch (_) { }
            setAuthPassword("");
        }
        catch (err) {
            var cloudErr = traceOpsNormalizeCloudError(err);
            var msg = cloudErr && cloudErr.message ? cloudErr.message : String(cloudErr || "");
            var low = String(msg || "").toLowerCase();
            setAuthErrMsg(msg);
            if (cloudErr && cloudErr.isCloudCooldown) {
                setCloudStatus("Reconectando nube...");
                setRealtimeStatus("DEGRADED");
            }
            else if (cloudErr && cloudErr.isNetworkFallback) {
                traceOpsTriggerCloudCooldown("Sin conexión real");
            }
            else if (cloudErr && (cloudErr.isCloudTimeout || low.indexOf("cloud_timeout") >= 0 || low.indexOf("504") >= 0 || low.indexOf("connection terminated") >= 0 || low.indexOf("too many concurrent requests") >= 0)) {
                setCloudStatus("Servidor lento · reintenta");
                setRealtimeStatus("DEGRADED");
            }
            else if (cloudErr && cloudErr.isTransientAuthLock) {
                setCloudStatus("Sesion ocupada · reintentando");
                setRealtimeStatus("DISCONNECTED");
            }
            else if (low.indexOf("invalid login credentials") >= 0 || low.indexOf("invalid credentials") >= 0 || low.indexOf("credenciales") >= 0) {
                setCloudStatus("Credenciales invalidas");
                setRealtimeStatus("LOCAL_ONLY");
            }
            else if (low.indexOf("email not confirmed") >= 0 || low.indexOf("correo no confirmado") >= 0) {
                setCloudStatus("Correo pendiente de confirmacion");
                setRealtimeStatus("LOCAL_ONLY");
            }
            else {
                setCloudStatus("Error de autenticacion");
                setRealtimeStatus("LOCAL_ONLY");
            }
            try {
                console.warn("[TraceOps][AuthSubmit]", {
                    mode: authMode,
                    message: msg,
                    originalMessage: cloudErr && cloudErr.originalMessage ? cloudErr.originalMessage : null,
                    networkFallback: !!(cloudErr && cloudErr.isNetworkFallback),
                    transientAuthLock: !!(cloudErr && cloudErr.isTransientAuthLock),
                    cooldown: !!(cloudErr && cloudErr.isCloudCooldown),
                    ua: navigator.userAgent
                });
            }
            catch (_) { }
        }
        finally {
            setSyncBusy(false);
        }
    }
    async function handleSignOut() {
        if (!(window.TraceOpsCloud && window.TraceOpsCloud.isConfigured()))
            return;
        setSyncBusy(true);
        try {
            await window.TraceOpsCloud.signOut();
            setAuthUser(null);
            setCloudStatus("Modo local");
            setAuthErrMsg("");
        }
        catch (err) {
            var cloudErr = traceOpsNormalizeCloudError(err);
            setAuthErrMsg(cloudErr && cloudErr.message ? cloudErr.message : String(cloudErr));
        }
        finally {
            setSyncBusy(false);
        }
    }
    React.useEffect(function () {
        if (!(window.TraceOpsCloud && window.TraceOpsCloud.isConfigured())) {
            setAuthReady(true);
            setCloudStatus("Modo local · sin backend");
            setRealtimeStatus("LOCAL_ONLY");
            return;
        }
        var realtimeSub = null;
        function stopRealtime() {
            try {
                if (realtimeSub && typeof realtimeSub.unsubscribe === "function")
                    realtimeSub.unsubscribe();
            }
            catch (_) { }
            realtimeSub = null;
            setRealtimeStatus(window.authUser ? "DISCONNECTED" : "LOCAL_ONLY");
        }
        var authFlowPromise = Promise.resolve();
        function startRealtime(user) {
            stopRealtime();
            if (cloudCooldownRef.current) {
                setRealtimeStatus("LOCAL_ONLY");
                return;
            }
            var realtimeUserId = String(user && user.id ? user.id : "").trim();
            if (!realtimeUserId || !(window.TraceOpsCloud && window.TraceOpsCloud.subscribeRccaRealtime)) {
                setRealtimeStatus("DISCONNECTED");
                return;
            }
            setRealtimeStatus("CONNECTING");
            realtimeSub = window.TraceOpsCloud.subscribeRccaRealtime(realtimeUserId, function () {
                setCloudStatus("RCCA en nube · actualización en tiempo real");
                refreshCloudRcca();
            }, function (status) {
                var next = String(status || "UNKNOWN").toUpperCase();
                if (next === "SUBSCRIBED") {
                    setRealtimeStatus("CONNECTED");
                    setAuthErrMsg("");
                }
                else if (next === "CHANNEL_ERROR" || next === "TIMED_OUT")
                    setRealtimeStatus("ERROR");
                else if (next === "CLOSED")
                    setRealtimeStatus(authUser ? "DISCONNECTED" : "LOCAL_ONLY");
                else if (next === "UNKNOWN")
                    setRealtimeStatus("CONNECTING");
                else
                    setRealtimeStatus(next);
            });
        }
        function runAuthFlow(user) {
            authFlowPromise = authFlowPromise.then(async function () {
                window.authUser = user || null;
                setAuthUser(user || null);
                if (typeof updateAuthUI === "function")
                    updateAuthUI();
                if (user) {
                    traceOpsClearCloudCooldown();
                    setCloudStatus("Sesion activa");
                    setRealtimeStatus("DISCONNECTED");
                    try {
                        await traceOpsSafeCloudCall(function () { return refreshCloudRcca(); }, 5000);
                    }
                    catch (_) { }
                    await new Promise(function (resolve) { setTimeout(resolve, 150); });
                    startRealtime(user);
                    try {
                        setTimeout(function () {
                            try {
                                if (cloudRetryHookRef.current && typeof cloudRetryHookRef.current === "function") {
                                    cloudRetryHookRef.current();
                                }
                            }
                            catch (_) { }
                        }, 800);
                    }
                    catch (_) { }
                }
                else {
                    stopRealtime();
                    setCloudStatus("Sin sesion en nube");
                    setRealtimeStatus("LOCAL_ONLY");
                }
                setAuthReady(true);
            }).catch(function (err) {
                var cloudErr = traceOpsNormalizeCloudError(err);
                setAuthReady(true);
                setAuthErrMsg(cloudErr && cloudErr.message ? cloudErr.message : String(cloudErr));
                if (cloudErr && cloudErr.isTransientAuthLock) {
                    setCloudStatus("Sesion ocupada · reintentando");
                    setRealtimeStatus("DISCONNECTED");
                }
                else if (cloudErr && cloudErr.isNetworkFallback) {
                    traceOpsTriggerCloudCooldown("Sin conexión real");
                }
                else if (cloudErr && cloudErr.isCloudTimeout) {
                    traceOpsTriggerCloudCooldown("Servidor lento · trabajando local");
                }
                else {
                    setCloudStatus("Error nube: " + (cloudErr && cloudErr.message ? cloudErr.message : String(cloudErr)));
                    setRealtimeStatus("ERROR");
                }
            });
            return authFlowPromise;
        }
        var unsub = window.TraceOpsCloud.onAuthChange(function (evt, user) {
            runAuthFlow(user);
        });
        async function attemptCloudBootstrap() {
            try {
                var user = await window.TraceOpsCloud.getUser();
                return await runAuthFlow(user);
            }
            catch (err) {
                var cloudErr = traceOpsNormalizeCloudError(err);
                setAuthReady(true);
                setAuthErrMsg(cloudErr && cloudErr.message ? cloudErr.message : String(cloudErr));
                if (cloudErr && cloudErr.isTransientAuthLock) {
                    setCloudStatus("Sesion ocupada · reintentando");
                    setRealtimeStatus("DISCONNECTED");
                }
                else if (cloudErr && (cloudErr.isNetworkFallback || cloudErr.isCloudTimeout)) {
                    traceOpsTriggerCloudCooldown(cloudErr.isNetworkFallback ? "Sin conexión real" : "Servidor lento · trabajando local");
                }
                else {
                    setCloudStatus("Sin sesion en nube");
                    setRealtimeStatus("LOCAL_ONLY");
                }
            }
        }
        cloudRetryHookRef.current = async function () {
            try {
                setCloudStatus("Reintentando conexion...");
                var user = await window.TraceOpsCloud.getUser();
                if (!user) {
                    setCloudStatus("Sin sesion en nube");
                    setRealtimeStatus("LOCAL_ONLY");
                    return;
                }
                await refreshCloudRcca();
                try {
                    startRealtime(user);
                }
                catch (_) { }
                setCloudStatus("Sincronizado");
                setRealtimeStatus("CONNECTED");
                setAuthErrMsg("");
            }
            catch (e) {
                traceOpsTriggerCloudCooldown("Reintento fallido");
            }
        };
        attemptCloudBootstrap();
        return function () {
            stopRealtime();
            cloudRetryHookRef.current = null;
            try {
                if (cloudCooldownTimerRef.current)
                    clearTimeout(cloudCooldownTimerRef.current);
            }
            catch (_) { }
            cloudCooldownTimerRef.current = null;
            try {
                var sub = unsub && unsub.data && unsub.data.subscription;
                if (sub && typeof sub.unsubscribe === "function")
                    sub.unsubscribe();
            }
            catch (_) { }
        };
    }, []);
    async function saveRcca(rcca) {
        var existingLocal = (Array.isArray(rccaList) ? rccaList.find(function (x) { return x && x.rcca_id === rcca.rcca_id; }) : null) || null;
        var normalized = traceOpsMergeRccaPayload(existingLocal, Object.assign({}, rcca, {
            source: rcca.source || "manual",
            updated_at: new Date().toISOString(),
            owner_email: authUser && authUser.email ? authUser.email : (rcca.owner_email || "")
        }));
        var updated = rccaList.filter(function (item) { return item.rcca_id !== normalized.rcca_id; });
        updated = [normalized].concat(updated);
        var persistResult = await persistRccaLocal(updated);
        if (!persistResult || !persistResult.ok) {
            var msg = "No se pudo guardar el RCCA localmente. El caso parece exceder el limite de almacenamiento del navegador. Exporta/limpia datos o inicia sesion en nube. Detalle: " + traceOpsSafeStorageError(persistResult && persistResult.error);
            setCloudStatus("Error de almacenamiento local");
            setStorageErrMsg(msg);
            alert(msg);
            return false;
        }
        setStorageErrMsg("");
        clearRccaDraft();
        if (!(window.TraceOpsCloud && window.TraceOpsCloud.isConfigured()) || !authUser) {
            setCloudStatus("Guardado local");
            return true;
        }
        try {
            setSyncBusy(true);
            await window.TraceOpsCloud.upsertRcca(normalized);
            setCloudStatus("Guardado en nube");
            await refreshCloudRcca({ baseList: updated });
            return true;
        }
        catch (err) {
            setCloudStatus("Guardado local · nube pendiente");
            setAuthErrMsg(err && err.message ? err.message : String(err));
            return true;
        }
        finally {
            setSyncBusy(false);
        }
    }
    async function deleteRcca(rcca_id) {
        var updated = rccaList.filter(function (r) { return r.rcca_id !== rcca_id; });
        var persistResult = await persistRccaLocal(updated);
        if (!persistResult || !persistResult.ok) {
            var msg = "No se pudo actualizar el almacenamiento local al eliminar RCCA. " + traceOpsSafeStorageError(persistResult && persistResult.error);
            setStorageErrMsg(msg);
            alert(msg);
            return;
        }
        setStorageErrMsg("");
        if (!(window.TraceOpsCloud && window.TraceOpsCloud.isConfigured()) || !authUser) {
            setCloudStatus("Eliminado local");
            return;
        }
        try {
            setSyncBusy(true);
            await window.TraceOpsCloud.removeRcca(rcca_id);
            setCloudStatus("Eliminado en nube");
        }
        catch (err) {
            setCloudStatus("Eliminado local · nube pendiente");
            setAuthErrMsg(err && err.message ? err.message : String(err));
        }
        finally {
            setSyncBusy(false);
        }
    }
    function traceOpsTextFilled(v) {
        return !!String(v || "").trim();
    }
    function traceOpsBuildEightdId(rccaId) {
        return "8D-" + String(rccaId || "CASE").replace(/[^A-Za-z0-9]+/g, "-") + "-" + Date.now().toString().slice(-6);
    }
    function traceOpsCollectLinkedEventsByIds(ids) {
        var map = {};
        (ev || []).forEach(function (item) { if (item && item.id)
            map[item.id] = item; });
        return (ids || []).map(function (id) { return map[id]; }).filter(Boolean);
    }
    function traceOpsEightdEvidenceMeta(draft) {
        var src = draft || {};
        var meta = (src.meta && src.meta.evidence) || {};
        var bad = typeof traceOpsPptExtractEvidenceNames === 'function' ? traceOpsPptExtractEvidenceNames(meta.bad_part || src.bad_part_images || src.bad_part_image || src.bad_part_evidence || []) : [];
        var good = typeof traceOpsPptExtractEvidenceNames === 'function' ? traceOpsPptExtractEvidenceNames(meta.good_part || src.good_part_images || src.good_part_image || src.good_part_evidence || []) : [];
        var general = typeof traceOpsPptExtractEvidenceNames === 'function' ? traceOpsPptExtractEvidenceNames(meta.general || src.evidence_images || src.installed_removed_images || []) : [];
        var linkedIds = Array.isArray(src.linked_event_ids) ? src.linked_event_ids.filter(Boolean) : (Array.isArray(src.event_ids) ? src.event_ids.filter(Boolean) : []);
        var traceFields = [src.modelo, src.linea, src.station || src.estacion_dominante, src.serial_range, src.lot_batch, src.build_window, src.trace_path, src.fecha];
        var traceabilityCount = traceFields.filter(function (v) { return traceOpsTextFilled(v); }).length;
        return {
            bad: bad,
            good: good,
            general: general,
            linkedCount: linkedIds.length,
            totalCount: bad.length + good.length + general.length,
            hasBadGood: bad.length > 0 && good.length > 0,
            traceabilityCount: traceabilityCount,
            traceabilityCoverage: Math.min(100, Math.round((traceabilityCount / 5) * 100))
        };
    }
    function traceOpsEightdStageLabel(draft, structureScore, evidenceScore, blockers) {
        var src = draft || {};
        if (/closed|complete/i.test(String(src.status || src.reportStatus || '')))
            return 'Closed';
        if (traceOpsTextFilled(src.d8_closure) && blockers.length === 0 && structureScore >= 90 && evidenceScore >= 75)
            return 'Ready for 8D';
        if (traceOpsTextFilled(src.d6_validation))
            return blockers.length ? 'Validated with gaps' : 'Validated';
        if (traceOpsTextFilled(src.d4_root_cause) || traceOpsTextFilled(src.d5_pca))
            return 'RCCA in progress';
        if (traceOpsTextFilled(src.d3_containment))
            return 'Contained';
        if (traceOpsTextFilled(src.d2_problem) || traceOpsTextFilled(src.complaint_anchor))
            return 'Triaged';
        return 'Detected';
    }
    function traceOpsComputeEightdReadiness(draft) {
        var weights = { d1_team: 5, d2_problem: 20, d3_containment: 15, d4_root_cause: 20, d4_escape_point: 10, d5_pca: 15, d6_validation: 10, d7_prevention: 5, d8_closure: 0 };
        var structureScore = 0;
        var structureMissing = [];
        Object.keys(weights).forEach(function (key) {
            if (traceOpsTextFilled(draft && draft[key]))
                structureScore += weights[key];
            else if (weights[key] > 0)
                structureMissing.push(key);
        });
        var evidence = traceOpsEightdEvidenceMeta(draft);
        var evidenceScore = 0;
        if (evidence.linkedCount > 0)
            evidenceScore += 20;
        if (evidence.hasBadGood)
            evidenceScore += 35;
        if (evidence.totalCount > 0)
            evidenceScore += 15;
        evidenceScore += Math.round(Math.min(20, (evidence.traceabilityCoverage / 100) * 20));
        if (traceOpsTextFilled(draft && draft.d6_validation))
            evidenceScore += 10;
        if (evidenceScore > 100)
            evidenceScore = 100;
        var blockers = [];
        if (!traceOpsTextFilled(draft && (draft.modelo || draft.product || draft.model)))
            blockers.push('Complete model / part number');
        if (!traceOpsTextFilled(draft && draft.linea))
            blockers.push('Complete line / station');
        if (evidence.linkedCount === 0)
            blockers.push('Link at least 1 trace event');
        if (!traceOpsTextFilled(draft && (draft.d2_problem || draft.complaint_anchor)))
            blockers.push('Define complaint anchor / D2');
        if (!evidence.hasBadGood)
            blockers.push('Classify bad / good evidence');
        if (evidence.totalCount === 0)
            blockers.push('Attach visual or file evidence');
        if (!(traceOpsTextFilled(draft && draft.d4_root_cause) && traceOpsTextFilled(draft && draft.d4_escape_point)))
            blockers.push('Complete occurrence + escape');
        if (!traceOpsTextFilled(draft && draft.d6_validation))
            blockers.push('Define verification / D6');
        blockers = Array.from(new Set(blockers));
        var overallScore = Math.round((structureScore * 0.6) + (evidenceScore * 0.4));
        var stage = traceOpsEightdStageLabel(draft, structureScore, evidenceScore, blockers);
        return {
            score: overallScore,
            overallScore: overallScore,
            structureScore: structureScore,
            evidenceScore: evidenceScore,
            missing: structureMissing,
            structureMissing: structureMissing,
            blockers: blockers,
            canPromote: blockers.length === 0,
            completed: 8 - structureMissing.length,
            stage: stage,
            evidence: evidence
        };
    }
    if (typeof window !== 'undefined') {
        window.traceOpsComputeEightdReadiness = traceOpsComputeEightdReadiness;
    }
    function traceOpsEightdHasText(v) {
        return String(v || '').replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim().length > 0;
    }
    function traceOpsEightdEsc(v) {
        return String(v || '').replace(/&/g, '&amp;').replace(/</g, '&lt;').replace(/>/g, '&gt;');
    }
    function traceOpsEightdUnique(arr) {
        var seen = {};
        return (arr || []).filter(function (item) {
            var key = String(item || '').trim();
            if (!key || seen[key])
                return false;
            seen[key] = true;
            return true;
        });
    }
    function traceOpsEightdShort(v, max) {
        var txt = String(v || '').replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim();
        if (!txt)
            return '';
        if (txt.length <= max)
            return txt;
        return txt.slice(0, Math.max(0, max - 3)).trim() + '...';
    }
    function traceOpsEightdJoinParagraphs(parts) {
        return traceOpsEightdUnique((parts || []).map(function (item) { return String(item || '').trim(); }).filter(Boolean)).join("\n\n");
    }
    function traceOpsEightdDateMs(ev) {
        if (!ev || !ev.fecha)
            return 0;
        return traceOpsGetDateValue(ev.fecha) || 0;
    }
    function traceOpsEightdCollectLinkedEvents(ids) {
        var linked = typeof traceOpsCollectLinkedEventsByIds === 'function' ? traceOpsCollectLinkedEventsByIds(ids || []) : [];
        return linked.slice().sort(function (a, b) { return traceOpsEightdDateMs(a) - traceOpsEightdDateMs(b); });
    }
    function traceOpsEightdIsWeakPlaceholder(value) {
        var v = String(value || '').trim();
        if (!v)
            return true;
        return /^(?:N\/D|N\/A|Pending|TBD|To be defined|Sin dato)$/i.test(v);
    }
    function traceOpsEightdCleanValue(value, fallback) {
        return traceOpsEightdIsWeakPlaceholder(value) ? String(fallback || '') : String(value || '').trim();
    }
    function traceOpsEightdSmartTracePath(src, linked, line, station) {
        if (Array.isArray(linked) && linked.length) {
            return linked.map(function (item) { return item.id || item.tipo_evento || 'Event'; }).join(' -> ');
        }
        var parts = ['Build'];
        if (!traceOpsEightdIsWeakPlaceholder(line))
            parts.push(line);
        if (!traceOpsEightdIsWeakPlaceholder(station) && station !== line)
            parts.push(station);
        parts.push('Complaint');
        parts.push('RCCA');
        return parts.join(' -> ');
    }
    function traceOpsEightdBuildModel(sourceLike, linkedEvents) {
        var src = sourceLike || {};
        var linked = linkedEvents || [];
        var firstEv = linked.length ? linked[0] : null;
        var lastEv = linked.length ? linked[linked.length - 1] : null;
        var stations = traceOpsEightdUnique(linked.map(function (item) { return item && item.linea_estacion ? item.linea_estacion : ''; }));
        var eventTypes = traceOpsEightdUnique(linked.map(function (item) { return item && item.tipo_evento ? item.tipo_evento : ''; }));
        var defects = traceOpsEightdUnique(linked.map(function (item) { return item && item.defecto_smt && item.defecto_smt !== 'N/A' ? item.defecto_smt : ''; }));
        var impacts = traceOpsEightdUnique(linked.map(function (item) { return item && item.impacto ? item.impacto : ''; }));
        var actions = traceOpsEightdUnique(linked.map(function (item) { return item && (item.accion_ejecutada_full || item.accion_ejecutada) ? (item.id + ': ' + (item.accion_ejecutada_full || item.accion_ejecutada)) : ''; }));
        var findings = traceOpsEightdUnique(linked.map(function (item) { return item && (item.engineer_findings_full || item.engineer_findings) ? (item.id + ': ' + (item.engineer_findings_full || item.engineer_findings)) : ''; }));
        var evidenceRefs = traceOpsEightdUnique(linked.map(function (item) { return item && item.id ? (item.id + ' · ' + [item.fecha || '', item.hora || ''].join(' ').trim()) : ''; }));
        var owners = traceOpsEightdUnique([src.owner_email || '', src.responsable || ''].concat(linked.map(function (item) { return item && (item.reporta || item.responsable_sugerido || item.sender) ? (item.reporta || item.responsable_sugerido || item.sender) : ''; })));
        var areas = traceOpsEightdUnique(['Quality'].concat(linked.map(function (item) { return item && (item.area_involucrada || item.tipo_evento || '') ? (item.area_involucrada || item.tipo_evento) : ''; })));
        var firstDate = traceOpsEightdCleanValue(src.primera_deteccion || (firstEv && firstEv.fecha) || src.fecha || '', '');
        var lastDate = traceOpsEightdCleanValue(src.ultima_deteccion || (lastEv && lastEv.fecha) || src.fecha || '', '');
        var detectionWindow = firstDate || lastDate ? [firstDate || lastDate || 'To be confirmed', lastDate || firstDate || 'To be confirmed'].join(' -> ') : 'To be confirmed';
        var model = traceOpsEightdCleanValue(src.modelo || (firstEv && firstEv.modelo) || '', 'To be confirmed');
        var line = traceOpsEightdCleanValue(src.linea || (firstEv && firstEv.linea_estacion) || '', 'To be confirmed');
        var station = traceOpsEightdCleanValue(src.station || src.estacion || src.estacion_dominante || stations[0] || '', line !== 'To be confirmed' ? line : 'To be confirmed');
        var defect = traceOpsEightdCleanValue(src.defecto_smt || src.defecto_dominante || src.failure_mode || src.failureMode || defects[0] || '', 'Issue under review');
        var pattern = traceOpsEightdCleanValue(src.patron_detectado || '', 'Pattern under technical review; formal statement pending.');
        var impact = traceOpsEightdCleanValue(src.alcance_exposicion || impacts[0] || '', 'Operational and quality impact under review.');
        var tracePath = traceOpsEightdSmartTracePath(src, linked, line, station);
        var complaintAnchor = traceOpsEightdCleanValue(src.complaint_anchor || src.problema || src.titulo_corto || (firstEv && (firstEv.evento_detectado_full || firstEv.evento_detectado)) || '', 'Complaint anchor requires customer-observed symptom.');
        var occurrenceSummary = traceOpsEightdHasText(src.causa_raiz)
            ? ('Confirmed occurrence mechanism based on current evidence: ' + src.causa_raiz)
            : (traceOpsEightdHasText(src.hipotesis)
                ? ('Working hypothesis under validation: ' + src.hipotesis + ' Final occurrence confirmation remains open.')
                : 'Occurrence mechanism is still under investigation; no confirmed root cause is available yet.');
        var expectedControl = traceOpsEightdCleanValue(src.expected_detection_control || src.expected_control || src.control_esperado || '', '');
        var escapePoint = traceOpsEightdCleanValue(src.escape_point || src.punto_escape || '', '');
        var escapeSummary = escapePoint
            ? ('Confirmed escape point: ' + escapePoint)
            : (expectedControl
                ? ('Escape remains under validation. Expected detection control: ' + expectedControl + '. Control-gap confirmation is still required against the real failure signature.')
                : (!traceOpsEightdIsWeakPlaceholder(station)
                    ? ('Escape remains under validation. Current trace suggests a detection gap around ' + station + ' and requires control review against the actual failure mode.')
                    : 'Escape remains under validation. Control-gap analysis is still pending.'));
        return {
            source: src,
            linked: linked,
            firstEv: firstEv,
            lastEv: lastEv,
            model: model,
            line: line,
            station: station,
            defect: defect,
            pattern: pattern,
            impact: impact,
            tracePath: tracePath,
            complaintAnchor: complaintAnchor,
            detectionWindow: detectionWindow,
            occurrenceSummary: occurrenceSummary,
            escapeSummary: escapeSummary,
            stations: stations,
            eventTypes: eventTypes,
            defects: defects,
            impacts: impacts,
            actions: actions,
            findings: findings,
            evidenceRefs: evidenceRefs,
            owners: owners,
            areas: areas,
            severity: src.severidad || 'N/D',
            recurrence: src.recurrencia || 'N/D',
            analysisMaturity: src.madurez_analisis || 'N/D',
            evidenceSummary: src.evidencia_resumen || '',
            lotBatch: src.lot_batch || src.lote_afectado || '',
            serialRange: src.serial_range || src.seriales_afectados || '',
            buildWindow: src.build_window || detectionWindow,
            skuVersion: src.sku_version || src.sku || '',
            componentPn: src.component_pn || src.component_part_number || src.part_number || '',
            supplierLot: src.supplier_lot || src.supplier_batch || '',
            dateCode: src.date_code || src.datecode || '',
            materialAffected: src.material_afectado || '',
            exposure: src.alcance_exposicion || '',
            customerImpact: src.impacto_cliente || '',
            prevention: src.accion_preventiva || '',
            lesson: src.leccion_aprendida || '',
            pca: src.accion_correctiva || '',
            validation: src.validacion || '',
            containment: src.contencion || '',
            rootCause: src.causa_raiz || '',
            hypothesis: src.hipotesis || ''
        };
    }
    function traceOpsEightdNormalizeTeamMembers(list) {
        return (Array.isArray(list) ? list : []).map(function (item) {
            return {
                name: String(item && item.name || '').trim(),
                email: String(item && item.email || '').trim(),
                role: String(item && item.role || '').trim()
            };
        }).filter(function (item) {
            return !!(item.name || item.email || item.role);
        });
    }
    function traceOpsEightdDefaultTeamRoles() {
        return ['PM', 'QE', 'SQE', 'TE', 'PE', 'PD'];
    }
    function traceOpsEightdSeedTeamMembers(model, list) {
        var normalized = traceOpsEightdNormalizeTeamMembers(list);
        var owner = model && model.owners && model.owners.length ? model.owners[0] : '';
        var defaults = traceOpsEightdDefaultTeamRoles();
        var extras = [];
        var byRole = {};
        normalized.forEach(function (item) {
            var roleKey = String(item && item.role || '').trim().toUpperCase();
            if (roleKey && defaults.indexOf(roleKey) >= 0 && !byRole[roleKey]) {
                byRole[roleKey] = { name: item.name || '', email: item.email || '', role: roleKey };
            }
            else {
                extras.push({ name: item.name || '', email: item.email || '', role: item.role || '' });
            }
        });
        var seeded = defaults.map(function (role) {
            if (byRole[role])
                return byRole[role];
            return { name: '', email: (role === 'QE' ? owner : ''), role: role };
        });
        extras.forEach(function (item) {
            seeded.push(item);
        });
        return traceOpsEightdNormalizeTeamMembers(seeded);
    }
    function traceOpsEightdBuildTeamTextFromMembers(members, model) {
        var rows = traceOpsEightdNormalizeTeamMembers(members);
        if (!rows.length)
            return traceOpsEightdBuildTeamText(model);
        var proofPoints = [];
        var owner = rows[0].name || rows[0].email || (model && model.owners && model.owners[0]) || 'Quality owner pending';
        var roleSet = traceOpsEightdUnique(rows.map(function (item) { return item.role || ''; }).filter(Boolean));
        proofPoints.push('Owner: ' + owner);
        proofPoints.push('Core team: ' + (roleSet.length ? roleSet.join(', ') : 'Pending'));
        proofPoints.push('Team roster: ' + rows.map(function (item) {
            var label = item.name || item.email || 'Pending member';
            var emailTag = item.email && item.name ? (' <' + item.email + '>') : (item.email && !item.name ? (' ' + item.email) : '');
            var roleTag = item.role ? (' · ' + item.role) : '';
            return label + emailTag + roleTag;
        }).join(' | '));
        proofPoints.push('Roles / ownership: Quality leads communication and closure readiness; Process / SMT owns occurrence controls; Test / ICT confirms detection coverage; Materiales / Kitting secures segregation and traceability.');
        if (model && model.linked && model.linked.length)
            proofPoints.push('TraceOps proof points: ' + model.evidenceRefs.slice(0, 4).join(' | '));
        return traceOpsEightdJoinParagraphs(proofPoints);
    }
    function traceOpsEightdDefaultEscalationRoles() {
        return [
            { role: 'Process Coordinator', sourceRole: 'PM' },
            { role: 'Quality Coordinator', sourceRole: 'QE' },
            { role: 'Quality Manager', sourceRole: 'SQE' },
            { role: 'TE Manager', sourceRole: 'TE' },
            { role: 'Manufacturing Manager', sourceRole: 'PE' },
            { role: 'BU Manager', sourceRole: 'PD' }
        ];
    }
    function traceOpsEightdSeedEscalationMembers(teamMembers, list) {
        var seededTeam = traceOpsEightdNormalizeTeamMembers(teamMembers);
        var normalized = traceOpsEightdNormalizeTeamMembers(list);
        var defaults = traceOpsEightdDefaultEscalationRoles();
        var teamByRole = {};
        var listByRole = {};
        var extras = [];
        seededTeam.forEach(function (item) {
            var roleKey = String(item && item.role || '').trim().toUpperCase();
            if (roleKey && !teamByRole[roleKey])
                teamByRole[roleKey] = item;
        });
        normalized.forEach(function (item) {
            var roleKey = String(item && item.role || '').trim().toUpperCase();
            var isDefault = defaults.some(function (def) { return def.role.toUpperCase() === roleKey; });
            if (isDefault && !listByRole[roleKey]) {
                listByRole[roleKey] = item;
            }
            else {
                extras.push({ role: item.role || '', name: item.name || '', email: item.email || '' });
            }
        });
        var seeded = defaults.map(function (def) {
            var existing = listByRole[def.role.toUpperCase()];
            if (existing) {
                return { role: def.role, name: existing.name || '', email: existing.email || '' };
            }
            var source = teamByRole[String(def.sourceRole || '').toUpperCase()] || {};
            return { role: def.role, name: source.name || '', email: source.email || '' };
        });
        extras.forEach(function (item) { seeded.push(item); });
        return traceOpsEightdNormalizeTeamMembers(seeded);
    }
    function traceOpsEightdBuildEscalationTextFromMembers(members, model) {
        var rows = traceOpsEightdNormalizeTeamMembers(members);
        if (!rows.length) {
            return traceOpsEightdJoinParagraphs([
                'Escalation roster pending.',
                'Release authority must be explicit whenever hold / release, customer risk, or control-gap validation is involved.'
            ]);
        }
        var owner = rows[0].name || rows[0].email || (model && model.owners && model.owners[0]) || 'Quality owner pending';
        return traceOpsEightdJoinParagraphs([
            'Escalation owner: ' + owner,
            'Escalation roster: ' + rows.map(function (item) {
                var role = item.role || 'Role pending';
                var label = item.name || item.email || 'Pending member';
                var emailTag = item.email && item.name ? (' <' + item.email + '>') : (item.email && !item.name ? (' ' + item.email) : '');
                return role + ': ' + label + emailTag;
            }).join(' | '),
            'Release authority must be explicit whenever hold / release, customer risk, or control-gap validation is involved.'
        ]);
    }
    function traceOpsEightdBuildTeamText(model) {
        var proofPoints = [];
        var owner = model.owners.length ? model.owners[0] : 'Quality owner pending';
        var roleSet = ['Quality'];
        var blob = [model.line || '', model.station || '', model.defect || '', model.pattern || '', model.rootCause || '', model.hypothesis || ''].join(' ').toLowerCase();
        if (model.areas.length)
            roleSet = traceOpsEightdUnique(roleSet.concat(model.areas));
        if (/setup|feeder|smt|printer|placement|reflow/.test(blob))
            roleSet = traceOpsEightdUnique(roleSet.concat(['Process', 'SMT']));
        if (/ict|aoi|5dx|x ray|inspection|test/.test(blob))
            roleSet = traceOpsEightdUnique(roleSet.concat(['Test / ICT']));
        if (/material|kitting|reel|pn|part|component/.test(blob))
            roleSet = traceOpsEightdUnique(roleSet.concat(['Materiales / Kitting']));
        proofPoints.push('Owner: ' + owner);
        proofPoints.push('Core team: ' + roleSet.join(', '));
        proofPoints.push('Roles / ownership: Quality leads communication and closure readiness; Process / SMT owns occurrence controls; Test / ICT confirms detection coverage; Materiales / Kitting secures segregation and traceability.');
        if (model.linked.length)
            proofPoints.push('TraceOps proof points: ' + model.evidenceRefs.slice(0, 4).join(' | '));
        return traceOpsEightdJoinParagraphs(proofPoints);
    }
    function traceOpsEightdBuildProblemText(model) {
        var lines = [];
        lines.push('Problem statement: ' + model.complaintAnchor);
        lines.push('Model / line / station: ' + [model.model, model.line, model.station].join(' · '));
        lines.push('Defect SMT / failure mode: ' + model.defect);
        lines.push('Detection window: ' + model.detectionWindow);
        lines.push('Impact / exposure: ' + (model.exposure || model.customerImpact || model.impact));
        lines.push('Detected pattern: ' + model.pattern);
        if (model.linked.length)
            lines.push('Traceability chain: ' + model.tracePath + '.');
        if (model.linked.length)
            lines.push('Affected event references: ' + model.evidenceRefs.join(' | '));
        lines.push('Technical interpretation: the issue shows a repeatable path across the analyzed trace and must be controlled as a manufacturable quality event, not only as an isolated symptom.');
        return traceOpsEightdJoinParagraphs(lines);
    }
    function traceOpsEightdBuildContainmentText(model) {
        var parts = [];
        if (traceOpsEightdHasText(model.containment))
            parts.push('Immediate containment: ' + model.containment);
        else
            parts.push('Immediate containment not formally captured yet. Define lot hold, WIP segregation, targeted inspection and customer protection before closure.');
        if (traceOpsEightdHasText(model.materialAffected))
            parts.push('Affected material / units: ' + model.materialAffected);
        if (traceOpsEightdHasText(model.exposure))
            parts.push('Exposure statement: ' + model.exposure);
        if (model.actions.length)
            parts.push('Containment actions seen in the trace: ' + model.actions.join(' | '));
        parts.push('Required containment check: separate affected vs non-affected population and confirm whether exposure remains internal, shipped or customer-facing.');
        return traceOpsEightdJoinParagraphs(parts);
    }
    function traceOpsEightdBuildOccurrenceText(model) {
        var parts = [];
        parts.push(model.occurrenceSummary);
        if (traceOpsEightdHasText(model.evidenceSummary))
            parts.push('Supporting evidence: ' + model.evidenceSummary);
        if (model.findings.length)
            parts.push('Engineer findings supporting occurrence: ' + model.findings.join(' | '));
        if (traceOpsEightdHasText(model.pattern))
            parts.push('Pattern correlation: ' + model.pattern);
        if (!traceOpsEightdHasText(model.rootCause) && traceOpsEightdHasText(model.hypothesis))
            parts.push('Status: hypothesis under evaluation; root cause is not confirmed yet and must not be treated as validated.');
        return traceOpsEightdJoinParagraphs(parts);
    }
    function traceOpsEightdBuildEscapeText(model) {
        var parts = [];
        parts.push(model.escapeSummary);
        parts.push('Relevant control stage: ' + model.station + ' · defect reference: ' + model.defect + '.');
        if (model.linked.length)
            parts.push('Escape trace: ' + model.tracePath + '.');
        if (model.findings.length)
            parts.push('Technical clues for escape review: ' + model.findings.slice(0, 3).join(' | '));
        parts.push('Verification need: explain why the installed-state or in-line control did not trigger earlier and what specific detection gap allowed the event to move forward.');
        return traceOpsEightdJoinParagraphs(parts);
    }
    function traceOpsEightdBuildPcaText(model) {
        var parts = [];
        if (traceOpsEightdHasText(model.pca))
            parts.push('Permanent corrective action: ' + model.pca);
        else
            parts.push('Permanent corrective action is still pending. Define the process change that directly blocks both occurrence and escape.');
        if (model.findings.length)
            parts.push('Engineering basis: ' + model.findings.slice(0, 2).join(' | '));
        parts.push('PCA expectation: remove process bypasses, restore capability and implement a control that would have prevented this case under the same trace path.');
        return traceOpsEightdJoinParagraphs(parts);
    }
    function traceOpsEightdBuildVerificationText(model) {
        var parts = [];
        if (traceOpsEightdHasText(model.validation))
            parts.push('Verification of effectiveness: ' + model.validation);
        else
            parts.push('Verification of effectiveness is still pending. Required evidence should include repeat inspection or test, recurrence review and post-action stability.');
        parts.push('Severity / recurrence / analysis maturity: ' + [model.severity, model.recurrence, model.analysisMaturity].join(' · '));
        if (model.evidenceRefs.length)
            parts.push('Evidence references used for effectiveness review: ' + model.evidenceRefs.slice(0, 5).join(' | '));
        parts.push('Acceptance rule: no recurrence signature, stable control behavior and traceable evidence connecting the action to the improved outcome.');
        return traceOpsEightdJoinParagraphs(parts);
    }
    function traceOpsEightdBuildPreventionText(model) {
        var parts = [];
        if (traceOpsEightdHasText(model.prevention))
            parts.push('Preventive action: ' + model.prevention);
        if (traceOpsEightdHasText(model.lesson))
            parts.push('Lesson learned: ' + model.lesson);
        if (traceOpsEightdHasText(model.pattern))
            parts.push('Yokoten trigger: ' + model.pattern);
        parts.push('System-level follow-up: update CTQs, control logic, traceability rules, alerts, audit checks and replication scope for similar models / stations where applicable.');
        return traceOpsEightdJoinParagraphs(parts);
    }
    function traceOpsEightdBuildClosureText(model, draftStatus) {
        var parts = [];
        if (traceOpsEightdHasText(model.validation)) {
            parts.push('Closure basis: the case can be reviewed for closure once the validated path confirms the action blocked recurrence and the control gap is addressed.');
        }
        else {
            parts.push('Closure basis not yet achieved. Effectiveness evidence is incomplete and the case should remain open for Quality review.');
        }
        parts.push('Current status: ' + (draftStatus || 'Draft') + '.');
        parts.push('Customer-facing statement: this report remains tied to the trace path, linked evidence and current validation status; no unsupported claim of confirmed root cause is made beyond the available evidence.');
        return traceOpsEightdJoinParagraphs(parts);
    }
    function traceOpsEightdNormalizeManualFields(map) {
        var next = {};
        Object.keys(map || {}).forEach(function (key) {
            if (map[key])
                next[key] = true;
        });
        return next;
    }
    function traceOpsEightdEnsureMeta(meta) {
        var next = Object.assign({}, meta || {});
        next.evidence = Object.assign({}, next.evidence || {});
        next.manual_fields = traceOpsEightdNormalizeManualFields(next.manual_fields);
        return next;
    }
    function traceOpsEightdFieldIsManual(draft, key) {
        return !!(draft && draft.meta && draft.meta.manual_fields && draft.meta.manual_fields[key]);
    }
    function traceOpsEightdSetFieldManual(draft, key, isManual) {
        var next = Object.assign({}, draft || {});
        next.meta = traceOpsEightdEnsureMeta(next.meta);
        if (isManual)
            next.meta.manual_fields[key] = true;
        else
            delete next.meta.manual_fields[key];
        return next;
    }
    function traceOpsEightdIsComplementaryField(key) {
        var map = {
            d1_team: 1,
            d1_escalation: 1,
            d2_traceability: 1,
            d2_5w2h: 1,
            bad_part_notes: 1,
            good_part_notes: 1,
            appendix_notes: 1
        };
        return !!map[key];
    }
    function traceOpsEightdHydrateDraftFields(draft) {
        var model = traceOpsEightdBuildModel((draft && draft.source_snapshot) || draft || {}, traceOpsEightdCollectLinkedEvents((draft && (draft.linked_event_ids || draft.event_ids)) || []));
        var next = Object.assign({}, draft || {});
        next.modelo = next.modelo || model.model;
        next.linea = next.linea || model.line;
        next.station = next.station || model.station;
        next.defecto_smt = next.defecto_smt || model.defect;
        next.detection_window = next.detection_window || model.detectionWindow;
        next.impact_summary = next.impact_summary || (model.exposure || model.customerImpact || model.impact);
        next.pattern_detected = next.pattern_detected || model.pattern;
        next.trace_path = next.trace_path || model.tracePath;
        next.complaint_anchor = next.complaint_anchor || model.complaintAnchor;
        next.report_positioning = next.report_positioning || ('Issue under analysis: ' + model.complaintAnchor + ' Issue is not positioned as a confirmed root cause beyond available evidence. Separate component-only findings from installed-state behavior.');
        next.serial_range = next.serial_range || model.serialRange;
        next.lot_batch = next.lot_batch || model.lotBatch;
        next.build_window = next.build_window || model.buildWindow;
        next.data_anchor = next.data_anchor || traceOpsEightdJoinParagraphs([
            model.serialRange ? ('Serial range: ' + model.serialRange) : '',
            model.lotBatch ? ('Lot / batch: ' + model.lotBatch) : '',
            model.supplierLot ? ('Supplier / lot: ' + model.supplierLot) : '',
            model.skuVersion ? ('SKU version: ' + model.skuVersion) : '',
            model.componentPn ? ('Component P/N: ' + model.componentPn) : '',
            model.dateCode ? ('Date code: ' + model.dateCode) : '',
            model.buildWindow ? ('Build window: ' + model.buildWindow) : '',
            'Line / station: ' + [model.line, model.station].join(' · '),
            'Defect SMT: ' + model.defect,
            'Trace path: ' + model.tracePath,
            model.evidenceRefs.length ? ('Event timestamps: ' + model.evidenceRefs.join(' | ')) : ''
        ]);
        next.evidence_summary = next.evidence_summary || traceOpsEightdJoinParagraphs([
            model.evidenceSummary ? ('Evidence summary: ' + model.evidenceSummary) : '',
            model.findings.length ? ('Engineer findings: ' + model.findings.join(' | ')) : '',
            model.actions.length ? ('Executed actions: ' + model.actions.join(' | ')) : ''
        ]);
        next.correlation_notes = next.correlation_notes || traceOpsEightdJoinParagraphs([
            'Correlation logic: ' + model.pattern,
            traceOpsEightdHasText(model.rootCause) ? ('Occurrence evidence supports: ' + model.rootCause) : (traceOpsEightdHasText(model.hypothesis) ? ('Working hypothesis: ' + model.hypothesis) : 'Occurrence hypothesis is still pending.'),
            'Escape review focuses on ' + model.station + ' against the observed failure mode ' + model.defect + '.'
        ]);
        next.evidence_checklist = next.evidence_checklist || '□ Customer symptom image / data\n□ Golden reference comparison\n□ Installed-state vs removed-state comparison\n□ Serial / batch trace\n□ Control limitation explanation\n□ Corrective action proof';
        next.meta = traceOpsEightdEnsureMeta(next.meta);
        next.d1_team_members = traceOpsEightdSeedTeamMembers(model, next.d1_team_members);
        next.d1_escalation_members = traceOpsEightdSeedEscalationMembers(next.d1_team_members, next.d1_escalation_members);
        var manual = next.meta.manual_fields || {};
        next.d1_team = manual.d1_team
            ? (next.d1_team || '')
            : traceOpsEightdBuildTeamTextFromMembers(next.d1_team_members, model);
        next.d1_escalation = manual.d1_escalation
            ? (next.d1_escalation || '')
            : traceOpsEightdBuildEscalationTextFromMembers(next.d1_escalation_members, model);
        next.d2_problem = manual.d2_problem
            ? (next.d2_problem || '')
            : traceOpsEightdBuildProblemText(model);
        next.d2_traceability = manual.d2_traceability
            ? (next.d2_traceability || '')
            : traceOpsEightdJoinParagraphs([
                model.model && model.model !== 'N/D' ? ('Model: ' + model.model) : '',
                model.skuVersion ? ('SKU version: ' + model.skuVersion) : '',
                model.serialRange ? ('Serial / batch: ' + model.serialRange) : '',
                model.lotBatch ? ('Lot / batch: ' + model.lotBatch) : '',
                model.supplierLot ? ('Supplier / lot: ' + model.supplierLot) : '',
                model.componentPn ? ('Component P/N: ' + model.componentPn) : '',
                model.dateCode ? ('Date code: ' + model.dateCode) : '',
                model.buildWindow ? ('Build window: ' + model.buildWindow) : '',
                'Line / station: ' + [model.line || 'To be confirmed', model.station || 'To be confirmed'].join(' · '),
                'Trace path: ' + (model.tracePath || 'Build -> Complaint -> RCCA')
            ]);
        next.d2_5w2h = manual.d2_5w2h
            ? (next.d2_5w2h || '')
            : traceOpsEightdJoinParagraphs([
                'What: ' + (model.defect || 'Issue under review'),
                'Where: ' + [model.line || 'To be confirmed', model.station || 'To be confirmed'].join(' / '),
                'When: ' + (model.detectionWindow || 'To be confirmed'),
                'Who: ' + ((model.owners && model.owners.join(' | ')) || next.owner_email || 'To be confirmed'),
                'How many: ' + (model.serialRange || model.impact || 'Under validation'),
                'Impact: ' + (model.impact || 'Operational and quality impact under review.')
            ]);
        next.bad_part_notes = manual.bad_part_notes
            ? (next.bad_part_notes || '')
            : (next.bad_part_notes || ('Observed bad condition: ' + (model.complaintAnchor || model.defect || 'installed-state deviation under review.')));
        next.good_part_notes = manual.good_part_notes
            ? (next.good_part_notes || '')
            : (next.good_part_notes || ('Reference condition: clean build path, correct P/N, correct feeder position, and expected installed-state behavior for ' + (model.model || 'the affected model') + '.'));
        next.d3_containment = manual.d3_containment
            ? (next.d3_containment || '')
            : traceOpsEightdBuildContainmentText(model);
        next.d4_root_cause = manual.d4_root_cause
            ? (next.d4_root_cause || '')
            : traceOpsEightdBuildOccurrenceText(model);
        next.d4_escape_point = manual.d4_escape_point
            ? (next.d4_escape_point || '')
            : traceOpsEightdBuildEscapeText(model);
        next.d5_pca = manual.d5_pca
            ? (next.d5_pca || '')
            : traceOpsEightdBuildPcaText(model);
        next.d6_validation = manual.d6_validation
            ? (next.d6_validation || '')
            : traceOpsEightdBuildVerificationText(model);
        next.d7_prevention = manual.d7_prevention
            ? (next.d7_prevention || '')
            : traceOpsEightdBuildPreventionText(model);
        next.d8_closure = manual.d8_closure
            ? (next.d8_closure || '')
            : traceOpsEightdBuildClosureText(model, next.status || 'Draft');
        next.appendix_notes = manual.appendix_notes
            ? (next.appendix_notes || '')
            : traceOpsEightdJoinParagraphs([
                'Use actual source evidence only.',
                'Keep each statement tied to one visible proof point.',
                'Do not convert draft text into evidence; the evidence must remain source-linked.'
            ]);
        return next;
    }
    function traceOpsBuildEightdDraftFromRcca(rcca, existing) {
        var source = Object.assign({}, rcca || {});
        var linkedEvents = traceOpsEightdCollectLinkedEvents((source && source.event_ids) || []);
        var model = traceOpsEightdBuildModel(source, linkedEvents);
        var baseDraft = Object.assign({}, existing || {}, {
            eightd_id: existing && existing.eightd_id ? existing.eightd_id : traceOpsBuildEightdId(source && source.rcca_id),
            eightd_title: existing && existing.eightd_title ? existing.eightd_title : (source && (source.titulo_corto || source.problema) ? (source.titulo_corto || source.problema) : ''),
            source_rcca_id: source && source.rcca_id ? source.rcca_id : '',
            source_title: source && (source.titulo_corto || source.problema) ? (source.titulo_corto || source.problema) : '',
            modelo: model.model,
            linea: model.line,
            station: model.station,
            defecto_smt: model.defect,
            detection_window: model.detectionWindow,
            impact_summary: model.exposure || model.customerImpact || model.impact,
            pattern_detected: model.pattern,
            trace_path: model.tracePath,
            complaint_anchor: model.complaintAnchor,
            report_positioning: existing && existing.report_positioning ? existing.report_positioning : ('Issue under analysis: ' + model.complaintAnchor + ' Issue is not positioned as a confirmed root cause beyond available evidence. Separate component-only findings from installed-state behavior.'),
            serial_range: (existing && existing.serial_range) || model.serialRange,
            lot_batch: (existing && existing.lot_batch) || model.lotBatch,
            build_window: (existing && existing.build_window) || model.buildWindow,
            fecha: source && source.fecha ? source.fecha : new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10),
            owner_email: (existing && existing.owner_email) || (source && source.owner_email) || (authUser && authUser.email) || '',
            status: (existing && existing.status) || 'Draft',
            linked_event_ids: (source && source.event_ids ? source.event_ids.slice() : []),
            source_snapshot: Object.assign({}, source, { meta_files: traceOpsNormalizeMetaFiles((source && source.meta_files) || []) }),
            source_rcca_updated_at: (source && source.updated_at) || '',
            source_evidence_fingerprint: traceOpsRccaFingerprint(source),
            meta: Object.assign({}, (source && source.meta) || {}, (existing && existing.meta) || {}, {
                evidence: (existing && existing.meta && existing.meta.evidence) || traceOpsBuildEvidenceMetaFromFiles((source && source.meta_files) || []),
                manual_fields: traceOpsEightdNormalizeManualFields(existing && existing.meta && existing.meta.manual_fields)
            }),
            bad_part_images: (existing && existing.bad_part_images) || (traceOpsBuildEvidenceDisplayMetaFromFiles((source && source.meta_files) || []).bad_part || []).join('\n'),
            good_part_images: (existing && existing.good_part_images) || (traceOpsBuildEvidenceDisplayMetaFromFiles((source && source.meta_files) || []).good_part || []).join('\n'),
            evidence_images: (existing && existing.evidence_images) || (traceOpsBuildEvidenceDisplayMetaFromFiles((source && source.meta_files) || []).general || []).join('\n'),
            evidence_summary: (existing && existing.evidence_summary) || '',
            correlation_notes: (existing && existing.correlation_notes) || '',
            evidence_checklist: (existing && existing.evidence_checklist) || '',
            d1_team_members: traceOpsEightdSeedTeamMembers(model, (existing && existing.d1_team_members) || []),
            d1_escalation_members: (existing && existing.d1_escalation_members) || [],
            d1_team: (existing && existing.d1_team) || '',
            d1_escalation: (existing && existing.d1_escalation) || '',
            d2_problem: (existing && existing.d2_problem) || '',
            d2_traceability: (existing && existing.d2_traceability) || '',
            d2_5w2h: (existing && existing.d2_5w2h) || '',
            bad_part_notes: (existing && existing.bad_part_notes) || '',
            good_part_notes: (existing && existing.good_part_notes) || '',
            appendix_notes: (existing && existing.appendix_notes) || '',
            d3_containment: (existing && existing.d3_containment) || '',
            d4_root_cause: (existing && existing.d4_root_cause) || '',
            d4_escape_point: (existing && existing.d4_escape_point) || '',
            d5_pca: (existing && existing.d5_pca) || '',
            d6_validation: (existing && existing.d6_validation) || '',
            d7_prevention: (existing && existing.d7_prevention) || '',
            d8_closure: (existing && existing.d8_closure) || '',
            updated_at: new Date().toISOString(),
            created_at: existing && existing.created_at ? existing.created_at : new Date().toISOString()
        });
        var draft = traceOpsEightdHydrateDraftFields(baseDraft);
        var readiness = traceOpsComputeEightdReadiness(draft);
        draft.readiness_score = readiness.overallScore;
        draft.structure_readiness_score = readiness.structureScore;
        draft.evidence_readiness_score = readiness.evidenceScore;
        draft.case_maturity_score = readiness.overallScore;
        draft.missing_fields = readiness.structureMissing;
        draft.escalation_blockers = readiness.blockers;
        draft.can_promote = readiness.canPromote;
        draft.draft_stage = readiness.stage;
        return draft;
    }
    async function saveEightdDraft(draft) {
        var draftToSave = Object.assign({}, draft, {
            owner_email: authUser && authUser.email ? authUser.email : (draft.owner_email || ""),
            updated_at: new Date().toISOString()
        });
        var currentMeta = Object.assign({}, draftToSave.meta || {});
        currentMeta = traceOpsEightdEnsureMeta(currentMeta);
        currentMeta.manual_fields = traceOpsEightdNormalizeManualFields(currentMeta.manual_fields);
        var existingEvidence = Object.assign({}, currentMeta.evidence || {});
        currentMeta.evidence = {
            bad_part: traceOpsMergeEvidenceLists(existingEvidence.bad_part || [], draftToSave.bad_part_images || [], draftToSave.bad_part_image || [], draftToSave.bad_part_evidence || []),
            good_part: traceOpsMergeEvidenceLists(existingEvidence.good_part || [], draftToSave.good_part_images || [], draftToSave.good_part_image || [], draftToSave.good_part_evidence || []),
            general: traceOpsMergeEvidenceLists(existingEvidence.general || [], draftToSave.evidence_images || [], draftToSave.installed_removed_images || [])
        };
        draftToSave.meta = currentMeta;
        if (draftToSave.source_snapshot) {
            draftToSave.source_snapshot = Object.assign({}, draftToSave.source_snapshot, { meta_files: traceOpsNormalizeMetaFiles((draftToSave.source_snapshot && draftToSave.source_snapshot.meta_files) || []) });
            draftToSave.source_rcca_updated_at = (draftToSave.source_snapshot && draftToSave.source_snapshot.updated_at) || draftToSave.source_rcca_updated_at || '';
            draftToSave.source_evidence_fingerprint = traceOpsRccaFingerprint(draftToSave.source_snapshot);
        }
        var normalized = traceOpsEightdHydrateDraftFields(draftToSave);
        var readiness = traceOpsComputeEightdReadiness(normalized);
        normalized.readiness_score = readiness.overallScore;
        normalized.structure_readiness_score = readiness.structureScore;
        normalized.evidence_readiness_score = readiness.evidenceScore;
        normalized.case_maturity_score = readiness.overallScore;
        normalized.missing_fields = readiness.structureMissing;
        normalized.escalation_blockers = readiness.blockers;
        normalized.can_promote = readiness.canPromote;
        normalized.draft_stage = readiness.stage;
        var updated = eightdList.filter(function (item) { return item.eightd_id !== normalized.eightd_id; });
        updated = [normalized].concat(updated).sort(function (a, b) {
            var ta = a && a.updated_at ? new Date(a.updated_at).getTime() : 0;
            var tb = b && b.updated_at ? new Date(b.updated_at).getTime() : 0;
            return tb - ta;
        });
        var persistResult = await persistEightdLocal(updated);
        if (!persistResult || !persistResult.ok) {
            alert("No se pudo guardar el Draft 8D localmente. " + traceOpsSafeStorageError(persistResult && persistResult.error));
            return false;
        }
        setEightdDetail(normalized);
        return true;
    }
    async function deleteEightdDraft(eightdId) {
        var updated = eightdList.filter(function (item) { return item.eightd_id !== eightdId; });
        var persistResult = await persistEightdLocal(updated);
        if (!persistResult || !persistResult.ok) {
            alert("No se pudo eliminar el Draft 8D. " + traceOpsSafeStorageError(persistResult && persistResult.error));
            return;
        }
        if (eightdDetail && eightdDetail.eightd_id === eightdId)
            setEightdDetail(null);
    }
    function openEightdDraftFromRcca(rcca, forceRefresh) {
        if (!rcca || !rcca.rcca_id)
            return;
        setActiveModule("8d");
        var existing = eightdList.find(function (item) { return item.source_rcca_id === rcca.rcca_id; });
        var currentFingerprint = traceOpsRccaFingerprint(rcca);
        var needsRefresh = !!(existing && existing.source_evidence_fingerprint !== currentFingerprint);
        if (existing && !forceRefresh && !needsRefresh) {
            setEightdDetail(existing);
            return;
        }
        var draft = traceOpsBuildEightdDraftFromRcca(rcca, existing);
        setEightdDetail(draft);
    }
    function traceOpsEightdDraftValue(primary, fallback, finalFallback) {
        if (traceOpsEightdHasText(primary))
            return primary;
        if (traceOpsEightdHasText(fallback))
            return fallback;
        return finalFallback || '';
    }
    function traceOpsBuildEightdHtml(draft) {
        var normalized = traceOpsEightdHydrateDraftFields(Object.assign({}, draft || {}));
        var model = traceOpsEightdBuildModel((normalized && normalized.source_snapshot) || normalized || {}, traceOpsEightdCollectLinkedEvents((normalized && (normalized.linked_event_ids || normalized.event_ids)) || []));
        function esc(v) { return traceOpsEightdEsc(v); }
        function block(title, body, variant) {
            return `<section class="fx-card${variant ? ' ' + variant : ''}"><div class="fx-label">${esc(title)}</div><div class="fx-copy">${esc(body || 'To be confirmed')}</div></section>`;
        }
        var linkedEvents = model.linked;
        var d1TeamMembers = traceOpsEightdSeedTeamMembers(model, normalized.d1_team_members);

        function teamTableCard(title, members, summary) {

                return `<tr><td>${esc(item.role || 'To be confirmed')}</td><td>${esc(item.name || 'To be confirmed')}</td><td>${esc(item.email || 'To be confirmed')}</td></tr>`;
            }).join('');
            return `<section class="fx-card"><div class="fx-label">${esc(title)}</div><table><thead><tr><th>Role</th><th>Name</th><th>E-mail</th></tr></thead><tbody>${rows}</tbody></table>${summary ? `<div class="note" style="margin-top:12px">${esc(summary)}</div>` : ''}</section>`;
        }
        var d1EscalationText = traceOpsEightdDraftValue(normalized.d1_escalation, '', 'Escalation path pending.');
        var d2TraceabilityText = traceOpsEightdDraftValue(normalized.d2_traceability, normalized.data_anchor, 'Traceability details pending.');
        var d25w2hText = traceOpsEightdDraftValue(normalized.d2_5w2h, '', '5W2H delimitation pending.');
        var badPartText = traceOpsEightdDraftValue(normalized.bad_part_notes, normalized.bad_part, normalized.complaint_anchor || model.complaintAnchor || 'Incorrect setup / failure condition.');

        var timelineRows = linkedEvents.length ? linkedEvents.slice(0, 10).map(function (item) {

        }).join('') : `<tr><td>Build</td><td>To be confirmed</td><td>Trace reconstruction pending</td><td>TraceOps</td></tr>`;
        var evidenceRows = linkedEvents.length ? linkedEvents.slice(0, 12).map(function (item) {
            var step = item && (item.linea_estacion || item.tipo_evento || item.area_involucrada || 'Event');
            var ts = [item && item.fecha || '', item && item.hora || ''].join(' ').trim();
            var result = item && (item.estatus || item.estado_historia || item.impacto || 'Observed');
            var observation = item && (item.engineer_findings_full || item.engineer_findings || item.evento_detectado_full || item.evento_detectado || item.defecto_smt || 'Pending');
            var source = item && (item.id || item.reporta || item.sender || 'TraceOps');
            var why = item && (item.accion_requerida || item.impacto || 'Supports the trace path');
            return `<tr><td>${esc(step)}</td><td>${esc(ts || 'N/D')}</td><td>${esc(result || 'Observed')}</td><td>${esc(traceOpsEightdShort(observation, 180) || 'Pending')}</td><td>${esc(source || 'TraceOps')}</td><td>${esc(traceOpsEightdShort(why, 120) || 'Supports the trace path')}</td></tr>`;
        }).join('') : `<tr><td>Build</td><td>To be confirmed</td><td>Observed</td><td>Evidence linkage pending</td><td>TraceOps</td><td>Starting condition</td></tr>`;
        var dataAnchor = normalized.data_anchor || traceOpsEightdJoinParagraphs([
            normalized.serial_range ? ('Serial range: ' + normalized.serial_range) : '',

            normalized.build_window ? ('Build window: ' + normalized.build_window) : '',
            'Line / station: ' + [normalized.linea || model.line, normalized.station || model.station].join(' · '),
            'Defect SMT: ' + (normalized.defecto_smt || model.defect),
            'Trace path: ' + (normalized.trace_path || model.tracePath || 'Build -> Complaint -> RCCA')
        ]);
        return `<!DOCTYPE html>
