    function traceOpsPptNormalizeUnicodeText(v) {
        var s = String(v == null ? "" : v);
        try {
            s = s.normalize('NFKC');
        }
        catch (_) { }
        var out = [];
        for (var i = 0; i < s.length; i++) {
            var code = s.charCodeAt(i);
            if (code >= 0xD800 && code <= 0xDBFF) {
                var next = s.charCodeAt(i + 1);
                if (next >= 0xDC00 && next <= 0xDFFF) {
                    out.push(s.charAt(i), s.charAt(i + 1));
                    i += 1;
                }
                continue;
            }
            if (code >= 0xDC00 && code <= 0xDFFF)
                continue;
            out.push(s.charAt(i));
        }
        return out.join('');
    }
    function traceOpsPptSanitizeText(v, limit) {
        var s = traceOpsPptNormalizeUnicodeText(v);
        s = s
            .replace(/\r/g, "")
            .replace(/[\u0000-\u0008\u000B\u000C\u000E-\u001F\u007F-\u009F]/g, "")
            .replace(/[\u200B\u200C\u200D\u200E\u200F\u202A\u202B\u202C\u202D\u202E\u202F\u2060\u2066\u2067\u2068\u2069\uFEFF]/g, "")
            .replace(/[\uFDD0-\uFDEF\uFFFE\uFFFF]/g, "")
            .replace(/\u2028|\u2029/g, "\n")
            .replace(/[\u2018\u2019]/g, "'")
            .replace(/[\u201C\u201D]/g, '"')
            .replace(/[\u2013\u2014]/g, "-")
            .replace(/[\u2022\u25CF\u25CB\u25A0\u25A1]/g, "•")
            .replace(/<br\s*\/?>/gi, "\n")
            .replace(/<[^>]+>/g, " ")
            .replace(/&nbsp;/gi, " ")
            .replace(/&amp;/gi, "&")
            .replace(/&lt;/gi, "<")
            .replace(/&gt;/gi, ">")
            .replace(/\t/g, " ")
            .replace(/\n{3,}/g, "\n\n")
            .replace(/[ ]{2,}/g, " ")
            .trim();
        if (limit && s.length > limit)
            s = s.slice(0, Math.max(0, limit - 3)).trim() + "...";
        return s;
    }
    function traceOpsPptSafe(v, limit) {
        return traceOpsPptSanitizeText(v, limit || 0);
    }
    function traceOpsPptSafeCell(v, limit) {
        var clean = traceOpsPptSanitizeText(v, limit || 180);
        return clean.replace(/\n+/g, " ").trim();
    }
    function traceOpsPptSanitizeOptionsDeep(value, depth) {
        if (depth > 8)
            return value;
        if (value == null)
            return value;
        if (typeof value === "string")
            return traceOpsPptSanitizeText(value, 0);
        if (Array.isArray(value)) {
            return value.map(function (item) { return traceOpsPptSanitizeOptionsDeep(item, depth + 1); });
        }
        if (typeof value === "object") {
            var out = {};
            Object.keys(value).forEach(function (key) {
                var item = value[key];
                if (key === "text")
                    out[key] = traceOpsPptSanitizeTextArg(item);
                else
                    out[key] = traceOpsPptSanitizeOptionsDeep(item, depth + 1);
            });
            return out;
        }
        return value;
    }
    function traceOpsPptSanitizeTextArg(text) {
        if (Array.isArray(text)) {
            return text.map(function (run) {
                if (run == null)
                    return { text: "" };
                if (typeof run === "string" || typeof run === "number" || typeof run === "boolean") {
                    return { text: traceOpsPptSanitizeText(run, 0) };
                }
                if (typeof run === "object") {
                    var out = {};
                    Object.keys(run).forEach(function (key) {
                        if (key === "text")
                            out[key] = traceOpsPptSanitizeText(run[key], 0);
                        else
                            out[key] = traceOpsPptSanitizeOptionsDeep(run[key], 0);
                    });
                    if (!("text" in out))
                        out.text = "";
                    return out;
                }
                return { text: traceOpsPptSanitizeText(String(run), 0) };
            });
        }
        if (text && typeof text === "object" && text.text != null) {
            var obj = {};
            Object.keys(text).forEach(function (key) {
                if (key === "text")
                    obj[key] = traceOpsPptSanitizeText(text[key], 0);
                else
                    obj[key] = traceOpsPptSanitizeOptionsDeep(text[key], 0);
            });
            return obj;
        }
        return traceOpsPptSanitizeText(text, 0);
    }
    function traceOpsPptSanitizeTableCell(cell) {
        if (cell && typeof cell === "object" && !Array.isArray(cell)) {
            var out = {};
            Object.keys(cell).forEach(function (key) {
                if (key === "text")
                    out[key] = traceOpsPptSafeCell(cell[key], 220);
                else if (key === "options")
                    out[key] = traceOpsPptSanitizeOptionsDeep(cell[key], 0);
                else
                    out[key] = traceOpsPptSanitizeOptionsDeep(cell[key], 0);
            });
            if (!("text" in out) && !("image" in out))
                out.text = "";
            return out;
        }
        return traceOpsPptSafeCell(cell, 220);
    }
    function traceOpsPptSafeTable(rows) {
        if (!Array.isArray(rows))
            return [];
        return rows.map(function (row) {
            if (!Array.isArray(row))
                row = [row];
            return row.map(function (cell) {
                return traceOpsPptSanitizeTableCell(cell);
            });
        });
    }
    function traceOpsPptWrap(v, limit) {
        var txt = traceOpsPptSafe(v, limit || 0);
        if (!txt)
            return "Pending";
        var clean = txt.replace(/\n{3,}/g, "\n\n");
        if (limit && clean.length > limit)
            return clean.slice(0, Math.max(0, limit - 3)).trim() + "...";
        return clean;
    }
    var _traceOpsPptxRef = null;
    function traceOpsPptPatchSlideMethods(slide) {
        if (!slide || slide.__traceopsPatched)
            return slide;
        slide.__traceopsPatched = true;
        var originalAddText = typeof slide.addText === "function" ? slide.addText : null;
        if (originalAddText) {
            slide.addText = function (text, options) {
                return originalAddText.call(this, traceOpsPptSanitizeTextArg(text), traceOpsPptSanitizeOptionsDeep(options, 0));
            };
        }
        var originalAddTable = typeof slide.addTable === "function" ? slide.addTable : null;
        if (originalAddTable) {
            slide.addTable = function (rows, options) {
                return originalAddTable.call(this, traceOpsPptSafeTable(rows), traceOpsPptSanitizeOptionsDeep(options, 0));
            };
        }
        var originalAddShape = typeof slide.addShape === "function" ? slide.addShape : null;
        if (originalAddShape) {
            slide.addShape = function (shapeType, options) {
                var resolvedShape = shapeType;
                if (typeof shapeType === "string") {
                    var st = (typeof PptxGenJS !== "undefined" && PptxGenJS && PptxGenJS.ShapeType)
                        ? PptxGenJS.ShapeType
                        : {};
                    var shapeMap = {
                        roundRect: st.roundRect,
                        rect: st.rect,
                        ellipse: st.ellipse,
                        chevron: st.chevron,
                        line: st.line
                    };
                    resolvedShape = shapeMap[shapeType] || st[shapeType] || shapeType;
                }
                return originalAddShape.call(this, resolvedShape, traceOpsPptSanitizeOptionsDeep(options, 0));
            };
        }
        var originalAddNotes = typeof slide.addNotes === "function" ? slide.addNotes : null;
        if (originalAddNotes) {
            slide.addNotes = function (text) {
                return originalAddNotes.call(this, traceOpsPptSanitizeText(text, 0));
            };
        }
        return slide;
    }
    function traceOpsPptHardenDeck(pptx) {
        if (!pptx || pptx.__traceopsDeckPatched)
            return pptx;
        _traceOpsPptxRef = pptx;
        pptx.__traceopsDeckPatched = true;
        var originalAddSlide = typeof pptx.addSlide === "function" ? pptx.addSlide : null;
        if (originalAddSlide) {
            pptx.addSlide = function () {
                var slide = originalAddSlide.apply(this, arguments);
                return traceOpsPptPatchSlideMethods(slide);
            };
        }
        if (typeof pptx.defineLayout === "function") {
            var originalDefineLayout = pptx.defineLayout;
            pptx.defineLayout = function (layout) {
                return originalDefineLayout.call(this, traceOpsPptSanitizeOptionsDeep(layout, 0));
            };
        }
        return pptx;
    }

    function traceOpsPptSplitBullets(value, maxItems, maxLen) {
        var txt = traceOpsPptWrap(value, maxLen || 900);
        if (!txt)
            return ['To be confirmed'];
        var parts = String(txt)
            .replace(/\r/g, '\n')
            .replace(/([.!?;])\s+/g, '$1\n')
            .replace(/\s*•\s+/g, '\n')
            .replace(/\s+-\s+/g, '\n')
            .split(/\n+/)
            .map(function (item) { return traceOpsPptSafe(item, 180).trim(); })
            .filter(function (item) { return item && item.length > 3; });
        if (!parts.length)
            parts = [traceOpsPptSafe(txt, 180)];
        return parts.slice(0, maxItems || 6);
    }
    function traceOpsPptDrawBulletList(slide, bullets, x, y, w, h, opts) {

        }
    }

    function traceOpsPptDrawFishbone(slide, categories, x, y, w, h) {
        if (!_traceOpsPptxRef || !_traceOpsPptxRef.ShapeType)
            return;
        var top = Array.isArray(categories) ? categories.slice(0, 3) : [];
        var bottom = Array.isArray(categories) ? categories.slice(3, 6) : [];
        while (top.length < 3)
            top.push({ label: 'Category', items: ['Reference evidence to be attached'] });
        while (bottom.length < 3)
            bottom.push({ label: 'Category', items: ['Reference evidence to be attached'] });
        function drawLineSafe(x1, y1, x2, y2, pt) {
            var left = Math.min(x1, x2);
            var topY = Math.min(y1, y2);
            slide.addShape(_traceOpsPptxRef.ShapeType.line, {
                x: left,
                y: topY,
                w: Math.abs(x2 - x1),
                h: Math.abs(y2 - y1),
                line: { color: '4A90E2', pt: pt || 1.2 }
            });
        }
        var centerY = y + (h / 2);
        var spineStartX = x + 0.56;
        var spineEndX = x + w - 0.72;
        drawLineSafe(spineStartX, centerY, spineEndX - 0.04, centerY, 1.8);
        slide.addShape(_traceOpsPptxRef.ShapeType.chevron, { x: spineEndX - 0.16, y: centerY - 0.22, w: 0.52, h: 0.44, line: { color: '4A90E2', pt: 1 }, fill: { color: '4A90E2' } });
        var ribs = [1.48, 3.16, 4.84];
        for (var i = 0; i < 3; i++) {
            var topItem = top[i] || { label: 'Category', items: ['Reference evidence to be attached'] };
            var bottomItem = bottom[i] || { label: 'Category', items: ['Reference evidence to be attached'] };
            var ax = x + ribs[i];
            var topJointX = ax - 0.68;
            var topJointY = centerY - 0.64;
            var bottomJointX = ax - 0.68;
            var bottomJointY = centerY + 0.64;
            drawLineSafe(ax, centerY, topJointX, topJointY, 1.2);
            drawLineSafe(ax, centerY, bottomJointX, bottomJointY, 1.2);
            slide.addShape((_traceOpsPptxRef && _traceOpsPptxRef.ShapeType && _traceOpsPptxRef.ShapeType.rect ? _traceOpsPptxRef.ShapeType.rect : "rect"), { x: ax - 1.14, y: y + 0.12, w: 1.48, h: 0.30, rectRadius: 0.04, line: { color: 'DCE9E2', pt: 1 }, fill: { color: 'FFFFFF' } });
            slide.addText(traceOpsPptSafe(topItem.label, 26), { x: ax - 1.06, y: y + 0.20, w: 1.30, h: 0.10, fontFace: 'Arial', fontSize: 8.2, bold: true, color: '2F6FB3', align: 'center', margin: 0, fit: 'shrink' });
            slide.addText(traceOpsPptWrap(((topItem.items && topItem.items[0]) || 'Reference evidence to be attached'), 74), { x: ax - 1.12, y: y + 0.46, w: 1.42, h: 0.34, fontFace: 'Arial', fontSize: 7.8, color: '102A43', margin: 0, fit: 'shrink', align: 'center' });
            slide.addShape((_traceOpsPptxRef && _traceOpsPptxRef.ShapeType && _traceOpsPptxRef.ShapeType.rect ? _traceOpsPptxRef.ShapeType.rect : "rect"), { x: ax - 1.14, y: y + h - 0.42, w: 1.48, h: 0.30, rectRadius: 0.04, line: { color: 'DCE9E2', pt: 1 }, fill: { color: 'FAFCFF' } });
            slide.addText(traceOpsPptSafe(bottomItem.label, 26), { x: ax - 1.06, y: y + h - 0.34, w: 1.30, h: 0.10, fontFace: 'Arial', fontSize: 8.2, bold: true, color: '2F6FB3', align: 'center', margin: 0, fit: 'shrink' });

        }
        slide.addText('Probable\nCause', { x: x + w - 1.24, y: centerY - 0.30, w: 0.54, h: 0.40, fontFace: 'Arial', fontSize: 8.8, bold: true, color: '4A90E2', margin: 0, align: 'center', valign: 'mid' });
    }

    function traceOpsPptExtractEvidenceNames(value) {
        if (!value)
            return [];
        if (Array.isArray(value))
            return value.filter(Boolean).map(function (item) { return String(item).trim(); }).filter(Boolean);
        if (typeof value === 'string') {
            return value.split(/[\n|,;]/).map(function (item) { return String(item || '').trim(); }).filter(Boolean);
        }
        return [];
    }
    async function traceOpsPptResolveImageData(value) {
        if (!value)
            return null;
        var src = String(value || '').trim();
        if (!src)
            return null;
        if (/^data:image\//i.test(src))
            return src;
        if (/^https?:\/\//i.test(src))
            return src;
        if (/\.(png|jpe?g|webp)$/i.test(src) && typeof loadImg === 'function') {
            try {
                return await loadImg(src);
            }
            catch (_) {
                return null;
            }
        }
        return null;
    }
    function traceOpsPptGetEvidenceMeta(normalized) {
        var ev = normalized && normalized.meta && normalized.meta.evidence ? normalized.meta.evidence : {};
        return {
            bad: traceOpsPptExtractEvidenceNames(ev.bad_part || ev.bad || []),
            good: traceOpsPptExtractEvidenceNames(ev.good_part || ev.good || []),
            general: traceOpsPptExtractEvidenceNames(ev.general || [])
        };
    }
    async function traceOpsPptPickEvidenceImage(normalized, slot) {
        var metaEv = traceOpsPptGetEvidenceMeta(normalized);
        var preferred = [];
        if (slot === 'bad') {
            preferred = preferred.concat(metaEv.bad, traceOpsPptExtractEvidenceNames(normalized.bad_part_image), traceOpsPptExtractEvidenceNames(normalized.bad_part_images), traceOpsPptExtractEvidenceNames(normalized.bad_part_evidence));
        }
        else if (slot === 'good') {
            preferred = preferred.concat(metaEv.good, traceOpsPptExtractEvidenceNames(normalized.good_part_image), traceOpsPptExtractEvidenceNames(normalized.good_part_images), traceOpsPptExtractEvidenceNames(normalized.good_part_evidence));
        }
        preferred = preferred.concat(metaEv.general, traceOpsPptExtractEvidenceNames(normalized.installed_removed_images), traceOpsPptExtractEvidenceNames(normalized.evidence_images));
        for (var i = 0; i < preferred.length; i++) {
            var resolved = await traceOpsPptResolveImageData(preferred[i]);
            if (resolved)
                return resolved;
        }
        return null;
    }
    async function traceOpsPptRenderEvidencePanel(slide, opts) {
        var x = opts.x, y = opts.y, w = opts.w, h = opts.h;
        var label = opts.label || 'Evidence';
        var caption = opts.caption || 'Reference evidence to be attached';
        var tone = opts.tone || 'neutral';
        var imageData = opts.imageData || null;
        var fills = { bad: ['FDF0EE', 'F0C4BE', 'C0392B'], good: ['EEF6FF', 'B8DECE', '1A7A3C'], neutral: ['FFFFFF', 'DCE9E2', '5F766C'] };
        var palette = fills[tone] || fills.neutral;
        traceOpsPptBox(slide, x, y, w, h, palette[0], palette[1]);
        slide.addText(traceOpsPptSafe(label, 34), { x: x + 0.10, y: y + 0.08, w: w - 0.20, h: 0.12, fontFace: 'Segoe UI', fontSize: 8.8, bold: true, color: '5F766C', align: 'center', margin: 0, fit: 'shrink' });
        var innerX = x + 0.12, innerY = y + 0.26, innerW = w - 0.24, innerH = h - 0.48;
        slide.addShape((_traceOpsPptxRef && _traceOpsPptxRef.ShapeType && _traceOpsPptxRef.ShapeType.rect ? _traceOpsPptxRef.ShapeType.rect : "rect"), { x: innerX, y: innerY, w: innerW, h: innerH, rectRadius: 0.04, line: { color: palette[1], pt: 1 }, fill: { color: 'FFFFFF' } });
        if (imageData) {
            try {
                slide.addImage({ data: imageData, x: innerX + 0.02, y: innerY + 0.02, w: innerW - 0.04, h: innerH - 0.04, sizing: 'contain' });
            }
            catch (_) {
                slide.addText('Image unavailable', { x: innerX + 0.10, y: innerY + (innerH / 2) - 0.08, w: innerW - 0.20, h: 0.16, fontFace: 'Segoe UI', fontSize: 8.6, color: '8A8580', align: 'center', margin: 0 });
            }
        }
        else {
            slide.addText('Reference evidence to be attached', { x: innerX + 0.10, y: innerY + (innerH / 2) - 0.08, w: innerW - 0.20, h: 0.16, fontFace: 'Segoe UI', fontSize: 8.6, color: '8A8580', align: 'center', margin: 0 });
        }
        slide.addText(traceOpsPptSafe(caption, 36), { x: x + 0.10, y: y + h - 0.16, w: w - 0.20, h: 0.10, fontFace: 'Segoe UI', fontSize: 7.2, bold: true, color: palette[2], align: 'center', margin: 0, fit: 'shrink' });
    }
    function traceOpsPptNormalizeWhys(source, fallbackLabel) {
        var arr = [];
        if (Array.isArray(source))
            arr = source.slice();
        else if (typeof source === 'string' && source.trim())
            arr = traceOpsPptSplitBullets(source, 5, 900);
        arr = arr.map(function (item) { return traceOpsPptWrap(item, 118); }).filter(Boolean);
        while (arr.length < 5) {
            arr.push((arr.length === 4 ? 'Under validation' : ((fallbackLabel || 'Why') + ' ' + (arr.length + 1) + ' pending confirmation')));
        }
        return arr.slice(0, 5);
    }
    function traceOpsPptBuildIshikawa(normalized, model) {
        var raw = normalized && normalized.d4_ishikawa;
        var sourceText = [
            normalized && normalized.d4_root_cause || '',
            normalized && normalized.d4_escape_point || '',
            normalized && normalized.d2_problem || '',
            normalized && normalized.evidence_summary || '',
            normalized && normalized.correlation_notes || '',
            model && model.pattern || '',
            model && model.rootCause || '',
            model && model.occurrenceSummary || '',
            model && model.findings && model.findings.length ? model.findings.slice(0, 4).join(' | ') : ''
        ].join(' ');
        var sourceBullets = traceOpsPptSplitBullets(sourceText, 18, 1800);
        var used = {};
        function norm(line) {
            return String(line || '').toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z0-9]+/g, ' ').trim();
        }
        function pickItems(key) {
            var items = [];
            if (raw && typeof raw === 'object' && Array.isArray(raw[key])) {
                items = raw[key].slice(0, 2);
            }
            if (!items.length) {
                items = sourceBullets.filter(function (line) {
                    var low = String(line || '').toLowerCase();
                    if (key === 'machine')
                        return /machine|equipment|printer|oven|fixture|feeder|tester|ict|aoi|5dx|x ray|x-ray|cleaning capability/.test(low);
                    if (key === 'method')
                        return /process|method|profile|stencil|print|inspection|procedure|control|bypass|cleaning|release/.test(low);
                    if (key === 'material')
                        return /solder|paste|flux|component|material|package|pad|pcb|geometry|supplier|residue/.test(low);
                    if (key === 'man')
                        return /operator|training|handling|setup|manual|discipline|released|wipe/.test(low);
                    if (key === 'measurement')
                        return /spi|measurement|detect|coverage|limit|threshold|verification|x ray|x-ray|aoi|ict|images/.test(low);
                    if (key === 'environment')
                        return /temperature|humidity|storage|contamination|environment/.test(low);
                    return false;
                }).slice(0, 3);
            }
            items = items.map(function (item) { return traceOpsEightdShort(item, 88); }).filter(Boolean).filter(function (item) {
                var k = norm(item);
                if (!k)
                    return false;
                if (used[k])
                    return false;
                used[k] = true;
                return true;
            });
            if (!items.length)
                items = ['Reference evidence to be attached'];
            return items.slice(0, 1);
        }
        return [
            { label: 'Machine', items: pickItems('machine') },
            { label: 'Method', items: pickItems('method') },
            { label: 'Material', items: pickItems('material') },
            { label: 'Man', items: pickItems('man') },
            { label: 'Measurement', items: pickItems('measurement') },
            { label: 'Environment', items: pickItems('environment') }
        ];
    }
    function traceOpsPptOccurrenceEvidence(model, normalized) {
        var bullets = [];
        if (model.findings && model.findings.length)
            bullets = bullets.concat(model.findings.slice(0, 2));
        if (traceOpsEightdHasText(model.pattern))
            bullets.push('Pattern: ' + model.pattern);
        if (traceOpsEightdHasText(normalized && normalized.evidence_summary))
            bullets.push('Evidence: ' + normalized.evidence_summary);
        if (!bullets.length)
            bullets.push('Reference evidence to be attached linkage to the trace path.');
        return bullets.slice(0, 4);
    }
    function traceOpsPptSortStrategyText(model, normalized) {
        var parts = [];
        if (model.actions && model.actions.length)
            parts = parts.concat(model.actions.slice(0, 2));
        if (traceOpsEightdHasText(model.validation))
            parts.push('Verification gate: ' + model.validation);
        if (traceOpsEightdHasText(model.containment) && parts.length < 4)
            parts.push('Hold / containment: ' + model.containment);
        parts = traceOpsEightdUnique(parts).map(function (item) { return traceOpsEightdShort(item, 140); }).filter(Boolean);
        if (!parts.length) {
            parts = [
                'Identify affected lot, work order or serial population before release.',
                'Inspect critical locations and adjacent material before disposition.',
                'Keep customer shielding active until control verification closes.'
            ];
        }
        return parts.slice(0, 4);
    }
    function traceOpsPptEscapeConclusionText(normalized, model) {
        var base = traceOpsEightdHasText(normalized && normalized.d4_escape_point) ? normalized.d4_escape_point : model.escapeSummary;
        var station = model.station || normalized.station || 'the expected detection stage';
        var defect = normalized.defecto_smt || model.defect || 'the failure mode';
        var parts = [];
        if (traceOpsEightdHasText(base))
            parts.push(traceOpsEightdShort(base, 150));
        parts.push('Current evidence indicates the missed trigger is associated with ' + station + '.');
        parts.push('Final escape point remains under validation until one specific control limitation is confirmed against ' + defect + '.');
        return traceOpsEightdJoinParagraphs(parts);
    }
    function traceOpsPptEvidenceSummaryText(normalized, model) {
        if (traceOpsEightdHasText(normalized && normalized.evidence_summary))
            return normalized.evidence_summary;
        var parts = [];
        if (model.findings && model.findings.length)
            parts = parts.concat(model.findings.slice(0, 3));
        if (model.evidenceRefs && model.evidenceRefs.length)
            parts.push('Linked references: ' + model.evidenceRefs.slice(0, 3).join(' | '));
        if (traceOpsEightdHasText(model.pattern))
            parts.push('Pattern confirmed in trace: ' + model.pattern);
        parts = traceOpsEightdUnique(parts).filter(Boolean);
        if (!parts.length)
            parts = ['Evidence summary pending. Add symptom proof, lot trace and control records before closure.'];
        return parts.join(' ');
    }
    function traceOpsPptCorrelationText(normalized, model) {
        if (traceOpsEightdHasText(normalized && normalized.correlation_notes))
            return normalized.correlation_notes;
        var parts = [];
        if (traceOpsEightdHasText(model.occurrenceSummary))
            parts.push('Occurrence pattern: ' + model.occurrenceSummary);
        if (traceOpsEightdHasText(model.escapeSummary))
            parts.push('Escape logic: ' + model.escapeSummary);
        if (model.tracePath && model.tracePath !== 'Build -> Complaint -> RCCA')
            parts.push('Trace path: ' + model.tracePath + '.');
        if (!parts.length)
            parts.push('Correlation pending. Connect one visible variation, one missed control and one measurable symptom.');
        return traceOpsEightdJoinParagraphs(parts);
    }
    function traceOpsPptAppendixCheckpointRows(normalized, model) {
        var evidenceRefs = Array.isArray(model && model.evidenceRefs) ? model.evidenceRefs : [];
        var symptomText = ''
            + ((model && model.complaintAnchor) || '')
            + ' ' + ((normalized && normalized.complaint_anchor) || '')
            + ' ' + ((model && model.issueTitle) || '');
        var evidenceSummary = traceOpsPptEvidenceSummaryText(normalized, model);
        var correlationText = traceOpsPptCorrelationText(normalized, model);
        var hasGolden = evidenceRefs.length > 1 || /golden|good part|reference/i.test(evidenceSummary + ' ' + correlationText);
        var hasCompare = evidenceRefs.length > 0 || /installed|removed|bad part|good part|comparison/i.test(evidenceSummary + ' ' + correlationText);
        var hasSerialTrace = /serial|batch|lot|trace/i.test(evidenceSummary + ' ' + correlationText);
        var hasControlGap = /control|escape|gap|trigger|detection/i.test(correlationText + ' ' + ((model && model.escapeSummary) || ''));
        var hasActionProof = Array.isArray(model && model.actions) && model.actions.length > 0;
        return [
            [
                'Customer symptom',
                traceOpsEightdHasText(symptomText) ? 'Available' : 'Pending',
                'Keep observable customer or internal symptom visible'
            ],
            [
                'Golden reference',
                hasGolden ? 'Available' : 'Review',
                'Maintain expected-good condition even if pending'
            ],
            [
                'Installed vs removed state comparison',
                hasCompare ? 'Available' : 'Review',
                'Do not suppress comparison checkpoint'
            ],
            [
                'Serial / batch trace',
                hasSerialTrace ? 'Available' : 'Pending',
                'Preserve lot or serial trace status'
            ],
            [
                'Control gap explanation',
                hasControlGap ? 'Available' : 'Pending',
                'State why earlier control did not trigger'
            ],
            [
                'Corrective action proof',
                hasActionProof ? 'Under validation' : 'Pending',
                'Closure requires post-action proof'
            ]
        ];
    }
    function traceOpsPptBuildActionRows(normalized, model) {
        var baseText = [
            normalized && normalized.d5_pca || '',
            model && model.pca || '',
            model && model.actions && model.actions.length ? model.actions.join(' | ') : ''
        ].join(' | ');
        var bullets = traceOpsPptSplitBullets(baseText, 10, 2200);
        bullets = traceOpsEightdUnique((bullets || []).map(function (item) {
            return traceOpsEightdShort(String(item || '').trim(), 120);
        }).filter(Boolean));
        if (!bullets.length) {
            bullets = [
                'Block recurrence at the occurrence point with one owner-defined action.',
                'Strengthen detection coverage at the escape control stage.',
                'Validate effectiveness with traceable post-action evidence before closure.'
            ];
        }
        return bullets.slice(0, 4).map(function (item, idx) {
            var low = String(item || '').toLowerCase();
            var address = 'Occurrence';
            if (/detect|aoi|ict|control|screen|inspection|coverage|escape|audit|verification|trigger/.test(low))
                address = 'Escape';
            if (/both|occurrence and escape|release gate|customer shielding/.test(low))
                address = 'Both';
            var owner = (model && model.owners && model.owners.length ? model.owners[0] : 'Quality');
            if (/kitting|material|reel|part|supplier|pcb/.test(low))
                owner = 'Materiales / Kitting';
            else if (/feeder|setup|placement|process|smt|stencil|paste|reflow|cleaning|printing/.test(low))
                owner = 'Process / SMT';
            else if (/aoi|ict|detect|inspection|coverage|audit|verification|screen|trigger/.test(low))
                owner = 'Quality / Test';
            var due = idx === 0 ? 'Now' : (idx === 1 ? 'Next' : 'Planned');
            var status = traceOpsEightdHasText(normalized && normalized.d6_validation) ? 'Validation' : (idx < 2 ? 'Open' : 'Planned');
            return [
                traceOpsPptWrap(item, 104),
                address,
                owner,
                due,
                status
            ];
        });
    }

    function traceOpsPptReadinessMeta(normalized) {
        var computed = traceOpsComputeEightdReadiness(normalized || {});
        var labelMap = {
            d1_team: 'D1 Team', d2_problem: 'D2 Problem', d3_containment: 'D3 Containment', d4_root_cause: 'D4 Occurrence',
            d4_escape_point: 'D4 Escape', d5_pca: 'D5 Actions', d6_validation: 'D6 Validation', d7_prevention: 'D7 Prevention'
        };
        return {
            score: computed.overallScore,
            structureScore: computed.structureScore,
            evidenceScore: computed.evidenceScore,
            missing: (computed.structureMissing || []).map(function (key) { return labelMap[key] || key; }),
            blockers: computed.blockers || [],
            completed: computed.completed,
            basis: 'Structure ' + computed.completed + '/8 · Evidence ' + computed.evidenceScore + '% · Overall ' + computed.overallScore + '%.',
            stage: computed.stage,
            canPromote: computed.canPromote
        };
    }
    function traceOpsPptNormalizeAxisLabel(text) {
        var low = String(text || '').toLowerCase();
        if (/detect|escape|aoi|ict|coverage|inspection|verification|screen|trigger|audit|control gap/.test(low))
            return 'Detection';
        if (/system|training|audit|governance|traceability|procedure|standard|yokoten|replication|control plan|pfmea/.test(low))
            return 'System';
        return 'Occurrence';
    }
    function traceOpsPptExtractDateDdMmYyyy(text) {
        var s = String(text || '').trim();
        if (!s)
            return '';
        var dm = s.match(/\b(\d{2})\/(\d{2})\/(\d{4})\b/);
        if (dm)
            return dm[1] + '/' + dm[2] + '/' + dm[3];
        var iso = s.match(/\b(\d{4})-(\d{2})-(\d{2})\b/);
        if (iso)
            return iso[3] + '/' + iso[2] + '/' + iso[1];
        return '';
    }
    function traceOpsPptPlannedDateFromBase(baseDate, daysToAdd) {
        var ms = traceOpsGetDateValue(baseDate);
        if (!ms)
            return 'Pending';
        var d = new Date(ms);
        d.setDate(d.getDate() + (daysToAdd || 0));
        var dd = String(d.getDate()).padStart(2, '0');
        var mm = String(d.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, '0');
        var yy = d.getFullYear();
        return dd + '/' + mm + '/' + yy;
    }
    function traceOpsPptNormLow(text) {
        return String(text || '').toLowerCase().normalize('NFD').replace(/[\u0300-\u036f]/g, '').replace(/[^a-z0-9]+/g, ' ').trim();
    }
    function traceOpsPptOwnerForAxis(axis, model, normalized, seed) {
        var ownerDefault = (model && model.owners && model.owners.length ? model.owners[0] : (normalized && normalized.owner_email) || 'Pending');
        var low = traceOpsPptNormLow(seed || '');
        if (axis === 'Detection')
            return /ict|aoi|inspection|test|quality/.test(low) ? 'Quality / Test' : ownerDefault;
        if (axis === 'System')
            return /material|kitting|supplier|traceability/.test(low) ? 'Materiales / Kitting' : 'Quality';
        if (/material|kitting|reel|part|supplier/.test(low))
            return 'Materiales / Kitting';
        if (/feeder|setup|placement|printer|stencil|paste|reflow|smt|process/.test(low))
            return 'Process / SMT';
        return ownerDefault;
    }
    function traceOpsPptEcdForAxis(axis, normalized, model, seed) {
        var explicit = traceOpsPptExtractDateDdMmYyyy(seed) || traceOpsPptExtractDateDdMmYyyy(normalized && normalized.d5_pca) || traceOpsPptExtractDateDdMmYyyy(normalized && normalized.d6_validation);
        if (explicit)
            return explicit;
        var baseDate = '';
        if (normalized && normalized.detection_window) {
            baseDate = String(normalized.detection_window).split('->')[0].trim();
        }
        if (!baseDate)
            baseDate = (model && model.detectionWindow) || (model && model.buildWindow) || '';
        if (axis === 'Occurrence')
            return traceOpsPptPlannedDateFromBase(baseDate, 7);
        if (axis === 'Detection')
            return traceOpsPptPlannedDateFromBase(baseDate, 14);
        return traceOpsPptPlannedDateFromBase(baseDate, 21);
    }
    function traceOpsPptInferOccurrenceAction(normalized, model) {
        function cleanCandidate(v) {
            var raw = String(v || '').trim();
            if (!raw)
                return '';
            var cleaned = raw
                .replace(/^occurrence\s*[:\-]?\s*/i, '')
                .replace(/^permanent corrective action\s*[:\-]?\s*/i, '')
                .replace(/^corrective action\s*[:\-]?\s*/i, '')
                .replace(/^action\s*[:\-]?\s*/i, '')
                .replace(/^open\s*$/i, '')
                .replace(/^pending\s*$/i, '')
                .trim();
            if (!cleaned)
                return '';
            var lowClean = traceOpsPptNormLow(cleaned);
            if (!lowClean || /^(pending|open|tbd|n d|na|occurrence)$/i.test(lowClean))
                return '';
            if (cleaned.length < 18)
                return '';
            return traceOpsEightdShort(cleaned, 160);
        }
        var low = traceOpsPptNormLow([normalized && normalized.defecto_smt, model && model.defect, normalized && normalized.complaint_anchor, model && model.complaintAnchor, normalized && normalized.d4_root_cause, model && model.rootCause, model && model.hypothesis].join(' '));
        var rawPca = (normalized && normalized.d5_pca) || (model && model.pca) || '';
        var bullets = traceOpsPptSplitBullets(rawPca, 10, 1600);
        var occ = '';
        (bullets || []).some(function (item, idx) {
            var label = traceOpsPptNormalizeAxisLabel(item);
            if (label === 'Occurrence') {
                occ = cleanCandidate(item);
                if (!occ && bullets[idx + 1])
                    occ = cleanCandidate(bullets[idx + 1]);
                return !!occ;
            }
            return false;
        });
        if (!occ) {
            occ = cleanCandidate(rawPca);
            if (occ && /^specific control gap/i.test(occ))
                occ = '';
        }
        if (occ)
            return occ;
        if (/wrong component|wrong p n|material mix|wrong part|feeder|reel|laser mark|kitting/.test(low))
            return 'Implement positive P/N verification at feeder release, eliminate empty-reel reuse, segregate similar packages, and block mixed-kitting returns before run start.';
        if (/short|bridge|solder|micro solder|u518|u519|fine pitch|stencil|paste|reflow/.test(low))
            return 'Adjust stencil, print, and reflow controls at the occurrence point and verify the solder-bridge signature is removed under controlled build conditions.';
        if (/open|lifted|pad|coplanar|pressfit|connector/.test(low))
            return 'Correct the occurrence mechanism at setup or assembly level and verify the physical defect signature is no longer created.';
        return 'Block recurrence at the occurrence point with one controlled setup or process action tied to the validated mechanism.';
    }
    function traceOpsPptInferDetectionAction(normalized, model) {
        var low = traceOpsPptNormLow([normalized && normalized.d4_escape_point, model && model.escapeSummary, normalized && normalized.station, model && model.station, normalized && normalized.defecto_smt, model && model.defect].join(' '));
        if (/wrong component|wrong p n|material mix|feeder|laser mark/.test(low))
            return 'Add positive wrong-part detection at setup: independent P/N confirmation, laser-mark match, and challenge verification against the actual wrong-part signature.';
        if (/short|bridge|solder|micro solder|fine pitch|ict|aoi|5dx|x ray/.test(low))
            return 'Challenge AOI / ICT / X-ray coverage against the actual solder-bridge signature and document the specific control limitation that allowed escape.';
        return 'Challenge the expected detection control with the real defect signature and confirm the trigger blocks the escape path.';
    }
    function traceOpsPptInferSystemAction(normalized, model) {
        var low = traceOpsPptNormLow([normalized && normalized.d7_prevention, model && model.lesson, model && model.pattern, normalized && normalized.complaint_anchor].join(' '));
        if (/wrong component|wrong p n|material mix|feeder|kitting|traceability/.test(low))
            return 'Update kitting, feeder-release, and traceability rules; train affected teams; and replicate the control to similar packages, models, and lines.';
        if (/short|bridge|solder|fine pitch|stencil|paste|reflow/.test(low))
            return 'Standardize design / stencil / process rules for similar fine-pitch components, update control documents, and deploy the lesson learned across affected families.';
        return 'Update standards, training, and audit controls so the same failure pattern cannot recur in similar models, stations, or process families.';
    }
    function traceOpsPptComplianceActionRows(normalized, model) {
        var occAction = traceOpsPptInferOccurrenceAction(normalized, model);
        var detAction = traceOpsPptInferDetectionAction(normalized, model);
        var sysAction = traceOpsPptInferSystemAction(normalized, model);
        return [
            ['Occurrence', traceOpsEightdShort(occAction, 160), traceOpsPptEcdForAxis('Occurrence', normalized, model, occAction), traceOpsPptOwnerForAxis('Occurrence', model, normalized, occAction), 'Open'],
            ['Detection', traceOpsEightdShort(detAction, 160), traceOpsPptEcdForAxis('Detection', normalized, model, detAction), traceOpsPptOwnerForAxis('Detection', model, normalized, detAction), 'Pending'],
            ['System', traceOpsEightdShort(sysAction, 160), traceOpsPptEcdForAxis('System', normalized, model, sysAction), traceOpsPptOwnerForAxis('System', model, normalized, sysAction), 'Pending']
        ];
    }
    function traceOpsPptComplianceVerificationRows(normalized, model) {
        var actionRows = traceOpsPptComplianceActionRows(normalized, model);
        var validationText = traceOpsEightdHasText(normalized && normalized.d6_validation) ? normalized.d6_validation : ((model && model.validation) || 'Validation pending.');
        return actionRows.map(function (row) {
            var axis = String(row[0] || 'Occurrence');
            var action = String(row[1] || 'Pending');
            var due = String(row[2] || 'Pending');
            var owner = String(row[3] || 'Pending').trim() || 'Pending';
            var method = axis === 'Detection'
                ? 'Challenge control logic against the actual defect signature and verify the trigger fires under controlled test conditions.'
                : (axis === 'System'
                    ? 'Audit rollout, training completion, document update, and rule adoption across replicated scope.'
                    : 'Verify setup, material handling, or process control at the occurrence point and confirm non-recurrence in controlled builds.');
            var result = axis === 'Detection'
                ? traceOpsEightdShort('Detection validation: ' + validationText, 130)
                : (axis === 'System'
                    ? traceOpsEightdShort('System validation: ' + validationText, 130)
                    : traceOpsEightdShort('Occurrence validation: ' + validationText, 130));
            return [axis, action, method, result, owner, due];
        });
    }
