    }
    function traceOpsPptBuildFlowNodes(draft, model) {
        var rows = traceOpsPptDetailedEventRows(draft, model);
        var nodes = [];
        function addNode(stage, station, date, tone) {
            nodes.push({
                stage: traceOpsPptSafe(stage || 'Stage', 34),
                station: traceOpsPptSafe(station || 'Pending', 42),
                date: traceOpsPptSafe(date || 'Pending', 28),
                tone: tone || 'blue'
            });
        }
        var buildDate = (draft && draft.build_window) || (model && model.buildWindow) || (draft && draft.detection_window) || (model && model.detectionWindow) || 'Pending';
        addNode('Build', (draft && draft.linea) || (model && model.line) || 'Line pending', buildDate, 'navy');
        if (Array.isArray(rows) && rows.length) {
            var seen = {};
            rows.forEach(function (row, idx) {
                if (nodes.length >= 4)
                    return;
                var stage = String(row[0] || 'Event').trim() || 'Event';
                var station = String(row[2] || row[3] || (draft && draft.station) || (model && model.station) || 'Pending').trim() || 'Pending';
                var date = String(row[4] || buildDate || 'Pending').trim() || 'Pending';
                var key = [stage, station, date].join('|');
                if (seen[key])
                    return;
                seen[key] = true;
                addNode(stage, station, date, idx === 0 ? 'cyan' : 'blue');
            });
        }
        else {
            addNode('Station', (draft && draft.station) || (model && model.station) || 'Pending', (draft && draft.detection_window) || (model && model.detectionWindow) || buildDate, 'blue');
        }
        addNode('Complaint', (draft && draft.station) || (model && model.station) || 'Complaint anchor', (draft && draft.detection_window) || (model && model.detectionWindow) || buildDate, 'red');
        addNode('RCCA', (draft && draft.source_rcca_id) ? ('ID ' + draft.source_rcca_id) : 'Actions defined', traceOpsPptExtractDateDdMmYyyy((draft && draft.updated_at) || (draft && draft.created_at) || '') || ((draft && draft.detection_window) || (model && model.detectionWindow) || buildDate), 'green');
        if (nodes.length > 5) {
            nodes = [nodes[0]].concat(nodes.slice(1, 4)).concat([nodes[nodes.length - 1]]);
        }
        return nodes;
    }
    function traceOpsPptDrawTraceFlow(slide, nodes, x, y, w, h) {
        if (!_traceOpsPptxRef || !_traceOpsPptxRef.ShapeType || !slide)
            return;
        var list = Array.isArray(nodes) && nodes.length ? nodes : [{ stage: 'Build', station: 'Pending', date: 'Pending', tone: 'navy' }, { stage: 'Complaint', station: 'Pending', date: 'Pending', tone: 'red' }];
        var count = list.length;
        var gap = count > 1 ? 0.18 : 0;
        var nodeW = (w - gap * Math.max(0, count - 1)) / count;
        var nodeH = h;
        for (var i = 0; i < count; i++) {
            var node = list[i] || {};
            var px = x + i * (nodeW + gap);
            var pal = traceOpsPptFlowPalette(node.tone);
            slide.addShape((_traceOpsPptxRef && _traceOpsPptxRef.ShapeType && _traceOpsPptxRef.ShapeType.rect ? _traceOpsPptxRef.ShapeType.rect : 'rect'), {
                x: px, y: y + 0.02, w: nodeW, h: nodeH - 0.04, rectRadius: 0.08,
                line: { color: 'D7E2EE', pt: 1 }, fill: { color: 'FFFFFF' }
            });
            slide.addShape((_traceOpsPptxRef && _traceOpsPptxRef.ShapeType && _traceOpsPptxRef.ShapeType.rect ? _traceOpsPptxRef.ShapeType.rect : 'rect'), {
                x: px, y: y + 0.02, w: nodeW, h: 0.11, rectRadius: 0.08,
                line: { color: pal.accent, pt: 0 }, fill: { color: pal.accent }
            });
            slide.addShape((_traceOpsPptxRef && _traceOpsPptxRef.ShapeType && _traceOpsPptxRef.ShapeType.rect ? _traceOpsPptxRef.ShapeType.rect : 'rect'), {
                x: px + 0.10, y: y + 0.18, w: nodeW - 0.20, h: 0.20, rectRadius: 0.07,
                line: { color: pal.line, pt: 0.8 }, fill: { color: pal.pill }
            });
            slide.addText(traceOpsPptSafe(node.date, 26), {
                x: px + 0.14, y: y + 0.23, w: nodeW - 0.28, h: 0.08,
                fontFace: 'Segoe UI', fontSize: 7.7, bold: true, color: pal.pillText, margin: 0, align: 'center', fit: 'shrink'
            });
            slide.addText(traceOpsPptSafe(node.stage, 28), {
                x: px + 0.12, y: y + 0.47, w: nodeW - 0.24, h: 0.16,
                fontFace: 'Segoe UI', fontSize: 9.2, bold: true, color: '102A43', margin: 0, align: 'center', fit: 'shrink'
            });
            slide.addText(traceOpsPptWrap('Station: ' + (node.station || 'Pending'), 52), {
                x: px + 0.12, y: y + 0.67, w: nodeW - 0.24, h: 0.22,
                fontFace: 'Segoe UI', fontSize: 7.8, color: '4F6478', margin: 0, align: 'center', fit: 'shrink', valign: 'mid'
            });
            if (i < count - 1) {
                var arrowX = px + nodeW;
                var midY = y + (nodeH / 2);
                slide.addShape(_traceOpsPptxRef.ShapeType.line, { x: arrowX + 0.02, y: midY, w: gap - 0.06, h: 0, line: { color: '8FB0D6', pt: 1.4 } });
                slide.addShape(_traceOpsPptxRef.ShapeType.chevron, { x: arrowX + gap - 0.10, y: midY - 0.08, w: 0.10, h: 0.16, line: { color: '8FB0D6', pt: 0.8 }, fill: { color: '8FB0D6' } });
            }
        }
    }
    function traceOpsPptStatusToneLocal(status) {
        var s = String(status || '').toLowerCase();
        if (/complete|approved|good|available|100|yes|ready|closed/.test(s))
            return 'ok';
        if (/risk|open|high|critical|pending validation|no /.test(s))
            return 'pending';
        return 'draft';
    }
    
// ===== CRITICALITY EVALUATION SYSTEM =====
function evaluateStatusRowCriticality(rowLabel, rowStatus, rowRemark, context) {
  // CRITICAL: Acciones requeridas AHORA
  if (rowLabel === '8D Draft Readiness') {
    var score = parseInt(rowStatus) || 0;
    if (score > 0 && score < 100) return 'CRITICAL';
    if (score === 0 && (context.readinessMeta.completed || 0) > 0) return 'WARNING';
    return 'INFO';
  }
  
  if (rowLabel === 'RCCA Maturity') {
    if (context.linkedRcca !== 'Yes' && (context.evList.length || 0) > 0) return 'CRITICAL';
    if (rowStatus === 'Draft') return 'WARNING';
    return 'INFO';
  }
  
  if (rowLabel === 'Incident Detection') {
    if (rowStatus === 'Completed' && (context.findingsCount || 0) === 0 && (context.evList.length || 0) > 0) return 'CRITICAL';
    if (rowStatus === 'Completed') return 'WARNING';
    return 'INFO';
  }
  
  if (rowLabel === 'Findings Review') {
    if (rowStatus === 'Pending' && (context.evList.length || 0) > 0) return 'WARNING';
    if (rowStatus === 'In Progress') return 'WARNING';
    return 'INFO';
  }
  
  if (rowLabel === 'Evidence Coverage' || rowLabel === 'Traceability Coverage') {
    if ((rowRemark || '').indexOf('Pending') > -1 || (rowRemark || '').indexOf('Reference') > -1) return 'WARNING';
    return 'INFO';
  }
  
  if (rowStatus === 'N/A' || rowStatus === 'N/D' || (rowRemark || '').indexOf('N/A') > -1) {
    return 'HIDDEN';
  }
  
  return 'INFO';
}

function shouldShowDriverRow(rowLabel, rowValue) {
  if (!rowValue || rowValue === 'N/A' || rowValue === 'N/D' || rowValue === 'Pending review') {
    return false;
  }
  return true;
}

function traceOpsPptBuildQualityDashboardData(normalized, model, linked) {
        var readinessMeta = traceOpsPptReadinessMeta(normalized || {});
        var evList = Array.isArray(linked) ? linked : [];
        var openItems = evList.filter(function (item) {
            return !/cerrado|closed/i.test(String(item && item.estatus || ''));
        }).length;
        var findingsCount = evList.filter(function (item) {
            return !!String((item && (item.engineer_findings_full || item.engineer_findings)) || '').trim();
        }).length;
        var evidenceCount = 0;
        evList.forEach(function (item) {
            if (Array.isArray(item && item.images))
                evidenceCount += item.images.length;
        });
        var metaEv = traceOpsPptGetEvidenceMeta(normalized || {});
        evidenceCount += (metaEv.bad || []).length + (metaEv.good || []).length + (metaEv.general || []).length;
        var totalIncidents = evList.length || Number((normalized && normalized.total_eventos) || 0) || 1;
        var highRisk = evList.filter(function (item) {
            return /critica|critical|alta|high/i.test(String(item && item.prioridad || ''));
        }).length;
        var mediumRisk = evList.filter(function (item) {
            return /media|medium/i.test(String(item && item.prioridad || ''));
        }).length;
        var lowRisk = Math.max(0, totalIncidents - highRisk - mediumRisk);
        var defectCounts = {};
        var stationCounts = {};
        var findingCounts = {};
        evList.forEach(function (item) {
            var defect = String(item && item.defecto_smt || '').trim();
            var station = String(item && (item.linea_estacion || item.station) || '').trim();
            var finding = String(item && (item.engineer_findings_full || item.engineer_findings || item.evento_detectado) || '').trim();
            if (defect && defect !== 'N/A')
                defectCounts[defect] = (defectCounts[defect] || 0) + 1;
            if (station && station !== 'N/D')
                stationCounts[station] = (stationCounts[station] || 0) + 1;
            if (finding) {
                var shortFinding = finding.replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim().slice(0, 64);
                findingCounts[shortFinding] = (findingCounts[shortFinding] || 0) + 1;
            }
        });
        function topKey(mapObj, fallback) {
            var best = fallback || 'N/D';
            var bestN = -1;
            Object.keys(mapObj || {}).forEach(function (k) {
                if ((mapObj[k] || 0) > bestN) {
                    best = k;
                    bestN = mapObj[k] || 0;
                }
            });
            return best;
        }
        var traceStatus = 'Partial';
        if (evList.length && evList.every(function (item) {
            return String(item && item.linea_estacion || '').trim() && String(item && item.linea_estacion || '').trim() !== 'N/D';
        }))
            traceStatus = 'Good';
        var evidenceStatus = evidenceCount > 1 ? 'Good' : (evidenceCount ? 'Partial' : 'Pending');
        var linkedRcca = normalized && normalized.source_rcca_id ? 'Yes' : 'No';
        var closureEligibility = readinessMeta.score === 100 && openItems === 0 ? 'Ready' : 'Pending validation';
        var focusActions = [];
        if (highRisk > 0)
            focusActions.push('Close top ' + highRisk + ' high-risk events before customer exposure increases.');
        if (topKey(stationCounts, '') && topKey(stationCounts, '') !== 'N/D')
            focusActions.push('Review repeated pattern at ' + topKey(stationCounts, 'N/D') + '.');
        if (/pending|partial/i.test(traceStatus))
            focusActions.push('Complete traceability fields to strengthen Appendix evidence.');
        if (findingsCount === 0)
            focusActions.push('Add engineer findings to support technical cause validation.');
        if (/pending|partial/i.test(evidenceStatus))
            focusActions.push('Link additional evidence and validate bad/good part references.');
        if (!focusActions.length)
            focusActions.push('Maintain closure evidence and monitor recurrence signatures.');
        focusActions = focusActions.slice(0, 4);
        return {
            totalIncidents: totalIncidents,
            openItems: openItems,
            findingsCount: findingsCount,
            evidenceCount: evidenceCount,
            rccaActive: linkedRcca === 'Yes' ? 1 : 0,
            draftStatus: normalized.status || 'Draft',
            header: {
                model: normalized.modelo || model.model || 'N/D',
                line: normalized.linea || model.line || 'N/D',
                station: normalized.station || model.station || 'N/D',
                window: normalized.detection_window || model.detectionWindow || 'N/D',
                primaryIssue: normalized.defecto_smt || model.defect || 'N/A',
                readiness: String(readinessMeta.score || 0) + '%'
            },
            statusRows: (function() {
            var enriched = [
              {
                label: 'Incident Detection',
                status: evList.length ? 'Completed' : 'Pending',
                remark: evList.length ? ('Events structured: ' + evList.length) : 'Event linkage pending',
                criticality: evaluateStatusRowCriticality('Incident Detection', evList.length ? 'Completed' : 'Pending', evList.length ? ('Events structured: ' + evList.length) : 'Event linkage pending', { findingsCount: findingsCount, evList: evList })
              },
              {
                label: 'Findings Review',
                status: findingsCount ? 'In Progress' : 'Pending',
                remark: findingsCount ? (findingsCount + ' technical findings linked') : 'Engineer findings missing',
                criticality: evaluateStatusRowCriticality('Findings Review', findingsCount ? 'In Progress' : 'Pending', findingsCount ? (findingsCount + ' technical findings linked') : 'Engineer findings missing', { evList: evList, findingsCount: findingsCount })
              },
              {
                label: 'RCCA Maturity',
                status: normalized.status || 'Draft',
                remark: linkedRcca === 'Yes' ? ('Linked to ' + normalized.source_rcca_id) : 'No RCCA linked',
                criticality: evaluateStatusRowCriticality('RCCA Maturity', normalized.status || 'Draft', linkedRcca === 'Yes' ? ('Linked to ' + normalized.source_rcca_id) : 'No RCCA linked', { linkedRcca: linkedRcca, evList: evList })
              },
              {
                label: '8D Draft Readiness',
                status: String(readinessMeta.score || 0) + '%',
                remark: readinessMeta.completed + '/8 mandatory sections completed',
                criticality: evaluateStatusRowCriticality('8D Draft Readiness', String(readinessMeta.score || 0) + '%', readinessMeta.completed + '/8 mandatory sections completed', { readinessMeta: readinessMeta })
              },
              {
                label: 'Evidence Coverage',
                status: evidenceStatus,
                remark: evidenceCount ? (String(evidenceCount) + ' evidence refs linked') : 'Reference evidence to be attached',
                criticality: evaluateStatusRowCriticality('Evidence Coverage', evidenceStatus, evidenceCount ? (String(evidenceCount) + ' evidence refs linked') : 'Reference evidence to be attached', { evidenceCount: evidenceCount })
              },
              {
                label: 'Traceability Coverage',
                status: traceStatus,
                remark: traceStatus === 'Good' ? 'Core trace fields available' : 'Appendix still needs stronger trace mapping',
                criticality: evaluateStatusRowCriticality('Traceability Coverage', traceStatus, traceStatus === 'Good' ? 'Core trace fields available' : 'Appendix still needs stronger trace mapping', { traceStatus: traceStatus })
              }
            ];
            var order = { CRITICAL: 0, WARNING: 1, INFO: 2, HIDDEN: 999 };
            var filtered = enriched.filter(function(r) { return r.criticality !== 'HIDDEN'; }).sort(function(a, b) { return order[a.criticality] - order[b.criticality]; });
            return filtered.map(function(r) { return [r.label, r.status, r.remark, r.criticality]; });
          })(),
            readinessRows: [
                ['Mandatory sections', readinessMeta.completed + ' / 8'],
                ['RCCA linked', linkedRcca],
                ['Evidence linked', evidenceCount ? 'Yes' : 'No'],
                ['Pending validations', String(Math.max(0, 8 - readinessMeta.completed + (openItems ? 1 : 0)))],
                ['Current status', normalized.status || 'Draft'],
                ['Closure eligibility', closureEligibility]
            ],
            riskRows: [
                ['High risk', String(highRisk)],
                ['Medium risk', String(mediumRisk)],
                ['Low risk', String(lowRisk)],
                ['Focus', highRisk ? ('Close top ' + highRisk + ' risks') : 'Monitor recurrence']
            ],
            driverRows: (function() {
            var rows = [];
            var topDefect = topKey(defectCounts, normalized.defecto_smt || model.defect || 'N/A');
            if (topDefect && topDefect !== 'N/A') rows.push(['Top defect', topDefect]);
            var topStation = topKey(stationCounts, normalized.station || model.station || 'N/D');
            if (topStation && topStation !== 'N/D') rows.push(['Top station', topStation]);
            if (findingsCount && findingsCount > 0) rows.push(['Findings signal', findingsCount + ' technical findings']);
            if (model.pattern) rows.push(['Repeated signature', model.pattern]);
            return rows.length > 0 ? rows : [['Status', 'No critical drivers found']];
          })()+)"[^>]*\\/?>', 'g');
            return xml.replace(rx, function (match, rid) {
                return valid[rid] ? match : '';
            });
        }
        var xmlNames = fileNames.filter(function (name) {
            return /\.xml$/i.test(name);
        });
        for (var i = 0; i < xmlNames.length; i++) {
            var xmlName = xmlNames[i];
            var xmlContent = await zip.file(xmlName).async('string');
            var fixedXml = traceOpsNormalizeOpenXmlMarkup(xmlContent);
            if (/^ppt\/(slides|slideLayouts|slideMasters|notesSlides)\//i.test(xmlName)) {
                fixedXml = traceOpsRenumberDuplicateCnvPrIds(fixedXml);
            }
            if (fixedXml !== xmlContent)
                writePart(xmlName, fixedXml);
        }
        var contentTypesPath = '[Content_Types].xml';
        if (zip.file(contentTypesPath)) {
            var ctXml = await zip.file(contentTypesPath).async('string');
            var fixedCtXml = traceOpsNormalizeOpenXmlMarkup(ctXml);
            fixedCtXml = traceOpsRemoveMissingContentTypeOverrides(fixedCtXml, existingSet);
            if (fixedCtXml !== ctXml)
                writePart(contentTypesPath, fixedCtXml);
        }
        var relNames = fileNames.filter(function (name) {
            return /_rels\/[^/]+\.rels$/i.test(name);
        });
        var relMap = {};
        var validMasterIds = [];
        var validSlideIds = [];
        for (var r = 0; r < relNames.length; r++) {
            var relName = relNames[r];
            var relXml = await zip.file(relName).async('string');
            var normRelXml = traceOpsNormalizeOpenXmlMarkup(relXml);
            var cleaned = traceOpsRemoveMissingInternalRelationships(normRelXml, relName, existingSet);
            relMap[relName] = cleaned.keptIds || [];
            if (cleaned.xml !== relXml)
                writePart(relName, cleaned.xml);
            if (relName === 'ppt/_rels/presentation.xml.rels') {
                var rows = cleaned.xml.match(/<Relationship\b[^>]*Id="[^"]+"[^>]*Target="[^"]+"[^>]*\/?>(?:<\/Relationship>)?/g) || [];
                rows.forEach(function (row) {
                    var idMatch = row.match(/\bId="([^"]+)"/i);
                    var targetMatch = row.match(/\bTarget="([^"]+)"/i);
                    var modeMatch = row.match(/\bTargetMode="([^"]+)"/i);
                    if (!idMatch || !targetMatch)
                        return;
                    if (modeMatch && /external/i.test(modeMatch[1] || ''))
                        return;
                    var resolved = traceOpsResolveRelationshipTarget(relName, targetMatch[1]);
                    if (!resolved || !(existingSet && existingSet[resolved]))
                        return;
                    if (/^\/ppt\/slideMasters\//i.test(resolved))
                        validMasterIds.push(idMatch[1]);
                    if (/^\/ppt\/slides\//i.test(resolved))
                        validSlideIds.push(idMatch[1]);
                });
            }
        }
        var presXmlPath = 'ppt/presentation.xml';
        if (zip.file(presXmlPath)) {
            var presXml = await zip.file(presXmlPath).async('string');
            var fixedPresXml = traceOpsNormalizeOpenXmlMarkup(presXml);
            fixedPresXml = traceOpsRemoveMissingPresentationMasterRefs(fixedPresXml, validMasterIds);
            fixedPresXml = removeMissingPresentationRefsLocal(fixedPresXml, validSlideIds, 'p:sldId');
            if (fixedPresXml !== presXml)
                writePart(presXmlPath, fixedPresXml);
        }
        /* ── PPT-TRUST: inyectar docProps para evitar Protected View ──────────
           PowerPoint entra en modo protegido cuando el archivo carece de
           metadatos de confianza (AppVersion, SharedDoc, HyperlinksChanged).
           Inyectarlos directamente en el ZIP elimina el bloqueo sin necesidad
           de que el usuario haga Unblock en Properties.
        ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
        var nowIso = new Date().toISOString().replace(/\.\d+Z$/, 'Z');
        var appXmlPath = 'docProps/app.xml';
        var appXmlContent = '';
        if (zip.file(appXmlPath)) {
            appXmlContent = await zip.file(appXmlPath).async('string');
        }
        if (!appXmlContent || appXmlContent.trim().length < 10) {
            appXmlContent = '<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8" standalone="yes"?>'
                + '<Properties xmlns="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/officeDocument/2006/extended-properties"'
                + ' xmlns:vt="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/officeDocument/2006/docPropsVTypes">'
                + '</Properties>';
        }
        // Inyectar AppVersion si falta (16.0 = Office 2016+, desactiva legacy protected mode)
        if (appXmlContent.indexOf('<AppVersion>') === -1) {
            appXmlContent = appXmlContent.replace('</Properties>', '<AppVersion>16.0000</AppVersion></Properties>');
        }
        // SharedDoc=false: archivo no compartido, PowerPoint no lo trata como externo
        if (appXmlContent.indexOf('<SharedDoc>') === -1) {
            appXmlContent = appXmlContent.replace('</Properties>', '<SharedDoc>false</SharedDoc></Properties>');
        }
        // HyperlinksChanged=false: evita que PPT marque el archivo como "de origen externo"
        if (appXmlContent.indexOf('<HyperlinksChanged>') === -1) {
            appXmlContent = appXmlContent.replace('</Properties>', '<HyperlinksChanged>false</HyperlinksChanged></Properties>');
        }
        // ScaleCrop=false: renderizado correcto de imágenes
        if (appXmlContent.indexOf('<ScaleCrop>') === -1) {
            appXmlContent = appXmlContent.replace('</Properties>', '<ScaleCrop>false</ScaleCrop></Properties>');
        }
        writePart(appXmlPath, appXmlContent);
        // Asegurar que docProps/app.xml esté en [Content_Types].xml
        var ctPath = '[Content_Types].xml';
        if (zip.file(ctPath)) {
            var ctXml2 = await zip.file(ctPath).async('string');
            if (ctXml2.indexOf('docProps/app.xml') === -1) {
                ctXml2 = ctXml2.replace('</Types>', '<Override PartName="/docProps/app.xml"'
                    + ' ContentType="application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.extended-properties+xml"/>'
                    + '</Types>');
                writePart(ctPath, ctXml2);
            }
        }
        var coreXmlPath = 'docProps/core.xml';
        var coreXmlContent = '';
        if (zip.file(coreXmlPath)) {
            coreXmlContent = await zip.file(coreXmlPath).async('string');
        }
        if (!coreXmlContent || coreXmlContent.trim().length < 10) {
            coreXmlContent = '<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8" standalone="yes"?>'
                + '<cp:coreProperties'
                + ' xmlns:cp="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/package/2006/metadata/core-properties"'
                + ' xmlns:dc="http://purl.org/dc/elements/1.1/"'
                + ' xmlns:dcterms="http://purl.org/dc/terms/"'
                + ' xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance">'
                + '</cp:coreProperties>';
        }
        // lastModifiedBy local desactiva la heurística "from another computer"
        if (coreXmlContent.indexOf('<cp:lastModifiedBy>') === -1) {
            coreXmlContent = coreXmlContent.replace('</cp:coreProperties>', '<cp:lastModifiedBy>TraceOps SMTintel</cp:lastModifiedBy></cp:coreProperties>');
        }
        else {
            coreXmlContent = coreXmlContent.replace(/<cp:lastModifiedBy>[^<]*<\/cp:lastModifiedBy>/, '<cp:lastModifiedBy>TraceOps SMTintel</cp:lastModifiedBy>');
        }
        // revision=1 + fechas coherentes
        if (coreXmlContent.indexOf('<cp:revision>') === -1) {
            coreXmlContent = coreXmlContent.replace('</cp:coreProperties>', '<cp:revision>1</cp:revision></cp:coreProperties>');
        }
        if (coreXmlContent.indexOf('<dcterms:modified') === -1) {
            coreXmlContent = coreXmlContent.replace('</cp:coreProperties>', '<dcterms:modified xsi:type="dcterms:W3CDTF">' + nowIso + '</dcterms:modified></cp:coreProperties>');
        }
        writePart(coreXmlPath, coreXmlContent);
        // Asegurar _rels/.rels apunta a ambos docProps
        var rootRelsPath = '_rels/.rels';
        if (zip.file(rootRelsPath)) {
            var rootRels = await zip.file(rootRelsPath).async('string');
            var relsChanged = false;
            if (rootRels.indexOf('docProps/app.xml') === -1) {
                rootRels = rootRels.replace('</Relationships>', '<Relationship Id="rIdApp" Type="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/officeDocument/2006/relationships/extended-properties" Target="docProps/app.xml"/>'
                    + '</Relationships>');
                relsChanged = true;
            }
            if (rootRels.indexOf('docProps/core.xml') === -1) {
                rootRels = rootRels.replace('</Relationships>', '<Relationship Id="rIdCore" Type="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/package/2006/relationships/metadata/core-properties" Target="docProps/core.xml"/>'
                    + '</Relationships>');
                relsChanged = true;
            }
            if (relsChanged)
                writePart(rootRelsPath, rootRels);
        }
        /* ── fin PPT-TRUST ─────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
        return await zip.generateAsync({
            type: 'arraybuffer',
            compression: 'DEFLATE'
        });
    }
    function traceOpsNormalizeZipPartName(path) {
        var s = String(path || '').replace(/\\/g, '/').trim();
        if (!s)
            return '';
        if (s.charAt(0) !== '/')
            s = '/' + s;
        return s;
    }
    function traceOpsNormalizeXmlPartName(path) {
        return traceOpsNormalizeZipPartName(String(path || '').replace(/^\/+/, ''));
    }
    function traceOpsRelBaseDir(relPath) {
        var clean = String(relPath || '').replace(/\\/g, '/');
        clean = clean.replace(/^\/+/, '');
        var relsIdx = clean.lastIndexOf('/_rels/');
        if (relsIdx >= 0)
            return clean.slice(0, relsIdx + 1);
        var idx = clean.lastIndexOf('/');
        return idx >= 0 ? clean.slice(0, idx + 1) : '';
    }
    function traceOpsResolveRelationshipTarget(relPath, target) {
        var t = String(target || '').replace(/\\/g, '/').trim();
        if (!t)
            return '';
        if (/^[a-z]+:/i.test(t) || /^\//.test(t))
            return traceOpsNormalizeXmlPartName(t);
        var baseDir = traceOpsRelBaseDir(relPath);
        var combined = (baseDir ? (baseDir + t) : t).split('/');
        var out = [];
        for (var i = 0; i < combined.length; i++) {
            var part = combined[i];
            if (!part || part === '.')
                continue;
            if (part === '..') {
                if (out.length)
                    out.pop();
                continue;
            }
            out.push(part);
        }
        return traceOpsNormalizeXmlPartName(out.join('/'));
    }
    function traceOpsRenumberDuplicateCnvPrIds(xml) {
        if (!xml)
            return xml;
        var seen = Object.create(null);
        var maxId = 0;
        xml.replace(/<p:cNvPr\b[^>]*\bid="(\d+)"/g, function (_, id) {
            var n = parseInt(id, 10) || 0;
            if (n > maxId)
                maxId = n;
            return _;
        });
        return xml.replace(/(<p:cNvPr\b[^>]*\bid=")([0-9]+)(")/g, function (match, start, id, end) {
            var n = parseInt(id, 10) || 0;
            if (!seen[n]) {
                seen[n] = true;
                return start + n + end;
            }
            do {
                maxId += 1;
            } while (seen[maxId]);
            seen[maxId] = true;
            return start + maxId + end;
        });
    }
    function traceOpsRemoveMissingContentTypeOverrides(xml, existingSet) {
        if (!xml)
            return xml;
        return xml.replace(/\s*<Override\b[^>]*PartName="([^"]+)"[^>]*\/?>/g, function (match, partName) {
            var norm = traceOpsNormalizeXmlPartName(partName);
            return existingSet && existingSet[norm] ? match : '';
        });
    }
    function traceOpsRemoveMissingInternalRelationships(xml, relPath, existingSet) {
        if (!xml)
            return { xml: xml, keptIds: [] };
        var keptIds = [];
        var cleanedXml = xml.replace(/\s*<Relationship\b([^>]*)\/?>/g, function (match, attrs) {
            var idMatch = attrs.match(/\bId="([^"]+)"/i);
            var targetMatch = attrs.match(/\bTarget="([^"]+)"/i);
            var modeMatch = attrs.match(/\bTargetMode="([^"]+)"/i);
            var relId = idMatch ? idMatch[1] : '';
            var target = targetMatch ? targetMatch[1] : '';
            var isExternal = modeMatch && /external/i.test(modeMatch[1] || '');
            if (isExternal || !target) {
                if (relId)
                    keptIds.push(relId);
                return match;
            }
            var resolved = traceOpsResolveRelationshipTarget(relPath, target);
            if (resolved && existingSet && existingSet[resolved]) {
                if (relId)
                    keptIds.push(relId);
                return match;
            }
            return '';
        });
        return { xml: cleanedXml, keptIds: keptIds };
    }
    function traceOpsRemoveMissingPresentationMasterRefs(xml, validRelIds) {
        if (!xml)
            return xml;
        var valid = {};
        (validRelIds || []).forEach(function (id) { valid[String(id)] = true; });
        return xml.replace(/\s*<p:sldMasterId\b[^>]*r:id="([^"]+)"[^>]*\/?>/g, function (match, rid) {
            return valid[rid] ? match : '';
        });
    }
    function traceOpsNormalizeOpenXmlMarkup(xml) {
        try {
            if (xml == null)
                return xml;
            xml = String(xml);
            xml = xml.replace(/[\x00-\x08\x0B\x0C\x0E-\x1F\x7F]/g, '');
            xml = xml.replace(/&(?!amp;|lt;|gt;|quot;|apos;|#\d+;|#x[0-9a-fA-F]+;)/g, '&amp;');
            xml = xml.replace(/<a:t\b[^>]*>\s*<\/a:t>/g, '<a:t xml:space="preserve"> </a:t>');
            xml = xml.replace(/<p:t\b[^>]*>\s*<\/p:t>/g, '<p:t xml:space="preserve"> </p:t>');
            return xml;
        }
        catch (_) {
            return xml;
        }
    }
    function traceOpsDownloadBlob(filename, blob) {
        var a = document.createElement('a');
        a.href = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
        a.download = filename;
        a.rel = 'noopener';
        document.body.appendChild(a);
        a.click();
        setTimeout(function () {
            try {
                document.body.removeChild(a);
            }
            catch (_) { }
            try {
                URL.revokeObjectURL(a.href);
            }
            catch (_) { }
        }, 3000);
    }
    async function traceOpsFinalizePptxBlob(blob) {
        await window.ensureZipTools();
        var zip = await JSZip.loadAsync(blob);
        var files = Object.keys(zip.files || {});
        var existing = {};
        files.forEach(function (name) {
            existing[String(name || '').replace(/^\/+/, '')] = true;
        });
        function normPart(name) {
            return String(name || '').replace(/^\/+/, '');
        }
        function hasPart(name) {
            return !!existing[normPart(name)];
        }
        function resolveRelationshipTarget(relPath, target) {
            var rel = normPart(relPath);
            var base = rel.split('/');
            base.pop();
            if (base.length && base[base.length - 1] === '_rels')
                base.pop();
            String(target || '').split('/').forEach(function (piece) {
                if (!piece || piece === '.')
                    return;
                if (piece === '..')
                    base.pop();
                else
                    base.push(piece);
            });
            return normPart(base.join('/'));
        }
        async function readText(name) {
            if (!zip.files[name])
                return '';
            return await zip.files[name].async('string');
        }
        async function writeText(name, value) {
            zip.file(name, value);
            existing[normPart(name)] = true;
        }
        function removeMissingInternalRelationships(xml, relPath) {
            if (!xml)
                return { xml: xml, keptIds: [] };
            var keptIds = [];
            var cleaned = xml.replace(/\s*<Relationship\b([^>]*)\/?>/g, function (match, attrs) {
                var idMatch = attrs.match(/\bId="([^"]+)"/i);
                var targetMatch = attrs.match(/\bTarget="([^"]+)"/i);
                var modeMatch = attrs.match(/\bTargetMode="([^"]+)"/i);
                var relId = idMatch ? idMatch[1] : '';
                var target = targetMatch ? targetMatch[1] : '';
                var isExternal = modeMatch && /external/i.test(modeMatch[1] || '');
                if (isExternal || !target) {
                    if (relId)
                        keptIds.push(relId);
                    return match;
                }
                var resolved = resolveRelationshipTarget(relPath, target);
                if (resolved && hasPart(resolved)) {
                    if (relId)
                        keptIds.push(relId);
                    return match;
                }
                return '';
            });
            return { xml: cleaned, keptIds: keptIds };
        }
        function removeMissingContentTypeOverrides(xml) {
            if (!xml)
                return xml;
            return xml.replace(/\s*<Override\b[^>]*PartName="([^"]+)"[^>]*\/?>/g, function (match, partName) {
                return hasPart(partName) ? match : '';
            });
        }
        function removeMissingPresentationRefs(xml, validRelIds, tagName) {
            if (!xml)
                return xml;
            var valid = {};
            (validRelIds || []).forEach(function (id) { valid[String(id)] = true; });
            var rgx = new RegExp('\\s*<' + tagName + '\\b[^>]*r:id="([^"]+)"[^>]*/?>', 'g');
            return xml.replace(rgx, function (match, rid) {
                return valid[rid] ? match : '';
            });
        }
        for (var i = 0; i < files.length; i++) {
            var name = files[i];
            if (!(/\.xml$/i.test(name) || /\.rels$/i.test(name)))
                continue;
            var content = await readText(name);
            if (!content)
                continue;
            content = traceOpsNormalizeOpenXmlMarkup(content);
            if (/\.rels$/i.test(name))
                content = removeMissingInternalRelationships(content, name).xml;
            await writeText(name, content);
        }
        if (zip.files['[Content_Types].xml']) {
            var ct = await readText('[Content_Types].xml');
            ct = traceOpsNormalizeOpenXmlMarkup(ct);
            ct = removeMissingContentTypeOverrides(ct);
            await writeText('[Content_Types].xml', ct);
        }
        var validMasterIds = [];
        var validSlideIds = [];
        if (zip.files['ppt/_rels/presentation.xml.rels']) {
            var presRels = await readText('ppt/_rels/presentation.xml.rels');
            presRels = traceOpsNormalizeOpenXmlMarkup(presRels);
            var relMatches = presRels.match(/<Relationship\b[^>]*Id="[^"]+"[^>]*Target="[^"]+"[^>]*\/?>(?:<\/Relationship>)?/g) || [];
            relMatches.forEach(function (row) {
                var idMatch = row.match(/\bId="([^"]+)"/i);
                var targetMatch = row.match(/\bTarget="([^"]+)"/i);
                var modeMatch = row.match(/\bTargetMode="([^"]+)"/i);
                if (!idMatch || !targetMatch)
                    return;
                if (modeMatch && /external/i.test(modeMatch[1] || ''))
                    return;
                var resolved = resolveRelationshipTarget('ppt/_rels/presentation.xml.rels', targetMatch[1]);
                if (!hasPart(resolved))
                    return;
                if (/^ppt\/slideMasters\//i.test(resolved))
                    validMasterIds.push(idMatch[1]);
                if (/^ppt\/slides\//i.test(resolved))
                    validSlideIds.push(idMatch[1]);
            });
            await writeText('ppt/_rels/presentation.xml.rels', removeMissingInternalRelationships(presRels, 'ppt/_rels/presentation.xml.rels').xml);
        }
        if (zip.files['ppt/presentation.xml']) {
            var pres = await readText('ppt/presentation.xml');
            pres = traceOpsNormalizeOpenXmlMarkup(pres);
            pres = removeMissingPresentationRefs(pres, validMasterIds, 'p:sldMasterId');
            pres = removeMissingPresentationRefs(pres, validSlideIds, 'p:sldId');
            await writeText('ppt/presentation.xml', pres);
        }
        return await zip.generateAsync({
            type: 'blob',
            compression: 'DEFLATE',
            mimeType: 'application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.presentationml.presentation'
        });
    }
    function traceOpsPptAddBlueGridGlow(slide, x, y, w, h, opts) {
        if (!_traceOpsPptxRef || !_traceOpsPptxRef.ShapeType)
            return;
        opts = opts || {};
        var radius = opts.radius || 0.22;
        var lineColor = opts.lineColor || '7FB3F4';
        var glowColor = opts.glowColor || '4A90E2';
        var dark1 = opts.dark1 || '0B1F33';
        var dark2 = opts.dark2 || '102A43';
        var dark3 = opts.dark3 || '1F3A5F';
        var gridOpacity = opts.gridOpacity == null ? 0.10 : opts.gridOpacity;
        var glowOpacity = opts.glowOpacity == null ? 0.16 : opts.glowOpacity;
        slide.addShape((_traceOpsPptxRef && _traceOpsPptxRef.ShapeType && _traceOpsPptxRef.ShapeType.rect ? _traceOpsPptxRef.ShapeType.rect : "rect"), {
            x: x, y: y, w: w, h: h,
            rectRadius: radius,
            line: { color: lineColor, transparency: 55, width: 1.1 },
            fill: { color: dark2 }
        });
        try {
            slide.addText('', {
                x: x, y: y, w: w, h: h,
                margin: 0,
                shape: 'rect',
                rectRadius: radius,
                fill: {
                    color: [{ color: dark1, pos: 0 }, { color: dark2, pos: 58 }, { color: dark3, pos: 100 }],
                    angle: 0,
                    type: 'grad'
                },
                line: { color: lineColor, transparency: 70, width: 1.0 }
            });
        }
        catch (_) { }
        var cols = opts.cols || 8;
        var rows = opts.rows || 5;
        for (var i = 1; i < cols; i++) {
            var gx = x + (w / cols) * i;
            slide.addShape(_traceOpsPptxRef.ShapeType.line, {
                x: gx, y: y + 0.02, w: 0, h: h - 0.04,
                line: { color: lineColor, transparency: 100 - Math.round(gridOpacity * 100), width: 0.8 }
            });
        }
        for (var j = 1; j < rows; j++) {
            var gy = y + (h / rows) * j;
            slide.addShape(_traceOpsPptxRef.ShapeType.line, {
                x: x + 0.02, y: gy, w: w - 0.04, h: 0,
                line: { color: lineColor, transparency: 100 - Math.round(gridOpacity * 100), width: 0.8 }
            });
        }
        slide.addShape(_traceOpsPptxRef.ShapeType.ellipse, {
            x: x + 0.18, y: y + 0.35, w: Math.min(w * 0.42, 2.6), h: Math.min(h * 0.70, 2.4),
            line: { color: glowColor, transparency: 100, width: 0 },
            fill: { color: glowColor, transparency: 100 - Math.round(glowOpacity * 100) }
        });
        slide.addShape(_traceOpsPptxRef.ShapeType.ellipse, {
            x: x + w * 0.56, y: y - 0.55, w: Math.min(w * 0.55, 3.4), h: Math.min(h * 1.05, 3.4),
            line: { color: glowColor, transparency: 88, width: 1.0 },
            fill: { color: glowColor, transparency: 100 }
        });
    }
    function traceOpsMetaFileStableKey(file) {
        var f = file || {};
        var id = String(f.id || '').trim();
        if (id)
            return id;
        var name = String(f.name || '').trim().toLowerCase();
        var size = String(f.size || '');
        var type = String(f.type || '').trim().toLowerCase();
        var kind = String(f.kind || '').trim().toLowerCase();
        var dataUrl = String(f.data_url || '');
        var head = dataUrl ? dataUrl.slice(0, 96) : '';
        return [name, size, type, kind, head].join('|');
    }
    function traceOpsNormalizeMetaFileForMerge(file) {
        var f = Object.assign({}, file || {});
        if (!f.id)
            f.id = 'meta_' + Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 10);
        if (!f.kind) {
            if (/^image\//i.test(String(f.type || '')))
                f.kind = 'image';
            else
                f.kind = 'file';
        }
        return f;
    }
    function traceOpsMergeMetaFiles(existingList, incomingList) {
        var out = [];
        var map = {};
        function upsert(item) {
            if (!item)
                return;
            var normalized = traceOpsNormalizeMetaFileForMerge(item);
            var key = traceOpsMetaFileStableKey(normalized);
            var prev = map[key];
            if (!prev) {
                map[key] = normalized;
                out.push(normalized);
                return;
            }
            var merged = Object.assign({}, prev, normalized);
            if (!merged.data_url)
                merged.data_url = prev.data_url || normalized.data_url || '';
            merged.evidence_role = traceOpsNormalizeEvidenceRole(normalized.evidence_role || prev.evidence_role || 'general');
            if (!merged.name)
                merged.name = normalized.name || prev.name || '';
            if (!merged.type)
                merged.type = normalized.type || prev.type || '';
            if (!merged.size)
                merged.size = normalized.size || prev.size || 0;
            map[key] = merged;
            var idx = out.findIndex(function (x) { return traceOpsMetaFileStableKey(x) === key; });
            if (idx >= 0)
                out[idx] = merged;
        }
        (Array.isArray(existingList) ? existingList : []).forEach(upsert);
        (Array.isArray(incomingList) ? incomingList : []).forEach(upsert);
        return out;
    }
    function traceOpsBuildEvidenceDisplayMetaFromFiles(metaFiles) {
        var evidence = { bad_part: [], good_part: [], general: [] };
        (Array.isArray(metaFiles) ? metaFiles : []).forEach(function (file) {
            if (!file || file.kind !== 'image')
                return;
            var role = String(file.evidence_role || 'general').toLowerCase();
            var name = file.name || '';
            if (!name)
                return;
            if (role === 'bad')
                evidence.bad_part.push(name);
            else if (role === 'good')
                evidence.good_part.push(name);
            else
                evidence.general.push(name);
        });
        evidence.bad_part = Array.from(new Set(evidence.bad_part));
        evidence.good_part = Array.from(new Set(evidence.good_part));
        evidence.general = Array.from(new Set(evidence.general));
        return evidence;
    }
    function traceOpsMergeEvidenceLists() {
        var merged = [];
        for (var i = 0; i < arguments.length; i++) {
            var part = arguments[i];
            var list = Array.isArray(part) ? part : traceOpsPptExtractEvidenceNames(part || []);
            for (var j = 0; j < list.length; j++) {
                var item = String(list[j] || '').trim();
                if (item && merged.indexOf(item) < 0)
                    merged.push(item);
            }
        }
        return merged;
    }
    function traceOpsMergeRccaPayload(existingRcca, incomingRcca) {
        var base = Object.assign({}, existingRcca || {}, incomingRcca || {});
        var existingMeta = Array.isArray(existingRcca && existingRcca.meta_files) ? existingRcca.meta_files : [];
        var incomingMeta = Array.isArray(incomingRcca && incomingRcca.meta_files) ? incomingRcca.meta_files : [];
        var mergedMeta = traceOpsMergeMetaFiles(existingMeta, incomingMeta);
        base.meta_files = mergedMeta;
        var existingMetaObj = (existingRcca && existingRcca.meta) || {};
        var incomingMetaObj = (incomingRcca && incomingRcca.meta) || {};
        base.meta = Object.assign({}, existingMetaObj, incomingMetaObj);
        base.meta.evidence = traceOpsBuildEvidenceMetaFromFiles(mergedMeta);
        var mergedDisplayEvidence = traceOpsBuildEvidenceDisplayMetaFromFiles(mergedMeta);
        base.bad_part_images = Array.from(new Set([].concat(base.bad_part_images || [], mergedDisplayEvidence.bad_part || [])));
        base.good_part_images = Array.from(new Set([].concat(base.good_part_images || [], mergedDisplayEvidence.good_part || [])));
        base.evidence_images = Array.from(new Set([].concat(base.evidence_images || [], mergedDisplayEvidence.general || [])));
        return base;
    }
    function exportEightdPpt(draft) {
        if (!draft)
            return;
        var normalized = traceOpsEightdHydrateDraftFields(Object.assign({}, draft || {}));
        if (normalized && normalized.source_snapshot) {
            normalized.source_evidence_fingerprint = traceOpsRccaFingerprint(normalized.source_snapshot);
            if ((!normalized.meta || !normalized.meta.evidence || (!((normalized.meta.evidence.bad_part || []).length) && !((normalized.meta.evidence.good_part || []).length) && !((normalized.meta.evidence.general || []).length))) && normalized.source_snapshot.meta_files) {
                normalized.meta = Object.assign({}, normalized.meta || {}, { evidence: traceOpsBuildEvidenceMetaFromFiles(normalized.source_snapshot.meta_files) });
            }
        }
        var readinessMeta = traceOpsPptReadinessMeta(normalized);
        normalized.readiness_score = readinessMeta.score;
        normalized.missing_fields = readinessMeta.missing;
        window.ensurePptxTools().then(async function () {
            var pptx = new PptxGenJS();
            traceOpsPptHardenDeck(pptx);
            try {
                if (typeof pptx.layout !== 'undefined')
                    pptx.layout = 'LAYOUT_WIDE';
            }
            catch (_) { }
            try {
                if (typeof pptx.defineLayout === 'function') {
                    pptx.defineLayout({ name: 'TRACEOPS_WIDE', width: 13.333, height: 7.5 });
                    pptx.layout = 'TRACEOPS_WIDE';
                }
            }
            catch (_) { }
            try {
                if (typeof pptx.setLayout === 'function')
                    pptx.setLayout('LAYOUT_WIDE');
            }
            catch (_) { }
            pptx.author = traceOpsPptSafe('OpenAI', 40);
            pptx.company = traceOpsPptSafe('TraceOps by SMTintel', 80);
            pptx.subject = traceOpsPptSafe('TraceOps 8D Draft', 80);
            pptx.title = traceOpsPptSafe(normalized.eightd_id || 'TraceOps_8D_Draft', 120);
            try {
                pptx.lang = 'es-MX';
            }
            catch (_) { }
            try {
                pptx.theme = { headFontFace: 'Segoe UI', bodyFontFace: 'Segoe UI', lang: 'es-MX', color: '0F2A44' };
            }
            catch (_) { }
            var model = traceOpsEightdBuildModel((normalized && normalized.source_snapshot) || normalized || {}, traceOpsGetEightdLinkedEventsForExport(normalized));
            var linked = model.linked;
            var fileBase = String(normalized.eightd_id || normalized.source_rcca_id || 'TraceOps_8D_Draft').replace(/[^A-Za-z0-9_-]+/g, '_');
            addExecutiveDashboardSlide(pptx, buildExecutiveDashboardPptModelLocal(Object.assign({}, normalized || {}, model || {}, { qualityDashboard: (model && model.qualityDashboard) || null })));
            traceOpsPptBuildExecutiveOverview(pptx, normalized, model, linked);
            await traceOpsPptBuildTeamProblemSlide(pptx, normalized, model);
            traceOpsPptBuildContainmentSlide(pptx, normalized, model);
            traceOpsPptBuildOccurrenceSlide(pptx, normalized, model);
            traceOpsPptBuildEscapeSlide(pptx, normalized, model);
            traceOpsPptBuildActionsSlide(pptx, normalized, model);
            traceOpsPptBuildVerificationSlide(pptx, normalized, model);
            traceOpsPptBuildPreventionClosureSlide(pptx, normalized, model);
            await traceOpsPptBuildAppendixSlide(pptx, normalized, model, linked);
            if (typeof pptx.write === 'function') {
                var arr = await pptx.write({ outputType: 'arraybuffer', compression: true });
                // Windows PowerPoint repair prompt fix:
                // export the raw PptxGenJS package and avoid post-processing the OOXML zip,
                // because the desktop fixer was causing package corruption on open.
                var blob = new Blob([arr], { type: 'application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.presentationml.presentation' });
                traceOpsDownloadBlob(fileBase + '.pptx', blob);
            }
            else if (typeof pptx.writeFile === 'function' && typeof pptx.write !== 'function') {
                await pptx.writeFile({ fileName: fileBase + '.pptx', compression: true });
            }
            else if (typeof pptx.save === 'function') {
                pptx.save(fileBase + '.pptx');
            }
            else {
                throw new Error('PptxGenJS no expone write/writeFile/save en este navegador.');
            }
        }).catch(function (err) {
            console.error('[TraceOps PPT]', err);
            alert('No se pudo generar el PPT. ' + (err && (err.message || String(err)) || 'Error desconocido'));
        });
    }
    function exportEightdHtml(draft) {
        if (!draft)
            return;
        var normalized = traceOpsEightdHydrateDraftFields(Object.assign({}, draft || {}));
        var filename = String(normalized.eightd_id || normalized.source_rcca_id || 'TraceOps_8D_Draft').replace(/[^A-Za-z0-9_-]+/g, '_') + '.html';
        var html = traceOpsBuildEightdHtml(normalized);
        try {
            var popup = window.open('', '_blank');
            if (popup && popup.document) {
                popup.document.open();
                popup.document.write(html);
                popup.document.close();
                return;
            }
        }
        catch (_) { }
        try {
            var blob = new Blob([html], { type: 'text/html' });
            var url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
            var a = document.createElement('a');
            a.href = url;
            a.download = filename;
            document.body.appendChild(a);
            a.click();
            a.remove();
            setTimeout(function () { try {
                URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
            }
            catch (_) { } }, 1000);
            return;
        }
        catch (_) { }
        try {
            var dataUrl = 'data:text/html;charset=utf-8,' + encodeURIComponent(html);
            window.location.href = dataUrl;
        }
        catch (_) { }
    }

    function traceOpsEsc(v) {
        return String(v == null ? "" : v)
            .replace(/&/g, "&amp;")
            .replace(/</g, "&lt;")
            .replace(/>/g, "&gt;")
            .replace(/"/g, "&quot;")
            .replace(/'/g, "&#39;");
    }
    function traceOpsSafeArray(v) {
        return Array.isArray(v) ? v : (v ? [v] : []);
    }
    function traceOpsSeverityValue(item) {
        var sev = Number(item && item.severidad != null ? item.severidad : 0);
        if (!isFinite(sev) || sev < 0)
            sev = 0;
        if (sev > 5)
            sev = 5;
        return sev;
    }
    function traceOpsStars(n) {
        var safe = Math.max(0, Math.min(5, Number(n) || 0));
        return "★★★★★".slice(0, safe) + "☆☆☆☆☆".slice(0, 5 - safe);
    }
    function traceOpsBadge(status) {
        var s = String(status || "NUEVO").toUpperCase();
        var style = { bg: "#F2F1EF", color: "#5D5751", border: "#DFDDD9" };
        if (s.indexOf("ANAL") >= 0)
            style = { bg: "#EEF5FF", color: "#2F6FB3", border: "#D8E6FB" };
        else if (s.indexOf("VALID") >= 0)
            style = { bg: "#EAF7EF", color: "#1E7A4A", border: "#BFE7CC" };
        else if (s.indexOf("CERR") >= 0 || s.indexOf("CLOSE") >= 0)
            style = { bg: "#F2F3F5", color: "#596274", border: "#D7DDE6" };
        else if (s.indexOf("NUEVO") >= 0 || s.indexOf("NEW") >= 0)
            style = { bg: "#FFF8E8", color: "#A26A00", border: "#F1DF9E" };
        return style;
    }
    function traceOpsField(label, value) {
        if (value == null || value === "")
            return "";
        return '<div class="to-field"><div class="to-label">' + traceOpsEsc(label) + '</div><div class="to-value">' + traceOpsEsc(value) + '</div></div>';
    }
    function traceOpsMetric(label, value, tone) {
        var tones = {
            red: ["#FEF0EE", "#F1C8C2", "#C0392B"],
            amber: ["#FEF9E8", "#F5E4A0", "#B87820"],
            purple: ["#F5F0FE", "#DBCDF8", "#6B2DA8"],
            green: ["#EAF2FF", "#C7DBF7", "#1F3A5F"]
        };
        var t = tones[tone] || tones.green;
        return '<div class="to-metric" style="background:' + t[0] + ';border-color:' + t[1] + '"><div class="to-metric-label" style="color:' + t[2] + '">' + traceOpsEsc(label) + '</div><div class="to-metric-value">' + traceOpsEsc(value) + '</div></div>';
    }
    function traceOpsCardHtml(item, idx) {
        var status = String(item.estatus_rcca || "NUEVO");
        var badge = traceOpsBadge(status);
        var sev = traceOpsSeverityValue(item);
        var rec = item.recurrencia != null && item.recurrencia !== "" ? "R" + item.recurrencia : "R0";
        var mad = item.madurez_analisis != null && item.madurez_analisis !== "" ? "M" + item.madurez_analisis : "M0";
        var evCount = traceOpsSafeArray(item.event_ids).length;
        var title = item.titulo_corto || item.problema || "Untitled RCCA";
        var eventsHtml = traceOpsSafeArray(item.event_ids).map(function (ev) {
            return '<span class="to-chip">' + traceOpsEsc(ev) + '</span>';
        }).join("");
        if (!eventsHtml)
            eventsHtml = '<span class="to-chip to-chip-muted">No linked EVT</span>';
        var sections = ''
            + traceOpsField('Problem', item.problema)
            + traceOpsField('Hypothesis', item.hipotesis)
            + traceOpsField('Root Cause', item.causa_raiz)
            + traceOpsField('Containment', item.contencion || item.accion_contencion)
            + traceOpsField('Validation', item.validacion)
            + traceOpsField('Detected Pattern', item.patron_detectado)
            + traceOpsField('Reusable Lesson', item.leccion_aprendida)
            + traceOpsField('Yokoten / Reapplication', item.yokoten || item.solucion_replicable || item.reaplicacion)
            + traceOpsField('Owner', item.owner_email)
            + traceOpsField('Source', item.source)
            + traceOpsField('Original RCCA', item.original_rcca_id)
            + traceOpsField('Created at', item.created_at)
            + traceOpsField('Updated at', item.updated_at);
        return ''
            + '<article class="to-card">'
            + '<div class="to-card-top">'
            + '<div class="to-id">' + traceOpsEsc(item.rcca_id || ('RCCA-' + (idx + 1))) + '</div>'
            + '<div class="to-badges">'
            + '<span class="to-badge" style="background:' + badge.bg + ';color:' + badge.color + ';border-color:' + badge.border + '">' + traceOpsEsc(status) + '</span>'
            + '<span class="to-badge to-badge-soft">' + traceOpsEsc(item.tipo_caso || 'GENERAL') + '</span>'
            + '</div>'
            + '</div>'
            + '<h2 class="to-title">' + traceOpsEsc(title) + '</h2>'
            + '<div class="to-sub">' + traceOpsEsc(item.modelo || 'N/D') + ' • ' + traceOpsEsc(item.linea || 'N/D') + ' • ' + traceOpsEsc(item.fecha || '-') + '</div>'
            + '<div class="to-metrics">'
            + traceOpsMetric('Sev', traceOpsStars(sev), 'red')
            + traceOpsMetric('Rec', rec, 'amber')
            + traceOpsMetric('Mad', mad, 'purple')
            + traceOpsMetric('EV', String(evCount).padStart(2, '0'), 'green')
            + '</div>'
            + '<div class="to-grid">'
            + sections
            + '</div>'
            + '<div class="to-events-wrap"><div class="to-label">Linked events</div><div class="to-events">' + eventsHtml + '</div></div>'
            + '</article>';
    }

    function rccaSimilarity(evItem, rcca) {
        var score = 0;
        if (!evItem || !rcca)
            return 0;
        var evModelo = (evItem.modelo || "").toLowerCase().trim();
        var rcModelo = (rcca.modelo || "").toLowerCase().trim();
        var evLinea = (evItem.linea_estacion || "").toLowerCase().trim();
        var rcLinea = (rcca.linea || "").toLowerCase().trim();
        var evDef = (evItem.defecto_smt || "").toLowerCase().trim();
        var rcProb = (rcca.problema || "").toLowerCase().trim();
        var evTipo = (evItem.tipo_evento || "").toLowerCase().trim();
        var evFindings = (evItem.engineer_findings || "").toLowerCase().trim();
        var rcCausa = (rcca.causa_raiz || "").toLowerCase().trim();
        var rcAccion = (rcca.accion_correctiva || "").toLowerCase().trim();
        if (evModelo && rcModelo && evModelo !== "n/d" && evModelo === rcModelo)
            score += 40;
        else if (evModelo && rcModelo && evModelo !== "n/d" && (rcModelo.indexOf(evModelo) >= 0 || evModelo.indexOf(rcModelo) >= 0))
            score += 20;
        if (evLinea && rcLinea && evLinea !== "n/d" && evLinea === rcLinea)
            score += 25;
        else if (evLinea && rcLinea && evLinea !== "n/d" && (rcLinea.indexOf(evLinea) >= 0 || evLinea.indexOf(rcLinea) >= 0))
            score += 12;
        if (evDef && evDef !== "n/a" && rcProb && rcProb.indexOf(evDef) >= 0)
            score += 25;
        else if (evDef && evDef !== "n/a" && rcProb && evDef.split(" ").some(function (w) { return w.length > 3 && rcProb.indexOf(w) >= 0; }))
            score += 12;
        if (evDef && evDef !== "n/a" && rcCausa && evDef.split(" ").some(function (w) { return w.length > 3 && rcCausa.indexOf(w) >= 0; }))
            score += 10;
        if (evFindings && (rcProb || rcCausa || rcAccion)) {
            var efWords = evFindings.split(/\s+/).filter(function (w) { return w.length > 4; });
            var matches = efWords.filter(function (w) {
                return (rcProb && rcProb.indexOf(w) >= 0) || (rcCausa && rcCausa.indexOf(w) >= 0) || (rcAccion && rcAccion.indexOf(w) >= 0);
            });
            if (matches.length >= 3)
                score += 20;
            else if (matches.length >= 1)
                score += 8;
        }
        if (evTipo && rcca.patron_detectado && rcca.patron_detectado.toLowerCase().indexOf(evTipo) >= 0)
            score += 10;
        return Math.min(score, 100);
    }
    function getMatches(evItem) {
        return rccaList
            .map(function (r) { return { rcca: r, score: rccaSimilarity(evItem, r) }; })
            .filter(function (x) { return x.score >= 30; })
            .sort(function (a, b) { return b.score - a.score; })
            .slice(0, 3);
    }

    function saveToHistory(res, stats, fileName, durationSecs) {
        var entry = {
            id: Date.now(), savedAt: new Date().toISOString(), fileName: fileName || "chat.zip",
            periodo: res.resumen ? res.resumen.periodo : "", grupo: res.resumen ? res.resumen.grupo : "",
            totalEventos: res.eventos ? res.eventos.length : 0,
            criticos: res.eventos ? res.eventos.filter(function (e) { return e.prioridad === "Critica"; }).length : 0,
            pendientes: res.eventos ? res.eventos.filter(function (e) { return e.estatus !== "Cerrado"; }).length : 0,
            msgs: stats ? stats.clean : 0, imgs: stats ? stats.imgs : 0,
            durationSecs: durationSecs || 0, apiUsage: traceOpsUsageFromResult(res), result: res
        };
        try {
            var prev = [];
            try {
                prev = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(HIST_KEY) || "[]");
            }
            catch (_) { }
            var updated = [entry].concat(prev).slice(0, HIST_MAX);
            localStorage.setItem(HIST_KEY, JSON.stringify(updated));
            setHistory(updated);
        }
        catch (_) { }
    }

        }

    }

    var STEPS = ["ZIP", "Parser", "Filtro", "IA", "Excel"];
    async function handle(file) {
        if (!file || !file.name.endsWith(".zip")) {
            setErrMsg("Sube un .zip exportado de WhatsApp");
            setState("error");
            return;
        }
        // API Key opcional: sin key, TraceOps usa modo local automatico
        var requestedDays = traceOpsGetWindowDays(filterMode, days, dateFrom, dateTo, weekNum, weekYear);
        if (requestedDays > 7 && !adminOverride && !window.confirm("Este rango cubre " + requestedDays + " dias y puede incrementar consumo de tokens y ruido. Se recomienda 3 a 5 dias. ¿Continuar de todos modos?")) {
            return;
        }
        fileNameRef.current = file.name;
        setApiUsage(null);
        setState("loading");
        setProg(8);
        setProgStep(0);
        try {
            var zipData = await readZip(file);
            setImgMeta(zipData.imgMeta || {});
            setProgStep(1);
            setProg(22);
            var waAll = zipData.hasWA ? parseWhatsApp(zipData.txt) : [];
            var emlAll = zipData.emlMsgs || [];
            var all = waAll.concat(emlAll).sort(function (a, b) {
                var dc = a.dateIso.localeCompare(b.dateIso);
                return dc !== 0 ? dc : a.timeStr.localeCompare(b.timeStr);
            });
            if (!all.length)
                throw new Error("No se encontraron mensajes en el ZIP (WhatsApp ni Email).");
            setProgStep(2);
            setProg(38);
            var filtered = filterMsgs(all, filterMode, days, dateFrom, dateTo, weekNum, weekYear);
            var scopedImgs = traceOpsFilterMediaNamesBySelectedRange(zipData.imgNames || [], zipData.imgMeta || {}, filtered);
            var scopedNoise = traceOpsFilterMediaNamesBySelectedRange(zipData.filteredMediaNames || [], zipData.imgMeta || {}, filtered);
            setZipImgNames(scopedImgs.names || []);
            setFilteredMediaCount((scopedNoise.names || []).length);
            setMediaOutOfRangeCount((scopedImgs.outsideRangeCount || 0) + (scopedImgs.unknownDateCount || 0) + (scopedNoise.outsideRangeCount || 0) + (scopedNoise.unknownDateCount || 0));
            var clean = cleanMsgs(filtered);
            var statsPayload = {
                total: all.length,
                filtered: filtered.length,
                clean: clean.length,
                imgs: (scopedImgs.names || []).length,
                filteredMedia: (scopedNoise.names || []).length,
                mediaOutsideRange: (scopedImgs.outsideRangeCount || 0) + (scopedImgs.unknownDateCount || 0) + (scopedNoise.outsideRangeCount || 0) + (scopedNoise.unknownDateCount || 0),
                waCount: waAll.length,
                emlCount: emlAll.length
            };
            setMsgStats(statsPayload);
            if (!clean.length)
                throw new Error("Sin mensajes operativos en el periodo. Aumenta el rango.");
            TRACEOPS_MAX_OUTPUT_TOKENS = traceOpsGetMaxOutputTokens(requestedDays, clean.length);
            var useLightCache = !(requestedDays > 7 || (file && file.size && file.size > 25 * 1024 * 1024));
            var fileHash = useLightCache ? await traceOpsHashFile(file) : [file && file.name || "file", file && file.size || 0, file && file.lastModified || 0, "nocache"].join("|");
            var cacheKey = traceOpsBuildAnalysisCacheKey(fileHash, filterMode, days, dateFrom, dateTo, weekNum, weekYear);
            var cached = useLightCache ? await traceOpsDbGet(cacheKey).catch(function () { return null; }) : null;
            if (cached && cached.result) {
                var cachedResult = cached.result;
                var cachedUsage = Object.assign({}, cached.apiUsage || traceOpsUsageFromResult(cachedResult) || {}, { api_calls: 0, cache_hit: true, cache_key: cacheKey });
                cachedResult.__traceops_api = cachedUsage;
                setApiUsage(cachedUsage);
                setProgStep(4);
                setProg(82);
                setEvImgs({});
                var cachedBytes = await buildXlsx(cachedResult);
                var totalSecsCached = Math.floor((Date.now() - startTimeRef.current) / 1000);
                setProg(100);
                setResult(cachedResult);
                setXlsxBytes(cachedBytes);
                setState("done");
                try {
                    sessionStorage.setItem("traceops_last_result", JSON.stringify({ result: cachedResult, msgStats: statsPayload }));
                }
                catch (e) { }
                saveToHistory(cachedResult, statsPayload, fileNameRef.current, totalSecsCached);
                return;
            }
            setProgStep(3);
            setProg(55);
            var res = await analyzeWithAI(clean, apiKey.trim());
            setApiUsage(traceOpsUsageFromResult(res));
            if (useLightCache) {
                traceOpsDbSet(cacheKey, { savedAt: new Date().toISOString(), result: res, apiUsage: traceOpsUsageFromResult(res), fileName: fileNameRef.current, range: traceOpsBuildRangeLabel(filterMode, days, dateFrom, dateTo, weekNum, weekYear) }).catch(function () { });
            }
            setProgStep(4);
            setProg(82);
            var autoEvImgs = traceOpsAutoAttachImagesToEvents((res && res.eventos) || [], scopedImgs.names || [], zipData.imgMeta || {});
            setEvImgs(autoEvImgs);
            var bytes = await buildXlsx(res);
            var totalSecs = Math.floor((Date.now() - startTimeRef.current) / 1000);
            setProg(100);
            setResult(res);
            setXlsxBytes(bytes);
            setState("done");
            try {
                sessionStorage.setItem("traceops_last_result", JSON.stringify({ result: res, msgStats: statsPayload }));
            }
            catch (e) { }
            saveToHistory(res, statsPayload, fileNameRef.current, totalSecs);
        }
        catch (e) {
            setErrMsg(e.message || String(e));
            setState("error");
        }
    }
    function download() {
        if (activeModule === "yieldflow") {
            exportYieldFlowXlsx().catch(function (e) { setErrMsg((e && e.message) || String(e)); });
            return;
        }
        if (!xlsxBytes)
            return;
        var blob = new Blob([xlsxBytes], { type: "application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet" });
        var a = document.createElement("a");
        a.href = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
        a.download = "TraceOps_" + new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10) + ".xlsx";
        a.click();
        URL.revokeObjectURL(a.href);
    }

    var evAll = (result && result.eventos) ? result.eventos : [];
    var kpisAll = (result && result.kpis) ? result.kpis : [];
    var res = (result && result.resumen) ? result.resumen : {};
    var analysisWindowDays = traceOpsGetWindowDays(filterMode, days, dateFrom, dateTo, weekNum, weekYear);
    var analysisRangeLabel = traceOpsBuildRangeLabel(filterMode, days, dateFrom, dateTo, weekNum, weekYear);
    function eventDateToIso(fechaStr) {
        if (!fechaStr)
            return "";
        var parts = String(fechaStr).split("/");
        if (parts.length !== 3)
            return "";
        return parts[2] + "-" + String(parts[1]).padStart(2, "0") + "-" + String(parts[0]).padStart(2, "0");
    }
    function formatIsoCalendarLabel(iso) {
        if (!iso)
            return "";
        var p = String(iso).split("-");
        return p.length === 3 ? (p[2] + "/" + p[1] + "/" + p[0]) : iso;
    }
    function isoParts(iso) {
        var p = String(iso || "").split("-");
        if (p.length !== 3)
            return null;
        return { y: parseInt(p[0], 10), m: parseInt(p[1], 10) - 1, d: parseInt(p[2], 10) };
    }
    function isoToDate(iso) {
        var parts = isoParts(iso);
        if (!parts)
            return null;
        return new Date(parts.y, parts.m, parts.d);
    }
    function dateToIsoLocal(d) {
        if (!d)
            return "";
        return d.getFullYear() + "-" + String(d.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, "0") + "-" + String(d.getDate()).padStart(2, "0");
    }
    function addDaysIso(iso, days) {
        var d = isoToDate(iso);
        if (!d)
            return "";
        d.setDate(d.getDate() + days);
        return dateToIsoLocal(d);
    }
    function getWeekStartIso(iso) {
        var d = isoToDate(iso);
        if (!d)
            return "";
        var offset = (d.getDay() + 6) % 7;
        d.setDate(d.getDate() - offset);
        return dateToIsoLocal(d);
    }
    function buildCalendarDayMap(eventRows) {
        var rows = (eventRows || []).slice().filter(function (e) { return !!eventDateToIso(e && e.fecha); });
        var dayMap = {};
        rows.forEach(function (e) {
            var iso = eventDateToIso(e && e.fecha);
            if (!iso)
                return;
            if (!dayMap[iso])
                dayMap[iso] = { iso: iso, eventCount: 0, critical: 0, findings: 0 };
            dayMap[iso].eventCount += 1;
            if (e && e.prioridad === "Critica")
                dayMap[iso].critical += 1;
            if (String((e && e.engineer_findings) || "").trim())
                dayMap[iso].findings += 1;
        });
        return dayMap;
    }
    function buildCalendarMonths(eventRows) {
        var dayMap = buildCalendarDayMap(eventRows);
        var dayKeys = Object.keys(dayMap).sort();
        var monthMap = {};
        dayKeys.forEach(function (iso) {
            var parts = iso.split("-");
            var ym = parts[0] + "-" + parts[1];
            if (!monthMap[ym])
                monthMap[ym] = [];
            monthMap[ym].push(dayMap[iso]);
        });
        var monthNames = ["January", "February", "March", "April", "May", "June", "July", "August", "September", "October", "November", "December"];
        return Object.keys(monthMap).sort().map(function (ym) {
            var yp = ym.split("-");
            var year = parseInt(yp[0], 10);
            var month = parseInt(yp[1], 10) - 1;
            var first = new Date(year, month, 1);
            var offset = (first.getDay() + 6) % 7;
            var totalDays = new Date(year, month + 1, 0).getDate();
            var cells = [];
            for (var i = 0; i < offset; i++)
                cells.push({ empty: true, key: ym + "-e" + i });
            for (var d = 1; d <= totalDays; d++) {
                var iso = year + "-" + String(month + 1).padStart(2, "0") + "-" + String(d).padStart(2, "0");
                var payload = dayMap[iso] || null;
                cells.push({
                    empty: false,
                    key: iso,
                    iso: iso,
                    day: d,
                    eventCount: payload ? payload.eventCount : 0,
                    critical: payload ? payload.critical : 0,
                    findings: payload ? payload.findings : 0
                });
            }
            while (cells.length % 7 !== 0)
                cells.push({ empty: true, key: ym + "-tail" + cells.length });
            return {
                ym: ym,
                label: monthNames[month] + " " + year,
                cells: cells,
                totalEvents: monthMap[ym].reduce(function (a, b) { return a + (b.eventCount || 0); }, 0),
                activeDays: monthMap[ym].length
            };
        });
    }
    function calendarSpanDays(viewKey) {
        return viewKey === "1d" ? 1 : (viewKey === "3d" ? 3 : (viewKey === "7d" ? 7 : 1));
    }
    function applyCalendarWindow(startIso, viewKey) {
        if (!startIso)
            return;
        var span = calendarSpanDays(viewKey || calendarView);
        setCalendarAnchorIso(startIso);
        setViewDateFrom(startIso);
        setViewDateTo(addDaysIso(startIso, span - 1));
        setViewHourFrom("");
        setViewHourTo("");
    }
    function selectCalendarDay(iso) {
        if (!iso)
            return;
        if (calendarView === "month") {
            if (viewDateFrom === iso && viewDateTo === iso) {
                setCalendarAnchorIso(iso);
                setViewDateFrom("");
                setViewDateTo("");
                return;
            }
            setCalendarAnchorIso(iso);
            setViewDateFrom(iso);
            setViewDateTo(iso);
            setViewHourFrom("");
            setViewHourTo("");
            return;
        }
        var span = calendarSpanDays(calendarView);
        if (viewDateFrom === iso && viewDateTo === addDaysIso(iso, span - 1)) {
            setCalendarAnchorIso(iso);
            setViewDateFrom("");
            setViewDateTo("");
            return;
        }
        applyCalendarWindow(iso, calendarView);
    }
    function buildCalendarStrip(eventRows, anchorIso, viewKey) {
        var dayMap = buildCalendarDayMap(eventRows);
        var keys = Object.keys(dayMap).sort();
        if (!keys.length)
            return { days: [], anchorIso: "", headerLabel: "" };
        var base = anchorIso && isoToDate(anchorIso) ? anchorIso : keys[keys.length - 1];
        var baseDate = isoToDate(base);
        var span = viewKey === "1d" ? 1 : (viewKey === "3d" ? 3 : 7);
        var startIso = viewKey === "7d" ? getWeekStartIso(base) : base;
        var days = [];
        for (var i = 0; i < span; i++) {
            var iso = addDaysIso(startIso, i);
            var payload = dayMap[iso] || {};
            var d = isoToDate(iso);
            days.push({
                iso: iso,
                day: d ? d.getDate() : "",
                weekday: d ? ["Sun", "Mon", "Tue", "Wed", "Thu", "Fri", "Sat"][d.getDay()] : "",
                eventCount: payload.eventCount || 0,
                critical: payload.critical || 0,
                findings: payload.findings || 0
            });
        }
        var startDate = isoToDate(startIso);
        var weekNum = (function (dateObj) {
            var d = new Date(Date.UTC(dateObj.getFullYear(), dateObj.getMonth(), dateObj.getDate()));
            d.setUTCDate(d.getUTCDate() + 4 - (d.getUTCDay() || 7));
            var yearStart = new Date(Date.UTC(d.getUTCFullYear(), 0, 1));
            return Math.ceil((((d - yearStart) / 86400000) + 1) / 7);
        })(startDate || new Date());
        var monthNames = ["January", "February", "March", "April", "May", "June", "July", "August", "September", "October", "November", "December"];
        var headerLabel = (startDate ? monthNames[startDate.getMonth()] + " " + startDate.getFullYear() : "") + " · Week " + weekNum;
        return { days: days, anchorIso: startIso, headerLabel: headerLabel };
    }
    function parseChatDateTimeMs(value) {
        if (!value)
            return null;
        var raw = String(value).trim();
        if (!raw)
            return null;
        var main = raw.split(" - ")[0].trim();
        var parts = main.split(" ");
        var datePart = parts[0] || "";
        var timePart = parts[1] || "00:00";
        var dp = datePart.split("/");
        if (dp.length !== 3)
            return null;
        var tp = parseClockParts(timePart);
        return new Date(parseInt(dp[2], 10), parseInt(dp[1], 10) - 1, parseInt(dp[0], 10), tp.h, tp.m, tp.s).getTime();
    }
    function matchesHourRange(hourValue, fromValue, toValue) {
        var hv = parseInt(hourValue, 10);
        if (isNaN(hv))
            return false;
        var hasFrom = fromValue !== "" && fromValue != null;
        var hasTo = toValue !== "" && toValue != null;
        if (!hasFrom && !hasTo)
            return true;
        var fromHour = hasFrom ? parseInt(fromValue, 10) : 0;
        var toHour = hasTo ? parseInt(toValue, 10) : 23;
        if (isNaN(fromHour))
            fromHour = 0;
        if (isNaN(toHour))
            toHour = 23;
        if (fromHour <= toHour)
            return hv >= fromHour && hv <= toHour;
        return hv >= fromHour || hv <= toHour;
    }
    function hasViewFilter() {
        return !!(viewDateFrom || viewDateTo || viewHourFrom !== "" || viewHourTo !== "");
    }
    function filterEventRange(evRow) {
        var iso = eventDateToIso(evRow && evRow.fecha);
        if (viewDateFrom && (!iso || iso < viewDateFrom))
            return false;
        if (viewDateTo && (!iso || iso > viewDateTo))
            return false;
        if (viewHourFrom !== "" || viewHourTo !== "") {
            var hourPart = evRow && evRow.hora ? String(evRow.hora).split(":")[0] : "";
            if (!matchesHourRange(hourPart, viewHourFrom, viewHourTo))
                return false;
        }
        return true;
    }
    function filterKpiRange(kpiRow) {
        if (!hasViewFilter())
            return true;
        var ms = parseChatDateTimeMs(kpiRow && kpiRow.fechahora);
        if (ms == null)
            return false;
        var d = new Date(ms);
        var iso = d.getFullYear() + "-" + String(d.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, "0") + "-" + String(d.getDate()).padStart(2, "0");
        if (viewDateFrom && iso < viewDateFrom)
            return false;
        if (viewDateTo && iso > viewDateTo)
            return false;
        if (viewHourFrom !== "" || viewHourTo !== "") {
            if (!matchesHourRange(d.getHours(), viewHourFrom, viewHourTo))
                return false;
        }
        return true;
    }

    function parseBitacoraDateValue(e) {

            return 0;

    function traceOpsCurrentRccaDateStampLocal() {
        var d = new Date();
        var mm = String((d.getMonth() || 0) + 1).padStart(2, "0");
        var dd = String(d.getDate() || 1).padStart(2, "0");
        var yyyy = String(d.getFullYear() || "");
