    }
    function traceOpsNormalizeBuCodeLocal(value) {
        var raw = String(value || "").toUpperCase();
        var compact = raw.replace(/[^A-Z]/g, "");
        if (!compact)
            return "";
        if (compact === "FIELDWORK" || compact === "FIELDWORKS" || compact === "FW" || compact === "FWBU")
            return "FWBU";
        if (compact === "UABU" || compact === "UA")
            return "UABU";
        if (compact === "CVEBU" || compact === "CVE")
            return "CVEBU";
        if (compact === "CRBU" || compact === "CR")
            return "CRBU";
        if (compact === "NGFWBU" || compact === "NGFW")
            return "NGFWBU";
        return compact.slice(0, 8);
    }
    function traceOpsInferProductCodeLocal(text) {
        var raw = String(text || "").toUpperCase();
        if (!raw)
            return "RC";
        if (/\bWESTMINSTER\b/.test(raw) || /\bWE[A-Z0-9-]*\b/.test(raw))
            return "WE";
        if (/\bWARWICK\b/.test(raw) || /\bWA[A-Z0-9-]*\b/.test(raw))
            return "WA";
        if (/\bLANCER\b/.test(raw) || /\bLC[A-Z0-9-]*\b/.test(raw))
            return "LC";
        var compact = raw.replace(/[^A-Z0-9]/g, "");
        return compact.slice(0, 2) || "RC";
    }
    function traceOpsInferBuCodeLocal(text) {
        var raw = String(text || "").toUpperCase();
        if (!raw)
            return "";
        if (/FIELD\s*WORKS?/.test(raw) || /\bFWBU\b/.test(raw))
            return "FWBU";
        if (/\bUABU\b/.test(raw))
            return "UABU";
        if (/\bCVEBU\b/.test(raw) || /\bCVE\b/.test(raw))
            return "CVEBU";
        if (/\bCRBU\b/.test(raw) || /\bCR\b/.test(raw))
            return "CRBU";
        if (/\bNGFWBU\b/.test(raw) || /\bNGFW\b/.test(raw))
            return "NGFWBU";
        return "";
    }
    function traceOpsBuildRccaSuffixLocal(baseId) {
        var used = {};
        (Array.isArray(rccaList) ? rccaList : []).forEach(function (item) {
            var id = String((item && item.rcca_id) || "").trim().toUpperCase();
            if (!id || id.indexOf(baseId + "-") !== 0)
                return;
            var suffix = id.slice((baseId + "-").length);
            if (/^[0-9][A-Z]$/.test(suffix))
                used[suffix] = true;
        });
        var letters = "ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ";
        for (var tens = 0; tens <= 9; tens++) {
            for (var i = 0; i < letters.length; i++) {
                var candidate = String(tens) + letters.charAt(i);
                if (!used[candidate])
                    return candidate;
            }
        }
        return "9Z";
    }
    function genRccaId(eventIds, evList) {
        var firstId = eventIds && eventIds.length > 0 ? eventIds[0] : null;
        var evData = firstId ? (evList || []).find(function (e) { return e.id === firstId; }) : null;
        var contextParts = [
            String((evData && evData.modelo) || ""),
            String((evData && evData.evento_detectado_full) || (evData && evData.evento_detectado) || ""),
            String((evData && evData.engineer_findings_full) || (evData && evData.engineer_findings) || ""),
            String((evData && evData.linea_estacion) || ""),
            String((evData && evData.tipo_evento) || "")
        ];
        var contextText = contextParts.join(" ").trim();
        var productCode = traceOpsInferProductCodeLocal(contextText || String((evData && evData.modelo) || ""));
        var buCode = traceOpsNormalizeBuCodeLocal(traceOpsInferBuCodeLocal(contextText) || "FWBU") || "FWBU";
        var dateStamp = traceOpsCurrentRccaDateStampLocal();
        var baseId = [productCode, buCode, dateStamp].join("-");
        return baseId + "-" + traceOpsBuildRccaSuffixLocal(baseId);
    }

        async function traceOpsCompressImageFileIfNeeded(file, opts) {
            var options = Object.assign({
                maxBytes: 15 * 1024 * 1024,
                maxDimension: 2200,
                jpegQualityStart: 0.9,
                jpegQualityMin: 0.55
            }, opts || {});
            if (!file || !/^image\//i.test(String(file.type || '')))
                return file;
            if ((file.size || 0) <= options.maxBytes)
                return file;
            try {
                var dataUrl = await new Promise(function (resolve, reject) {
                    var fr = new FileReader();
                    fr.onload = function () { resolve(fr.result); };
                    fr.onerror = reject;
                    fr.readAsDataURL(file);
                });
                var img = await new Promise(function (resolve, reject) {
                    var im = new Image();
                    im.onload = function () { resolve(im); };
                    im.onerror = reject;
                    im.src = dataUrl;
                });
                var w = img.naturalWidth || img.width || 0;
                var h = img.naturalHeight || img.height || 0;
                if (!w || !h)
                    return file;
                var scale = Math.min(1, options.maxDimension / Math.max(w, h));
                var tw = Math.max(1, Math.round(w * scale));
                var th = Math.max(1, Math.round(h * scale));
                var canvas = document.createElement('canvas');
                canvas.width = tw;
                canvas.height = th;
                var ctx = canvas.getContext('2d', { alpha: false });
                if (!ctx)
                    return file;
                ctx.fillStyle = '#FFFFFF';
                ctx.fillRect(0, 0, tw, th);
                ctx.drawImage(img, 0, 0, tw, th);
                var outType = /^image\/png$/i.test(String(file.type || '')) ? 'image/jpeg' : (file.type || 'image/jpeg');
                var q = options.jpegQualityStart;
                var blob = await new Promise(function (resolve) { canvas.toBlob(resolve, outType, q); });
                while (blob && blob.size > options.maxBytes && q > options.jpegQualityMin) {
                    q = Math.max(options.jpegQualityMin, q - 0.08);
                    blob = await new Promise(function (resolve) { canvas.toBlob(resolve, outType, q); });
                }
                if (!blob)
                    return file;
                if (blob.size > options.maxBytes)
                    return file;
                var newName = String(file.name || 'image').replace(/\.(png|jpg|jpeg|webp)$/i, '');
                var ext = outType === 'image/jpeg' ? '.jpg' : '';
                return new File([blob], newName + ext, { type: outType, lastModified: Date.now() });
            }
            catch (_) {
                return file;
            }
        }
        async function traceOpsPrepareMetaFilesWithCompression(fileList, limits) {
            var list = Array.from(fileList || []);
            var prepared = [];
            for (var i = 0; i < list.length; i++) {
                var file = list[i];
                if (/^image\//i.test(String(file.type || '')) && (file.size || 0) > ((limits && limits.perFile) || (15 * 1024 * 1024))) {
                    file = await traceOpsCompressImageFileIfNeeded(file, { maxBytes: (limits && limits.perFile) || (15 * 1024 * 1024) });
                }
                prepared.push(file);
            }
            return prepared;
        }
        function replaceMetaFiles(nextFiles) {
            var n = {};
            Object.keys(form).forEach(function (fk) { n[fk] = form[fk]; });
            n.meta_files = traceOpsNormalizeMetaFiles(nextFiles || []);
            n.meta = Object.assign({}, n.meta || {}, { evidence: traceOpsBuildEvidenceMetaFromFiles(n.meta_files) });
            setForm(n);
        }
        function setMetaFileRole(fileId, role) {
            var nextFiles = traceOpsNormalizeMetaFiles(form.meta_files || []).map(function (item) {
                if (item.id !== fileId)
                    return item;
                var next = Object.assign({}, item);
                next.evidence_role = traceOpsNormalizeEvidenceRole(role);
                return next;
            });
            replaceMetaFiles(nextFiles);
        }
        function removeMetaFile(fileId) {
            replaceMetaFiles((form.meta_files || []).filter(function (item) { return item.id !== fileId; }));
            try {
                if (metaInputRef.current)
                    metaInputRef.current.value = "";
            }
            catch (_) { }
        }
        function downloadMetaFile(item) {
            if (!item || !item.data_url)
                return;
            var a = document.createElement('a');
            a.href = item.data_url;
            a.download = item.name || 'meta-file';
            document.body.appendChild(a);
            a.click();
            setTimeout(function () { try {
                document.body.removeChild(a);
            }
            catch (_) { } }, 50);
        }
        async function addMetaFiles(fileList) {
            var incoming = Array.prototype.slice.call(fileList || []);
            if (!incoming.length)
                return;
            var current = traceOpsNormalizeMetaFiles(form.meta_files || []);
            if (current.length + incoming.length > TRACEOPS_RCCA_META_MAX_FILES) {
                alert('Puedes guardar hasta ' + TRACEOPS_RCCA_META_MAX_FILES + ' archivos meta por RCCA.');
                return;
            }
            var totalBytes = current.reduce(function (sum, item) { return sum + Number(item.size || 0); }, 0);
            var prepared = [];
            for (var i = 0; i < incoming.length; i++) {
                var file = incoming[i];
                var ext = traceOpsMetaExt(file && file.name);
                if (TRACEOPS_RCCA_META_ACCEPT.indexOf(ext) < 0) {
                    alert('Formato no permitido: ' + (file && file.name ? file.name : 'archivo') + '. Usa ZIP, PPT/PPTX o JPG/PNG.');
                    return;
                }
                if (file.size > TRACEOPS_RCCA_META_MAX_FILE_BYTES) {
                    alert('El archivo ' + file.name + ' excede el limite de ' + traceOpsFormatBytes(TRACEOPS_RCCA_META_MAX_FILE_BYTES) + '.');
                    return;
                }
                totalBytes += file.size || 0;
                if (totalBytes > TRACEOPS_RCCA_META_MAX_TOTAL_BYTES) {
                    alert('El total de adjuntos meta excede ' + traceOpsFormatBytes(TRACEOPS_RCCA_META_MAX_TOTAL_BYTES) + '.');
                    return;
                }
                var dataUrl = await new Promise(function (resolve, reject) {
                    try {
                        var reader = new FileReader();
                        reader.onload = function () { resolve(reader.result); };
                        reader.onerror = function () { reject(new Error('No se pudo leer ' + file.name)); };
                        reader.readAsDataURL(file);
                    }
                    catch (err) {
                        reject(err);
                    }
                });
                var suggestedRole = traceOpsSuggestEvidenceRole(file, current.concat(prepared));
                prepared.push({
                    id: 'meta_' + Date.now().toString(36) + '_' + i + '_' + Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 7),
                    name: file.name,
                    type: file.type || '',
                    size: Number(file.size || 0),
                    kind: traceOpsMetaTypeLabel(file),
                    data_url: String(dataUrl || ''),
                    evidence_role: traceOpsIsImageMetaFile(file) ? suggestedRole : undefined
                });
            }
            replaceMetaFiles(current.concat(prepared));
            try {
                if (metaInputRef.current)
                    metaInputRef.current.value = "";
            }
            catch (_) { }
        }

                writeRccaDraft({
                    ts: new Date().toISOString(),
                    mode: isEdit ? "edit" : "new",

                });

                persistNow(); }
            window.addEventListener("pagehide", persistNow);
            window.addEventListener("beforeunload", persistNow);
            document.addEventListener("visibilitychange", onVisibility);
            return function () {
                window.removeEventListener("pagehide", persistNow);
                window.removeEventListener("beforeunload", persistNow);
                document.removeEventListener("visibilitychange", onVisibility);
            };

        function upd(k, v) { var n = {}; Object.keys(form).forEach(function (fk) { n[fk] = form[fk]; }); n[k] = v; setForm(n); }
        function toggleEvent(evId) {
            var cur = form.event_ids;
            var newIds = cur.indexOf(evId) >= 0 ? cur.filter(function (x) { return x !== evId; }) : cur.concat([evId]);
            var firstEv = newIds.length > 0 ? ev.find(function (e) { return e.id === newIds[0]; }) : null;
            var n = {};
            Object.keys(form).forEach(function (fk) { n[fk] = form[fk]; });
            n.event_ids = newIds;
            n.rcca_id = isEdit ? (form.original_rcca_id || form.rcca_id) : genRccaId(newIds, ev);
            if (firstEv) {
                if (!form.modelo || form.modelo === init.modelo)
                    n.modelo = firstEv.modelo || "";
                if (!form.linea || form.linea === init.linea)
                    n.linea = firstEv.linea_estacion || "";
                if (!form.estacion_dominante)
                    n.estacion_dominante = firstEv.linea_estacion || "";
                if (!form.defecto_dominante && firstEv.defecto_smt && firstEv.defecto_smt !== "N/A")
                    n.defecto_dominante = firstEv.defecto_smt;
                if (!form.fecha || form.fecha === init.fecha) {
                    var dp = (firstEv.fecha || "").split("/");
                    n.fecha = dp.length === 3 ? dp[2] + "-" + dp[1].padStart(2, "0") + "-" + dp[0].padStart(2, "0") : form.fecha;
                }
                if (!form.problema && firstEv.evento_detectado)
                    n.problema = firstEv.evento_detectado;
                if (!form.titulo_corto && firstEv.evento_detectado)
                    n.titulo_corto = firstEv.evento_detectado.slice(0, 52);
            }
            if (newIds.length > 0) {
                var linked = newIds.map(function (id) { return ev.find(function (e) { return e.id === id; }); }).filter(Boolean);
                var sortedAsc = linked.slice().sort(function (a, b) { return traceOpsGetDateValue(a.fecha) - traceOpsGetDateValue(b.fecha); });
                var sortedDesc = linked.slice().sort(function (a, b) { return traceOpsGetDateValue(b.fecha) - traceOpsGetDateValue(a.fecha); });
                if (!form.primera_deteccion && sortedAsc.length > 0)
                    n.primera_deteccion = sortedAsc[0].fecha || "";
                if (!form.ultima_deteccion && sortedDesc.length > 0)
                    n.ultima_deteccion = sortedDesc[0].fecha || "";
            }
            setForm(n);
        }

    function EightdDraftEditor(props) {
        var init = props.init || {};
        var sourceRcca = props.sourceRcca || null;
        var formArr = _useState(function () { return Object.assign({}, init); });
        var form = formArr[0];
        var setForm = formArr[1];
        var mobileArr = _useState(function () { try {
            return window.innerWidth <= 760;
        }
        catch (_) {
            return false;
        } });
        var mobile = mobileArr[0];
        var setMobile = mobileArr[1];
        var collapsedArr = _useState(function () { return { source: false, missing: false, events: true }; });
        var collapsed = collapsedArr[0];
        var setCollapsed = collapsedArr[1];
        React.useEffect(function () {
            var nextInit = Object.assign({}, props.init || {});
            nextInit.d1_team_members = traceOpsEightdNormalizeTeamMembers(nextInit.d1_team_members);
            nextInit.d1_escalation_members = traceOpsEightdNormalizeTeamMembers(nextInit.d1_escalation_members);
            setForm(nextInit);
        }, [props.init && props.init.eightd_id, props.init && props.init.updated_at]);
        React.useEffect(function () {
            function onResize() {
                try {
                    setMobile(window.innerWidth <= 760);
                }
                catch (_) { }
            }
            onResize();
            window.addEventListener('resize', onResize);
            return function () { window.removeEventListener('resize', onResize); };
        }, []);
        React.useEffect(function () {
            if (!sourceRcca || !sourceRcca.rcca_id)
                return;
            var sourceFingerprint = traceOpsRccaFingerprint(sourceRcca);
            var currentFingerprint = form && form.source_snapshot ? traceOpsRccaFingerprint(form.source_snapshot) : '';
            if (sourceFingerprint && sourceFingerprint !== currentFingerprint) {
                var refreshed = traceOpsBuildEightdDraftFromRcca(sourceRcca, form || {});
                setForm(refreshed);
            }
        }, [sourceRcca && sourceRcca.rcca_id, sourceRcca && sourceRcca.updated_at, traceOpsMetaFilesFingerprint(sourceRcca && sourceRcca.meta_files)]);
        function applyDraftReadiness(next) {
            var ready = traceOpsComputeEightdReadiness(next);
            next.readiness_score = ready.overallScore;
            next.structure_readiness_score = ready.structureScore;
            next.evidence_readiness_score = ready.evidenceScore;
            next.case_maturity_score = ready.overallScore;
            next.missing_fields = ready.structureMissing;
            next.escalation_blockers = ready.blockers;
            next.can_promote = ready.canPromote;
            next.draft_stage = ready.stage;
            return next;
        }
        function upd(k, v, opts) {
            var next = Object.assign({}, form);
            next.meta = traceOpsEightdEnsureMeta(next.meta);
            next[k] = v;
            if (!(opts && opts.fromSource)) {
                next.meta.manual_fields[k] = true;
            }
            if (opts && opts.clearManual) {
                delete next.meta.manual_fields[k];
            }
            setForm(applyDraftReadiness(next));
        }
        function refreshDraftFieldFromRcca(key) {
            if (!sourceRcca || !sourceRcca.rcca_id)
                return;
            var seed = Object.assign({}, form);
            seed.meta = traceOpsEightdEnsureMeta(seed.meta);
            var refreshed = traceOpsBuildEightdDraftFromRcca(sourceRcca, seed);
            setForm(applyDraftReadiness(refreshed));
        }
        function syncD1TeamMembers(nextMembers) {
            var next = Object.assign({}, form);
            next.meta = traceOpsEightdEnsureMeta(next.meta);
            var model = traceOpsEightdBuildModel((next.source_snapshot) || next || {}, traceOpsEightdCollectLinkedEvents((next.linked_event_ids || next.event_ids) || []));
            next.d1_team_members = traceOpsEightdNormalizeTeamMembers(nextMembers);
            next.d1_team = traceOpsEightdBuildTeamTextFromMembers(next.d1_team_members, model);
            next.meta.manual_fields.d1_team = true;
            if (!next.meta.manual_fields.d1_escalation) {
                next.d1_escalation_members = traceOpsEightdSeedEscalationMembers(next.d1_team_members, []);
                next.d1_escalation = traceOpsEightdBuildEscalationTextFromMembers(next.d1_escalation_members, model);
            }
            setForm(applyDraftReadiness(next));
        }
        function syncD1EscalationMembers(nextMembers) {
            var next = Object.assign({}, form);
            next.meta = traceOpsEightdEnsureMeta(next.meta);
            var model = traceOpsEightdBuildModel((next.source_snapshot) || next || {}, traceOpsEightdCollectLinkedEvents((next.linked_event_ids || next.event_ids) || []));
            next.d1_escalation_members = traceOpsEightdNormalizeTeamMembers(nextMembers);
            next.d1_escalation = traceOpsEightdBuildEscalationTextFromMembers(next.d1_escalation_members, model);
            next.meta.manual_fields.d1_escalation = true;
            setForm(applyDraftReadiness(next));
        }
        function d1TeamSeededRows() {
            var snapshot = (form && form.source_snapshot) || form || {};
            var model = traceOpsEightdBuildModel(snapshot, traceOpsEightdCollectLinkedEvents((form && (form.linked_event_ids || form.event_ids)) || []));
            return traceOpsEightdSeedTeamMembers(model, form.d1_team_members);
        }
        function addD1TeamMember() {
            var current = d1TeamSeededRows();
            current.push({ name: '', email: '', role: '' });
            syncD1TeamMembers(current);
        }
        function updateD1TeamMember(index, key, value) {
            var current = d1TeamSeededRows();
            while (current.length <= index)
                current.push({ name: '', email: '', role: '' });
            current[index] = Object.assign({}, current[index] || {});
            current[index][key] = value;
            syncD1TeamMembers(current);
        }
        function removeLastD1TeamMember() {
            var current = d1TeamSeededRows();
            if (current.length <= traceOpsEightdDefaultTeamRoles().length)
                return;
            current.pop();
            syncD1TeamMembers(current);
        }
        function d1EscalationSeededRows() {
            return traceOpsEightdSeedEscalationMembers(d1TeamSeededRows(), form.d1_escalation_members);
        }
        function copyEscalationFromTeam() {
            syncD1EscalationMembers(traceOpsEightdSeedEscalationMembers(d1TeamSeededRows(), []));
        }
        function addD1EscalationMember() {
            var current = d1EscalationSeededRows();
            current.push({ name: '', email: '', role: '' });
            syncD1EscalationMembers(current);
        }
        function updateD1EscalationMember(index, key, value) {
            var current = d1EscalationSeededRows();
            while (current.length <= index)
                current.push({ name: '', email: '', role: '' });
            current[index] = Object.assign({}, current[index] || {});
            current[index][key] = value;
            syncD1EscalationMembers(current);
        }
        function removeLastD1EscalationMember() {
            var current = d1EscalationSeededRows();
            if (current.length <= traceOpsEightdDefaultEscalationRoles().length)
                return;
            current.pop();
            syncD1EscalationMembers(current);
        }

    var _loadQueue = { running: 0, max: 4, pending: [] };
    function enqueueLoad(fname, cb) {
        if (_loadQueue.running < _loadQueue.max) {
            _loadQueue.running++;
            loadImg(fname).then(function (url) { _loadQueue.running--; cb(url); if (_loadQueue.pending.length) {
                var next = _loadQueue.pending.shift();
                enqueueLoad(next.fname, next.cb);
            } });
        }
        else {
            _loadQueue.pending.push({ fname: fname, cb: cb });
        }
    }
    function LazyImg(props) {
        var fname = props.fname;
        var className = props.className || "";
        var style = props.style || {};
        var onClick = props.onClick;
        var srcArr = _useState(null);
        var src = srcArr[0];
        var setSrc = srcArr[1];
        var visibleArr = _useState(false);
        var visible = visibleArr[0];
        var setVisible = visibleArr[1];
        var enqueuedRef = _useRef(false);
        var domRef = _useRef(null);
        React.useEffect(function () { var el = domRef.current; if (!el)
            return; if (!window.IntersectionObserver) {
            setVisible(true);
            return;
        } var obs = new IntersectionObserver(function (entries) { if (entries[0].isIntersecting) {
            setVisible(true);
            obs.disconnect();
        } }, { rootMargin: "200px" }); obs.observe(el); return function () { obs.disconnect(); }; }, []);
        React.useEffect(function () { if (!visible || src || enqueuedRef.current)
            return; enqueuedRef.current = true; enqueueLoad(fname, function (url) { setSrc(url); }); }, [visible]);
        if (!src)
            return React.createElement("div", { ref: domRef, className: className, style: Object.assign({ background: "#EEECEA", display: "flex", alignItems: "center", justifyContent: "center", color: "#C8C4BE", fontSize: 9, borderRadius: 8 }, style) }, visible ? "..." : "");
        return React.createElement("img", { ref: domRef, className: className, src: src, alt: fname, style: style, onClick: onClick ? function () { onClick(src); } : undefined });
    }
    function toggleImg(evId, fname) {
        var cur = evImgs[evId] || [];
        var next = cur.indexOf(fname) >= 0 ? cur.filter(function (f) { return f !== fname; }) : cur.concat([fname]);
        var updated = {};
        Object.keys(evImgs).forEach(function (k) { updated[k] = evImgs[k]; });
        updated[evId] = next;
        setEvImgs(updated);
    }
    var imgNames = zipImgNames;
    function formatDateIso(dateIso) { if (!dateIso)
        return ""; var p = dateIso.split("-"); return p.length === 3 ? (p[2] + "/" + p[1] + "/" + p[0]) : dateIso; }
    function parseClockParts(timeStr) { var parts = String(timeStr || "00:00:00").split(":"); return { h: parseInt(parts[0], 10) || 0, m: parseInt(parts[1], 10) || 0, s: parseInt(parts[2], 10) || 0 }; }
    function parseIsoDateTimeMs(dateIso, timeStr) { if (!dateIso)
        return null; var p = dateIso.split("-"); if (p.length !== 3)
        return null; var t = parseClockParts(timeStr); return new Date(parseInt(p[0], 10), parseInt(p[1], 10) - 1, parseInt(p[2], 10), t.h, t.m, t.s).getTime(); }
    function parseEventDateTimeMs(evRow) { if (!evRow || !evRow.fecha)
        return null; var p = String(evRow.fecha).split("/"); if (p.length !== 3)
        return null; var t = parseClockParts(evRow.hora); return new Date(parseInt(p[2], 10), parseInt(p[1], 10) - 1, parseInt(p[0], 10), t.h, t.m, t.s).getTime(); }
    function sameCalendarDay(msA, msB) { if (msA == null || msB == null)
        return false; var a = new Date(msA); var b = new Date(msB); return a.getFullYear() === b.getFullYear() && a.getMonth() === b.getMonth() && a.getDate() === b.getDate(); }
    function sortImageNamesNewestFirst(namesList) { return namesList.slice().sort(function (a, b) { var ma = imgMeta[a], mb = imgMeta[b]; if (!ma && !mb)
        return a.localeCompare(b); if (!ma)
        return 1; if (!mb)
        return -1; return ((mb.dateIso || "") + (mb.timeStr || "")).localeCompare((ma.dateIso || "") + (ma.timeStr || "")); }); }
    function uniqueNames(list) { var out = []; var seen = {}; list.forEach(function (name) { if (!name || seen[name])
        return; seen[name] = true; out.push(name); }); return out; }
    function formatEventRef(evRow) { if (!evRow)
        return ""; return evRow.hora ? (evRow.fecha || "") + " " + evRow.hora : (evRow.fecha || ""); }
    function buildPickerDataForEvent(evRow, attachedNames) {
        var sorted = sortImageNamesNewestFirst(imgNames);
        var refMs = parseEventDateTimeMs(evRow);
        if (refMs == null)
            return { list: uniqueNames((attachedNames || []).concat(sorted)).slice(0, 120), modeLabel: "mas nuevas primero", refText: "" };
        var exact = [], near15 = [], near60 = [], near180 = [], sameDay = [], rest = [];
        sorted.forEach(function (fname) { var meta2 = imgMeta[fname] || {}; var ms = parseIsoDateTimeMs(meta2.dateIso, meta2.timeStr); if (ms == null) {
            rest.push(fname);
            return;
        } var diff = Math.abs(ms - refMs); if (diff <= 5 * 60 * 1000)
            exact.push(fname);
        else if (diff <= 15 * 60 * 1000)
            near15.push(fname);
        else if (diff <= 60 * 60 * 1000)
            near60.push(fname);
        else if (diff <= 3 * 60 * 60 * 1000)
            near180.push(fname);
        else if (sameCalendarDay(ms, refMs))
            sameDay.push(fname);
        else
            rest.push(fname); });
        var contextual = uniqueNames((attachedNames || []).concat(exact, near15, near60, near180, sameDay));
        if (contextual.length < 36)
            contextual = uniqueNames(contextual.concat(rest.slice(0, 36 - contextual.length)));
        var modeLabel = "mas nuevas primero";
        if (exact.length)
            modeLabel = "+-5 min";
        else if (near15.length)
            modeLabel = "+-15 min";
        else if (near60.length)
            modeLabel = "+-1h";
        else if (near180.length)
            modeLabel = "+-3h";
        else if (sameDay.length)
            modeLabel = "mismo dia";
        return { list: contextual.slice(0, 120), modeLabel: modeLabel, refText: formatEventRef(evRow) };
    }
    function traceOpsNormSenderSafeLocal(s) {
        return String(s || "").toLowerCase().replace(/^~/, "").replace(/[^a-z0-9]+/g, " ").trim();
    }
    function traceOpsTextBlobForEvent(ev) {
        return [
            ev && ev.reporta || "",
            ev && ev.responsable_sugerido || "",
            ev && ev.modelo || "",
            ev && ev.linea_estacion || "",
            ev && ev.defecto_smt || "",
            ev && ev.evento_detectado || "",
            ev && ev.accion_requerida || "",
            ev && ev.accion_ejecutada || "",
            ev && ev.engineer_findings || ""
        ].join(" ");
    }
    function traceOpsExtractModelTokensSafeLocal(text) {
        try {
            if (typeof extractModelTokensLocal === "function")
                return extractModelTokensLocal(text);
        }
        catch (_) { }
        var s = String(text || "");
        var out = [];
        var m = s.match(/\b(?:N\/P|P\/N|MODEL|MODELO|PART)\s*[:# ]?\s*([A-Z0-9][A-Z0-9-]{4,})/ig) || [];
        m.forEach(function (hit) {
            var m2 = hit.match(/([A-Z0-9][A-Z0-9-]{4,})/i);
            if (m2)
                out.push(String(m2[1]).toUpperCase());
        });
        var m3 = s.match(/\b([A-Z]{2,}[0-9]{3,}[A-Z0-9-]*)\b/g) || [];
        m3.forEach(function (v) { out.push(String(v).toUpperCase()); });
        return Array.from(new Set(out)).slice(0, 12);
    }
    function traceOpsExtractPartsSafeLocal(text) {
        try {
            if (typeof extractPartsLocal === "function")
                return extractPartsLocal(text);
        }
        catch (_) { }
        var s = String(text || "");
        var found = s.match(/\b(?:U|R|C|Q|L|D|TP|IC|CN|FB)\d{1,4}\b/ig) || [];
        return Array.from(new Set(found.map(function (v) { return String(v).toUpperCase(); }))).slice(0, 20);
    }
    function traceOpsMiniNormLocal(text) {
        return String(text || "")
            .toLowerCase()
            .normalize("NFD")
            .replace(/[\u0300-\u036f]/g, "")
            .replace(/[^a-z0-9]+/g, " ")
            .trim();
    }
    function traceOpsTokenOverlapScoreLocal(a, b) {
        var tokens = Array.from(new Set(traceOpsMiniNormLocal(a).split(" ").filter(function (w) { return w && w.length > 3; })));
        var blob = " " + traceOpsMiniNormLocal(b) + " ";
        var score = 0;
        tokens.forEach(function (t) {
            if (blob.indexOf(" " + t + " ") >= 0)
                score += 1;
        });
        return score;
    }
    function traceOpsAutoAttachImagesToEvents(eventos, imageNames, metaMap) {
        var map = {};
        var evs = (eventos || []).slice();
        var imgs = imageNames || [];
        if (!evs.length || !imgs.length)
            return map;
        imgs.forEach(function (fname) {
            var meta = (metaMap && metaMap[fname]) || {};
            var imgMs = parseIsoDateTimeMs(meta.dateIso, meta.timeStr);
            if (imgMs == null)
                return;
            var bestEv = null;
            var bestScore = -9999;
            var nearestEv = null;
            var nearestDiff = 999999;
            var sameDayEvents = evs.filter(function (ev) {
                var evMs0 = parseEventDateTimeMs(ev);
                return evMs0 != null && sameCalendarDay(imgMs, evMs0);
            });
            evs.forEach(function (ev) {
                var evMs = parseEventDateTimeMs(ev);
                if (evMs == null)
                    return;
                if (!sameCalendarDay(imgMs, evMs))
                    return;
                var diffMin = Math.abs(imgMs - evMs) / 60000;
                if (diffMin < nearestDiff) {
                    nearestDiff = diffMin;
                    nearestEv = ev;
                }
                var score = 0;
                if (diffMin <= 5)
                    score += 14;
                else if (diffMin <= 15)
                    score += 11;
                else if (diffMin <= 30)
                    score += 9;
                else if (diffMin <= 60)
                    score += 6;
                else if (diffMin <= 180)
                    score += 3;
                else if (diffMin <= 480)
                    score += 1;
                else
                    score += 0;
                var imgSender = traceOpsNormSenderSafeLocal(meta.sender || "");
                var evSender = traceOpsNormSenderSafeLocal(ev.reporta || "");
                var respSender = traceOpsNormSenderSafeLocal(ev.responsable_sugerido || "");
                if (imgSender && evSender && imgSender === evSender)
                    score += 5;
                else if (imgSender && respSender && imgSender === respSender)
                    score += 4;
                var eventBlob = traceOpsTextBlobForEvent(ev);
                var contextText = String(meta.contextText || "");
                var overlap = traceOpsTokenOverlapScoreLocal(contextText, eventBlob);
                score += Math.min(8, overlap * 2);
                var ctxModels = traceOpsExtractModelTokensSafeLocal(contextText);
                var ctxParts = traceOpsExtractPartsSafeLocal(contextText);
                if (ctxModels.length && overlap > 0)
                    score += 2;
                if (ctxParts.length && overlap > 0)
                    score += 3;
                if (/\b(?:aoi|ict|smt|pth|socket|dimm|mix|mezcla|material|label|etiqueta|board|pcb|u\d+|r\d+|c\d+)\b/i.test(contextText))
                    score += 1;
                if (score > bestScore) {
                    bestScore = score;
                    bestEv = ev;
                }
            });
            if (!bestEv && sameDayEvents.length === 1) {
                bestEv = sameDayEvents[0];
                bestScore = 3;
            }
            if ((!bestEv || bestScore < 3) && sameDayEvents.length <= 2 && nearestEv && nearestDiff <= 720) {
                bestEv = nearestEv;
                bestScore = 2;
            }
            if (bestEv && (bestScore >= 3 || (sameDayEvents.length <= 2 && nearestDiff <= 720))) {
                if (!map[bestEv.id])
                    map[bestEv.id] = [];
                map[bestEv.id].push(fname);
            }
        });
        Object.keys(map).forEach(function (evId) {
            map[evId] = uniqueNames(map[evId]).slice(0, 6);
        });
        return map;
    }

        }
        window.addEventListener("traceops-maintenance-log-updated", refreshMaintenanceLogFromStorage);
        return function () { window.removeEventListener("traceops-maintenance-log-updated", refreshMaintenanceLogFromStorage); };
    }, []);
    React.useEffect(function () {
        window.traceOpsImportMaintenanceRecord = function (record) {
            try {
                if (!record) return false;
                setMaintenanceRecords(function (prev) {
                    var list = Array.isArray(prev) ? prev.slice() : [];
                    var key = String(record.sourceRef || record.id || "");
                    var ix = list.findIndex(function (x) {
                        return String(x.sourceRef || x.id || "") === key || String(x.id || "") === String(record.id || "");
                    });
                    if (ix >= 0) list[ix] = Object.assign({}, list[ix], record);
                    else list.unshift(record);
                    try { localStorage.setItem(MAINT_KEY, JSON.stringify(list)); } catch (_) { }
                    return list;
                });
                setMaintenanceTab("log");
                return true;
            } catch (_) { return false; }
        };
        return function () { try { delete window.traceOpsImportMaintenanceRecord; } catch (_) { window.traceOpsImportMaintenanceRecord = null; } };
    }, []);
    React.useEffect(function () {
        function refreshMaintenanceLogFromStorage() {
            try {
                var parsed = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(MAINT_KEY) || "[]");
                if (Array.isArray(parsed)) setMaintenanceRecords(parsed);
            }
            catch (_) { }
        }
        var timer = setInterval(refreshMaintenanceLogFromStorage, 1200);
        window.addEventListener("storage", refreshMaintenanceLogFromStorage);
        return function () { clearInterval(timer); window.removeEventListener("storage", refreshMaintenanceLogFromStorage); };
    }, []);
    function traceOpsGenerateMaintenanceId() {
        var now = new Date();
        var y = now.getFullYear();
        var m = String(now.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, "0");
        var d = String(now.getDate()).padStart(2, "0");
        var hh = String(now.getHours()).padStart(2, "0");
        var mm = String(now.getMinutes()).padStart(2, "0");
        var ss = String(now.getSeconds()).padStart(2, "0");
        return "MNT-" + y + m + d + "-" + hh + mm + ss;
    }
    function saveMaintenanceRecord() {
        var row = Object.assign({}, maintenanceForm || {});
        if (!row.machine && !row.partReplaced && !row.symptom) {
            alert("Completa al menos Machine, Part Replaced o Symptom.");
            return;
        }
        if (!row.id)
            row.id = traceOpsGenerateMaintenanceId();
        setMaintenanceRecords(function (prev) {
            var list = Array.isArray(prev) ? prev.slice() : [];
            var ix = list.findIndex(function (x) { return String(x.id || "") === String(row.id || ""); });
            if (ix >= 0)
                list[ix] = row;
            else
                list.unshift(row);
            return list;
        });
        setMaintenanceForm(traceOpsEmptyMaintenanceRecord());
        setMaintenanceTab("log");
    }
    function editMaintenanceRecord(id) {
        var row = (maintenanceRecords || []).find(function (x) { return String(x.id || "") === String(id || ""); });
        if (!row)
            return;
        setMaintenanceForm(Object.assign({}, row));
        setActiveModule("maintenance");
        setMaintenanceTab("capture");
        try {
            var el = document.getElementById("maintenance-section");
            if (el)
                el.scrollIntoView({ behavior: "smooth" });
        }
        catch (_) { }
    }
    function deleteMaintenanceRecord(id) {
        if (!window.confirm("Eliminar este registro de mantenimiento?"))
            return;
        setMaintenanceRecords(function (prev) {
            return (prev || []).filter(function (x) { return String(x.id || "") !== String(id || ""); });
        });
    }
    function clearMaintenanceLog() {
        if (!window.confirm("Borrar toda la bitácora de mantenimiento?"))
            return;
        setMaintenanceRecords([]);
    }
    function escalateMaintenanceToRcca(row) {
        if (!row)
            return;
        setActiveModule("rcca");
        setRccaForm({
            event_ids: row.linkedEventId ? [row.linkedEventId] : [],
            modelo: row.machine || row.equipmentType || "",
            linea: row.line || row.station || "",
            fecha: row.date || new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10),
            problema: [
                row.machine ? ("Machine: " + row.machine) : "",
                row.partReplaced ? ("Part: " + row.partReplaced) : "",
                row.partNumber ? ("P/N: " + row.partNumber) : "",
                row.symptom ? ("Symptom: " + row.symptom) : "",
                row.failureMode ? ("Failure mode: " + row.failureMode) : ""
            ].filter(Boolean).join(" | ")
        });
        try {
            var el = document.getElementById("rcca-section");
            if (el)
                el.scrollIntoView({ behavior: "smooth" });
        }
        catch (_) { }
    }
    function filteredMaintenanceRecords() {
        return (maintenanceRecords || []).filter(function (r) {
            if (maintenanceFilters.line !== "ALL" && String(r.line || "") !== String(maintenanceFilters.line || ""))
                return false;
            if (maintenanceFilters.machine !== "ALL" && String(r.machine || "") !== String(maintenanceFilters.machine || ""))
                return false;
            if (maintenanceFilters.status !== "ALL" && String(r.status || "") !== String(maintenanceFilters.status || ""))
                return false;
            if (maintenanceFilters.recurrence !== "ALL" && String(r.recurrence || "") !== String(maintenanceFilters.recurrence || ""))
                return false;
            if (maintenanceFilters.from && String(r.date || "") < String(maintenanceFilters.from))
                return false;
            if (maintenanceFilters.to && String(r.date || "") > String(maintenanceFilters.to))
                return false;
            return true;
        });
    }
    function maintenanceUnique(field) {
        var map = {};
        (maintenanceRecords || []).forEach(function (r) {
            var v = String((r && r[field]) || "").trim();
            if (v)
                map[v] = true;
        });
        return Object.keys(map).sort();
    }
    function maintenanceKpis() {
        var rows = filteredMaintenanceRecords();
        var totalDowntime = rows.reduce(function (acc, r) {
            return acc + (parseFloat(r.downtimeMin || 0) || 0);
        }, 0);
        var recurrentCases = rows.filter(function (r) { return String(r.recurrence || "") === "Yes"; }).length;
        var openCases = rows.filter(function (r) { return String(r.status || "") === "Open"; }).length;
        var uniqueMachines = {};
        rows.forEach(function (r) {
            var m = String(r.machine || "").trim();
            if (m)
                uniqueMachines[m] = true;
        });
        return {
            totalEvents: rows.length,
            totalDowntime: totalDowntime,
            recurrentCases: recurrentCases,
            openCases: openCases,
            uniqueMachines: Object.keys(uniqueMachines).length
        };
    }
    async function exportMaintenanceXlsx() {
        try {
            await window.ensureExcelTools();
            var wb = new ExcelJS.Workbook();
            wb.creator = "TraceOps by SMTintel";
            wb.created = new Date();
            var ws = wb.addWorksheet("Maintenance_Log");
            ws.columns = [
                { header: "ID", key: "id", width: 20 },
                { header: "Date", key: "date", width: 14 },
                { header: "Time", key: "time", width: 10 },
                { header: "Shift", key: "shift", width: 10 },
                { header: "Line", key: "line", width: 12 },
                { header: "Machine", key: "machine", width: 18 },
                { header: "Station", key: "station", width: 16 },
                { header: "EquipmentType", key: "equipmentType", width: 16 },
                { header: "AssetID", key: "assetId", width: 16 },
                { header: "PartReplaced", key: "partReplaced", width: 22 },
                { header: "PartNumber", key: "partNumber", width: 18 },
                { header: "Supplier", key: "supplier", width: 16 },
                { header: "Symptom", key: "symptom", width: 30 },
                { header: "FailureMode", key: "failureMode", width: 24 },
                { header: "ActionTaken", key: "actionTaken", width: 30 },
                { header: "Technician", key: "technician", width: 18 },
                { header: "VerifiedBy", key: "verifiedBy", width: 18 },
                { header: "DowntimeMin", key: "downtimeMin", width: 14 },
                { header: "Recurrence", key: "recurrence", width: 12 },
                { header: "Status", key: "status", width: 12 },
                { header: "ImpactToQuality", key: "impactToQuality", width: 16 },
                { header: "ImpactToOutput", key: "impactToOutput", width: 16 },
                { header: "LinkedRCCA", key: "linkedRccaId", width: 20 },
                { header: "Notes", key: "notes", width: 28 }
            ];
            (filteredMaintenanceRecords() || []).forEach(function (r) {
                ws.addRow(r);
            });
            ws.getRow(1).font = { name: "Segoe UI", size: 10, bold: true };
            ws.getRow(1).alignment = { vertical: "middle", horizontal: "center" };
            ws.views = [{ state: "frozen", ySplit: 1 }];
            var buf = await wb.xlsx.writeBuffer();
            var blob = new Blob([buf], {
                type: "application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet"
            });
            var url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
            var a = document.createElement("a");
            a.href = url;
            a.download = "traceops_maintenance_log_" + new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10) + ".xlsx";
            document.body.appendChild(a);
            a.click();
            setTimeout(function () {
                URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
                a.remove();
            }, 800);
        }
        catch (err) {
            console.error(err);
            alert("No se pudo exportar Maintenance Log.");
        }
    }

    }

    function traceOpsBoardNormalizeRef(value) {
        return String(value || "").toUpperCase().replace(/[^A-Z0-9_]+/g, "").trim();
    }
    function traceOpsBoardPickFirstRefFromText(value) {
        var txt = String(value || "").toUpperCase();
        var matches = txt.match(/\b[A-Z]{1,4}[0-9]{1,5}(?:_[A-Z0-9]+)?\b/g) || [];
        return matches.length ? matches[0] : "";
    }
    function openBoardImpactFromYield(seed) {
        var pattern = null;
        try {
            var patterns = yieldFlowModel.failurePatterns || [];
            pattern = patterns.find(function (p) {
                var refs = (p.refs || []).join(' ');
                var txt = String((p.pattern || '') + ' ' + refs).toLowerCase();
                var probe = String((seed && (seed.mode || seed.failureMode || seed.title || seed.type)) || '').toLowerCase();
                return probe && txt.indexOf(probe.split(' ')[0]) >= 0;
            }) || patterns[0] || null;
        }
        catch (_) { pattern = null; }
        var rows = (seed && seed.rows) || (seed && seed.action && seed.action.rows) || (pattern && pattern.serials) || [];
        var first = rows && rows.length ? rows[0] : {};
        var rowRefs = traceOpsBoardRefsFromRows(rows);
        var rawRef = (seed && (seed.ref || seed.refdes)) || (pattern && pattern.refs && pattern.refs[0]) || rowRefs[0] || first.location || first.ref || first.refdes || traceOpsBoardPickFirstRefFromText(first.symptom || first.mode || first.failureMode || "") || "R209";
        var ref = traceOpsBoardNormalizeRef(String(rawRef || "R209").split(/[;, ]/)[0]);
        var ctx = {
            source: "Yield Flow",
            mode: (seed && (seed.mode || seed.failureMode || seed.title || seed.type)) || (pattern && pattern.pattern) || "Component issue",
            refdes: ref,
            wo: (seed && seed.wo) || first.wo || (yieldFilters && yieldFilters.wo && yieldFilters.wo !== "ALL" ? yieldFilters.wo : "WO scope"),
            sku: first.sku || (yieldFilters && yieldFilters.sku && yieldFilters.sku !== "ALL" ? yieldFilters.sku : "Current SKU"),
            family: first.family || (yieldFilters && yieldFilters.family && yieldFilters.family !== "ALL" ? yieldFilters.family : "Current model"),
            station: first.station || "AOI / Repair",
            rows: rows || [],
            refs: rowRefs.length ? rowRefs : ((pattern && pattern.refs) || (ref ? [ref] : []))
        };
        setBoardImpactContext(ctx);
        setBoardSelectedRef(ref || "R209");
        setActiveModule("boardimpact");
        if (isMobile()) setSidebarOpen(false);
        setTimeout(function () { if (!scrollToSection("boardimpact-section")) scrollToSection("module-workspace"); }, 80);
    }

    function traceOpsBoardManifestKey(value) {
        return String(value || "")
            .toUpperCase()
            .replace(/[_-]+/g, " ")
            .replace(/\s+/g, " ")
            .trim();
    }
    function traceOpsBoardGetPdfFilename(family) {
        var key = traceOpsBoardManifestKey(family);
        if (!key || key === "ALL" || key === "TODOS") return TRACEOPS_BOARD_PDF_MANIFEST.WARWICK;
        if (TRACEOPS_BOARD_PDF_MANIFEST[key]) return TRACEOPS_BOARD_PDF_MANIFEST[key];
        var keys = Object.keys(TRACEOPS_BOARD_PDF_MANIFEST);
        for (var i = 0; i < keys.length; i++) {
            if (key.indexOf(keys[i]) >= 0 || keys[i].indexOf(key) >= 0) return TRACEOPS_BOARD_PDF_MANIFEST[keys[i]];
        }
        return key.replace(/\s+/g, "-") + ".pdf";
    }
    function traceOpsBoardNormalizeFamilyName(family) {
        return traceOpsBoardGetPdfFilename(family).replace(/\.pdf$/i, "");
    }
    function traceOpsBoardTryPdfUrls() {
        var filename = traceOpsBoardGetPdfFilename(yieldFilters.family);
        return ["./" + filename, filename, "./board-impact-assets/" + filename, "board-impact-assets/" + filename];
    }

    function traceOpsBoardGetManualBox(ref) {
        var key = traceOpsBoardNormalizeRef(ref);
        var mapKeys = Object.keys(TRACEOPS_BOARD_REF_BOXES || {});
        for (var i = 0; i < mapKeys.length; i++) {
            if (traceOpsBoardNormalizeRef(mapKeys[i]) === key) return TRACEOPS_BOARD_REF_BOXES[mapKeys[i]];
        }
        return null;
    }
    function traceOpsBoardSeverityColor(status) {
        var s = String(status || "").toLowerCase();
        if (s.indexOf("crit") >= 0 || s.indexOf("critical") >= 0) return { fill: "rgba(255, 59, 48, .22)", stroke: "rgba(255, 59, 48, .95)", glow: "rgba(255, 59, 48, .55)" };
        if (s.indexOf("alt") >= 0 || s.indexOf("high") >= 0) return { fill: "rgba(255, 149, 0, .24)", stroke: "rgba(255, 149, 0, .95)", glow: "rgba(255, 149, 0, .55)" };
        return { fill: "rgba(255, 204, 0, .26)", stroke: "rgba(184, 120, 32, .95)", glow: "rgba(255, 204, 0, .55)" };
    }
    React.useEffect(function () {
        if (activeModule !== "boardimpact") return;
        var cancelled = false;
        var renderSeq = Date.now() + "_" + Math.random();
        window.__traceopsBoardPdfSeq = renderSeq;
        async function getPdfDocument() {
            await window.ensurePdfTools();
            var urls = traceOpsBoardTryPdfUrls();
            var lastErr = null;
            for (var i = 0; i < urls.length; i++) {
                try { return { pdf: await window.pdfjsLib.getDocument({ url: urls[i], disableAutoFetch: false, disableStream: false }).promise, url: urls[i] }; }
                catch (err) { lastErr = err; }
            }
            throw lastErr || new Error("Missing PDF for product family: " + yieldFilters.family);
        }
        function findTextItem(textContent, ref) {
            var target = traceOpsBoardNormalizeRef(ref);
            if (!target) return null;
            var items = textContent.items || [];
            for (var i = 0; i < items.length; i++) {
                var item = items[i] || {};
                if (traceOpsBoardNormalizeRef(item.str).indexOf(target) >= 0) return item;
            }
            return null;
        }
        async function searchPdf(pdf, ref) {
            var target = traceOpsBoardNormalizeRef(ref);
            if (!target) return null;
            var maxPages = Math.min(pdf.numPages || 1, 2);
            for (var pageNo = 1; pageNo <= maxPages; pageNo++) {
                var page = await pdf.getPage(pageNo);
                var text = await page.getTextContent();
                var item = findTextItem(text, target);
                if (item) return { pageNo: pageNo, item: item, textContent: text };
            }
            return null;
        }
        async function run() {
            try {
                setBoardPdfState({ status: "loading", message: "Cargando PDF de tablilla...", page: boardSide === "bottom" ? 2 : 1, found: false });
                var loaded = await getPdfDocument();
                if (cancelled || window.__traceopsBoardPdfSeq !== renderSeq) return;
                var pdf = loaded.pdf;
                var desiredPage = boardSide === "bottom" ? 2 : 1;
                var ref = traceOpsBoardNormalizeRef(boardSelectedRef || (boardImpactContext && boardImpactContext.refdes) || "");
                var manualBox = ref ? traceOpsBoardGetManualBox(ref) : null;
                var manualPage = manualBox && manualBox.bounding_box && manualBox.bounding_box.page ? Number(manualBox.bounding_box.page) : null;
                var hit = ref && !manualBox ? await searchPdf(pdf, ref) : null;
                if (cancelled || window.__traceopsBoardPdfSeq !== renderSeq) return;
                if (manualPage && manualPage !== desiredPage) { setBoardSide(manualPage === 2 ? "bottom" : "top"); return; }
                if (!manualBox && hit && hit.pageNo && hit.pageNo !== desiredPage) { setBoardSide(hit.pageNo === 2 ? "bottom" : "top"); return; }
                var pageNo = manualPage || (hit && hit.pageNo ? hit.pageNo : desiredPage);
                var page = await pdf.getPage(pageNo);
                var container = document.getElementById("traceops-board-pdf-stage");
                var canvas = document.getElementById("traceops-board-pdf-canvas");
                var overlay = document.getElementById("traceops-board-pdf-overlay");
                if (!container || !canvas || !overlay) return;
                var baseViewport = page.getViewport({ scale: 1 });
                var available = Math.max(280, Math.min((container.clientWidth || 900) - (isMobile() ? 28 : 46), 1180));
                var fitScale = Math.max(.45, Math.min(isMobile() ? 1.15 : 2.0, available / baseViewport.width));
                var zoomFactor = boardDetailZoom ? (isMobile() ? 1.65 : 2.05) : 1;
                var scale = Math.max(.45, Math.min(isMobile() ? 2.05 : 3.35, fitScale * zoomFactor));
                var viewport = page.getViewport({ scale: scale });
                canvas.width = Math.floor(viewport.width); canvas.height = Math.floor(viewport.height);
                canvas.style.width = Math.floor(viewport.width) + "px"; canvas.style.height = Math.floor(viewport.height) + "px";
                overlay.width = canvas.width; overlay.height = canvas.height;
                overlay.style.width = canvas.style.width; overlay.style.height = canvas.style.height;
                overlay.style.left = canvas.offsetLeft + "px"; overlay.style.top = canvas.offsetTop + "px";
                var ctx2d = canvas.getContext("2d");
                ctx2d.fillStyle = "#fff"; ctx2d.fillRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
                await page.render({ canvasContext: ctx2d, viewport: viewport }).promise;
                if (cancelled || window.__traceopsBoardPdfSeq !== renderSeq) return;
                var over = overlay.getContext("2d");
                over.clearRect(0,0,overlay.width,overlay.height);
                try {
                    var heatRows = (boardImpactContext && boardImpactContext.rows) || [];
                    var heatRefs = traceOpsBoardBuildRefStats(heatRows, (boardImpactContext && boardImpactContext.refs) || []);
                    var textForHeat = await page.getTextContent();
                    heatRefs.slice(0, 60).forEach(function(stat, idx) {
                        var refKey = traceOpsBoardNormalizeRef(stat.ref);
                        if (!refKey) return;
                        var item = null;
                        for (var hi = 0; hi < (textForHeat.items || []).length; hi++) {
                            var ti = textForHeat.items[hi] || {};
                            if (traceOpsBoardNormalizeRef(ti.str).indexOf(refKey) >= 0) { item = ti; break; }
                        }
                        if (!item) return;
                        var txh = window.pdfjsLib.Util.transform(viewport.transform, item.transform);
                        var hx = txh[4], hy = txh[5];
                        var hh = Math.max(10, Math.abs(txh[3]) || (item.height || 8) * scale);
                        var hw = Math.max(34, (item.width || 28) * scale);
                        var hp = Math.max(7, hh * .34);
                        var sevH = stat.severity || traceOpsBoardSeverityForCount(stat.qty, stat.pct, idx);
                        over.save();
                        over.globalAlpha = refKey === traceOpsBoardNormalizeRef(ref) ? .98 : .66;
                        over.fillStyle = sevH.key === 'critical' ? 'rgba(255,59,48,.28)' : (sevH.key === 'high' ? 'rgba(255,149,0,.28)' : (sevH.key === 'medium' ? 'rgba(255,204,0,.26)' : 'rgba(47,111,179,.20)'));
                        over.strokeStyle = sevH.color || 'rgba(31,111,235,.9)';
                        over.lineWidth = refKey === traceOpsBoardNormalizeRef(ref) ? Math.max(3, scale * 1.8) : Math.max(1.5, scale * 1.1);
                        over.shadowColor = sevH.color || 'rgba(31,111,235,.45)';
                        over.shadowBlur = refKey === traceOpsBoardNormalizeRef(ref) ? 20 : 10;
                        if (over.roundRect) { over.beginPath(); over.roundRect(hx - hp, hy - hh - hp, hw + hp * 2, hh + hp * 2, 8); over.fill(); over.stroke(); }
                        else { over.fillRect(hx - hp, hy - hh - hp, hw + hp * 2, hh + hp * 2); over.strokeRect(hx - hp, hy - hh - hp, hw + hp * 2, hh + hp * 2); }
                        over.restore();
                    });
                } catch (_) {}
                var foundItem = hit && hit.item;
                var manualFound = false;
                if (manualBox && manualBox.bounding_box) {
                    try {
                        var b = manualBox.bounding_box;
                        var rect = viewport.convertToViewportRectangle([Number(b.x), Number(b.y), Number(b.x) + Number(b.width), Number(b.y) + Number(b.height)]);
                        var rx = Math.min(rect[0], rect[2]);
                        var ry = Math.min(rect[1], rect[3]);
                        var rw = Math.max(8, Math.abs(rect[2] - rect[0]));
                        var rh = Math.max(8, Math.abs(rect[3] - rect[1]));
                        var color = traceOpsBoardSeverityColor(manualBox.metadata && manualBox.metadata.status);
                        var padBox = Math.max(8, Math.min(18, rw * .55));
                        over.save();
                        over.fillStyle = color.fill;
                        over.strokeStyle = color.stroke;
                        over.lineWidth = Math.max(2.5, scale * 1.6);
                        over.shadowColor = color.glow;
                        over.shadowBlur = 18;
                        if (over.roundRect) { over.beginPath(); over.roundRect(rx - padBox, ry - padBox, rw + padBox * 2, rh + padBox * 2, 8); over.fill(); over.stroke(); }
                        else { over.fillRect(rx - padBox, ry - padBox, rw + padBox * 2, rh + padBox * 2); over.strokeRect(rx - padBox, ry - padBox, rw + padBox * 2, rh + padBox * 2); }
                        over.restore();
                        manualFound = true;
                        try { container.scrollTo({ left: Math.max(0, rx - container.clientWidth / 2), top: Math.max(0, ry - container.clientHeight / 2), behavior: "smooth" }); } catch (_) {}
                    } catch (_) {}
                } else if (foundItem) {
                    try {
                        var tx = window.pdfjsLib.Util.transform(viewport.transform, foundItem.transform);
                        var x = tx[4], y = tx[5];
                        var hgt = Math.max(10, Math.abs(tx[3]) || (foundItem.height || 8) * scale);
                        var wdt = Math.max(34, (foundItem.width || 28) * scale);
                        var pad = Math.max(8, hgt * .35);
                        over.save();
                        over.fillStyle = "rgba(255, 214, 10, .42)";
                        over.strokeStyle = "rgba(184,120,32,.95)";
                        over.lineWidth = Math.max(2, scale * 1.4);
                        over.shadowColor = "rgba(255, 214, 10, .7)";
                        over.shadowBlur = 18;
                        if (over.roundRect) { over.beginPath(); over.roundRect(x - pad, y - hgt - pad, wdt + pad * 2, hgt + pad * 2, 8); over.fill(); over.stroke(); }
                        else { over.fillRect(x - pad, y - hgt - pad, wdt + pad * 2, hgt + pad * 2); over.strokeRect(x - pad, y - hgt - pad, wdt + pad * 2, hgt + pad * 2); }
                        over.restore();
                        try { if (!isMobile()) container.scrollTo({ left: Math.max(0, x - container.clientWidth / 2), top: Math.max(0, y - container.clientHeight / 2), behavior: "smooth" }); } catch (_) {}
                    } catch (_) {}
                }
                var metaDesc = manualBox && manualBox.metadata && manualBox.metadata.description ? (" · " + manualBox.metadata.description) : "";
                setBoardPdfState({ status: "ok", message: manualFound ? ("Referencia localizada por coordenadas: " + ref + metaDesc) : (foundItem ? ("Referencia localizada en PDF: " + ref) : (ref ? ("No se encontro texto exacto para " + ref + "; mostrando lado seleccionado.") : "PDF renderizado")), page: pageNo, found: !!(manualFound || foundItem), url: loaded.url, manual: manualFound });
            }
            catch (err) { if (!cancelled) setBoardPdfState({ status: "error", message: "No se pudo renderizar el PDF: " + ((err && err.message) || String(err)), page: boardSide === "bottom" ? 2 : 1, found: false }); }
        }
        run();
        return function () { cancelled = true; };
    }, [activeModule, boardSide, boardSelectedRef, boardDetailZoom, boardImpactContext && boardImpactContext.refdes, boardImpactContext && boardImpactContext.mode, boardImpactContext && boardImpactContext.rows]);

    function traceOpsBuildRecoveryFlowIntelligence(model) {
        model = model || {};
        var kpi = model.kpi || {};
        var serialMap = {};
        function cleanSn(v) {
            try { if (typeof traceOpsYieldCleanSn === 'function') return traceOpsYieldCleanSn(v); } catch (_) {}
            return String(v || '').replace(/\s+/g,'').toUpperCase();
        }
        function addSerial(row, source, pattern) {
            if (!row) return;
            var sn = cleanSn(row.sn || row.SN || row.serial || row.serialNumber || row.serial_number);
            if (!sn) sn = cleanSn([row.wo || row.workOrder || '', row.location || row.ref || row.refdes || '', pattern || source || '', Math.random().toString(36).slice(2,7)].join('|'));
            if (!serialMap[sn]) {
                serialMap[sn] = { sn: sn, wo: row.wo || row.workOrder || row.WO || '', sku: row.sku || row.SKU || '', family: row.family || row.model || row.Model || '', bu: row.bu || row.buLabel || '', line: row.line || row.Line || '', station: row.station || row.currentEvent || row.event || row.testArea || row.area || 'Repair / Test', failureMode: row.failureMode || row.symptom || row.mode || pattern || 'Pending failure mode', location: row.location || row.ref || row.refdes || row.RefDes || '', eventTime: row.eventTime || row.recordTime || row.date || row.time || '', repairTime: row.repairTime || row.closeTime || '', source: source || 'Yield Flow', hits: 0, reentry: 0, recovered: false };
            }
            var item = serialMap[sn];
            item.hits += 1;
            if (!item.failureMode || item.failureMode === 'Pending failure mode') item.failureMode = row.failureMode || row.symptom || row.mode || pattern || item.failureMode;
            if (!item.location) item.location = row.location || row.ref || row.refdes || row.RefDes || '';
            if (!item.station || item.station === 'Repair / Test') item.station = row.station || row.currentEvent || row.event || row.testArea || row.area || item.station;
            if (!item.wo) item.wo = row.wo || row.workOrder || row.WO || '';
            if (!item.sku) item.sku = row.sku || row.SKU || '';
            if (!item.family) item.family = row.family || row.model || row.Model || '';
            if (!item.bu) item.bu = row.bu || row.buLabel || '';
            if (!item.eventTime) item.eventTime = row.eventTime || row.recordTime || row.date || row.time || '';
            if (row.repairTime || /REPAIR|RETEST|DEBUG|REWORK/i.test([row.station,row.currentEvent,row.event,row.symptom,row.failureMode].join(' '))) item.reentry += 1;
            if (/PASS|STOCKIN|COMPLETE|RECOVER/i.test([row.result,row.currentEvent,row.event,row.status].join(' '))) item.recovered = true;
        }
        (model.failurePatterns || []).forEach(function(fp) { (fp.serials || fp.rows || []).forEach(function(r) { addSerial(r, 'Failure Pattern', fp.pattern || fp.cause || 'Failure pattern'); }); });
        (model.topRiskSku || []).forEach(function(x) { (x.serials || []).forEach(function(r) { addSerial(r, 'Top Risk SKU', x.topSymptom || x.family || 'Risk SKU'); }); });
        (model.causeSummary || []).forEach(function(c) { (c.serials || c.rows || []).forEach(function(r) { addSerial(r, 'Cause Summary', c.cause || c.pattern || 'Cause'); }); });
        var serials = Object.keys(serialMap).map(function(key) {
            var x = serialMap[key];
            var stateClass = x.recovered ? 'recovered' : (x.reentry > 0 ? 'reentry_failure' : 'fresh_or_pending');
            var state = x.recovered ? 'RECOVERED' : (x.reentry > 0 ? 'RETEST LOOP' : 'OPEN / FRESH');
            var agingHours = null;
            try { var dt = x.eventTime ? new Date(x.eventTime) : null; if (dt && !isNaN(dt.getTime())) agingHours = Math.max(0, (Date.now() - dt.getTime()) / 36e5); } catch (_) {}
            return Object.assign({}, x, { stateClass: stateClass, currentState: state, agingHours: agingHours });
        }).sort(function(a,b) { return (b.reentry - a.reentry) || String(a.sn).localeCompare(String(b.sn)); });
        var totalRiskUnits = Number(kpi.risk || 0);
        var serialOpenUnits = serials.filter(function(x){ return !x.recovered; }).length;
        var serialRecoveredUnits = serials.filter(function(x){ return x.recovered; }).length;
        var recoveredUnits = serialRecoveredUnits || Number(kpi.clean || 0);
        var activePool = serials.length ? serialOpenUnits : Math.max(0, totalRiskUnits - recoveredUnits);
        var failurePool = totalRiskUnits || (serialOpenUnits + serialRecoveredUnits);
        var reentryUnits = serials.filter(function(x){ return x.reentry > 0 && !x.recovered; }).length;
        var freshFailures = Math.max(0, activePool - reentryUnits);
        var pendingUnits = freshFailures;
        var netBleeding = freshFailures + reentryUnits - recoveredUnits;
        var byFailure = {};
        serials.forEach(function(x) {
            var key = x.failureMode || 'Pending failure mode';
            if (!byFailure[key]) byFailure[key] = { failureMode: key, active: 0, fresh: 0, reentry: 0, recovered: 0, locations: {}, stations: {} };
            if (x.recovered) byFailure[key].recovered += 1; else byFailure[key].active += 1;
            if (x.reentry > 0) byFailure[key].reentry += 1; else if (!x.recovered) byFailure[key].fresh += 1;
            if (x.location) byFailure[key].locations[x.location] = (byFailure[key].locations[x.location] || 0) + 1;
            if (x.station) byFailure[key].stations[x.station] = (byFailure[key].stations[x.station] || 0) + 1;
        });
        var failureRows = Object.keys(byFailure).map(function(key) {
            var r = byFailure[key];
            var loc = Object.keys(r.locations).sort(function(a,b){ return r.locations[b]-r.locations[a]; })[0] || 'N/D';
            var st = Object.keys(r.stations).sort(function(a,b){ return r.stations[b]-r.stations[a]; })[0] || 'N/D';
            var risk = r.active >= 8 || r.reentry >= 3 ? 'Critical' : (r.active >= 3 || r.reentry >= 1 ? 'High' : 'Medium');
            return Object.assign({}, r, { location: loc, station: st, risk: risk });
        }).sort(function(a,b){ return b.active - a.active || b.reentry - a.reentry; });
        return { serials: serials, failureRows: failureRows, kpi: { failurePool: failurePool, activePool: activePool, freshFailures: freshFailures, reentryUnits: reentryUnits, recoveredUnits: recoveredUnits, pendingUnits: pendingUnits, netBleeding: netBleeding, topFailure: failureRows[0] ? failureRows[0].failureMode : 'N/D', topStation: failureRows[0] ? failureRows[0].station : 'N/D', topLocation: failureRows[0] ? failureRows[0].location : 'N/D' } };
    }

    async function exportYieldFlowXlsx() {

            ws.views = [{ state: "frozen", ySplit: 1 }];
        }

        ]);
        addSheet("Yield_by_WO", ["week", "line", "bu", "family", "sku", "wo", "yield", "touch", "total", "clean", "risk", "severity", "riskRate"], (model.rows || []).map(function (r) { var sev = traceOpsYieldWoSeverity(r); return Object.assign({}, r, { severity: sev.level, riskRate: traceOpsYieldFlowFmt(sev.rate, 2) + "%" }); }));

        addSheet("Station_FPY", ["station", "expected", "current", "defects", "fpy", "ojt", "woCount", "health"], (model.stationFpy || []).map(function (x) { return Object.assign({}, x, { fpy: x.fpy == null ?         addSheet("FT_Breakdown", ["testArea", "pass", "fail", "test", "yieldPct", "goalPct", "frPct", "deltaPct", "passToGoal", "topFails"], (model.ftAreaRows || []).map(function (x) { return Object.assign({}, x, { yieldPct: traceOpsYieldFlowFmt(x.yieldPct, 2) + "%", goalPct: traceOpsYieldFlowFmt(x.goalPct, 2) + "%", frPct: traceOpsYieldFlowFmt(x.frPct, 2) + "%", deltaPct: traceOpsYieldFlowFmt(x.deltaPct, 2) + "%", topFails: (x.topFails || []).map(function (f) { return f.name + " (" + f.count + ")"; }).join("; ") }); }));
        addSheet("Support_Action_Tracker", ["id", "rccaId", "category", "owner", "comments", "startDate", "dueDate", "closeDate", "status", "priority", "source", "scope", "workOrder", "sku", "model", "failureMode", "station", "supportArea", "actionType", "action", "metaFiles"], (yieldActionList || []).map(function (x) { return Object.assign({}, x, { category: x.category || x.actionType || "", startDate: x.startDate || x.date || "", metaFiles: (x.meta_files || []).map(function (f) { return f.name; }).join(", ") }); }));

        var serialEvidenceRows = [];
        (model.failurePatterns || []).forEach(function (pat) { (pat.serials || []).forEach(function (r) { serialEvidenceRows.push({ pattern: pat.pattern, sn: r.sn, wo: r.wo, sku: r.sku, family: r.family, bu: r.bu, symptom: r.symptom, location: r.location, station: r.station, week: r.week, line: r.line }); }); });

        var buf = await wb.xlsx.writeBuffer();
        var blob = new Blob([buf], { type: "application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet" });
        var a = document.createElement("a");
        a.href = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
        a.download = "TraceOps_Yield_Flow_" + new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10) + ".xlsx";
        a.click();
        URL.revokeObjectURL(a.href);
    }

                                            React.createElement("div", { style: { fontSize: 9.5, fontWeight: 700, color: "#5F766C", textTransform: "uppercase" } }, pair[0]),
                                            React.createElement("div", { style: { fontSize: 11.5, fontWeight: 800, color: "#102A43", marginTop: 3 } }, pair[1]));
                                    }))) : null,

                                React.createElement("div", { style: { overflowX: "auto" } },
                                    React.createElement("table", { style: { width: "100%", borderCollapse: "collapse", fontSize: 11, minWidth: 460 } },
                                        React.createElement("thead", null, React.createElement("tr", { style: { background: "#FEF5DC", color: "#7A5B10", fontSize: 9.5, textTransform: "uppercase" } },
                                            React.createElement("th", { style: { textAlign: "left", padding: "6px 8px", borderBottom: "1px solid #F5E4A0" } }, "Estación"),
                                            React.createElement("th", { style: { textAlign: "left", padding: "6px 8px", borderBottom: "1px solid #F5E4A0" } }, "Síntoma"),
