    function traceOpsBoardSplitRefs(value) {
        var txt = String(value == null ? "" : value).toUpperCase().trim();
        if (!txt || /^(N\/D|NA|N\/A|NULL|0|SIN REFERENCIA)$/i.test(txt)) return [];
        var out = [], seen = {};
        function add(v) {
            v = traceOpsBoardNormalizeRef(v);
            if (!v || seen[v]) return;
            if (/^(ND|NA|NULL|NONE|SINREFERENCIA)$/.test(v)) return;
            seen[v] = true; out.push(v);
        }
        txt.split(/[;,|\/\n\r\t ]+/).forEach(add);
        var matches = txt.match(/\b[A-Z]{1,5}[0-9]{1,6}(?:_[A-Z0-9]+)?\b/g) || [];
        matches.forEach(add);
        return out;
    }
    function traceOpsBoardExtractRefsFromRow(row) {
        row = row || {};
        var direct = [row.ref, row.refdes, row.RefDes, row.location, row.failLocation, row.failureLocation, row.reference, row.FailLocation].join(" ");
        var refs = traceOpsBoardSplitRefs(direct);
        if (!refs.length) refs = traceOpsBoardSplitRefs([row.symptom, row.failureMode, row.mode, row.rootCause, row.rootcause].join(" "));
        return refs;
    }
    function traceOpsBoardRefsFromRows(rows) {
        var seen = {}, out = [];
        (Array.isArray(rows) ? rows : []).forEach(function(row) {
            traceOpsBoardExtractRefsFromRow(row).forEach(function(ref) { if (!seen[ref]) { seen[ref] = true; out.push(ref); } });
        });
        return out;
    }
    function traceOpsBoardComponentCodesFromRows(rows) {
        var map = {};
        (Array.isArray(rows) ? rows : []).forEach(function(row) {
            var code = String((row && (row.componentCode || row.componentPn || row.partNumber || row.pn || row.component_code || row.ComponentCode)) || "").trim();
            if (!code) return;
            map[code] = (map[code] || 0) + 1;
        });
        return Object.keys(map).sort(function(a,b) { return map[b] - map[a] || String(a).localeCompare(String(b)); }).map(function(code) { return { code: code, count: map[code] }; });
    }
    function traceOpsBoardPrimaryComponentCode(rows) {
        var codes = traceOpsBoardComponentCodesFromRows(rows);
        return codes.length ? codes[0].code : "N/D";
    }
    function traceOpsBoardPrimaryComponentDetail(rows) {
        var list = Array.isArray(rows) ? rows : [];
        var code = traceOpsBoardPrimaryComponentCode(list);
        var bom = traceOpsYieldEnrichComponent(code);
        var row = list.find(function(r) { return r && (r.componentType || r.componentDescription); }) || {};
        return {
            code: code,
            componentType: row.componentType || bom.componentType || "N/D",
            componentDescription: row.componentDescription || bom.componentDescription || "N/D"
        };
    }
    
    function traceOpsBoardBuildRefStats(rows, seedRefs) {
        var refs = traceOpsBoardRefsFromRows(rows).concat(seedRefs || []);
        var seen = {}, ordered = [];
        refs.forEach(function(ref) { ref = traceOpsBoardNormalizeRef(ref); if (ref && !seen[ref]) { seen[ref] = true; ordered.push(ref); } });
        return ordered.map(function(ref, i) {
            var refSerialRows = traceOpsBoardUniqueSerialRows(traceOpsBoardRowsForRef(rows, ref));
            var qty = refSerialRows.length;
            var total = traceOpsBoardUniqueSerialRows(rows).length || rows.length || 1;
            var pct = Number((qty / total * 100).toFixed(1));
            var sev = traceOpsBoardSeverityForCount(qty, pct, i);
            var componentDetail = traceOpsBoardPrimaryComponentDetail(refSerialRows);
            return { ref: ref, rows: refSerialRows, qty: qty, pct: pct, componentCode: componentDetail.code, componentType: componentDetail.componentType, componentDescription: componentDetail.componentDescription, componentCodes: traceOpsBoardComponentCodesFromRows(refSerialRows), severity: sev };
        }).filter(function(x) { return x.ref; }).sort(function(a,b) {
            var order = { critical: 4, high: 3, medium: 2, low: 1 };
            return (order[b.severity.key] || 0) - (order[a.severity.key] || 0) || b.qty - a.qty || String(a.ref).localeCompare(String(b.ref));
        });
    }
    function traceOpsBoardBuildModeOptions(model) {
        return ((model && model.causeSummary) || []).filter(function(c) { return Number(c.risk || 0) > 0; }).map(function(c) {
            var serials = c.serials || [];
            var refs = traceOpsBoardRefsFromRows(serials);
            return { mode: c.cause || c.pattern || "Sin sintoma", risk: Number(c.risk || serials.length || 0), serials: serials, refs: refs, sharePct: Number(c.sharePct || 0), topFamilies: c.topFamilies || [], topSkus: c.topSkus || [] };
        }).sort(function(a,b) { return b.risk - a.risk || String(a.mode).localeCompare(String(b.mode)); });
    }
    function traceOpsBoardRowsForRef(rows, ref) {
        var target = traceOpsBoardNormalizeRef(ref);
        var list = Array.isArray(rows) ? rows : [];
        if (!target) return list;
        var matched = list.filter(function (r) {
            var refs = traceOpsBoardExtractRefsFromRow(r);
            if (refs.some(function(x) { return traceOpsBoardNormalizeRef(x) === target; })) return true;
            var probe = [r.ref, r.refdes, r.location, r.failLocation, r.failureLocation, r.symptom, r.mode, r.failureMode, r.rootCause, r.rootcause].map(function (x) { return traceOpsBoardNormalizeRef(x); }).join(' ');
            return probe.indexOf(target) >= 0;
        });
        return matched.length ? matched : [];
    }
    function traceOpsBoardUniqueSerialRows(rows) {
        var seen = {};
        return (Array.isArray(rows) ? rows : []).filter(function (r, idx) {
            var sn = traceOpsYieldCleanSn((r && (r.sn || r.SN || r.serial || r.serialNumber)) || '') || ('row_' + idx);
            if (seen[sn]) return false;
            seen[sn] = true;
            return true;
        });
    }
    function traceOpsBoardSeverityForCount(count, pct, fallbackIdx) {
        var n = Number(count || 0);
        var p = Number(pct || 0);
        if (n >= 10 || p >= 4 || fallbackIdx === 0) return { key: 'critical', label: 'Critica', color: '#C44141', bg: '#FDEEEE', border: '#F3B6B0' };
        if (n >= 5 || p >= 2) return { key: 'high', label: 'Alta', color: '#E0782F', bg: '#FFF1E6', border: '#F7C89F' };
        if (n >= 2 || p >= 1) return { key: 'medium', label: 'Media', color: '#D9A441', bg: '#FFF7D8', border: '#F0D987' };
        return { key: 'low', label: 'Baja', color: '#6B7A90', bg: '#F1F5FA', border: '#D5DDE8' };
    }
    function traceOpsBoardSnValue(row, idx) {
        return traceOpsYieldCleanSn((row && (row.sn || row.SN || row.serial || row.serialNumber)) || '') || ('SN-' + String(idx + 1).padStart(3, '0'));
    }
    function traceOpsBoardWeekKey(row) {
        row = row || {};
        var week = String(row.week || row.ciscoWeek || row.fiscalWeek || row.WFCSY || row.Semana || '').trim();
        if (week && !/^imported$/i.test(week)) return week;
        var raw = String(row.repairTime || row.eventTime || row.recordTime || row.date || row.Date || '').trim();
        if (raw && typeof traceOpsYieldResolveCiscoWeek === 'function') {
            try {
                var wk = traceOpsYieldResolveCiscoWeek({ Date: raw, Fecha: raw, 'Calendar Date': raw }, (typeof TRACEOPS_YIELD_CISCO_CALENDAR_MAP !== 'undefined' ? TRACEOPS_YIELD_CISCO_CALENDAR_MAP : null));
                if (wk) return wk;
            } catch (_) {}
        }
        return 'Imported';
    }
    function traceOpsBoardTrendRowsForMode(mode) {
        var rows = (mode && mode.serials) || [];
        var hasRefs = traceOpsBoardRefsFromRows(rows);
        if (!hasRefs.length) return null;
        var byWeek = {};
        rows.forEach(function(row, idx) {
            var wk = traceOpsBoardWeekKey(row);
            if (!byWeek[wk]) byWeek[wk] = { week: wk, snMap: {}, refs: {}, rows: [] };
            var sn = traceOpsBoardSnValue(row, idx);
            byWeek[wk].snMap[sn] = true;
            traceOpsBoardExtractRefsFromRow(row).forEach(function(ref) { byWeek[wk].refs[ref] = true; });
            byWeek[wk].rows.push(row);
        });
        var points = Object.keys(byWeek).map(function(wk) {
            var x = byWeek[wk];
            return { week: wk, value: Object.keys(x.snMap).length, refs: Object.keys(x.refs).length, rows: x.rows };
        }).sort(function(a,b) { return traceOpsYieldWeekSortValue(a.week) - traceOpsYieldWeekSortValue(b.week) || String(a.week).localeCompare(String(b.week)); });
        return points.length ? points : null;
    }
    function traceOpsBoardRenderSparkline(points, tone) {
        var h = React.createElement;
        points = points || [];
        var w = isMobile() ? 132 : 168, hh = isMobile() ? 32 : 46, pad = 5;
        var vals = points.map(function(p) { return Number(p.value || 0); });
        var max = Math.max.apply(null, vals.concat([1]));
        var step = points.length > 1 ? (w - pad * 2) / (points.length - 1) : 0;
        var coords = points.map(function(p, i) {
            var x = pad + i * step;
            var y = hh - pad - ((Number(p.value || 0) / max) * (hh - pad * 2));
            return [x, y];
        });
        var line = coords.map(function(c) { return c[0].toFixed(1) + ',' + c[1].toFixed(1); }).join(' ');
        var area = coords.length ? (pad + ',' + (hh - pad) + ' ' + line + ' ' + (w - pad) + ',' + (hh - pad)) : '';
        var color = tone === 'good' ? '#1A7A3C' : tone === 'bad' ? '#C44141' : '#1F6FEB';
        return h('svg', { width: w, height: hh, viewBox: '0 0 ' + w + ' ' + hh, style: { display: 'block', width: '100%', maxWidth: w, overflow: 'visible' } }, [
            h('polyline', { key: 'area', points: area, fill: color, opacity: .10, stroke: 'none' }),
            h('polyline', { key: 'line', points: line, fill: 'none', stroke: color, strokeWidth: 3, strokeLinecap: 'round', strokeLinejoin: 'round' }),
            coords.map(function(c, i) { return h('circle', { key: 'c' + i, cx: c[0], cy: c[1], r: i === coords.length - 1 ? 3.6 : 2.6, fill: '#fff', stroke: color, strokeWidth: 2 }); })
        ]);
    }
    function traceOpsBoardGetFailureTrendTone(delta, totalSN) {
        if (delta > 0) return 'bad';
        if (delta < 0) return 'good';
        if (totalSN <= 3) return 'low';
        return 'flat';
    }
    function traceOpsBoardRenderFailureTrendPanel(modeOptions) {
        var h = React.createElement;
        var modes = (modeOptions || []).map(function(m) {
            var points = traceOpsBoardTrendRowsForMode(m);
            if (!points) return null;
            var recent = points.slice(-6);
            var last = recent.length ? Number(recent[recent.length - 1].value || 0) : 0;
            var prev = recent.length > 1 ? Number(recent[recent.length - 2].value || 0) : last;
            var delta = last - prev;
            return { mode: m.mode, risk: m.risk, refs: (m.refs || []).length, points: recent, total: points.reduce(function(a,b){ return a + Number(b.value || 0); }, 0), last: last, prev: prev, delta: delta };
        }).filter(Boolean).sort(function(a,b) { return b.total - a.total || b.risk - a.risk || String(a.mode).localeCompare(String(b.mode)); }).slice(0, 6);
        if (!modes.length) {
            return h('section', { style: { background: '#fff', border: '1px solid #D9E6F7', borderRadius: 18, padding: '14px 16px' } },
                h('div', { style: { fontSize: 14, fontWeight: 900, color: '#102A43' } }, 'Tendencias por modo de falla'),
                h('div', { style: { fontSize: 11, color: '#5F766C', marginTop: 6 } }, 'No hay semanas Cisco suficientes con RefDes valido para graficar tendencias.'));
        }
        return h('section', { style: { background: '#fff', border: '1px solid #D9E6F7', borderRadius: 18, overflow: 'hidden' } }, [
            h('div', { key: 'hdr', style: { padding: '14px 18px', background: 'linear-gradient(135deg,#F7FAFF,#FFFFFF)', borderBottom: '1px solid #ECF3FF', display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between', gap: 12, flexWrap: 'wrap', alignItems: 'center' } }, [
                h('div', { key: 'copy' }, [
                    h('div', { key: 'ey', style: { fontSize: 9.5, fontWeight: 900, color: '#2F6FB3', letterSpacing: '.12em', textTransform: 'uppercase' } }, 'Cisco weekly trend'),
                    h('div', { key: 'ti', style: { fontSize: isMobile() ? 13.5 : 15, fontWeight: 900, color: '#102A43', marginTop: 3 } }, 'Tendencias por modo de falla'),
                    h('div', { key: 'su', style: { display: isMobile() ? 'none' : 'block', fontSize: 10.5, color: '#5F766C', marginTop: 4, lineHeight: 1.35 } }, 'Mini graficos por semana Cisco usando Repair_record: SN + Rootcause + FailLocation. Delta negativo indica mejora vs semana previa.')
                ]),
                h('div', { key: 'tag', style: { display: 'inline-flex', padding: '6px 10px', borderRadius: 999, background: '#EEF5FF', color: '#1F3A5F', fontSize: 10.5, fontWeight: 900 } }, modes.length + ' modos con RefDes valido')
            ]),
            h('div', { key: 'legend', style: { display: 'flex', gap: 6, flexWrap: 'wrap', margin: isMobile() ? '8px 10px 0' : '8px 14px 0', fontSize: 11 } }, [
                h('span', { key: 'lb', style: { padding: '4px 8px', borderRadius: 999, fontWeight: 800, background: '#EDF3FF', color: '#2F6EDB' } }, 'Azul: estable / bajo volumen'),
                h('span', { key: 'lg', style: { padding: '4px 8px', borderRadius: 999, fontWeight: 800, background: '#EEF8F0', color: '#34834A' } }, 'Verde: mejora'),
                h('span', { key: 'lr', style: { padding: '4px 8px', borderRadius: 999, fontWeight: 800, background: '#FDEEEE', color: '#BD4B4B' } }, 'Rojo: sube falla')
            ]),
            h('div', { key: 'grid', style: { padding: isMobile() ? 10 : 14, display: 'grid', gridTemplateColumns: isMobile() ? '1fr' : 'repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr))', gap: isMobile() ? 8 : 10 } }, modes.map(function(m) {
                var trendTone = traceOpsBoardGetFailureTrendTone(m.delta, m.total);
                var trendLabel = trendTone === 'good' ? ('Mejora ' + Math.abs(m.delta) + ' SN') : (trendTone === 'bad' ? ('Sube +' + m.delta + ' SN') : (trendTone === 'low' ? 'Estable · bajo volumen' : 'Estable'));
                var chipBg = trendTone === 'good' ? '#EEF9F1' : (trendTone === 'bad' ? '#FDEEEE' : (trendTone === 'low' ? '#EDF3FF' : '#F3F6FB'));
                var chipColor = trendTone === 'good' ? '#1A7A3C' : (trendTone === 'bad' ? '#C44141' : (trendTone === 'low' ? '#2F6EDB' : '#5F766C'));
                var weekLabels = m.points.map(function(p) { return String(p.week || '').replace(/^FY\d+\s*/i, '').replace(/Cisco\s*/i, ''); }).slice(-3).join(' · ');
                return h('button', { key: m.mode, type: 'button', onClick: function() {
                    var opt = (modeOptions || []).find(function(x) { return String(x.mode) === String(m.mode); });
                    if (opt) {
                        var modeRefs = traceOpsBoardRefsFromRows(opt.serials || []);
                        var nextRef = modeRefs[0] || '';
                        setBoardDetailZoom(false);
                        setBoardImpactContext(Object.assign({}, boardImpactContext || {}, { mode: opt.mode, rows: opt.serials || [], refs: modeRefs, refdes: nextRef, source: 'Yield Flow Repair Record' }));
                        setBoardSelectedRef(nextRef);
                    }
                }, style: { textAlign: 'left', border: '1px solid #D9E6F7', background: '#fff', borderRadius: isMobile() ? 14 : 16, padding: isMobile() ? '9px 10px' : '12px 12px', cursor: 'pointer', boxShadow: '0 8px 18px rgba(16,42,67,.045)' } }, [
                    h('div', { key: 'top', style: { display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between', alignItems: 'flex-start', gap: 10 } }, [
                        h('div', { key: 'name', style: { fontSize: isMobile() ? 10.5 : 11, fontWeight: 900, color: '#102A43', lineHeight: 1.18, minHeight: isMobile() ? 18 : 28, overflow: 'hidden', display: isMobile() ? '-webkit-box' : 'block', WebkitLineClamp: isMobile() ? 2 : 'unset', WebkitBoxOrient: 'vertical' } }, m.mode),
                        h('span', { key: 'chip', style: { flex: '0 0 auto', borderRadius: 999, padding: isMobile() ? '3px 6px' : '4px 7px', background: chipBg, color: chipColor, fontSize: isMobile() ? 8.8 : 9.5, fontWeight: 900 } }, trendLabel)
                    ]),
                    h('div', { key: 'spark', style: { marginTop: isMobile() ? 5 : 8 } }, traceOpsBoardRenderSparkline(m.points, trendTone)),
                    h('div', { key: 'meta', style: { display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between', gap: 8, marginTop: isMobile() ? 5 : 8, fontSize: isMobile() ? 9.8 : 10.5, color: '#5F766C', fontWeight: 800 } }, [
                        h('span', { key: 'sn' }, m.total + ' SN acumulados'),
                        h('span', { key: 'refs' }, m.refs + ' refs')
                    ]),
                    h('div', { key: 'weeks', style: { fontSize: isMobile() ? 8.8 : 9.5, color: '#8B98B8', marginTop: isMobile() ? 3 : 5, whiteSpace: 'nowrap', overflow: 'hidden', textOverflow: 'ellipsis' } }, weekLabels || 'Semana Cisco no disponible')
                ]);
            }))
        ]);
    }
    function renderBoardImpactSection() {
        var ctx = boardImpactContext || {};

        var selectedRef = boardSelectedRef || ctx.refdes || refs[0] || "R209";
        var uniqueRefs = Array.from(new Set(refs.concat(selectedRef ? [selectedRef] : []).map(function (x) { return traceOpsBoardNormalizeRef(x); }).filter(Boolean)));
        var selectedRowsRaw = traceOpsBoardRowsForRef(rows, selectedRef);

        function traceOpsBoardFailureRate(qty, total) {
            qty = Number(qty || 0);
            total = Number(total || 0);
            return total ? (qty / total * 100) : 0;
        }
        var h = React.createElement;
        function kpi(label, value, meta, tone) {
            var colors = tone === "red" ? ["#FDEEEE", "#C44141"] : tone === "amber" ? ["#FFF1E6", "#E0782F"] : tone === "yellow" ? ["#FFF7D8", "#D9A441"] : tone === "purple" ? ["#F4ECFF", "#6B2DA8"] : ["#EEF5FF", "#1F3A5F"];

        function traceOpsBoardPackageForRef(row) {
            var pkg = row && (row.packageType || row.package || row.pkg || row.paquete);
            var ref = row && row.ref;
            if (!pkg && ref) pkg = /U/i.test(ref) ? "BGA/QFN" : /J/i.test(ref) ? "CONN" : /TP/i.test(ref) ? "TP ARRAY" : "0402/0603";

        function traceOpsBoardDescriptionForStat(row) {

        }

        function toggleRefSort(key) {
            if (refSortKey === key) {
                setRefSortDir(refSortDir === "asc" ? "desc" : "asc");
                return;
            }
            setRefSortKey(key);
            setRefSortDir((key === "failureRate" || key === "frBuilt" || key === "qty" || key === "pct" || key === "severity") ? "desc" : "asc");
        }
        function getRefSortIndicator(key) {
            if (refSortKey !== key) return "↕";
            return refSortDir === "asc" ? "↑" : "↓";
        }
        function getRefSortValue(row, key) {
            if (!row) return "";
            if (key === "ref") return String(row.ref || "").toLowerCase().trim();
            if (key === "partNumber") return String(row.componentCode || row.partNumber || row.pn || row.component_code || "").toLowerCase().trim();
            if (key === "componentType") return String(row.componentType || row.compType || row.type || "").toLowerCase().trim();
            if (key === "componentDescription") return String(row.componentDescription || row.compDesc || row.description || "").toLowerCase().trim();
            if (key === "severity") {
                var sevOrder = { critical: 4, high: 3, medium: 2, low: 1 };
                return sevOrder[row.severity && row.severity.key] || 0;
            }
            if (key === "description") return String(traceOpsBoardDescriptionForStat(row)).toLowerCase().trim();
            if (key === "packageType") return String(traceOpsBoardPackageForRef(row)).toLowerCase().trim();
            if (key === "side") return String(traceOpsBoardSideForStat(row)).toLowerCase().trim();
            if (key === "qty") return Number(row.qty || 0);
            if (key === "pct") return Number(String(row.pct || 0).replace("%", "").trim()) || 0;
            if (key === "failureRate") {
                var value = row.failureRate ?? row.frMfg ?? row.fr_mfg ?? row.percentBoards ?? row.percentPlacas ?? row.placasPct;
                if (value == null) value = traceOpsBoardFailureRate(row.qty, totalManufacturedUnits);
                return Number(String(value).replace("%", "").trim()) || 0;
            }
            if (key === "frBuilt") return traceOpsBoardFailureRate(row.qty, totalBuiltUnits);
            return String(row[key] || "").toLowerCase().trim();
        }

        }

            if (typeof av === "number" && typeof bv === "number") cmp = av - bv;

            if (cmp === 0) {
                var order = { critical: 4, high: 3, medium: 2, low: 1 };
                cmp = ((order[a.severity && a.severity.key] || 0) - (order[b.severity && b.severity.key] || 0)) || ((a.qty || 0) - (b.qty || 0));

            return refSortDir === "asc" ? cmp : -cmp;

    function renderRecoveryIntelligenceSection() {
        var h = React.createElement;
        var rec = traceOpsBuildRecoveryFlowIntelligence(yieldFlowModel);
        var k = rec.kpi || {};
        var serialRowsAll = (rec.serials || []);
        var serialPreviewLimit = isMobile() ? 10 : 28;
        var serialRows = serialRowsAll.slice(0, serialPreviewLimit);
        var failureRows = rec.failureRows || [];
        function badge(text, bg, color) {
            return h("span", { style: { display: "inline-flex", padding: "4px 8px", borderRadius: 999, background: bg || "#EAF2FF", color: color || "#1F3A5F", fontSize: 9.5, fontWeight: 900, whiteSpace: "nowrap" } }, text);
        }
        function recoveryClassLabel(v) {
            if (v === 'reentry_failure') return 'Re-entry';
            if (v === 'recovered') return 'Recovered';
            if (v === 'fresh_or_pending') return isMobile() ? 'Open' : 'Fresh / Open';
            return String(v || 'Open');
        }
        function recoveryClassBadge(v) {
            return badge(recoveryClassLabel(v), v === 'reentry_failure' ? '#FFF7E8' : (v === 'recovered' ? '#EEF6FF' : '#FDEEEE'), v === 'reentry_failure' ? '#9A6A16' : (v === 'recovered' ? '#145A28' : '#C44141'));
        }

        function recoveryIcon(type, size, color, bg) {
            var iconSize = size || 34;
            var stroke = color || '#1F3A5F';
            var fillBg = bg || '#EEF5FF';
            var common = { width: iconSize, height: iconSize, viewBox: '0 0 24 24', fill: 'none', stroke: stroke, strokeWidth: 2, strokeLinecap: 'round', strokeLinejoin: 'round' };
            var shapes;
            if (type === 'bonepile') {
                shapes = [
                    h('path', { key: 'b1', d: 'M4 16.5 12 21l8-4.5' }),
                    h('path', { key: 'b2', d: 'M4 11.5 12 16l8-4.5' }),
                    h('path', { key: 'b3', d: 'M4 6.5 12 11l8-4.5L12 2 4 6.5Z' })
                ];
            } else if (type === 'reentry') {
                shapes = [
                    h('path', { key: 'r1', d: 'M20 11a8 8 0 0 0-14.2-5' }),
                    h('path', { key: 'r2', d: 'M4 5v5h5' }),
                    h('path', { key: 'r3', d: 'M4 13a8 8 0 0 0 14.2 5' }),
                    h('path', { key: 'r4', d: 'M20 19v-5h-5' })
                ];
            } else if (type === 'pass') {
                shapes = [
                    h('path', { key: 'p1', d: 'M20 6 9 17l-5-5' }),
                    h('circle', { key: 'p2', cx: 12, cy: 12, r: 9 })
                ];
            } else if (type === 'fresh') {
                shapes = [
                    h('path', { key: 'f1', d: 'M12 3 3 20h18L12 3Z' }),
                    h('path', { key: 'f2', d: 'M12 9v5' }),
                    h('path', { key: 'f3', d: 'M12 17h.01' })
                ];
            } else if (type === 'scope') {
                shapes = [
                    h('rect', { key: 's1', x: 4, y: 4, width: 16, height: 16, rx: 3 }),
                    h('path', { key: 's2', d: 'M8 9h8M8 13h8M8 17h5' })
                ];
            } else {
                shapes = [h('circle', { key: 'd1', cx: 12, cy: 12, r: 8 }), h('path', { key: 'd2', d: 'M12 8v4l3 2' })];
            }
            return h('div', { style: { width: iconSize + 14, height: iconSize + 14, borderRadius: 16, background: fillBg, display: 'inline-flex', alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'center', flexShrink: 0, border: '1px solid rgba(31,58,95,.10)' } }, h('svg', common, shapes));
        }
        function recoveryIconKey(label) {
            label = String(label || '').toLowerCase();
            if (/bonepile|pool hoy|pool ayer|failure pool|open/.test(label)) return 'bonepile';
            if (/fresh/.test(label)) return 'fresh';
            if (/re-entry|reentry|retest|loop/.test(label)) return 'reentry';
            if (/pass|recover/.test(label)) return 'pass';
            if (/wo|sn|scope/.test(label)) return 'scope';
            return 'status';
        }
        function kpiCard(label, value, meta, color, iconKey) {
            var icon = iconKey || recoveryIconKey(label);
            return h("div", { key: label, style: { background: "#fff", border: "1px solid #D9E6F7", borderRadius: 18, padding: "14px 16px", boxShadow: "0 8px 18px rgba(16,42,67,.045)", minHeight: 126, display: "flex", flexDirection: "column", justifyContent: "space-between" } }, [
                h("div", { key: "top", style: { display: "flex", alignItems: "flex-start", justifyContent: "space-between", gap: 10 } }, [
                    h("div", { key: "txt", style: { minWidth: 0 } }, [
                        h("div", { key: "l", style: { fontSize: 9.5, fontWeight: 900, letterSpacing: ".10em", textTransform: "uppercase", color: "#5F766C" } }, label),
                        h("div", { key: "v", style: { fontSize: 34, fontWeight: 900, color: color || "#102A43", lineHeight: 1, marginTop: 8 } }, value)
                    ]),
                    recoveryIcon(icon, isMobile() ? 22 : 26, color || "#1F3A5F", icon === 'fresh' ? '#FDEEEE' : (icon === 'pass' ? '#EEF6FF' : (icon === 'reentry' ? '#FFF7E8' : '#EEF5FF')))
                ]),
                h("div", { key: "m", style: { fontSize: 10.5, color: "#5F766C", marginTop: 6, lineHeight: 1.35 } }, meta || "")
            ]);
        }
        var flowNodes = [
            { label: "WO / SN scope", value: traceOpsYieldFlowFmt(yieldFlowModel.kpi.orders || 0), hot: false },

        var netPositive = Number(k.netBleeding || 0) > 0;

        var actionRows = failureRows.slice(0, 6).map(function(r, idx) {

"16px 14px" : "18px 20px", color: "#fff", display: "grid", gridTemplateColumns: isMobile() ? "1fr" : "minmax(0,1fr) auto", gap: 12, alignItems: "center" } }, [
                h("div", { key: "copy" }, [
                    h("div", { key: "eyebrow", style: { fontSize: 10, fontWeight: 900, letterSpacing: ".12em", textTransform: "uppercase", opacity: .74 } }, "Yield Flow drilldown"),

                ]),
                h("div", { key: "actions", style: { display: "flex", gap: 8, flexWrap: "wrap", justifyContent: isMobile() ? "flex-start" : "flex-end" } }, [

                    badge("Local session", "rgba(255,255,255,.12)", "#fff"),

                    h("button", { key: "back", type: "button", onClick: function(){ setActiveModule("yieldflow"); setTimeout(function(){ scrollToSection("yieldflow-section"); }, 60); }, style: { border: "1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.35)", background: "rgba(255,255,255,.14)", color: "#fff", borderRadius: 999, padding: "8px 12px", fontSize: 11, fontWeight: 900, cursor: "pointer" } }, "Regresar a Yield Flow")
                ])
            ]),
            h("section", { key: "kpis", style: { display: "grid", gridTemplateColumns: isMobile() ? "repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr))" : "repeat(6,minmax(0,1fr))", gap: 12 } }, [

    function PickerThumb(props) {
        var fname = props.fname;
        var srcArr = _useState(_imgCache[fname] || null);
        var src = srcArr[0];
        var setSrc = srcArr[1];
        var queuedRef = _useRef(false);
        React.useEffect(function () { var alive = true; if (src || queuedRef.current)
            return; queuedRef.current = true; enqueueLoad(fname, function (url) { if (alive)
            setSrc(url); }); return function () { alive = false; }; }, [fname, src]);
        if (!src)
            return React.createElement("div", { className: "picker-thumb", style: { background: "#EEECEA" } });
        return React.createElement("img", { className: "picker-thumb", src: src, alt: fname });
    }

                    React.createElement("p", null,

<script>
(function loadMaintenanceAndonModuleSafe(){
  try {
    var isLocal = location.protocol === "file:" || location.protocol === "content:" || String(location.href || "").indexOf("content://") === 0;
    var isProduction = !!(location.hostname && location.hostname.indexOf("github.io") >= 0);
    if (isLocal && !isProduction) {
      window.TRACEOPS_MAINTENANCE_MODULE_SKIPPED = true;
      try { console.warn("[TraceOps] Maintenance module skipped in local test mode."); } catch(_) {}
      return;
    }
    var s = document.createElement("script");
    s.src = "./maintenance-andon-module.js";
    s.defer = true;
    s.onload = function(){ window.TRACEOPS_MAINTENANCE_MODULE_READY = true; };
    s.onerror = function(){ window.TRACEOPS_MAINTENANCE_MODULE_ERROR = true; try { console.warn("[TraceOps] Maintenance module unavailable. App continues."); } catch(_) {} };
    document.head.appendChild(s);
  } catch (err) {
    window.TRACEOPS_MAINTENANCE_MODULE_ERROR = true;
    try { console.warn("[TraceOps] Maintenance module loader failed", err); } catch(_) {}
  }
})();
</script>
<style>
/* ── Sentinel Shield Hover / Touch Energy Animation ───────────── */
.sentinel-hero {
  position: relative;
  cursor: default;
  -webkit-user-select: none;
  user-select: none;
  -webkit-touch-callout: none;
  -webkit-tap-highlight-color: transparent;
  touch-action: manipulation;
}
.sentinel-hero * {
  -webkit-user-select: none;
  user-select: none;
  -webkit-touch-callout: none;
}

/* glow on the whole SVG when hero is active */
.sentinel-hero:hover .sentinel-raven-svg,
.sentinel-hero.energy-active .sentinel-raven-svg {
  animation: sentinelSvgGlow .9s ease-in-out infinite alternate;
}
@keyframes sentinelSvgGlow {
  from { filter: drop-shadow(0 0 6px rgba(30,144,255,.5)) drop-shadow(0 0 14px rgba(34,211,238,.3)); }
  to   { filter: drop-shadow(0 0 22px rgba(34,211,238,.9)) drop-shadow(0 0 44px rgba(30,144,255,.6)) drop-shadow(0 0 70px rgba(30,144,255,.3)); }
}

/* canvas overlay for particles */
#sentinel-energy-canvas {
  position: absolute;
  inset: 0;
  pointer-events: none;
  z-index: 5;
  border-radius: inherit;
  opacity: 0;
  transition: opacity .25s;
}
.sentinel-hero:hover #sentinel-energy-canvas,
.sentinel-hero.energy-active #sentinel-energy-canvas { opacity: 1; }

<script>
(function(){
  /* ── Sentinel Shield Energy Animation ── */
  var RAF = null;
  var particles = [];
  var bolts = [];
  var canvas, ctx, hero, svg;
  var canvasCssW = 0, canvasCssH = 0;

  /* SVG viewBox: 900×520. Map to canvas CSS px. */
  var VW = 900, VH = 520;
  /* Shield centre in viewBox coords */
  var SX = 450, SY = 310;
  /* Eye positions */
  var EYES = [{ x: 312, y: 162, color: "#22D3EE" }, { x: 588, y: 162, color: "#24C3A2" }];

  function vx(x) { return (x / VW) * canvasCssW; }
  function vy(y) { return (y / VH) * canvasCssH; }

  function resizeCanvas() {
    if (!canvas || !ctx || !hero) return;
    var dpr = window.devicePixelRatio || 1;
    canvasCssW = hero.offsetWidth || 1;
    canvasCssH = hero.offsetHeight || 1;
    var nextW = Math.max(1, Math.floor(canvasCssW * dpr));
    var nextH = Math.max(1, Math.floor(canvasCssH * dpr));
    if (canvas.width !== nextW || canvas.height !== nextH) {
      canvas.width = nextW;
      canvas.height = nextH;
      canvas.style.width = canvasCssW + "px";
      canvas.style.height = canvasCssH + "px";
      ctx.setTransform(dpr, 0, 0, dpr, 0, 0);
    }
  }

  /* ── Particle ── */
  function spawnParticle(originX, originY, color) {
    var angle = Math.random() * Math.PI * 2;
    var speed = 0.6 + Math.random() * 2.2;
    particles.push({
      x: vx(originX), y: vy(originY),
      vx: Math.cos(angle) * speed, vy: Math.sin(angle) * speed,
      life: 1, decay: 0.018 + Math.random() * 0.03,
      r: 1.5 + Math.random() * 3,
      color: color
    });
  }

  /* ── Lightning bolt between two canvas points ── */
  function spawnBolt(x1, y1, x2, y2, color, forks) {
    bolts.push({ x1:x1, y1:y1, x2:x2, y2:y2, color:color, forks: forks||0, life:1, decay:.06 });
  }

  function drawBolt(b) {
    var segs = 7;
    var pts = [{ x: b.x1, y: b.y1 }];
    var dx = (b.x2 - b.x1) / segs, dy = (b.y2 - b.y1) / segs;
    for (var i = 1; i < segs; i++) {
      pts.push({
        x: b.x1 + dx * i + (Math.random() - .5) * 28,
        y: b.y1 + dy * i + (Math.random() - .5) * 28
      });
    }
    pts.push({ x: b.x2, y: b.y2 });
    ctx.save();
    ctx.globalAlpha = b.life * 0.85;
    ctx.strokeStyle = b.color;
    ctx.lineWidth = 1.5 + b.life * 1.5;
    ctx.shadowColor = b.color;
    ctx.shadowBlur = 12;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(pts[0].x, pts[0].y);
    for (var j = 1; j < pts.length; j++) ctx.lineTo(pts[j].x, pts[j].y);
    ctx.stroke();
    /* fork */
    if (b.forks > 0 && Math.random() > .5) {
      var mid = pts[Math.floor(pts.length / 2)];
      var fa = Math.random() * Math.PI * 2;
      var fl = 30 + Math.random() * 60;
      spawnBolt(mid.x, mid.y, mid.x + Math.cos(fa)*fl, mid.y + Math.sin(fa)*fl, b.color, 0);
    }
    ctx.restore();
  }

  /* ── Constellation ring ── */
  function drawConstellation() {
    var cx = vx(SX), cy = vy(SY);
    var r = vx(90) + Math.sin(Date.now() / 400) * vx(8);
    var n = 8;
    var pts2 = [];
    for (var i = 0; i < n; i++) {
      var a = (i / n) * Math.PI * 2 - Math.PI / 2;
      pts2.push({ x: cx + Math.cos(a) * r, y: cy + Math.sin(a) * r });
    }
    ctx.save();
    ctx.strokeStyle = "rgba(34,211,238,.35)";
    ctx.lineWidth = .8;
    for (var i = 0; i < n; i++) {
      for (var j = i + 1; j < n; j += 2) {
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.moveTo(pts2[i].x, pts2[i].y);
        ctx.lineTo(pts2[j].x, pts2[j].y);
        ctx.stroke();
      }
    }
    pts2.forEach(function(p) {
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(p.x, p.y, 2.5, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(34,211,238,.7)";
      ctx.fill();
    });
    ctx.restore();
  }

  var tick = 0;
  function frame() {
    if (!canvas || !canvas.parentElement) { RAF = null; return; }
    resizeCanvas();
    ctx.clearRect(0, 0, canvasCssW, canvasCssH);

    tick++;

    /* Spawn particles every few frames */
    if (tick % 2 === 0) {
      spawnParticle(SX + (Math.random()-0.5)*60, SY + (Math.random()-0.5)*60, "#22D3EE");
      spawnParticle(SX + (Math.random()-0.5)*60, SY + (Math.random()-0.5)*60, "#1E90FF");
    }
    EYES.forEach(function(e) {
      if (tick % 4 === 0) spawnParticle(e.x, e.y, e.color);
    });

    /* Spawn lightning bolts occasionally */
    if (tick % 18 === 0) {
      var angle = Math.random() * Math.PI * 2;
      var dist  = vx(160) + Math.random() * vx(80);
      spawnBolt(
        vx(SX), vy(SY),
        vx(SX) + Math.cos(angle) * dist,
        vy(SY) + Math.sin(angle) * dist,
        Math.random() > .5 ? "#22D3EE" : "#1E90FF", 1
      );
    }
    /* Arc to each eye */
    if (tick % 40 === 0) {
      EYES.forEach(function(e) {
        spawnBolt(vx(SX), vy(SY), vx(e.x), vy(e.y), e.color, 0);
      });
    }

    /* Shield pulse ring */
    var pulseR = ((tick * 1.8) % vx(130)) + vx(55);
    var pulseA = Math.max(0, .5 - pulseR / vx(140));
    ctx.save();
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(vx(SX), vy(SY), pulseR, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.strokeStyle = "rgba(34,211,238," + pulseA + ")";
    ctx.lineWidth = 2;
    ctx.shadowColor = "#22D3EE";
    ctx.shadowBlur = 10;
    ctx.stroke();
    ctx.restore();

    drawConstellation();

    /* Draw bolts */
    bolts = bolts.filter(function(b) { return b.life > 0; });
    bolts.forEach(function(b) { drawBolt(b); b.life -= b.decay; });

    /* Draw particles */
    particles = particles.filter(function(p) { return p.life > 0; });
    particles.forEach(function(p) {
      ctx.save();
      ctx.globalAlpha = p.life * .9;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(p.x, p.y, p.r * p.life, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.fillStyle = p.color;
      ctx.shadowColor = p.color;
      ctx.shadowBlur = 8;
      ctx.fill();
      ctx.restore();
      p.x += p.vx; p.y += p.vy;
      p.vx *= .96; p.vy *= .96;
      p.life -= p.decay;
    });

    RAF = requestAnimationFrame(frame);
  }

  function startAnim(ev) {
    if (ev && ev.cancelable) ev.preventDefault();
    if (hero) hero.classList.add("energy-active");
    resizeCanvas();
    if (RAF) return;
    particles = []; bolts = []; tick = 0;
    frame();
  }
  function stopAnim() {
    if (hero) hero.classList.remove("energy-active");
    if (RAF) { cancelAnimationFrame(RAF); RAF = null; }
    particles = []; bolts = [];
    if (ctx && canvas) ctx.clearRect(0, 0, canvasCssW || canvas.width, canvasCssH || canvas.height);
  }

  function init(heroEl) {
    hero = heroEl;
    svg  = hero.querySelector(".sentinel-raven-svg");
    canvas = document.getElementById("sentinel-energy-canvas");
    if (!canvas) {
      canvas = document.createElement("canvas");
      canvas.id = "sentinel-energy-canvas";
      hero.appendChild(canvas);
    }
    ctx = canvas.getContext("2d");
    resizeCanvas();
    hero.addEventListener("mouseenter", startAnim);
    hero.addEventListener("mouseleave", stopAnim);
    if (window.matchMedia && window.matchMedia("(hover: hover)").matches) {
      startAnim();
    }
    /* Touch support: passive:false prevents iOS text selection on labels */
    hero.addEventListener("touchstart", startAnim, { passive: false });
    hero.addEventListener("touchend",   stopAnim,  { passive: true });
    hero.addEventListener("touchcancel", stopAnim, { passive: true });
    window.addEventListener("resize", resizeCanvas, { passive: true });
  }

  /* Wait for React to render the sentinel section */
  function tryInit() {
    var h = document.querySelector(".sentinel-hero");
    if (h) { init(h); return; }
    var obs = new MutationObserver(function() {
      var h2 = document.querySelector(".sentinel-hero");
      if (h2) { obs.disconnect(); init(h2); }
    });
    obs.observe(document.body, { childList: true, subtree: true });
  }

  if (document.readyState === "loading") {
    document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", tryInit);
  } else {
    setTimeout(tryInit, 800);
  }
})();
</script>
</body>
</html>

}
.traceops-home-center * {
  -webkit-user-select: none;
  user-select: none;
  -webkit-touch-callout: none;
}
.traceops-home-center:hover .traceops-raven-emblem svg,
.traceops-home-center.energy-active .traceops-raven-emblem svg,
.traceops-home-center:hover .traceops-raven-emblem img,
.traceops-home-center.energy-active .traceops-raven-emblem img {
  animation: traceopsHomeSvgGlow .9s ease-in-out infinite alternate;
}
@keyframes traceopsHomeSvgGlow {
  from {
    filter: drop-shadow(0 0 6px rgba(47,134,255,.45)) drop-shadow(0 0 16px rgba(34,211,238,.28));
  }
  to {
    filter: drop-shadow(0 0 22px rgba(34,211,238,.88)) drop-shadow(0 0 44px rgba(47,134,255,.58)) drop-shadow(0 0 70px rgba(21,150,107,.28));
  }
}
#traceops-energy-canvas {
  position: absolute;
  inset: 0;
  pointer-events: none;
  z-index: 6;
  border-radius: 28px;
  opacity: 0;
  transition: opacity .25s ease;
}
.traceops-home-center:hover #traceops-energy-canvas,
.traceops-home-center.energy-active #traceops-energy-canvas {
  opacity: 1;
}
.traceops-home-center.energy-active .traceops-core-glow {
  animation-duration: 1s;
  filter: blur(10px) saturate(1.25);
}
</style>
<script id="traceops-energy-restore-script">
(function(){
  var RAF = null;
  var particles = [];
  var bolts = [];
  var canvas = null;
  var ctx = null;
  var center = null;
  var emblem = null;
  var canvasCssW = 0;
  var canvasCssH = 0;
  var touchTimer = null;

  var VW = 1536, VH = 1536;
  var SX = 768, SY = 740;
  var EYES = [
    { x: 279, y: 252, color: "#22D3EE" },
    { x: 1253, y: 250, color: "#24C3A2" }
  ];

  function vx(x) { return (x / VW) * canvasCssW; }
  function vy(y) { return (y / VH) * canvasCssH; }

  function resizeCanvas() {
    if (!canvas || !ctx || !center) return;
    var dpr = window.devicePixelRatio || 1;
    canvasCssW = center.offsetWidth || 1;
    canvasCssH = center.offsetHeight || 1;
    var nextW = Math.max(1, Math.floor(canvasCssW * dpr));
    var nextH = Math.max(1, Math.floor(canvasCssH * dpr));
    if (canvas.width !== nextW || canvas.height !== nextH) {
      canvas.width = nextW;
      canvas.height = nextH;
      canvas.style.width = canvasCssW + "px";
      canvas.style.height = canvasCssH + "px";
      ctx.setTransform(dpr, 0, 0, dpr, 0, 0);
    }
  }

  function spawnParticle(originX, originY, color, spread) {
    var angle = Math.random() * Math.PI * 2;
    var speed = 0.8 + Math.random() * 2.6;
    particles.push({
      x: vx(originX) + (Math.random() - 0.5) * (spread || 10),
      y: vy(originY) + (Math.random() - 0.5) * (spread || 10),
      vx: Math.cos(angle) * speed,
      vy: Math.sin(angle) * speed,
      life: 1,
      decay: 0.016 + Math.random() * 0.03,
      r: 1.2 + Math.random() * 3.2,
      color: color
    });
  }

  function spawnBolt(x1, y1, x2, y2, color, forks) {
    bolts.push({ x1:x1, y1:y1, x2:x2, y2:y2, color:color, forks:forks || 0, life:1, decay:.055 + Math.random() * .02 });
  }

  function drawBolt(b) {
    var segs = 7;
    var pts = [{ x: b.x1, y: b.y1 }];
    var dx = (b.x2 - b.x1) / segs;
    var dy = (b.y2 - b.y1) / segs;
    for (var i = 1; i < segs; i++) {
      pts.push({
        x: b.x1 + dx * i + (Math.random() - 0.5) * 24,
        y: b.y1 + dy * i + (Math.random() - 0.5) * 24
      });
    }
    pts.push({ x: b.x2, y: b.y2 });

    ctx.save();
    ctx.globalAlpha = b.life * 0.92;
    ctx.strokeStyle = b.color;
    ctx.lineWidth = 1.6 + b.life * 1.6;
    ctx.shadowColor = b.color;
    ctx.shadowBlur = 14;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(pts[0].x, pts[0].y);
    for (var j = 1; j < pts.length; j++) ctx.lineTo(pts[j].x, pts[j].y);
    ctx.stroke();
    ctx.restore();

    if (b.forks > 0 && Math.random() > 0.55) {
      var mid = pts[Math.floor(pts.length / 2)];
      var fa = Math.random() * Math.PI * 2;
      var fl = 18 + Math.random() * 38;
      spawnBolt(mid.x, mid.y, mid.x + Math.cos(fa) * fl, mid.y + Math.sin(fa) * fl, b.color, 0);
    }
  }

  function drawConstellation() {
    var cx = vx(SX), cy = vy(SY);
    var r = Math.min(canvasCssW, canvasCssH) * 0.18 + Math.sin(Date.now() / 380) * 5;
    var n = 8;
    var pts = [];
    for (var i = 0; i < n; i++) {
      var a = (i / n) * Math.PI * 2 - Math.PI / 2;
      pts.push({ x: cx + Math.cos(a) * r, y: cy + Math.sin(a) * r });
    }
    ctx.save();
    ctx.strokeStyle = "rgba(34,211,238,.26)";
    ctx.lineWidth = .8;
    for (var k = 0; k < n; k++) {
      var next = (k + 2) % n;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(pts[k].x, pts[k].y);
      ctx.lineTo(pts[next].x, pts[next].y);
      ctx.stroke();
    }
    pts.forEach(function(p, idx) {
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(p.x, p.y, 2.4, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.fillStyle = idx % 2 ? "rgba(36,195,162,.74)" : "rgba(34,211,238,.74)";
      ctx.fill();
    });
    ctx.restore();
  }

  var tick = 0;
  function frame() {
    if (!canvas || !canvas.parentElement || !ctx) { RAF = null; return; }
    resizeCanvas();
    ctx.clearRect(0, 0, canvasCssW, canvasCssH);
    tick++;

    if (tick % 2 === 0) {
      spawnParticle(SX, SY, "#22D3EE", 34);
      spawnParticle(SX, SY, "#1E90FF", 34);
      spawnParticle(SX, SY, "#24C3A2", 26);
    }
    EYES.forEach(function(e, idx) {
      if (tick % 3 === 0) spawnParticle(e.x, e.y, e.color, 12);
      if (tick % 22 === 0) {
        var rayAngle = idx === 0 ? Math.PI + (Math.random() - 0.5) * .8 : (Math.random() - 0.5) * .8;
        var rayDist = 42 + Math.random() * 36;
        spawnBolt(vx(e.x), vy(e.y), vx(e.x) + Math.cos(rayAngle) * rayDist, vy(e.y) + Math.sin(rayAngle) * rayDist, e.color, 1);
      }
    });

    if (tick % 16 === 0) {
      EYES.forEach(function(e) {
        spawnBolt(vx(SX), vy(SY), vx(e.x), vy(e.y), e.color, 1);
      });
    }
    if (tick % 18 === 0) {
      var angle = Math.random() * Math.PI * 2;
      var dist = Math.min(canvasCssW, canvasCssH) * (0.18 + Math.random() * 0.14);
      spawnBolt(vx(SX), vy(SY), vx(SX) + Math.cos(angle) * dist, vy(SY) + Math.sin(angle) * dist, Math.random() > .5 ? "#22D3EE" : "#1E90FF", 1);
    }

    var pulseR = ((tick * 1.7) % (Math.min(canvasCssW, canvasCssH) * 0.19)) + Math.min(canvasCssW, canvasCssH) * 0.10;
    var pulseA = Math.max(0, .50 - pulseR / (Math.min(canvasCssW, canvasCssH) * 0.28));
    ctx.save();
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(vx(SX), vy(SY), pulseR, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.strokeStyle = "rgba(34,211,238," + pulseA + ")";
    ctx.lineWidth = 2;
    ctx.shadowColor = "#22D3EE";
    ctx.shadowBlur = 12;
    ctx.stroke();
    ctx.restore();

    drawConstellation();

    bolts = bolts.filter(function(b){ return b.life > 0; });
    bolts.forEach(function(b){ drawBolt(b); b.life -= b.decay; });

    particles = particles.filter(function(p){ return p.life > 0; });
    particles.forEach(function(p){
      ctx.save();
      ctx.globalAlpha = p.life * .92;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(p.x, p.y, p.r * p.life, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.fillStyle = p.color;
      ctx.shadowColor = p.color;
      ctx.shadowBlur = 9;
      ctx.fill();
      ctx.restore();
      p.x += p.vx;
      p.y += p.vy;
      p.vx *= .965;
      p.vy *= .965;
      p.life -= p.decay;
    });

    RAF = requestAnimationFrame(frame);
  }

  function startAnim(ev) {
    if (ev && ev.cancelable) ev.preventDefault();
    if (!center) return;
    center.classList.add("energy-active");
    resizeCanvas();
    if (RAF) return;
    particles = [];
    bolts = [];
    tick = 0;
    frame();
  }

  function stopAnim() {
    if (touchTimer) {
      clearTimeout(touchTimer);
      touchTimer = null;
    }
    if (center) center.classList.remove("energy-active");
    if (RAF) {
      cancelAnimationFrame(RAF);
      RAF = null;
    }
    particles = [];
    bolts = [];
    if (ctx && canvas) ctx.clearRect(0, 0, canvasCssW || canvas.width, canvasCssH || canvas.height);
  }

  function touchStart(ev) {
    startAnim(ev);
    if (touchTimer) clearTimeout(touchTimer);
    touchTimer = setTimeout(stopAnim, 2400);
  }

  function init(el) {
    center = el;
    emblem = center.querySelector(".traceops-raven-emblem img, .traceops-raven-emblem svg");
    if (!emblem) return;
    canvas = document.getElementById("traceops-energy-canvas");
    if (!canvas) {
      canvas = document.createElement("canvas");
      canvas.id = "traceops-energy-canvas";
      center.appendChild(canvas);
    }
    ctx = canvas.getContext("2d");
    resizeCanvas();
    center.addEventListener("mouseenter", startAnim);
    center.addEventListener("mouseleave", stopAnim);
    center.addEventListener("touchstart", touchStart, { passive: false });
    center.addEventListener("touchend", function(){}, { passive: true });
    center.addEventListener("touchcancel", stopAnim, { passive: true });
    center.addEventListener("click", function(){
      if (center.classList.contains("energy-active")) stopAnim();
      else {
        startAnim();
        if (touchTimer) clearTimeout(touchTimer);
        touchTimer = setTimeout(stopAnim, 2400);
      }
    });
    window.addEventListener("resize", resizeCanvas, { passive: true });
  }

  function tryInit() {
    var el = document.querySelector(".traceops-home-center");
    if (el) {
      init(el);
      return;
    }
    var obs = new MutationObserver(function(){
      var node = document.querySelector(".traceops-home-center");
      if (node) {
        obs.disconnect();
        init(node);
      }
    });
    obs.observe(document.body, { childList: true, subtree: true });
  }

  if (document.readyState === "loading") {
    document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", tryInit);
  } else {
    setTimeout(tryInit, 300);
  }
})();
</script>

<script id="traceops-real-emblem-replace">
(function(){
  var TRACEOPS_EMBLEM_DATA_URI = "data:image/png;base64,";
  function injectRealEmblem(){
    var wrap = document.querySelector('.traceops-raven-emblem');
    if(!wrap) return false;
    var existing = wrap.querySelector('img.traceops-real-emblem-img');
    if(existing && existing.getAttribute('src') === TRACEOPS_EMBLEM_DATA_URI) return true;
    wrap.innerHTML = '';
    wrap.dataset.realEmblemApplied = '1';
    var img = document.createElement('img');
    img.className = 'traceops-real-emblem-img';
    img.src = TRACEOPS_EMBLEM_DATA_URI;
    img.alt = 'TraceOps Sentinel shield';
    img.decoding = 'async';
    img.loading = 'eager';
    img.style.width = '100%';
    img.style.height = '100%';
    img.style.objectFit = 'contain';
    img.style.display = 'block';
    img.style.filter = 'drop-shadow(0 24px 38px rgba(16,42,67,.18))';
    wrap.appendChild(img);
    return true;
  }
  function scheduleRetries(){ [0,50,150,350,800,1500,3000].forEach(function(ms){ setTimeout(injectRealEmblem, ms); }); }
  if(document.readyState === 'loading'){ document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', scheduleRetries); } else { scheduleRetries(); }
  var obs = new MutationObserver(function(){ injectRealEmblem(); });
  function startObs(){ if(document.body) obs.observe(document.body, {childList:true, subtree:true}); }
  if(document.body) startObs(); else document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', startObs);
})();
</script>
